tagline: India's largest hackathon conducted on the beachside.
desc:
**BeachHack** is the flagship event of the **Department of Computer Science and Engineering**, a legacy event hosted by the **Community Of Developers (CODe)** from **Christ College of Engineering, Irinjalakuda**.

It is a national-level hackathon that dares to be different-held not in classrooms or auditoriums, but at a beach resort right beside the shoreline, where creativity flows as freely as the waves. Returning for another season of innovation, **BeachHack 7** invites developers, designers, and entrepreneurs to collaborate, create, and conquer under the open sky. This isn’t just a coding competition; it’s a **36-hour celebration of technology, creativity, and community spirit.**

This year, we are thrilled to present the **7th edition of Beach Hack**, proudly celebrated as **India’s one and only beachside hackathon**.

We offer a **prize pool of ₹2 lakhs**, with two competitive tracks:

* **Hack4Christ** – exclusively for students of Christ College of Engineering *(₹50,000 prize pool)*
* **Beach Hack** – for participants from other colleges *(₹1,00,000 prize pool)*

# **Why BeachHack?**
🌴 **The Only Beach Hackathon:** Experience the unique thrill of debugging with a sea breeze.
🚀 **Legacy of Excellence:** Organized by the face of the CSE Department at CCE, adhering to a tradition of quality and student-centric events.
🤝 **Networking & Mentorship:** Connect with industry experts, like-minded peers, and tech leaders in an informal, high-energy setting.
🏆 **200K+ :** Compete for substantial cash prizes and exclusive swag.
🎟 **Zero Registration Fee:** Innovation should have no barriers. Admission is completely free.

# **Format:**
Team Size: 4 Members
Duration: 36 Hours
Selection: Abstract-based shortlisting 
***Problem Statements** will be released **after the first phase** of the Beach Hack.*

# **Event Structure - Hack4Christ**
*Exclusive for **students of Christ College of Engineering**.*
**Phase 1 ‐ Screening**
* Jan 1‐3: Screening for 2nd, 3rd & 4th year students
* Jan 17‐19: Screening for 1st year students
*Top performing teams will be shortlisted for the hackathon.*

**Phase 2 ‐ Hackathon**
* Jan 30 ‐ Feb 1: Shortlisted teams will take part in a 36‐hour beachside coding marathon, building solutions under the stars.

# **Event Structure - Beach Hack**
*Exclusive for **external participants** of Beach Hack.*
**Phase 1 ‐ Screening**
* Jan 14‐16: Screening for external participants of Beach Hack.
*Top performing teams will be shortlisted for the hackathon.*

**Phase 2 ‐ Hackathon**
* Jan 30 ‐ Feb 1: Shortlisted teams will take part in a 36‐hour beachside coding marathon, building solutions under the stars.

# **Domains:**
* **AI Pipelines & MLOps Orchestration**
The track focuses on the engineering layer behind AI - pipelines, automation, monitoring, reliability, and optimization. Participants are expected to deliver solutions that enhance the scalability, trustworthiness, and operational robustness of modern AI systems.
* **Web3 Infrastructure & On-Chain Forensics**
A deep dive into the structural and analytical components of blockchain ecosystems. This track emphasizes transparency, secure infrastructure development, cross-chain operability, and identity management in decentralized systems.
* **Cloud-Native & DevOps Intelligence**
Here we look for innovations that elevate cloud efficiency and system intelligence. From infrastructure observability to automated optimization, the focus is on systems that improve performance, reduce overhead, and strengthen cloud-native workflows.
* **Cybersecurity & Threat Intelligence**
The track expects participants to push the boundaries of digital security. Emphasis is on identifying vulnerabilities, strengthening security posture, analyzing threat patterns, and building systems capable of proactive protection.
* **Algorithmic FinTech & RegTech**
Centered around the data and compliance backbone of financial technology. Participants will work on intelligent systems that enhance regulatory accuracy, financial transparency, risk assessment, and backend financial automation.
* **Defense Tech & Situational Awareness**
Participants explore technologies that improve monitoring, decision-making, and secure communication in defense contexts. The focus is on awareness, precision, and reliability in mission-critical environments.
* **Industrial IoT & Predictive Maintenance**
The track spotlights innovations in connected industrial environments. You are expected to engineer systems that enhance operational intelligence, minimize downtime, and refine the interaction between machines, sensors, and data.
* **Health Data Systems & Bio-Informatics**
The focus here is responsible handling of complex medical data, intelligent diagnostic workflows, and secure bio-information processing. Participants are expected to elevate healthcare systems through accuracy, security, and computational insight.
* **Open Innovation**
Build any impactful solution by identifying a real-world problem of your choice. We value originality, strong problem-solution fit, technical depth, and real-world relevance over predefined themes. (**Hack4Christ Exclusive**)


**Beach Hack isn’t just an event.
It’s a movement of ideas, collaboration, passion, and engineering excellence.**

🔗 Learn more: [https://www.beachhack.in/](https://www.beachhack.in/)

Hackcelerate’26 is a national-level offline hackathon where students from across the country collaborate to build impactful and technology-driven solutions. Participants will have **24 hours** to conceptualize, prototype, and present innovative solutions addressing real-world challenges.

This hackathon is designed to encourage innovation, teamwork, problem-solving, and practical implementation.

## Important Note
- Every team member must submit the **same idea and the same PPT**.
- Submissions must strictly follow the [Hackcelerate’26 PPT template](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1_M0sUzz2M1ZkbeE3S3iKeJKvisG6fMGS5QLlGTZ3_qA/edit?usp=sharing)

- Upload the PPT in PDF format.
- Only teams with valid submissions will be considered for shortlisting.

**Submission Deadline:** January 15th, 2026

---

## Eligibility Criteria
1. Submissions must follow the official PPT template.
2. Team size must be **2 to 4 members**.
3. Each participant must submit the same idea as part of a team.
4. Participants must be current UG students.  
   Members may be from different colleges.

---

## Submission Rules
- Round 1 will be conducted entirely online.
- Participants may select any problem statement under approved domains on our website.
- Shortlisted teams must RSVP within **48 hours** of the announcement.  
  Failure to RSVP will lead to disqualification.
- Only RSVP-confirmed teams will be eligible for Round 2.

---

## Round 2: Offline Hackathon (January 30–31)
- The hackathon duration is **24 hours**.
- Internet connectivity and power supply will be provided.
- Core development must take place **during the hackathon window**.
- Participants may research and plan beforehand, but **no pre-built projects or reused code** will be allowed without disclosure.
- Any violation may result in disqualification.

---

## Judging Criteria
Projects will be evaluated by a panel of external judges, domain experts, and sponsor representatives based on:

- Innovation
- Technical Implementation
- Impact and Usefulness
- Feasibility and Scalability
- Presentation and Demonstration

The decision of the jury will be final.

---

## Participation Policy
- Team changes or reshuffling will **not** be allowed after submission.
- Only complete and rule-compliant submissions will be considered.

---

Hackcelerate’26 is an opportunity to create meaningful solutions, learn through collaboration, and bring ideas to life.  
We look forward to your participation.

# HackJNU 4.0 @ School of Engineering, Jawaharlal Nehru University

HackJNU 4.0 is the annual flagship hackathon of the School of Engineering, Jawaharlal Nehru University. This 30+hour on-site event brings together skilled student innovators from across India to design and develop technically rigorous solutions to contemporary real-world challenges. In an environment inspired by the ethos of the *Matrix*, where perception meets possibility, participants will immerse themselves in focused creation, systems thinking, and technological problem-solving.
****
## Key Features
- 30 hours of continuous development cycle  
- Open to undergraduate students; teams of up to four members  
- No registration fee  
- Themes provided by the organising committee (*not restricted to the above themes only)  
- Mentorship from industry professionals and academic experts

View [our brochure](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1oGpgXiYGON3i4OczueZ2LmiedAMq-UzF/view?usp=sharing) for eligibility and other details.

## Team Formation Details
- Minimum team size should be 2 and upto 4 members, otherwise you will be disqualified. 
- The team leader should ensure all members are added before submission via the referral code at the top of the registration page.
- All participants should be currently enrolled students in a regular course across any institute in India.

****
## Hackathon Structure
**Round 1: Online Idea Submission**  
Teams must submit a max 8-slide presentation outlining the problem statement, proposed solution, feasibility, and innovation. 
Shortlisted teams advance to the offline round.

**Round 2: Initial Evaluation (Offline)**  
Teams present preliminary progress and clarity of approach on Day 1.

**Round 3: Final Build and Presentation (Offline)**  
Participants complete their prototype and deliver the final presentation on Day 2.  
*All work must be developed exclusively during the hackathon duration.*

****
## Judging Criteria
Projects will be evaluated based on:  
- Innovation and novelty
- Impact and relevance  
- Feasibility and practicality  
- Technical depth  
- Design and user experience  
- Clarity and effectiveness of presentation  
****
## Code of Conduct
HackJNU 4.0 adheres to a strict professional and ethical standard. Plagiarism, harassment, misconduct, or any form of unauthorised technological exploitation will result in immediate disqualification. Participants are expected to maintain a respectful, collaborative, and academically honest environment throughout the event.
****
## Event Details
**Dates:** 30–31 January 2026 
**Venue:** Convention Centre and Engineering Lecture Complex, JNU  
**Duration:** 30 hours (9:00 AM on 30 January to 3:00 PM on 31 January)

name: ANVESHANA NATIONAL LEVEL PROTOTYPE COMPETITION
desc:
The Anveshana National Level Prototype Competition 2026, a National Level Innovation Challenge, is hosted by the Institution’s Innovation Council of BMSIT&M (IIC BMSIT&M) and  BMS Innovation Centre and Entrepreneurship Park (BICEP) at BMS Institute of Technology and Management (BMSIT&M), Bengaluru. This event aims to inspire innovative ideas, foster entrepreneurial spirit, and provide a platform for innovators to transform their concepts into tangible solutions. Industrial experts will evaluate the projects, and the best-performing teams will win attractive prizes.

**Eligibility Protocol:**
*Open To:* Students, faculty members, and research scholars associated with any recognized institution in India.

**Team Composition:**
*Size:* Minimum 1 member, Maximum 4 members.
*Formation Rule:* Teams may consist of any combination of individuals (students, faculty, or mixed) provided that all members belong to the same institution/organization.
*Strict Prohibition:* Cross-institutional teams are not allowed. A participant can be part of only one team.

**Registration Guidelines:**
*Method:* Online submission via the Unstop platform.
Submission Limit: Exactly one registration per team.
*Procedure:*
The Team Leader registers the team.
Team members are added by the Leader after the initial registration.
*Teammate Finding:* Applicants seeking members may use the designated teammates_finder group.
*Compliance: *Incomplete data or missed deadlines result in automatic disqualification.

**Competition Tracks:**
Teams must identify with one of the following 7 domain tracks. Track Prizes are awarded based on these categories:

*Health, Life and Human Safety
-Energy, Climate & Environmental Systems
-Mobility, Infrastructure & Built Environment
-Industry, Manufacturing & Automation
-Digital, Economic & Information Systems
-Agriculture, Food & Biological Production Systems
-Open Innovation*

**Competition Roadmap & Elimination:**
This competition operates on a funnel system. Decisions made by the evaluators at every stage are final and binding.

***Phase 1:*** PPT Submission 
    *Requirement:* Submission of a PowerPoint Presentation (PPT).
    *Constraint:* Maximum of 7 slides.
    *Mandatory Content:* The PPT must cover exactly these 6 points:
        -Problem & Evidence
        -Proposed Solution & Differentiation
        -System Architecture / Design
        -Prototype Status
        -Feasibility, Cost & Impact
        -Execution Plan
*Assessment:* Evaluated by domain experts based on content quality and adherence to the structure above.
Outcome: Qualification or Elimination. (No prizes awarded in this round).

***Phase 2:*** Virtual Presentation (Semi-Finals)
    *Selection: *Approximately 100 teams advance from Phase 1.
    *Activity:* Virtual presentation of the idea.
    *Liability:* Teams bear 100% responsibility for network stability and device reliability.
    *Consequence:* Network interruptions or technical failures during the slot may lead to disqualification.
    *Outcome:* Top 50 teams are shortlisted for the Final Round.

***Phase 3:*** Prototype Competition (Finals)
*Location:* On-campus at BMSIT&M, Bengaluru.
*Activity:* Physical demonstration of the functional prototype.
*Assessment:* Jury evaluation and Prototype Exhibition(Parallel sessions).
*Criteria:* Innovation, Functionality, and Presentation.

**Evaluation Metrics:**
Entries will be judged strictly on the following parameters:

*Innovation:* Originality and relevance of the core idea.
*Technical Feasibility:* Practicality and potential for real-world implementation.
*Impact Potential:* Value addition to society or specific target users.
*Presentation:* Clarity, persuasiveness, and communication skills.

**Zero-Tolerance Policies:**
*Disqualification: *Any deviation from the guidelines (e.g., exceeding slide limits), late reporting, or incomplete submissions leads to immediate disqualification.
*Liability:* BMSIT&M is not responsible for technical glitches on the participant's end during virtual rounds or inconveniences caused by non-compliance with rules.
*Final Authority: *The decisions of the evaluators and the jury are absolute and cannot be challenged.

desc:
PayLoad is a fintech hackathon focused on building practical, innovative solutions for real-world financial problems. The event brings together developers, designers, and finance enthusiasts to collaborate, prototype, and present impactful fintech ideas using technologies like AI, blockchain, machine learning, and game development.

# Eligibility

1. Open to all B.Tech, BCA, MCA and BSc(CS) students interested in finance, technology, design, and innovation
2. Beginner-friendly track available (Freshers Only)
3. Inter-college teams: Allowed
4. Inter-specialization teams: Allowed

# Team Formation 

Participants must form teams of 1–4 members.
Solo participation is also allowed.

# Competition Format 

The competition will be conducted in two rounds:

**Round 1: Pitch Deck Submission (Online)**

Teams are required to submit a Pitch Deck (5–7 slides) covering the following:

1. Team & Track Selection and Challenges Addressed
2. Proposed Solution - Overview of the solution and how it addresses the identified problem 
3. Innovation & Uniqueness
4. Technology Stack & Architecture
5. Demo & Implementation - GitHub repository link
Prototype / YouTube demo video link (if any)
6. Impact & Future Scope (Optional)

**Round 2: Final Pitch & Demonstration (Offline)**

The final round will be conducted at NSUT, Dwarka.
Top 8 teams per problem statement will be shortlisted.
Shortlisted teams will present and demonstrate their projects before the judges.
Evaluation will focus on functionality and potential impact.

# Problem Statements

Participants must choose one problem statement:
1. OnChain Rewards – Blockchain
2. Off-Road Semantic Scene Segmentation - Computer Vision
3. Hostel Life Utility Manager – UI/UX Beginner Track (Freshers Only)
4. Financial Games & Finopoly – Game Development
5. Quantifying the Markets – Machine Learning
6. Open Innovation

# Rules 

1. Teams must submit a pitch deck containing project repository link and supporting documentation (if any).
2. PPT submission is mandatory.
3. Only shortlisted teams will advance to the final round.

👉 For detailed explanations of individual problem statements and tracks, click here - [Payload - Problem Statements.pdf](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1cRE188knKfg_NXqlkD_TOKrST2MOPyF4/view?usp=sharing)

name: WinterSpark
desc:
# ❄ WinterSpark – Deploy Your Career

Step into a winter experience where your projects break free from localhost and launch confidently into the cloud.  
Organized collaboratively by **GDG • DDU** and **CSI • DDU**, **WinterSpark** is a focused two-day journey designed to transform developers from code creators into cloud-ready engineers.

This is not just another workshop. WinterSpark marks a new chapter in empowering the tech community with real-world deployment skills, industry-level AWS practices, and the mindset needed to ship production-ready solutions. Here, every participant becomes an architect of impact elevating their projects from local machines to secure, scalable, global cloud platforms.

---

## 🔥 What Awaits You?

Across two immersive days of learning, experimentation, and cloud-powered breakthroughs, you will:

### **Core Deployment & Cloud Fundamentals**
- Understand the modern deployment landscape: static hosting, CI/CD, serverless workflows, containerized workloads, and more.
- Learn how real engineering teams take a project from development to live production.

### **Hands-On AWS Mastery**
- Explore **Core AWS Services** essential for any cloud engineer.
- Get introduced to **must-know AWS tools** used in modern development environments.
- Deploy your own application live on AWS through instructor-led sessions.
- Build a strong foundation in cloud configurations and service integrations.

### **Real Industry Use Cases**
- Host and deliver a production-grade website using **Amazon S3 + CloudFront**.
- Understand how AWS underpins the global AI acceleration scaling models, workloads, and distributed systems.
- Explore **high-level architectural insights** from industry leaders like **Netflix**, understanding how AWS services power massive-scale systems.

### **Career Acceleration**
- Get guidance on AWS certifications, role pathways, skill roadmaps, and how to stand out in cloud-driven careers.
- Learn practical DevOps workflows and deployment techniques used by top engineering teams across the world.

Because deployment is what transforms a project into a product.

---

## 🎯 Who Is This For?

WinterSpark is built for:

- **Beginners** taking their first step beyond localhost  
- **Builders and innovators** who want their work to be scalable and production-ready  

If you're ready to elevate your engineering journey, this is your launchpad.

---

## ❄ Join Us

Pack your laptops, fire up your terminals, and prepare to ignite your cloud journey this winter.

**Dates:** December 20–21, 2025  
**Location:** DDU, Nadiad

name: Hack For Nothing
desc:
Hack for Nothing is a hackathon for ideas that should not exist, but now that they do, you cannot stop thinking about them. There are no problem statements, no pitch decks, and no expectation that this turns into a startup. The only valid reason to build something here is “technically, this is possible.”

This is a throwback to how hackathons used to be. Before demos became investor auditions. Before every project needed a market, a narrative, and a monetization slide. Back when cracked engineers stayed up too late, wired together strange systems, and learned more by building something cursed than by polishing something sensible.

### What we’re looking for

- Projects that are useless on paper but fascinating in execution  
- Systems that react to humans instead of helping them  
- Ideas that make people laugh first and then ask “wait… how did you even build this?”

### Example energy

- A doorbell that, when pressed, triggers a physical hand to knock on the door instead of ringing  
- A speaker that listens to conversations and randomly plays a dramatic background score when it senses tension, even if the topic is trivial  
- A browser extension that publicly tweets every website you visit and everything you type, in real time, no filters

Build something random, invasive, over engineered, and slightly unhinged.  
If your demo makes people uncomfortable but impressed, you’re doing it right.

desc:
Join builders from across Indonesia to create the next wave of industry-defining onchain applications.
###
The **Base Indonesia Hackathon 2025** (Dec 10, 2025 – Jan 31, 2026) is a hackathon designed to help teams turn ideas into real, functional onchain products—and accelerate Indonesia’s Web3 ecosystem.
###
Hosted and operated by **BlockDevId**, supported by **Base**, **IDRX** & **Thetanuts Finance**, this hackathon gives teams the resources, guidance, and momentum needed to build and ship.
###
****
###

**Overview**
###
This hackathon brings together Indonesia’s strongest Web3 builders to create impactful applications on Base. Over the course of several weeks, teams receive mentorship, technical support, ecosystem connections, and the opportunity to pitch live for **6,000 USDC** in prizes.
###
**Mission:**
Build real onchain products that solve real problems—and push Indonesia’s onchain future forward.
###

****
###

**Challenge Tracks**
###
Participants will build solutions under two innovation tracks, each supporting different onchain use cases.
Your project must be functional and deployed on Base.

###

**🟦 Base Track**

Build a Base Mini-App that elevates the onchain user experience.
Solve meaningful UX challenges:
- Complex DeFi processes
- Lack of social coordination
- Poor onboarding
- Limited accessibility for retail users

Leverage:
- Base L2 (fast, secure, low-cost)
- OnchainKit (plug-and-play UX)
- Base SDKs & tools

**Integrate IDRX to be eligible for the Best Project (IDRX) bonus prize.**

###
###

**🟩 Thetanuts Track**

Build a Thetanuts-powered DeFi application that makes options simple, accessible, and engaging for everyday users.

Focus on:
- Gamified and intuitive UI
- AI-powered onboarding
- Personalized strategy guidance
- Campaign-driven engagement loops (missions, streaks, instant rewards)

Use Thetanuts Finance infrastructure to deliver a retail-friendly onchain DeFi experience.
###

****
###

**Who Should Join**
###
This hackathon is for:
- Indonesian Web3 builders & startup teams (1–5 members)
- Teams with a working MVP or prototype
- Projects deployed or ready to deploy on Base
- Teams preparing for GTM or early growth
- Builders who want to ship something real—not just ideate
###

****
###

**Why Join?**
###
🏆 Total Prize Pool: 6,000 USDC
- Base Track: 2,500 USDC + 500 USDC (Best Project IDRX)
- Thetanuts Track: 3,000 USDC

Sponsored by Base, IDRX, and Thetanuts Finance.
###
🤝 Mentorship & Visibility
- Mentorship from Base Indonesia & partners
- Featured across Base Indonesia and partner channels
- Warm introductions to partners & accelerator programs
###
🛠️ Technical Support
- DevRel support throughout the hackathon
- Guided onboarding into the Base ecosystem (SDKs, tools, best practices)
###

****
###

**Opportunity: Network School Residency**
###
Beyond prizes, select high-performing teams may be nominated by the Base Team for a 1-month Network School Residency—a global builder program designed to accelerate exceptional onchain projects.
###
**Please note:**
###
- Hackathon winners are not guaranteed residency selection
- Selection is made solely by the Base Team, based on project quality and team execution
- Time slots depend on Network School’s scheduling availability
- All decisions are final and non-negotiable
###
This is an exclusive opportunity for standout teams to receive deeper mentorship, ecosystem access, and acceleration beyond the hackathon.
###

****
###

**Event Structure & Timeline**

###

**📍 Registration & Submission Open**
10 December 2025 — 31 January 2026
Submit all materials through Devfolio.
###

**⏳ Midpoint Submission**
12 January 2026
###

**📣 Shortlisted Finalist Announcement**
4 February 2026
###

**🏁 Final Day — Live Pitching (Offline)**
7 February 2026, in Jakarta (Venue TBA)
Shortlisted teams will pitch live; winners announced on the same day.
###

****
###

**Submission Requirements**
###
To qualify, your submission must include:
- One project per track per team
- Functional MVP or demo already deployed on Base
- Public GitHub repository
- Demo video (≥1 minute: intro → problem → solution → demo)
- Proof of deployment on Base
- Roadmap & detailed team information
###
****
###
**Evaluation Criteria**
###
Judges will evaluate based on:
###
✔ Product Readiness
A real, working MVP—not ideation.
###
✔ Technical Execution
Depth of Base integration, smart contracts, and implementation.
###
✔ Market Fit & GTM
Target users, adoption strategy, and growth potential.
###
✔ Ecosystem Impact
Contribution to Base ecosystem and user growth.
###
✔ Team Capability
Execution strength, speed, and ability to iterate.

###
****
###

**Summary**
###
- Hackathon runs Dec 10, 2025 – Jan 31, 2026, with the Final Day on Feb 7, 2026 (offline in Jakarta, venue TBA)

- Two tracks: Base Track and Thetanuts Track

- Total prize pool: 6,000 USDC

- All submissions must be functional, deployed on Base, and include a public GitHub repository

- 10 finalists will present their projects live on Final Day in Jakarta

- Standout teams may be nominated for a Network School Residency (exclusive, not guaranteed)

name: Awesome Hackathon 2.0
desc:
In 2016, **NPCI** launched the **UPI** payments network which took off like a rocket ship; in May 2020, UPI was used by almost **100 million** people, with a total transaction volume of ~**1.25 billion** (greater than American Express globally).



It is now time for the launch of the Account Aggregator (AA) framework. From this month onwards, some of the nation's biggest and most esteemed banks will go live on the AA network.

There is no better time for developers, startups, and engaged citizens to learn more about the potential of this system and to start building on top of it.

For this reason, India's first Account Aggregator Hackathon is being announced - a **4-week** virtual event hosted in partnership with Devfolio.

A link to the official announcement can be found [here](https://sahamati.org.in/blog/first-account-aggregator-hackathon/).

## Hackathon Themes

- **Consent Management UI/UX**: This theme deals with designing informed consent journeys for users of Account Aggregators. How can the consent flow for users be made more accessible, understandable, and secure? Can you design consent flows for low-literacy users? Feature phone users? What does a consent authorization chain look like for SMEs and enterprises? Is there a certain design language or iconography that can make the consent experience better for users?
- **Security and Middleware**: Once a customer's data has been shared with an FIU, how can the customer gain confidence that the data will be deleted after the consent period expires? How can it be made easier for banks and other FIUs to adopt the AA framework? Can we develop secure environments for lenders to extract insights from user data without revealing the data itself? How can consent fraud be minimized? How can interoperability and user onboarding be enhanced?
- **FIU Use Cases**: What useful applications can be built with a user's financial data? Personal finance managers? Expense trackers? Robo-advisors? How about tools for underwriting? Or data enrichment?
- **AI/ML**: Thanks to the AA framework, app developers will have a much easier time getting access to high-fidelity customer financial data (with consent, of course). How can you use this data to give value to the customer?
Personalized expense managers and savings recommendations engines? Individualized consumer spending models? Underwriting models? What insights would you generate if you could convince users to share their spending and investment data with you?

name: ETHIndiaVilla
tagline: A new format. A closer circle. The same drive to build what comes next.
desc:
## A New Beginning for ETHIndia

ETHIndia has always been a home for ambitious builders. Over the years we have watched thousands gather, collide, and create in one shared space. BlockTrain reminded us that smaller, sharper formats can unlock a different kind of momentum. For 2025, we are continuing that experimental spirit and shaping an edition built around focus and depth.

## A Shift in Format

This year brings a couple dozen of India’s strongest Ethereum builders into the ETHIndiaVilla. It is a setting built for clarity, immersion, and genuine collaboration. Builders and experts share the same environment, the same energy, and the same creative spark. The usual separation between teams and mentors gives way to building together in the same trenches.

## What Makes This Edition Special

Teams will stay small and intentional. Each group will have three or four members, including one Super Hacker. These are the mentors and judges from past editions, now joining the action as teammates. You can apply as a team of three or apply solo and join a squad. No one builds alone. Every idea is shaped through shared thinking.

## The Journey

The experience begins online, where selected builders meet for a virtual kickoff on **November 28**. The first ideas are shaped across two days of remote hacking on **November 28 and 29**. Once the groundwork is set, everyone arrives in Bengaluru for the ETHIndiaVilla from **November 30 to December 1**. The shift from virtual momentum to the intensity of the villa sets the rhythm for the final sprint.

## The Schedule

- **Virtual kickoff:** November 28
- **Online hacking:** November 28 and 29 
- **ETHIndiaVilla in Bengaluru:** November 30 to December 1

Kenya's forests are under threat - we lose over 200,000 acres to deforestation every single year - and traditional response systems aren't keeping pace. 


As an innovator, you have the power to build solutions that can detect illegal logging in real-time, track conservation impact with precision, and educate communities in ways never before possible.


We are commemorating 20 years since Prof. Wangari Maathai received the Nobel Peace Prize and this hackathon is a powerful opportunity to honour her enduring legacy and carry forward her vision for a greener, more peaceful, equitable and just world.


Be a hummingbird, join the movement.

-----------------------------------------

There are 3 hackathon tracks you can participate in:
Yes, there are 3 hackathon tracks:

**Track 1: Localized Forest Watch & Monitoring**
**The Challenge:**
Build real-time forest monitoring systems to detect environmental threats as they happen.

**What You'll Build:**

Satellite data integration for forest change detection
Anonymous reporting systems using blockchain technology
Ground-truth validation through IoT sensors
Real-time alert systems for rapid response

**Tech Stack**
Satellite APIs, GIS tools, mobile frameworks, blockchain, IoT sensors


**Track 2: Data-Driven Impact Measurement**

**The Challenge:**
Create comprehensive systems to track, analyze, and showcase conservation impact.

**What You'll Build:**

Tree survival rate tracking systems
Interactive M&E dashboards for stakeholders
Nursery mapping with species and capacity data
Biodiversity visualization tools
AI-powered impact prediction models

**Tech Stack:**
Data visualization libraries, mobile data collection, database systems, AI/ML platforms

**Track 3: Community Engagement & Education**

**The Challenge:**
Develop innovative platforms to enhance public awareness and sustained participation.

**What You'll Build:**

Interactive community engagement platforms
Gamified environmental education tools

Civic engagement tools for democratic participation

**Tech Stack:**
Frontend frameworks, gamification engines, social media APIs, content management systems

# About The Big Hack

Welcome to **The Big Hack** - Acharya Institute of Technology's premier technology hackathon where brilliant minds converge to transform ideas into reality. This intensive coding marathon brings together students, developers, designers, and tech enthusiasts from across disciplines to collaborate, innovate, and build solutions that matter.

Over the course of this action-packed event, participants will dive deep into cutting-edge technologies, work alongside industry mentors, and compete for exciting prizes while tackling real-world challenges. Whether you're a seasoned developer or a curious beginner, The Big Hack provides the perfect platform to push your limits, learn new skills, and create something extraordinary.

## What Makes The Big Hack Special?

- **Collaborative Innovation**: Work in diverse teams to combine different perspectives and expertise
- **Cutting-Edge Challenges**: Solve problems spanning AI, sustainability, fintech, healthcare, and emerging technologies
- **Learn & Grow**: Workshops, tech talks, and hands-on sessions throughout the event
- **Network & Connect**: Build lasting relationships with fellow innovators and industry professionals
- **Win Big**: Compete for substantial prizes, internship opportunities, and startup funding

## Who Should Participate?

**✅ Eligibility:** Students from any background and any college across India can participate  
**📅 Duration:** 24 hours (November 14-15, 2025)

You’ll spend a day at our [Indiranagar HQ](https://2586labs.space), working on real-world challenges that reflect how we build, design, and communicate at Devfolio.

desc:
# Walrus Haulout Hackathon 2025

Powered by DeepSurge | Featuring Walrus, Seal, and Nautilus

**Building the Next Wave of On-Chain Data**

The decentralized data layer is here. Walrus, Seal, and Nautilus are redefining how data is stored, verified, and accessed across the Sui ecosystem — secure, composable, and infinitely scalable.

Haulout is your chance to explore. Build storage-powered apps, AI tools, data marketplaces, or verification systems using Walrus’ decentralized storage and Seal/Nautilus integrations. Whether you’re a first-time builder or a veteran developer, this is where you can start innovating.

Learn how Walrus powers verifiable data and how Seal and Nautilus extend its capabilities.

# Key Dates & Details

- **Hackathon Period**: November 6 – 23 PT
- **Judging**: November 23 – Dec 18
- **Results Announced**: December 18
- **X Space Recap**: Early January

**Goal**: Build projects that use Walrus, Seal, or Nautilus to create new ways to manage, verify, or monetize data.
**Eligibility**: Open to all — from data scientists and AI devs to Sui builders and new Move learners.
**Prizes**: $100,000 across tracks + participation NFTs for verified builders.

# Tracks
- Data Economy & Marketplaces
- AI x Data
- Provably Authentic (Truth Engine + Trust Oracle)
- Data Security & Privacy

**Read full track details** → [Haulout Hackathon Handbook](https://mystenlabs.notion.site/Walrus-Haulout-Hackathon-Participant-Handbook-2886d9dcb4e980e2adc1d047a95dfef8?source=copy_link)
**Register on** [DeepSurge](https://deepsurge.xyz/)

# About Walrus

Walrus is a decentralized storage protocol that turns data into verifiable on-chain assets. It works hand-in-hand with Seal, a consensus layer for distributed storage validation, and Nautilus, a high-performance data indexing engine.

Together, they create a foundation for transparent, provably authentic, and programmable data infrastructure on Sui.

Read the docs → [Walrus Documentation](https://www.walrus.xyz/get-started)

Hack This Fall marks five incredible years of bringing together builders, creators, and innovators worldwide. The latest edition, **Hack This Fall 2025**, is a milestone edition that features a month-long virtual hackathon in November, paired with 5 in-person Build Stations across India. - 9.11.2025 → Ahmedabad Build Station

Our team will review all applications and invite selected builders. Remember — Build Stations are invite-only, so make your application stand out. We can’t wait to see what you build!

desc:
​👉 If you only want to attend the screening, apply for an Audience Pass [here](https://luma.com/ycicqehv). **If you want to participate, read below:**


​👉 For real time updates and announcement feel free to join our WhatsApp group [here](https://chat.whatsapp.com/F2nzIP9Lhd2Gc2LPoDUMGd).

# What are we doing? 
- We’re hosting a 3-day hackathon where filmmakers, technologists, and creatives (or anyone with impeccable taste) team up to explore the next frontier of storytelling — powered by AI.
- We’ll fly in 50 selected artists from across India and the world. Flights (international and domestic), accommodation, and meals are fully covered. 
- Participants will form teams of 3 (or be matched if you don’t have one) and create 2-minute films using AI.
- ​On the final day, your film will premiere on the big screen at the Royal Opera House, a historic landmark in Mumbai, in front of Bollywood veterans, industry leaders, and an audience of ~400.

DeFi strategies and their integration is a crucial for Octant v2’s vaults. We’re looking for builders who can bring innovation, uniqueness, and an interesting perspective to DeFi strategies, design, and public goods for our vaults.

# HackNova - Innovation. Redefined by Women  

## About HackNova  
**HackNova** is an 18-hour exhilarating hackathon organized by **Shadan Women's College of Engineering and Technology**, designed to spark innovation and creativity in the tech community.  

Join us for a day of coding, collaboration, and creation , where you'll turn your ideas into reality! 

- **Theme:** Innovation for Tomorrow  
- **Date:** 30, 31 October (7 AM to 5 PM)
- **Location:** Shadan Women's College of Engineering and Technology, Khairtabad, Hyderabad  
- **Duration:** 18 Hours of intense innovation  
- **👥 Team Size:** 3–5 members  

---

## Tracks  

### AI/ML & Data Science  
Unleash the power of artificial intelligence and data-driven innovation!  
Build intelligent systems that solve real-world challenges using data analysis, predictive modeling, and machine learning.  

**Example Projects:**  
- AI for education, environment, or accessibility  
- Predictive analytics for social impact  
- Data visualization and insight platforms  
- Generative AI and automation tools  

---

### Cybersecurity & Privacy  
Protect what matters most — information, identity, and integrity.  
Create solutions that make the digital world safer and more transparent.  

**Example Projects:**  
- Threat detection and vulnerability assessment tools  
- Secure authentication systems  
- Privacy-preserving apps  
- Cyber awareness or phishing detection platforms  

---

### Web Development  
Bring your ideas to life through sleek, functional, and impactful web solutions.  
From creative landing pages to scalable full-stack apps — your imagination sets the limit!  

**Example Projects:**  
- Web apps for community engagement  
- Tools for productivity or education  
- Platforms supporting women empowerment  
- Interactive dashboards and AI-integrated web tools  

---

### IoT & Hardware  
Where innovation meets the physical world!  
Design smart devices and embedded systems that make everyday life better.  

**Example Projects:**  
- IoT-based environmental monitoring systems  
- Smart healthcare or home automation  
- Assistive tech devices  
- Wearable safety or health gadgets  

---

### 🏅 Special Mentions  
- 🏫 **Best Team from Shadan** – Celebrating our in-house innovators!  
- 💭 **Best Ideation Team** – Rewarding the brightest and most creative concepts!  

---

## 💰 Prize Pool  
**Total Prize Pool:** ₹25,000 + Swags  

### 🏆 Track Prizes  
Overall Top 3 Winners will be awarded 
- 🥇 1st Place: 16, 000 INR 
- 🥈 2nd Place: 7, 000 INR 
- 🥉 3rd Place: 3,000 INR 

---

## Tentative Schedule  

- **Registrations:** October 
- **Idea Submissions:** October 
- **Shortlisting of Ideas:** October 
- **Official Hackathon:** October
---

## Technologies  

Bring your favorite tools and technologies! We welcome all stacks and frameworks 

- **Frontend:** React, Vue, Angular, Flutter  
- **Backend:** Node.js, Python, Java, .NET  
- **Mobile:** React Native, Flutter, Native Platforms  
- **AI/ML:** TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn  
- **Hardware:** Arduino, Raspberry Pi, IoT Platforms  
- **Blockchain:** Ethereum, Solidity, Web3  
- **Cloud:** AWS, Azure, Google Cloud  

---

## 👥 Eligibility  
- Students from any college/university  
- All skill levels welcome - beginners encouraged!  
- Teams of 3-5 members  
- Women-led, Women-only hackathon 💪  

---

## Registration  

1. Form teams of 3–5 members  
2. Register via **[Platform Link – Coming Soon]**  
3. Join our WhatsApp community for updates and networking  
4. Prepare your ideas and get ready to hack!  

---

**Innovation (25%)** – Originality and creativity of the idea  
**Technical Implementation (25%)** – Code quality and use of technology  
**Impact & Relevance (25%)** – Social good potential and usefulness  
**Design & UX (15%)** – User interface and overall experience  
**Presentation (10%)** – Clarity, demo, and delivery

---

HackNova isn’t just a hackathon - it’s a platform to **empower women in tech**, showcase creativity, and redefine innovation.  

Get ready to **code, create, and conquer!**

desc:
📖 About Aptos Winterschool

Aptos Winterschool is a 7-day residential bootcamp designed for early-stage founders building on Aptos. From 25th–31st October 2025, 15 - 20 selected teams and 10 selected creators will gather at IIT Delhi for an immersive experience that blends product building, GTM strategy, community growth, and revenue model design.

You’ll work closely with top mentors, investors, and creators to refine your MVP, amplify your reach, and prepare for scale. The top 3 projects from Winterschool will be fast-tracked into the Aptos Global Program, with a chance to access grants up to $50K.

If you’re an ambitious founder or team with an idea and an early product, this is your chance to level up and build alongside the Aptos ecosystem.

👥 Who is this for?

We are looking for builders and founders who are:

Building projects on Aptos or looking to bring their ideas to life within the Aptos ecosystem.

Early-stage but with some progress, not necessarily mainnet-ready.

Team Composition Requirements

Each team should ideally have at least 2 members:

1 Developer → Must have working knowledge of Move language (on-site mentorship will support further development).

And having a Non Tech co-founder is a plus!

Virtual members can continue contributing remotely.

🔑 What to Expect

Team-building & bonding programs → Strengthen collaboration and leadership skills.

Peer-learning sessions → Share knowledge, exchange feedback, and grow together as a founder community.

Mentor-driven workshops → Deep dives into product, GTM, community, and revenue strategies.

Final Demo Day → On the last day, teams will present their refined product, business plan, and roadmap to mentors, investors, and the Aptos ecosystem.

🌍 What Aptos Aims to Achieve Through Winterschool

Aptos Winterschool is not just a bootcamp, it’s a launchpad to bring ambitious founders and creators deeper into the Aptos ecosystem. Through this program, we want to:

Incubate promising projects → Support early-stage founders in refining their MVPs, shaping GTM strategies, and preparing for scale.

Provide early support → Teams will have access to micro-grants during the program, and the most promising projects will advance to the Aptos Global Program where they can secure larger grants (up to $50K).

Strengthen the ecosystem → By bringing diverse teams together on campus, we create opportunities for collaboration, peer learning, and community-driven growth.

Role of Creators

Alongside founders, we are inviting 10 creators to participate in Winterschool. They will be matched with projects to:

Amplify social presence of teams through video content, written storytelling, and creative strategy.

Experiment with different styles of content across Twitter/X, Instagram, YouTube, and blogs.

Contribute to the distribution and visibility of Aptos-native projects.

Compete for recognition and prizes awarded to the best content creators across social media.

This dual track, builders + creators, ensures that projects not only get built but also reach the right audiences, creating momentum inside and outside the Aptos ecosystem.

desc:
# What are Base Batches? 

Base Batches - is a program that helps builders take their idea, turn it into a product, and kickstart their business.

This is your chance to get noticed, get funded, and get the support you need post-buildathon to bring your idea to market.

Base Batches this year will feature two dedicated tracks: 
- **Startup Track** – For existing teams with live products who are ready to take the next step. Teams will complete an application and accepted teams will earn a spot to present live at Demo Day  from Devconnect. Please submit your application here
- **Builder Track** – For new or early-stage teams who are pre-product. The builder track includes an application and a 4-week virtual buildathon where teams build the alpha version of their product. 100 teams will be admitted into Incubase, gain access to virtual mentorship, receive feedback on their products, and get the support they need to launch their first version of their product. Top teams will also be considered for incubator placements and may be invited to Demo Day 003.

**This is the page for the Builder Track.**


# THE PROMPT
Simple. Build the next killer onchain app* 

We are looking for innovative applications across gaming, AI, messaging, defi, mini apps or anything you think can help us in our mission to bring a billion users onchain.

**If you submit your application telling us about your onchain product by October 10th you'll get added to a dedicated support discord channel to get early judging and feedback on your product. 
Submit your application + full alpha version of your product by October 24*

# WHY PARTICIPATE?
Up to 100 teams will be accepted into Incubase and receive

- **Prizes:** $5000 USDC
- **Network:** Connections with some of the most prolific Base builders in your region, with direct access to the Base team.
- **Dedicated Advisor:** Each team will be appointed a dedicated advisor from the Base Growth team 
- **Virtual Mentorship Portal Access:** book 1:1 virtual sessions from a roster of industry veterans and experts from across specialities 
- **Resource Credits:** get credits to support your efforts to build and grow including ad credits, development resources, and audit support.
- **Network School Access:** a select number of top Incubase teams will be invited to join the Network School 
- **Social Amplification:** Admitted teams will be featured on Base socials 

# HOW IT WORKS

In order to be eligible, the projects must follow the below rules:
- Must submit one project per team
- Must include a functioning onchain app at a publicly accessible URL
- Must include an open-source GitHub repository for source code built during the buildathon
- Must include a video, with a minimum length of 1 minute (Intro, Demo, Problem Statement, Solution, Architecture Overview) 
- Integrating Basenames and Base Accountis strongly recommended; they make it easy for anyone to get onchain.
- Must submit proof of deployment and 1+ transactions on Base testnet

# Evaluation Criteria
- Onchain: Built on Base
- Technicality: Functions as pitched
- Originality: Clearly defined Unique Value Prop
- Viability: Clearly defined Target Customer Profile
- Specific: Is focused on testing your Unique Value Prop
- Practicality: Usable and accessible by anyone
- Wow Factor: Remarkable impact within time frame

name: Devfolio Student Hackathon Grants
desc:
We’re launching a grant program to empower student organizers across India to host world-class hackathons on their campuses.

- 💰 Grant Amount: Up to USD 500 per hackathon (tailored to scale & needs)
- 🎓 Who can apply: Student Organizers at universities and colleges across India conducting hackathons between October 2025 and December 2025
- ⚡ What’s included: Direct funding support, access to AWS workshops, content bundle, and environment to build your prototype.
- ✨ The Devfolio platform to streamline applications and project submissions.

But the best part? Organizers and participants will get to tap into the [AWS Builder Center](https://builder.aws.com/?trk=1d57bb9e-f8ea-41cd-b74a-77fc937043a4&sc_channel=el), home for builders to access all builder resources, engage with the AWS community, and provide feedback or product suggestions to AWS product teams.

# How it works? 🛠️
1. Get Hackathon verified on Devfolio - Get your hackathon set up and verified on Devfolio. Our verification process is thorough and allows us to ensure all the details are available for hackers before your hackathon is announced. 

2. Apply for the grant – Fill out the grant application explaining about your hackathon mission, why you want to host it, and how you’ll use the grant.
**Only one representative from the hackathon team should apply to the grant.**

3. Get shortlisted – Our team will evaluate applications based on vision, scale, student impact and support scope for your hackathon. We may reach out to get more details.

4. Receive funding & support – If selected, you’ll be onboarded to our grant program which will include sponsorship + support from AWS team during your hackathon.

5. Host your hackathon – Build the event you’ve always dreamed of, with all the resources you need in place.

6. Read the FAQs - We answer most of your questions related to the program in the FAQ below, please go through all of them before applying to the program.

> There should be no conflict of interest when applying for the grants.


## Why this matters 💡
With thousands of students across India building the future, hackathons are the beating heart of the developer ecosystem. By lowering the barrier to organizing them, we’re giving more students the chance to host meaningful events and inspire their peers to build.
AWS brings global expertise and infrastructure to the table. Devfolio brings a decade of hackathon know-how. Together, we want to make it easier for the next generation of student leaders to create experiences that launch ideas, careers, and communities.

name: Lisk Builders Challenge: Round Three
desc:
# **Level up your Idea, Build a Real-World Venture**

Join [Lisk](https://lisk.com/) and [BlockDevId](https://blockdev.id/) for the Lisk Builders Challenge Round 3, a hackathon spanning Southeast Asia! This is your chance to turn your innovative blockchain ideas into a tangible, future-ready dApp. Whether you're an aspiring startup founder, seasoned dev or builder, a creative designer, or just starting your journey into the decentralized world, this is your platform. Gather your team and let's build the future, one block at a time.

# **Your Journey to Demo Day**
With a four-month timeline, you'll have ample time to build your project. We'll support you with [Online Technical & Business Bootcamp and Mentorship](https://bit.ly/LBC-Round-3-Bootcamp) from our education partners [Pelita Bangsa Academy](https://pelitabangsa.co.id), [ETH Jakarta](https://ethjkt.com/) from Indonesia, and [sqrDAO](https://www.sqrdao.com/). We will select the 10 best projects to compete in the final round. The final Demo Day will be featuring live project presentations, judging, and networking opportunities.

- Open Submission: Wed, Sept 24, 2025
- Kickoff Event (AMA): Wed, Oct 1, 2025
- Technical & Business Bootcamp: Oct 8 - Dec 10, 2025 (every Wednesday at 19:30 - 21:00 (GMT+7) | 10 sessions)
- Submission Deadline: Sat, Jan 10, 2026 at 23:59 WIB (GMT+7)
- Judging: Mon - Fri, Jan 12 - 16, 2026
- Announcement of Finalists: Sat, Jan 17, 2026
- Finalists Coaching: Mon-Fri, Jan 19 - 23, 2026
- Socmed Cutoff Time: Wed, Jan 28, 2026 at 18:00 WIB (GMT+7)
- Demo Day (Hybrid): Sat, Jan 31, 2026


# **Building the Blockchain Ecosystem in South East Asia**

Our mission is to foster the growth of the blockchain ecosystem in South East Asia. We aim to empower developers and builders to create impactful projects that leverage blockchain technology's potential. By encouraging innovation and collaboration, we strive to igniting South East Asia's blockchain development.

# **Unlock Prizes, Mentorship, and Opportunities**
- Compete for a total prize pool of up to USD 5,600 in development challenges!
- Gain knowledge and enhance your skills from [Bootcamp](https://bit.ly/LBC-Round-3-Bootcamp) led by industry professionals and experts.
- Showcase your project to a wide audience through social media and partner promotions.


# **The Founder's Challenge: Ready to go beyond the Code?**
This isn't just a hackathon; it's your launchpad. Our theme challenges you to build a **real venture**, not just a cool project. Think like a founder from day one and create a dApp with a solid business plan, a clear path to market, and the potential to scale. It's time to build something the world actually needs.

# **Feeling a little lost on what to build?**
No worries! You may find some inspiration through this [Idea Bank](https://lisksea.notion.site/Idea-Bank-to-Inspire-Your-Next-Project-213fbe9c43ab805c9539c6e01c32d640/) to spark your imagination! Now, while it's packed with cool suggestions around **Stablecoins & Localized Payments**, **Consumer Apps**, **DeFi & Financial Inclusion**, and **Others**, don't feel like you have to stick to it. If you've got a brilliant idea in your mind, we absolutely want to see it! We are open to any creative dApp Ideas that align with the builders challenge's theme to be submitted for the Lisk Builders Challenge. 😄

**Please kindly follow the requirements down below! 😉**

# **Project Submission Guidelines**
You must provide these links during project submissions:
1. Smart Contract(s) URL deployed on [Lisk Sepolia Testnet](https://docs.lisk.com/user/connecting-to-a-wallet#lisk-sepolia-testnet) or [Lisk Mainnet](https://docs.lisk.com/user/connecting-to-a-wallet/#lisk-mainnet) and verified on [Blockscout Explorer](https://sepolia-blockscout.lisk.com/).
2. Live Project URL
3. Public Project Repository URL on GitHub
4. Pitch Deck URL (Google Drive Link shared publicly)

You also must fulfill these project requirements:
1. Upload Presentation & Demo Video (YouTube Video URL)
2. Upload Project Screenshot (PNG)
3. Your dApp should utilize smart contract deployed on either Lisk Mainnet or Lisk Sepolia Testnet

# **Complete these steps to submit your project**
This is an **online hackathon** on Devfolio
1. Begin by ensuring you have registered an account on Devfolio.
2. Proceed to apply for the hackathon. Here's the [guidance link](https://guide.devfolio.co/hackers/participate/online-hackathons).
3. Whether you are participating individually or as a team, you may create a new team or join an existing one. Please refer to this [flow](https://guide.devfolio.co/hackers/participate/create-join-a-team).
4. Finally, submit your project. Please refer to the [submission guidance](https://guide.devfolio.co/hackers/participate/project-submission) for further information.

# **Judging Criteria**
To ensure a fair and comprehensive evaluation, please see the following evaluation metrics:
- DApp Use Case Impact and Real Problems Solved (30pts)
- Pitch & Presentation Quality (20pts)
- Technical Implementation (15pts)
- UI/UX & Usability (15pts)
- Innovation & Uniqueness (10pts)
- Project Documentation & Code Quality (10pts)

# **What We Look Out For?**
1. Creating a project that you truly believe and passionate about deeply to solve a real problem is a HUGE advantage!
2. You MUST emphasize this strong desire on why you want to build this project in the pitching video when submitting the projects
3. ALWAYS Include Your Revenue Model for Your Web3 Startup: How do you Make Money?
4. Commitment to launch the project on Lisk Mainnet will be a huge plus and become the consideration when selecting the winners
5. We would also like to funnel the projects to our future Incubator Programs

# **Get Ready for the Challenge**

1. Join the BlockDevId [social media](https://linktr.ee/blockdev_id?fbclid=PAZXh0bgNhZW0CMTEAAab5aM-O-jTaLpZRMKckRUqNAEnifsXhREuEZNjLS8gJp5u1zLANNDhlm6Y_aem_AQFx_ujnu065_4F5F463ng) channels for the latest updates, announcements, and community discussions.
2. Participate in our series of preparatory sessions, where we'll cover essential topics, provide technical & business guidance, and answer your questions. Don't miss the Kickoff AMA session on BlockDevId [Youtube!](https://www.youtube.com/live/exk-f_JuQuU?si=EK8E24eXnUy9Aef5)

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/030b041535514a4db9321a346b6551d0/574c6160-1a78-44b0-8196-96407ded63b1.jpeg)


# **Get to know Lisk**

[Lisk](https://lisk.com/) is a growing Ethereum L2 built for high-growth markets with near-zero fees. Follow our [Social Media Channels](https://linktr.ee/LiskSEA) to stay connected. Also, check out our [docs with multilingual AI chatbot support](https://docs.lisk.com/) for in-depth technical information and helpful guides about the Lisk blockchain.

# **Get to know BlockDevId**

BlockDevId is a community that helps developers in Indonesia to learn and develop web3 and blockchain technology through collaboration and experience sharing. Its goal is to build a new blockchain-based economy in Indonesia by facilitating faster adoption of web3 technology. This community is open to anyone who wants to be involved in the development of web3 and blockchain technology in Indonesia. Find us on [social media](https://linktr.ee/blockdev_id?fbclid=PAZXh0bgNhZW0CMTEAAaa4YF_CQ9eeem1d6pkB_Rx65e3iRmAjEO6eDhaUbftyaABZSDASClFR1Jg_aem_vUwDeNKPAcjOxvXGtXU13g) to stay connected.

# **Get to know Pelita Bangsa Academy**

[Pelita Bangsa Academy](https://pelitabangsa.co.id) is an EduTech Startup with a mission to Upskill and Reskill Indonesian Tech Talents in Blockchain Technology so we can compete globally. We provide intensive Blockchain Developer Bootcamp. We are chosen as the Education Partner for Lisk Builders Challenge Round One and Two where we provided 6-session bootcamp and mentoring guiding the participants' web3 development journey! Find us on [social media](https://linktr.ee/pelitabangsa.co.id) to stay connected.

# **What is ETH Jakarta?**
[ETH Jakarta](https://ethjkt.com/) is an Ethereum-centered community, where developers, entrepreneurs, and blockchain enthusiast collaborate to build decentralize ecosystem in Jakarta.

# **Learn about sqrDAO**
[sqrDAO](https://www.sqrdao.com/) is a Vietnam-based Web3 Builder Community connecting developers, founders, and ecosystem partners across Southeast Asia.

We organize hackathons, developer programs, and strategic collaborations to help builders access grants, technical resources, and market opportunities. By bridging local talent with global ecosystems, sqrDAO drives web3 innovation and sustainable growth.

name: BlockTrain
tagline: Every grand week needs a beginning.
desc:
On September 20th, a train departs Bengaluru. Not an ordinary train, but a vessel of builders, mentors, and dreamers bound for Delhi. For two days, it becomes a moving *sabha* - an intimate gathering where ideas spark, conversations flow, and projects are born at 120 km/h.
![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

This is **BlockTrain.** The ceremonial start to a week where Ethereum in India takes center stage.
![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

## What’s BlockTrain?

Before the lights, the stages, and the conferences, there’s the journey. BlockTrain is Devfolio’s invitation to experience the week differently - to start not with noise, but with closeness; not with crowds, but with a rare circle of peers.
 
Think of it as the prologue. The caravan that sets everything in motion. The rite of passage for those who want to arrive in Delhi already carrying momentum.
 
The prize here isn’t measured in tokens or trophies. It’s access.
 
Every carriage is shared space. You’ll sit alongside mentors and judges, break bread with veteran builders, and spark conversations that usually happen behind velvet ropes. Here, everyone is simply a co-traveller.
 
This is where the most important ideas of the week are first whispered - in motion, before they echo across Delhi.
![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

## Why Ride?

- **No Hierarchies:** Mentors, judges, veterans - they’re all riding right with you.
- **A Moving Lab:** The train is your playground. It's time to restart using people as rubber duckies, instead of ChatGPT.
- **Community in Motion**: Forge bonds that outlast the journey.
- **A prologue to Delhi:** You don’t just arrive. You *build your way there*.
![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

## The Details
📅 **Date**: 20-22 September 2025 (36 hour journey)
🚉 **Departure**: Bengaluru
🛤 **Destination**: New Delhi
🎟 **Eligibility**: Builders, dreamers, tinkerers. Come solo or bring your crew. 
🏆 **Prize**: Access. Conversations. Elevation.
![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

Seats are finite. The whistle will blow. Will you be aboard? Apply and find out.

**Note:** We’re especially excited to see applications from women, non-binary, and other underrepresented builders
location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

Welcome to SDGForge 2025, a transformative 12-hour hackathon where purpose meets innovation!
Hosted at Atria Institute of Technology, this event is your opportunity to code for a cause, ideate for impact, and bring your vision for a sustainable world to life. Whether you're a UG/PG or a passionate changemaker, this is your stage to build solutions that truly matter.

📅 **Event Details**
**Date:** August 13-14, 2025
**Team Size:** 2-4

**SDGForge** is a mission-driven hackathon centered around the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). It's more than just a competition—it's a movement to create lasting social and environmental change through the power of technology.

💡 **Why Join SDGForge 2025?**
✅ **Build with Purpose** – Tackle real-world global challenges using tech.
✅ **Mentorship & Learning** – Access expert guidance and real-time feedback.
✅ **Impactful Projects** – Work on ideas that can be scaled into real change.

SDGForge aims to align innovation with sustainability, driving progress across key SDG domains. Participants will develop AI-powered solutions with a measurable social impact.

🌐 **1. AI for Responsible Health Information**
Problem: Misinformation online has become a public health hazard.
Objective: Develop an AI tool that identifies and flags potentially harmful health misinformation across social media and websites, while suggesting reliable, verified alternatives.

Objective: Create an AI tool that predicts crop yields and suggests optimized crop rotation plans based on soil health, weather, and historical data.

The IndeHub Hackathon, in collaboration with Swift communities across India

desc:
# Welcome to **Hack4Bengal 4.0** - Eastern India’s **LARGEST** in-person hackathon, where innovation meets opportunity! 🚀

 

At Hack4Bengal, we believe in the power of code to transform ideas into reality. Whether you're just starting your journey as a developer or you're already building the future, this is your platform to create, connect, and compete alongside some of the brightest minds in the country.

 
 
 

## **💡 Code. Create. Collaborate. Compete.**

Hack4Bengal 4.0 is designed to challenge and inspire - pushing boundaries, solving real-world problems, and showcasing talent on a grand stage.

 

## 🧭 Why Should You Join?

 

- **✨ 1:1 Mentorship Opportunities**: Work closely with industry veterans, tech leaders, and startup founders who will guide you throughout the hackathon.


- **🤝 Unparalleled Collaboration**: Meet and team up with students, developers, and innovators from across India, building solutions that can make a real impact.



- **🚀 Get Noticed**: Put your skills in front of top tech communities, recruiters, and companies scouting for future tech leaders.

 

## 👩‍💻 Who Can Participate?

- ✅ Students from any background (Yes, **2025 passouts** included!)
- ✅ Teams of 2 to 4 members — find your squad and start building
- ✅ No selection barriers - Whether you're from tech, design, management, or any field - Hack4Bengal 4.0 is open for all dreamers and doers.

 

## 🛠 Hackathon Format

- **⏳ 36 hours of In-Person Hacking**: Build your projects during an intense and thrilling virtual hackathon.

- **💻 Diverse Tracks to Explore**:

   - AI & Machine Learning
   - Web3 & Blockchain
   - Healthcare Innovation
   - Sustainability Solutions
   - Open Innovation

- ❤️ **Hack with Purpose**: Go beyond coding for the sake of it - create meaningful, impactful solutions that can change lives.


 

## **🎯 Ready to Make Your Mark?**

Join a community of dreamers, coders, builders, and problem-solvers who believe in thinking big and building bold.

Whether you're hacking for passion, learning new skills, or making new connections - Hack4Bengal 4.0 is where it all begins.

 

**💬 Join our Community**: [Discord Server](https://www.hack4bengal.tech/discord)

**📜 Know the Rules**: [Code of Conduct](http://hack4bengal.tech/coc)

 

**Hack4Bengal 4.0**

> Build bold. Think big. Hack with Bengal.

Whether you're building cutting-edge solutions in BTCfi, AI, SocialFi, DeFi, Gaming, or Web3 infra — this is your moment to launch, scale, and pitch at the global stage in Singapore. Build with Core in Hack4Bengal 4.0 and be eligible for [Core Connect Global Buildathon](https://dorahacks.io/hackathon/core-connect-global-buildathon/detail).

### Objectives

- Just one goal, to build using Core.
- Submit the project on [Core Connect Global Buildathon](https://dorahacks.io/hackathon/core-connect-global-buildathon/detail).

### Prizes (From Core Connect Global Buildathon)

**Up to $1.2 Million in Rewards & Funding!**

- The Core Connect Global Buildathon features up to $1.2 million in rewards and prizes, spread across diverse categories to reward the most innovative projects with support to scale to success.
- **Funding from Core Ventures:** Up to $500,000 in funding from Core Ventures for the top-most innovative projects.
- **Core Builder Incentive Program:** Up to $400,000 in CORE tokens to support projects that contribute exceptionally to Core’s on-chain growth.
- **Core Starter Program:** Up to $200,000 worth of exclusive benefits, including discounts on security audits, website hosting, Google Cloud credits, and more to accelerate development.
- **Gas Rebate Program:** Get up to 6 months of free gas to help cover transaction costs after your dApp goes live on the mainnet.
- **AWS Activate Credits:** Winners and runners-up can receive up to $100,000 in AWS credits to build and scale their projects on AWS.

<aside>
🗒️

**NOTE: The Prize for this track will be fulfilled from Core, the project submitted at Hack4Bengal 4.0, can also be submitted to the** [Core Connect Global Buildathon](https://dorahacks.io/hackathon/core-connect-global-buildathon/detail). **If your submitted project wins at the** [Core Connect Global Buildathon](https://dorahacks.io/hackathon/core-connect-global-buildathon/detail)**, you’ll receive the prizes from Core itself. Prizes for this track will not be fulfilled from Hack4Bengal’s side.**

</aside>

### Judging Criteria

Projects will be evaluated based on **innovation, utility, technical depth**, and **alignment with the Core ecosystem**. Judges will score entries across the following categories:

**Innovation & Originality (20%)**

- Introduction of novel ideas, features, or approaches
- Creative application of blockchain and Web3 primitives
- Avoids clones, forks, or heavily derivative work

**Utility & Ecosystem Impact (20%)**

- Clear value and relevance to the **Core ecosystem**
- Integration of Core-native products like **BTC Staking**, **stCORE**, **Dual Staking**, etc.
- Potential to drive **TVL**, **active users**, **transaction volume**, or **community participation**
- Addresses real-world use cases or solves meaningful problems

**Design & Usability (10%)**

- User-friendly, intuitive UX/UI
- Smooth interaction flow and well-thought-out user journey
- Visual polish and accessibility

**Core Integration (20%)**

- Depth and creativity of integration with the **Core blockchain infrastructure**
- Effective use of **Core-specific primitives** (e.g., Satoshi Plus, native staking, etc.)
- Demonstrates understanding of Core's architecture and aligns with its vision

**Scalability & Technical Architecture (10%)**

- Capacity to support a growing user base
- Modular, maintainable, and upgrade-ready codebase
- Sound infrastructure and foresight in scaling logic

**Feasibility & Growth Potential (10%)**

- Potential fit for Core Ventures incubation or funding
- PMF evaluation and growth potential
- Impact for the Core Ecosystem

**Code Quality & Open Source Readiness (10%)**

- Clean, readable, and well-documented code
- Follows best practices in smart contract and Web3 development
- Open-source or demonstrably ready for collaborative growth

- [Foundry Starter](https://https//github.com/coredao-org/Core-Foundry-Kit): A minimal setup for quickly starting smart contract development with Foundry.
- [Next.js + RainbowKit](https://https//https://github.com/coredao-org/Core-NextJs-Rainbowkit): A starter template combining Next.js with RainbowKit for building Web3-enabled frontend on Core.

name: Lisk Builders Challenge: Round Two
desc:
# **Let's Build! Your Opportunity Awaits**

[Lisk](https://lisk.com/) and [BlockDevId](https://blockdev.id/) are thrilled to bring you the Lisk Builders Challenge! This is your chance to turn your innovative blockchain ideas into reality. Whether you're a seasoned developer or just starting your blockchain journey, this hackathon provides the platform and resources you need to succeed. This time, in Round 2, we'll be covering Southeast Asia.

# **Your Journey to Demo Day**
The challenge will run for 3 months, giving you ample time to develop your project. During this period, we'll host online workshops and provide mentorship to guide you through our education partners [Pelita Bangsa Academy](https://pelitabangsa.co.id) and [DevWeb3Jogja](https://x.com/devweb3jogja) from Indonesia. We will select the 10 best projects to compete in the final round. The final Demo Day will be held in Bali (hybrid), featuring live project presentations, judging, and networking opportunities.

- Open Submission: June 10, 2025
- Kickoff Event (AMA): June 11, 2025
- [Workshop](https://lu.ma/qi5fnjx6): June 18 - July 23, 2025
- Submission Deadline: August 3, 2025
- Judging: August 4 - 8, 2025
- Announcement of Finalists: August 9, 2025
- Finalists Coaching: August 11-15, 2025
- SocMed Challenge Cutoff Time: August 17, 2025 | 18:00 (GMT+7)
- Most Fav Project Voting Cutoff Time: August 17, 2025 | 18:00 (GMT+7)

- Demo Day (Bali - Hybrid): August 20, 2025


# **Building the Blockchain Ecosystem in South East Asia**

Our mission is to foster the growth of the blockchain ecosystem in South East Asia. We aim to empower developers and builders to create impactful projects that leverage blockchain technology's potential. By encouraging innovation and collaboration, we strive to igniting South East Asia's blockchain development.

# **Unlock Prizes, Mentorship, and Opportunities**
- Compete for a total prize pool of up to USD 5,000 in development challenges!
- Gain knowledge and enhance your skills from [workshops](https://lu.ma/qi5fnjx6) led by industry professionals and experts.
- Showcase your project to a wide audience through social media and partner promotions.


# **Building Tomorrow's Fun: User-Friendly Web3 & Localized DeFi for Everyone!**
Here are the two main themes for this round of the hackathon:
**1. Consumer Apps: Web3 for Everyone!**
This track is all about making Web3 awesome and super easy for everyday users. Think outside the box and create apps that bring the magic of decentralized tech right to people's fingertips.
- DePIN (Decentralized Physical Infrastructure Networks): Imagine building apps that connect the real world
- Real-World Assets (RWAs): Imagine turning everyday stuff into digital treasures on the blockchain. What cool apps can you dream up?
- SocialFi (Social Finance): Ready to mix social media with decentralized finance? Dream up apps where communities can connect, create, and even earn together in new, exciting ways.
- Web3 Gaming: Let's build the next big game where players truly own their digital worlds!
- Collectibles: Beyond NFTs! How can we make digital collecting even more exciting and accessible for everyone?
- And so much more!

**2. Localized Decentralized Finance: DeFi, But Local and Loved!**
Ready to make finance fun, fair, and totally seamless for your community? It challenges you to build super secure and stable DeFi solutions. We're talking easy transactions for daily life and smooth sailing for money moving across borders. Let's make finance friendly for everyone!

# **Feeling a little lost on what to build?**
No worries! You may find some inspiration through this [Idea Bank](https://lisksea.notion.site/Idea-Bank-to-Inspire-Your-Next-Project-213fbe9c43ab805c9539c6e01c32d640/) to spark your imagination! Now, while it's packed with cool suggestions, don't feel like you have to stick to it. If you've got a brilliant idea in your mind, we absolutely want to see it! We are open to any creative dApp Ideas that align with the builders challenge's theme to be submitted for the Lisk Builders Challenge. 😄

**Please kindly follow each track's requirements and idea banks to be elligible! See Prizes Section~ 😉**

# **Project Submission Guidelines**
You must provide these links during project submissions:
1. Smart Contract(s) URL deployed on [Lisk Sepolia Testnet](https://docs.lisk.com/user/connecting-to-a-wallet#lisk-sepolia-testnet) or [Lisk Mainnet](https://docs.lisk.com/user/connecting-to-a-wallet/#lisk-mainnet) and verified on [Blockscout Explorer](https://sepolia-blockscout.lisk.com/).
2. Live Project URL
3. Public Project Repository URL on GitHub
4. Pitch Deck URL (Google Drive Link shared publicly)

You also must fulfill these project requirements:
1. Upload Presentation & Demo Video (YouTube Video URL)
2. Upload Project Screenshot (PNG)
3. Your dApp should utilize smart contract deployed on either Lisk Mainnet or Lisk Sepolia Testnet

# **Complete these steps to submit your project**
This is an **online hackathon** on Devfolio
1. Begin by ensuring you have registered an account on Devfolio.
2. Proceed to apply for the hackathon. Here's the [guidance link](https://guide.devfolio.co/hackers/participate/online-hackathons).
3. Whether you are participating individually or as a team, you may create a new team or join an existing one. Please refer to this [flow](https://guide.devfolio.co/hackers/participate/create-join-a-team).
4. Finally, submit your project. Please refer to the [submission guidance](https://guide.devfolio.co/hackers/participate/project-submission) for further information.

To ensure a fair and comprehensive evaluation, please see the following evaluation metrics:
- DApp Use Case Impact towards the Lisk Ecosystem (30pts)
- Innovation & Uniqueness (20pts)
- Technical Implementation (20pts)
- UI/UX & Usability (10pts)
- Project Documentation & Code Quality (10pts)
- Pitch & Presentation Quality (10pts)

Commitment to launch the project on Lisk Mainnet will be a huge plus and become a consideration when selecting the winners.

desc:
Build the future of onchain finance and AI alongside thousands of developers, creators, artists, and mentors with the goal of enabling new use cases that combine DeFi, Tokenized Assets, and AI.

- Running from May 30 - June 29
- Free registration
- Completely virtual and global
