- Gain hands-on experience with the backbone of blockchain
- Explore innovative use cases in AI, Tokenization, RWAs, and more
- Learn with Chainlink’s developer resources and connect with the community

This hackathon fast-tracks developers’ journey into onchain finance with focused workshops, clear prize tracks, and opportunities for networking.

--
# Important Reminders:

- Opening Ceremony: **May 30, 12 PM Eastern Time**
- Project submission deadline: **June 29, 11:59 PM Eastern Time**
- Closing Ceremony: **July 17, 10AM Eastern Time**
- Hackathon workshop schedule can be downloaded [here](https://calendar.google.com/calendar/embed?src=c_42d83e0c2ba9d11d37dd8c76a383bd097d55beaefc5d88cfe55a8ce60777e9de%40group.calendar.google.com)

As blockchain technology evolves, the need for skilled developers grows. This hackathon supports everyone—from beginners to experienced pros—in building the future of decentralized finance. What you gain depends on what you put in. Chromion provides the resources and time to challenge yourself, connect with others, and make an impact in the blockchain space. Don’t miss your chance to learn, innovate, and help shape onchain finance.

--
# What is Chainlink?
Chainlink is the standard for onchain finance, verifiable data, and cross-chain interoperability. Chainlink is unifying liquidity across global markets and has enabled over $20 trillion in transaction value across the blockchain economy. Major financial market infrastructures and institutions, such as Swift, Fidelity International, and ANZ Bank, as well as top DeFi protocols including Aave, GMX, and Lido, use Chainlink to power next-generation applications for banking, asset management, and other major sectors. Learn more by visiting [chain.link](https://chain.link).

--
# Register today and gear up with hackathon resources
To help maximize the success of projects, hackathon participants will be provided with direct access to experienced mentors and technical support, extensive educational materials for learning about off-chain services, live workshops showcasing how to use Chainlink, and much more. We also encourage you to join the hackathon channel in the official [Chainlink Discord](https://discord.com/invite/chainlink) to meet other hackers and to explore our collection of developer resources below:

-   [Chainlink Docs](https://docs.chain.link/)
-   [Hardhat Starter Kit](https://github.com/smartcontractkit/hardhat-starter-kit)
-   [Foundry Starter Kit](https://github.com/smartcontractkit/foundry-starter-kit)
-   [CCIP Starter Kit Hardhat](https://github.com/smartcontractkit/ccip-starter-kit-hardhat)
-   [CCIP Starter Kit Foundry](https://github.com/smartcontractkit/ccip-starter-kit-foundry)
-   [Functions Hardhat Starter Kit](https://github.com/smartcontractkit/functions-hardhat-starter-kit)
-   [Bootcamps](https://www.youtube.com/@chainlink/streams)
-   [Chainlink Developer Hub](https://dev.chain.link/)
-   [CCIP Local Simulator](https://github.com/smartcontractkit/chainlink-local)
-   [Chainlink Faucet](https://chain.link/faucets)
-   [Chainlink Discord Channel](https://discord.com/invite/chainlink)

--
# Requirements
- Each project must use Chainlink in some form to make a state change on a blockchain, otherwise it will not be eligible for the Chainlink core prizes. This means that a front end simply reading from Chainlink data feeds doesn't count. Using one of Chainlink Data Feeds, Chainlink Data Streams, Chainlink VRF, Chainlink Proof of Reserves, Chainlink Automation, Chainlink Functions or Chainlink CCIP inside your smart contracts is required.

- For sponsor prizes, you do not have to use Chainlink - but to make your project eligible for both sponsor prizes as well as the main Chainlink ones, it's recommended that you do!

- Note that past hackathon projects will not be accepted as valid submissions. The only exception to this rule is if you and your team have built an existing project and are updating it with new components. These can be added upon and submitted in a valid manner.

- 3-5 minute, publicly viewable video

- Publicly accessible source code (eg Github public repo)

- README: link to all files that use Chainlink

- Project Description That Also Covers Stack/Architecture

- Optional: Link to “live” deployed demo

prizes.desc:
**Hackthon Track Prize**

**🧩 Problem Statement: "Build an All-in-One Tech Collaboration Platform"**

**Overview:**
The modern tech ecosystem thrives on collaboration — whether through freelancing, tech events, or engaging communities. However, these ecosystems are currently scattered across various platforms: freelancing sites like Upwork, event platforms like Eventbrite, and chat apps like WhatsApp or Discord.

This fragmentation creates inefficiencies in communication, discovery, and engagement. Startups, developers, and tech communities often juggle between tools to organize events, find freelance talent, or build communities, leading to poor user experience and lost opportunities.

**Challenge:**
1. Build a unified, web-based platform that combines:
2. freelancing marketplace for tech gigs and collaborations.
3. An event organizing module for hackathons, webinars, and meetups.
4. real-time community feature with chat (like WhatsApp/Discord), groups, and networking tools.

The goal is to empower startups, tech communities, and freelancers with a single platform to connect, collaborate, and grow together.

**🎯 Key Features to Implement (Minimum Requirements):
**
🧑‍💻 Freelancing Module:
1.Create gig listings (by startups or clients)
2.Freelancers can apply to gigs with proposals
3.Profile creation and review system
4.Dashboard for tracking project statuses

📅 Event Management:
1. Event creation: title, description, time, venue/online links and registration system
2. Admin tools to manage attendees
3. Option to list hackathons, meetups, webinars

💬 Community + Real-Time Chat:
1. Public and private groups
2. 1:1 direct messages
3. Real-time messaging (WebSocket or Firebase)
4. Group announcements, media sharing

**🛠️ Tech Stack Suggestions (Any):**
Frontend: React.js / Next.js + Tailwind CSS

Backend: Node.js (Express) / Django / FastAPI

Database: MongoDB / PostgreSQL

Authentication: Firebase Auth / JWT

Chat System: Firebase Realtime DB / Socket.io

Cloud Storage: AWS S3 / Firebase Storage

Hosting: Vercel / Render / Railway / AWS / Firebase Hosting

**📌 Evaluation Criteria:**
1. Functionality: Does the platform cover all core modules smoothly?
2. User Interface/UX: Clean, intuitive, responsive design
3. Scalability: Is the platform structured for future growth?
4. Innovation: Unique features, seamless experience, or automation
5. Code Quality: Organized, modular, and well-documented

🧠 Bonus Features (Optional for Extra Points):
Payment gateway integration (Stripe/Razorpay) for freelance payments

1. Event reminder notifications (email or push)
2. AI-based gig recommendations
3. Admin dashboard with analytics
4. Voice/video call integration in chat

# **Aventus 3.0 - Unleash Your Innovation**

Calling all creative thinkers, passionate builders, and future tech pioneers!  
Step into **Aventus 3.0**, an adrenaline-packed 24-hour hackathon hosted by **Dayananda Sagar College of Engineering** in collaboration with the **Department of Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning** and **Techmiya Solutions**.  
We’re here to spark innovation, unlock your potential, and inspire you to disrupt the tech landscape with your brightest ideas.

---



## **Important Instructions**

-  **Problem Statements are available on our website – [hackaventus.com](https://www.hackaventus.com)**
- During the submission round, **participants must copy-paste the exact problem statement** from the website into their project submission.

---

## 🚀 **The Challenge is Yours to Conquer**  
This isn’t just any hackathon. It’s a high-energy marathon where you’ll have the opportunity to develop **bold, real-world solutions** and turn your innovative concepts into **functional prototypes**.

---

## 💡 **Why Join Aventus 3.0?**  
It’s more than a competition – it’s a launchpad for future success. Here’s what you can look forward to:

- **Build Your Dream Team:**  
  Connect with talented peers from diverse backgrounds, exchange fresh ideas, and form partnerships that can redefine the future of technology.

- **Sharpen Your Skills:**  
  Take part in hands-on workshops, gain practical knowledge from seasoned mentors, and network with other passionate innovators.

- **Showcase Your Talent:**  
  Compete on a major platform, win exciting prizes, and gain industry recognition that could take your tech career to new heights.

---

## 🌟 **Why Aventus 3.0 is Your Ultimate Destination**  

- **Innovation Ignition:**  
  Break barriers, craft groundbreaking solutions, and unlock your full potential.  

- **Thriving Innovation Ecosystem:**  
  Engage with a dynamic ecosystem of makers, creators, and entrepreneurs.  

- **Limitless Potential:**  
  Embrace endless opportunities and propel yourself into a future brimming with possibilities.  

---

## 🛠️ **Hackathon Tracks**  
Choose from the following tracks to unleash your creativity:

- **AI in Healthcare**  
- **AI in Cybersecurity**  
- **AI in Edge Computing**  
- **AI in Defence & Disaster Response**  

---

## 📜 **Hackathon Guidelines**  

- You can choose from the provided problem statements or bring your own idea to life.  
- If submitting your own project, be sure to select a specific track; failure to do so may result in disqualification.  
- The **team leader** must create and complete the team’s application.  
- Team members can join the team using the **provided join code**.  
- Every member must upload the **same presentation** as part of the submission process.  
- **Individual applications will not be accepted**, so make sure you register as a complete team!  

---

## 🧠 **Get Ready to Innovate!**  
Brainstorm, build, and break boundaries at **Aventus 3.0**, where **innovation meets opportunity**.  
Don’t miss your chance to shine and make your mark on the future of technology!

name: Base Batch Messaging Buildathon
desc:
We’re stoked to add a dedicated messaging buildathon as part of Base Batch 001. 

Builders interested in driving the future of messaging on Base can jump in and get started building. 

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

### Overview
**Messaging presents a huge opportunity for Base builders.** Messaging is the largest use-case in the world, but it’s more than just conversations—it’s a secure, programmable channel for financial and social innovation. When combined with the onchain capabilities of Coinbase Wallet, builders have a new surface area to build 10X better messaging experiences not currently possible on legacy platforms like WhatsApp or Messenger.

**Secure group chats & DMs are the new surface area for developers.**

Coinbase Wallet & XMTP are bringing AI + crypto + mini apps into secure messaging to unlock use-cases never before possible. 

This could include:
- AI Agents that trade, swap, bridge and more.
- Group chats with tokens and micro-economies.
- Mini-app games you play with friends in group chats

There are so many powerful things you can build...

This is your chance to get noticed, get funded, and get the support you need post-buildathon to bring your idea to market.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

### THE PROMPT
Simple. *Build the next killer agent or messaging mini-app.*

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

### FOCUS AREAS
We’ve provided the following 5 areas to help focus your energy on where to start building agents for messaging. 

- **Utility Agents** - Messaging meets productivity. Create agents that help groups plan events, split payments, manage shared wallets, or track action items. DMs and group chats become the new coordination layer with an agent powered by financial rails. 
- **Trading and DeFi Agents** - Build agents that manage your portfolio, track trending tokens, notify a group chat of price actions, and help a user to rebalance holdings. Whether it's a DM or group chat experience, create an agent with serious knowledge of how to help a degen out. 
- **Agent and Mini App Interaction** - Build a creative way for an agent to utilize mini apps. Your agent could launch a mini app directly inside a group chat for a multiplayer game, or use a mini app for visualizing a recent poll. Anything goes, bring the power of mini apps to the chat experience.
- **Gaming Agents** - Create an agent that facilitates a game in a group, this could be a known game like “Guess Who” for an icebreaker experience, or an agent sharing score alerts in a group chat. 
- **Social Agents** - Build an agent that makes group chats more fun, interactive, and engaging. This could be dropping in curated content for the group, or an agent that helps people match for meetups, share recommendations, and rewards users for posting their recs! 



### TRY IT NOW

Want to experience a real agent, built on XMTP? You can try the Bankr agent below on the xmtp.chat developer tool.

[Bankr Agent on XMTP](https://xmtp.chat/dm/0x7F1c0d2955F873Fc91F1728C19b2ED7be7a9684D)

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

### BUILDER RESOURCES
- [Getting Started with XMTP (Video)](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=djRLnWUvwIA)
- [Building Agents on XMTP](https://github.com/ephemeraHQ/xmtp-agent-examples)
- [XMTP Documentation](https://docs.xmtp.org/)
- [Coinbase AgentKit](https://github.com/coinbase/agentkit)
- [Coinbase Developer Platform](https://docs.cdp.coinbase.com/)
- [Faucets (CDP, thirdweb)](https://portal.cdp.coinbase.com/products/faucet)
- [OnchainKit](https://onchainkit.xyz/)

Additional resources can be found by visiting [base.org/builders](https://www.base.org/builders)

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

### WHY PARTICIPATE?
Join fellow builders and dream up the next killer messaging app and get the feedback, distribution, and the funding needed to take your build to the next level. 


#### Overview of Prizes:
- **Prizes**: 🥇10K  | 🥈7K | 🥉3K (all paid in USDC)
- **Base Batches Demo Day Invitation**: The top 3 teams will be invited to Demo Day this summer with up to $1m in funding.
- **Marketing & Distribution**: All winners will be featured on Base social channels (X, Warpcast) plus get a global stage to present during Demo Day.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

### HOW IT WORKS
In order to be eligible, the projects must follow the below rules:
- Must submit one project per team.
- Must include a functioning onchain app at a publicly accessible URL.
- Must include an open-source GitHub repository for all source code in the app (showcase track submissions can have closed source code).
- Must include a video, with a minimum length of 1 minute (Intro, Demo, Problem Statement, Solution, Architecture Overview) .
- Must submit proof of deployment and 1+ transactions on Base mainnet.
- Submissions built before the Buildathon are eligible for submission, but must clearly delineate what new feature or product was built during the Buildathon.
- Must be built using XMTP
- Submissions must utilize AgentKit and Basenames to the extent possible.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

### EVALUATION CRITERIA
- Onchain: Built on Base and uses XMTP.
- Technicality: Functions as pitched.
- Originality: Innovation / originality to solve problems.
- Practicality: Usable and accessible by anyone.
- Aesthetics: Intuitive, easy-to-navigate.
- Wow Factor: Remarkable impact within time frame

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

By accessing our services, you attest that you are not subject to any sanctions and are not on any OFAC lists, and we reserve the right to block transactions or interactions involving individuals, entities, or countries that are subject to U.S. sanctions.*

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

desc:
# HyperHack: Hyperion AI & Real-Time Web3 Hackathon

## What's the HyperHack?

HyperHack is a three-month hackathon where developers can build and test dApps leveraging Hyperion’s next-gen high-performance capabilities, including parallel execution, onchain AI, and high-throughput performance.

## How to Participate
1. **Apply**: Submit your application on our [official forum](https://forum.ceg.vote/t/welcome-to-the-hyperhack-hackathon-forum/3966) by June 2
2. **Ideate**: Join AMAs and workshops to refine your project concept
3. **Build**: Develop on Hyperion testnet using parallel execution and AI SDKs
4. **Test**: Participate in "Corrupted Alith Takeover" campaign for stress testing
5. **Submit**: Final projects evaluated on innovation, code quality, performance, and engagement

# Submit your Idea in our Forum [Mandatory Step] 
Forum Link: [https://forum.ceg.vote/t/tutorial-how-to-apply-and-submit-a-proposal/4066](https://forum.ceg.vote/t/tutorial-how-to-apply-and-submit-a-proposal/4066)

## Timeline
**Applications & Ideathon:** May 15 – June 15, 2025
**Development Stage:**  June 2 – August 7, 2025
**Stress-Testing Stage:** July 15 – August 7, 2025
**Judgment & Wrap-Up:** August 7 – August 16, 2025
**Winner Announcement:** August 16, 2025

## Project Tracks

### AI-Native and Core-Aligned Projects (Track 1)
- **AI-Native dApps**: Applications with AI embedded in the logic layer
- **Onchain AI & Data**: Protocols bringing AI workflows directly on-chain

### Real-Time Systems (Track 2)
- **Real-Time Web3**: Applications requiring minimal latency
- **Real-Time Gaming and DeFi**: Games and finance platforms needing fast interaction

### Infrastructure and Ecosystem Tools (Track 3)
- **Traditional DeFi Protocols**: Core primitives reimagined for Hyperion
- **Web3 Infrastructure**: Developer-facing tools and services
- **Interoperability with Metis SDK**: Projects bridging Hyperion and Andromeda

### Special Category: Alith Integrations
- Projects extending Hyperion's built-in AI co-agent Alith

## Prize Distribution
- **Total Prize Pool**: $200,000 USD
- **Track 1 & 2 Top Projects**: $150,000 (split among top 3–4)
- **Track 3 Winners**: $20,000 (split among top 1–3)
- **Alith Integration Prizes**: $30,000

## Technical Highlights
- Parallelized Transactions for Hyper-Scalability
- High Performance On-chain LLMS Inference
- AI-Optimized Powerhouse
- Seamless Ethereum and Cross-Chain Integration
- 10x faster state sync & 50% reduced storage state

## Resources
- **Official Forum & Application**: [https://forum.ceg.vote/t/welcome-to-the-hyperhack-hackathon-forum/3966](https://forum.ceg.vote/t/welcome-to-the-hyperhack-hackathon-forum/3966)
- **Documentation**: [https://docs.metis.io/hyperion](https://docs.metis.io/hyperion)
- **Testnet Faucet**: [https://t.me/hyperion_testnet_bot](https://t.me/hyperion_testnet_bot)
- **Join Metis Developer Community:** [https://t.me/metis_dev](https://t.me/metis_dev)

name: Base Batch LatAm
tagline: Join builders from across the world to create the next wave of industry defining applications onchain
desc:
# What are Base Batches? 

*Enter a Base Batch Buildathon → Earn an incubator placement → Present on Demo Day*
![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)
We’re kicking off Base Batches, a global builder program that is bringing the next generation of builders from across the world to create industry defining applications onchain.

This is your chance to get noticed, get funded, and get the support you need post-buildathon to bring your idea to market.

Base Batches three part program consists of buildathon activations, incubator placements, and a season-ending Demo Day.

Over 50 teams and individuals that join our inaugural Base Batches Global Buildathon will be directly placed into incubator programs and invited to our season-ending Demo Day.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

## Supporters
This buildathon is supported by [Aerodrome](https://aerodrome.finance), [Farcaster](https://www.farcaster.xyz), [Uniswap Foundation](https://www.uniswapfoundation.org/), [Ohara AI](https://ohara.ai), [MXNE](https://brale.xyz/stablecoins/MXNe), [Transfero](https://transfero.com/), and [Virtuals Protocol](https://virtuals.io).
![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/7e2cf913793f4bddb809713a0bcd14ae/cb03c5fc-4db5-4435-ba89-00cf3910f919.png)

## Base Batch #001 Demo Day

Top teams from this program will be invited to join Demo Day this summer to pitch on a public stage to top judges from across Coinbase, Base and our partners for a share of up to $1,000,000 in funding.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

### THE PROMPT
Simple. *Build the next killer onchain app.*

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

### TRACKS
We are going to select a minimum of 1-2 teams from each of the following tracks:

- **AI** - Build an AI agent on Base that can perform useful onchain actions using AgentKit and other Coinbase developer platform tools.
- **Stablecoins** - Develop an application that leverages Base's growing network of onchain currency stablecoins. Use cases can include: Personal Finance, Merchant Acceptance, DeFi, Business Applications and Cross Border Payments.
- **Mini-apps** - Use MiniKit to build a mini app that is distributed directly in the feed and leverages the social graph in unique ways.
- **Entertainment** - Create a consumer-facing app including in gaming, media, entertainment or whatever innovative idea you can dream up
- **Showcase** - Bring an existing app built before the buildathon, build a new feature and get judged on your entire submission.
- **Vibe Coding** - Vibe-code the next viral app on Base using [Ohara](https://ohara.ai/apps).
- **DeFi** - Redefine the boundaries of onchain DeFi infrastructure with [Uniswap v4](https://v4.uniswap.org/) hooks. Unlock custom liquidity logic, dynamic fees, rehypothecation, stablecoin-optimized pools, and beyond. Build it to be composable and easy to integrate.


Note: Teams can only win a single track.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

### WHY PARTICIPATE?
Join fellow builders in your region and dream up the next killer app and get the feedback, distribution, and the funding needed to take your build to the next level. Each region will have a prize pool of up to 7.5 ETH with 5 to 10+ winners selected from each region.

The top team from each track gets:
- **Rewards**: 1 ETH from Base.
- **Incubator Placement**: Each winning team will be placed into an incubator program.
- **Demo Day Invitation**: Teams will be invited to Demo Day this summer with up to $1m in funding.
- **Marketing & Distribution**: All winners will be featured on Base social channels (X, Warpcast) plus get a global stage to present during Demo Day.
- **Network**: Connections with some of the most prolific Base builders in your region, with direct access to the Base team.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

## HOW IT WORKS
In order to be eligible, the projects must follow the below rules:
- Must submit one project per team.
- Must include a functioning onchain app at a publicly accessible URL.
- Must include an open-source GitHub repository for all source code in the app (showcase track submissions can have closed source code).
- Must include a video, with a minimum length of 1 minute (Intro, Demo, Problem Statement, Solution, Architecture Overview) .
- Integrating Basenames and Smart Wallet is strongly recommended; they make it easy for anyone to get onchain.
- Must submit proof of deployment and 1+ transactions on Base mainnet.
- Apps built before the Buildathon are eligible for submission, but must clearly delineate what new feature or product was built during the Buildathon.
- **Only For Projects Submitted To The Vibe Coding Track**: Must submit a 10-page pitch deck alongside the prototype they vibe-coded. Submissions will be judged on a combination of the quality of the prototype, the idea, the GTM plan, and the team.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

## EVALUATION CRITERIA
- Onchain: Built on Base.
- Technicality: Functions as pitched.
- Originality: Innovation / originality to solve problems.
- Practicality: Usable and accessible by anyone.
- Aesthetics: Intuitive, easy-to-navigate.
- Wow Factor: Remarkable impact within time frame

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

## BUILDER RESOURCES

desc:
# What are Base Batches? 

*Enter a Base Batch Buildathon → Earn an incubator placement → Present on Demo Day*
![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)
We’re kicking off Base Batches, a global builder program that is bringing the next generation of builders from across the world to create industry defining applications onchain.

This is your chance to get noticed, get funded, and get the support you need post-buildathon to bring your idea to market.

Base Batches three part program consists of buildathon activations, incubator placements, and a season-ending Demo Day.

Over 50 teams and individuals that join our inaugural Base Batches Global Buildathon will be directly placed into incubator programs and invited to our season-ending Demo Day.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

## Supporters
This buildathon is supported by [Aerodrome](https://aerodrome.finance), [Farcaster](https://www.farcaster.xyz), [Uniswap Foundation](https://uniswapfoundation.org), [Ohara AI](https://ohara.ai), [BiLira](https://www.bilira.co/en/home), [IDRX](https://home.idrx.co/en), and [Virtuals Protocol](https://virtuals.io).
![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/7e2cf913793f4bddb809713a0bcd14ae/dd8007af-3c49-4704-b59c-c0880d5694f3.png)

## Base Batch #001 Demo Day

Top teams from this program will be invited to join Demo Day this summer to pitch on a public stage to top judges from across Coinbase, Base and our partners for a share of up to $1,000,000 in funding.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

### THE PROMPT
Simple. *Build the next killer onchain app.*

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

### TRACKS
We are going to select a minimum of 1-2 teams from each of the following tracks:

- **AI** - Build an AI agent on Base that can perform useful onchain actions using AgentKit and other Coinbase developer platform tools.
- **Stablecoins** - Develop an application that leverages Base's growing network of onchain currency stablecoins. Use cases can include: Personal Finance, Merchant Acceptance, DeFi, Business Applications and Cross Border Payments.
- **Mini-apps** - Use MiniKit to build a mini app that is distributed directly in the feed and leverages the social graph in unique ways.
- **Entertainment** - Create a consumer-facing app including in gaming, media, entertainment or whatever innovative idea you can dream up
- **Showcase** - Bring an existing app built before the buildathon, build a new feature and get judged on your entire submission.
- **Vibe Coding** - Vibe-code the next viral app on Base using [Ohara](https://ohara.ai/apps).
- **DeFi** - Redefine the boundaries of onchain DeFi infrastructure with [Uniswap v4](https://v4.uniswap.org/) hooks. Unlock custom liquidity logic, dynamic fees, rehypothecation, stablecoin-optimized pools, and beyond. Build it to be composable and easy to integrate.


Note: Teams can only win a single track.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

### WHY PARTICIPATE?
Join fellow builders in your region and dream up the next killer app and get the feedback, distribution, and the funding needed to take your build to the next level. Each region will have a prize pool of up to 7.5 ETH with 5 to 10+ winners selected from each region.

The top team from each track gets:
- **Rewards**: 1 ETH from Base.
- **Incubator Placement**: Each winning team will be placed into an incubator program.
- **Demo Day Invitation**: Teams will be invited to Demo Day this summer with up to $1m in funding.
- **Marketing & Distribution**: All winners will be featured on Base social channels (X, Warpcast) plus get a global stage to present during Demo Day.
- **Network**: Connections with some of the most prolific Base builders in your region, with direct access to the Base team.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

## HOW IT WORKS
In order to be eligible, the projects must follow the below rules:
- Must submit one project per team.
- Must include a functioning onchain app at a publicly accessible URL.
- Must include an open-source GitHub repository for all source code in the app (showcase track submissions can have closed source code).
- Must include a video, with a minimum length of 1 minute (Intro, Demo, Problem Statement, Solution, Architecture Overview) .
- Integrating Basenames and Smart Wallet is strongly recommended; they make it easy for anyone to get onchain.
- Must submit proof of deployment and 1+ transactions on Base mainnet.
- Apps built before the Buildathon are eligible for submission, but must clearly delineate what new feature or product was built during the Buildathon.
- **Only For Projects Submitted To The Vibe Coding Track**: Must submit a 10-page pitch deck alongside the prototype they vibe-coded. Submissions will be judged on a combination of the quality of the prototype, the idea, the GTM plan, and the team.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

## EVALUATION CRITERIA
- Onchain: Built on Base.
- Technicality: Functions as pitched.
- Originality: Innovation / originality to solve problems.
- Practicality: Usable and accessible by anyone.
- Aesthetics: Intuitive, easy-to-navigate.
- Wow Factor: Remarkable impact within time frame

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

name: Base Batch India
tagline: Join builders from across the world to create the next wave of industry defining applications onchain
desc:
# What are Base Batches? 

*Enter a Base Batch Buildathon → Earn an incubator placement → Present on Demo Day*
![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)
We’re kicking off Base Batches, a global builder program that is bringing the next generation of builders from across the world to create industry defining applications onchain.

This is your chance to get noticed, get funded, and get the support you need post-buildathon to bring your idea to market.

Base Batches three part program consists of buildathon activations, incubator placements, and a season-ending Demo Day.

Over 50 teams and individuals that join our inaugural Base Batches Global Buildathon will be directly placed into incubator programs and invited to our season-ending Demo Day.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

## Supporters
This buildathon is supported by [Aerodrome](https://aerodrome.finance), [Farcaster](https://www.farcaster.xyz), [Uniswap Foundation](https://uniswapfoundation.org), [Ohara AI](https://ohara.ai), and [Virtuals Protocol](https://virtuals.io).
![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/7e2cf913793f4bddb809713a0bcd14ae/69128fc4-0167-4835-a252-ae949e10d7e1.png)

## Base Batch #001 Demo Day

Top teams from this program will be invited to join Demo Day this summer to pitch on a public stage to top judges from across Coinbase, Base and our partners for a share of up to $1,000,000 in funding.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

### THE PROMPT
Simple. *Build the next killer onchain app.*

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

### TRACKS
We are going to select a minimum of 1-2 teams from each of the following tracks:

- **AI** - Build an AI agent on Base that can perform useful onchain actions using AgentKit and other Coinbase developer platform tools.
- **Stablecoins** - Develop an application that leverages Base's growing network of onchain currency stablecoins. Use cases can include: Personal Finance, Merchant Acceptance, DeFi, Business Applications and Cross Border Payments.
- **Mini-apps** - Use MiniKit to build a mini app that is distributed directly in the feed and leverages the social graph in unique ways.
- **Entertainment** - Create a consumer-facing app including in gaming, media, entertainment or whatever innovative idea you can dream up
- **Showcase** - Bring an existing app built before the buildathon, build a new feature and get judged on your entire submission.
- **Vibe Coding** - Vibe-code the next viral app on Base using [Ohara](https://ohara.ai/apps).
- **DeFi** - Redefine the boundaries of onchain DeFi infrastructure with [Uniswap v4](https://v4.uniswap.org/) hooks. Unlock custom liquidity logic, dynamic fees, rehypothecation, stablecoin-optimized pools, and beyond. Build it to be composable and easy to integrate.


Note: Teams can only win a single track.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

### WHY PARTICIPATE?
Join fellow builders in your region and dream up the next killer app and get the feedback, distribution, and the funding needed to take your build to the next level. Each region will have a prize pool of up to 7.5 ETH with 5 to 10+ winners selected from each region.

The top team from each track gets:
- **Rewards**: 1 ETH from Base.
- **Incubator Placement**: Each winning team will be placed into an incubator program.
- **Demo Day Invitation**: Teams will be invited to Demo Day this summer with up to $1m in funding.
- **Marketing & Distribution**: All winners will be featured on Base social channels (X, Warpcast) plus get a global stage to present during Demo Day.
- **Network**: Connections with some of the most prolific Base builders in your region, with direct access to the Base team.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

## HOW IT WORKS
In order to be eligible, the projects must follow the below rules:
- Must submit one project per team.
- Must include a functioning onchain app at a publicly accessible URL.
- Must include an open-source GitHub repository for all source code in the app (showcase track submissions can have closed source code).
- Must include a video, with a minimum length of 1 minute (Intro, Demo, Problem Statement, Solution, Architecture Overview) .
- Integrating Basenames and Smart Wallet is strongly recommended; they make it easy for anyone to get onchain.
- Must submit proof of deployment and 1+ transactions on Base mainnet.
- Apps built before the Buildathon are eligible for submission, but must clearly delineate what new feature or product was built during the Buildathon.
- **Only For Projects Submitted To The Vibe Coding Track**: Must submit a 10-page pitch deck alongside the prototype they vibe-coded. Submissions will be judged on a combination of the quality of the prototype, the idea, the GTM plan, and the team.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

## EVALUATION CRITERIA
- Onchain: Built on Base.
- Technicality: Functions as pitched.
- Originality: Innovation / originality to solve problems.
- Practicality: Usable and accessible by anyone.
- Aesthetics: Intuitive, easy-to-navigate.
- Wow Factor: Remarkable impact within time frame

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

## BUILDER RESOURCES
- [Getting Started on Base](https://www.base.org/getstarted)
- [Base Documentation](https://docs.base.org/)
- [Basenames (OnchainKit, Wagmi)](https://base.org/names)
- [Coinbase Developer Platform](https://docs.cdp.coinbase.com/)
- [Faucets (CDP, thirdweb)](https://portal.cdp.coinbase.com/products/faucet)
- [OnchainKit](https://onchainkit.xyz/)
- [Smart Wallet](https://smartwallet.dev/)
- [Telegram Group](https://t.me/+dydB0KinoZw5ZjYx) - You can join this group to interact with the Base India team.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

Additional resources can be found by visiting [base.org/builders](https://www.base.org/builders)

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

**Disclaimer**
*By using our services, you acknowledge and agree that all IP addresses and Ethereum wallet addresses are subject to screening against U.S. Department of the Treasury’s Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) lists. By accessing our services, you attest that you are not subject to any sanctions and are not on any OFAC lists, and we reserve the right to block transactions or interactions involving individuals, entities, or countries that are subject to U.S. sanctions.*

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

Read the T&C for the Buildathon [here](https://nsb.dev/base-batch-2025-terms-and-conditions).

name: Base Batch North America
tagline: Join builders from across the world to create the next wave of industry defining applications onchain
desc:
# What are Base Batches? 

*Enter a Base Batch Buildathon → Earn an incubator placement → Present on Demo Day*
![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)
We’re kicking off Base Batches, a global builder program that is bringing the next generation of builders from across the world to create industry defining applications onchain.

This is your chance to get noticed, get funded, and get the support you need post-buildathon to bring your idea to market.

Base Batches three part program consists of buildathon activations, incubator placements, and a season-ending Demo Day.

Over 50 teams and individuals that join our inaugural Base Batches Global Buildathon will be directly placed into incubator programs and invited to our season-ending Demo Day.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

## Supporters
This buildathon is supported by [Aerodrome](https://aerodrome.finance), [Farcaster](https://www.farcaster.xyz), [Uniswap Foundation](https://uniswapfoundation.org), [Ohara AI](https://ohara.ai), and [Virtuals Protocol](https://virtuals.io).
![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/7e2cf913793f4bddb809713a0bcd14ae/69128fc4-0167-4835-a252-ae949e10d7e1.png)

## Base Batch #001 Demo Day

Top teams from this program will be invited to join Demo Day this summer to pitch on a public stage to top judges from across Coinbase, Base and our partners for a share of up to $1,000,000 in funding.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

### THE PROMPT
Simple. *Build the next killer onchain app.*

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

### TRACKS
We are going to select a minimum of 1-2 teams from each of the following tracks:

- **AI** - Build an AI agent on Base that can perform useful onchain actions using AgentKit and other Coinbase developer platform tools.
- **Stablecoins** - Develop an application that leverages Base's growing network of onchain currency stablecoins. Use cases can include: Personal Finance, Merchant Acceptance, DeFi, Business Applications and Cross Border Payments.
- **Mini-apps** - Use MiniKit to build a mini app that is distributed directly in the feed and leverages the social graph in unique ways.
- **Entertainment** - Create a consumer-facing app including in gaming, media, entertainment or whatever innovative idea you can dream up
- **Showcase** - Bring an existing app built before the buildathon, build a new feature and get judged on your entire submission.
- **Vibe Coding** - Vibe-code the next viral app on Base using [Ohara](https://ohara.ai/apps).
- **DeFi** - Redefine the boundaries of onchain DeFi infrastructure with [Uniswap v4](https://v4.uniswap.org/) hooks. Unlock custom liquidity logic, dynamic fees, rehypothecation, stablecoin-optimized pools, and beyond. Build it to be composable and easy to integrate.


Note: Teams can only win a single track.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

### WHY PARTICIPATE?
Join fellow builders in your region and dream up the next killer app and get the feedback, distribution, and the funding needed to take your build to the next level. Each region will have a prize pool of up to 7.5 ETH with 5 to 10+ winners selected from each region.

The top team from each track gets:
- **Rewards**: 1 ETH from Base.
- **Incubator Placement**: Each winning team will be placed into an incubator program.
- **Demo Day Invitation**: Teams will be invited to Demo Day this summer with up to $1m in funding.
- **Marketing & Distribution**: All winners will be featured on Base social channels (X, Warpcast) plus get a global stage to present during Demo Day.
- **Network**: Connections with some of the most prolific Base builders in your region, with direct access to the Base team.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

## HOW IT WORKS
In order to be eligible, the projects must follow the below rules:
- Must submit one project per team.
- Must include a functioning onchain app at a publicly accessible URL.
- Must include an open-source GitHub repository for all source code in the app (showcase track submissions can have closed source code).
- Must include a video, with a minimum length of 1 minute (Intro, Demo, Problem Statement, Solution, Architecture Overview) .
- Integrating Basenames and Smart Wallet is strongly recommended; they make it easy for anyone to get onchain.
- Must submit proof of deployment and 1+ transactions on Base mainnet.
- Apps built before the Buildathon are eligible for submission, but must clearly delineate what new feature or product was built during the Buildathon.
- **Only For Projects Submitted To The Vibe Coding Track**: Must submit a 10-page pitch deck alongside the prototype they vibe-coded. Submissions will be judged on a combination of the quality of the prototype, the idea, the GTM plan, and the team.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

## EVALUATION CRITERIA
- Onchain: Built on Base.
- Technicality: Functions as pitched.
- Originality: Innovation / originality to solve problems.
- Practicality: Usable and accessible by anyone.
- Aesthetics: Intuitive, easy-to-navigate.
- Wow Factor: Remarkable impact within time frame

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

## BUILDER RESOURCES
- [Getting Started on Base](https://www.base.org/getstarted)
- [Base Documentation](https://docs.base.org/)
- [Basenames (OnchainKit, Wagmi)](https://base.org/names)
- [Coinbase Developer Platform](https://docs.cdp.coinbase.com/)
- [Faucets (CDP, thirdweb)](https://portal.cdp.coinbase.com/products/faucet)
- [OnchainKit](https://onchainkit.xyz/)
- [Smart Wallet](https://smartwallet.dev/)

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

Additional resources can be found by visiting [base.org/builders](https://www.base.org/builders)

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

**Disclaimer**

By accessing our services, you attest that you are not subject to any sanctions and are not on any OFAC lists, and we reserve the right to block transactions or interactions involving individuals, entities, or countries that are subject to U.S. sanctions.*

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

name: KVGCE Hackwise
desc:
All that you need to know about KVGCE Hackwise Hackathon 2025 – 24-Hour Offline AI Hackathon on Space Station Safety
KVGCE Hackwise 2025 – 24-Hour Offline AI Hackathon on Space Station Safety
Opportunity Details:
KVGCE Hackwise 2025 is a 24-hour offline AI hackathon where participants will tackle AI-powered space station safety challenges. Teams will develop AI models for anomaly detection in a simulated space station environment, using FalconEditor VMs and AI training resources provided by our tech partner, Duality AI.

KVGCE Hackwise 2025 is a 24-hour AI hackathon organized by Sphere Hive and KVG College of Engineering, bringing together top innovators to tackle real-world challenges.

Eligibility:
Open to all college students across India.
Inter-college teams allowed.
Inter-specialization teams allowed.
Team Size: Maximum 4 members.

Hackathon Format:
Round 1: Online Submission (Shortlisting Stage)

Teams must submit a 2-minute video or a PPT explaining their problem-solving approach.
Top 25 teams will be shortlisted for the final offline hackathon.
Round 2: 24-Hour Offline Hackathon (April 25-26, 2025)

Single Round: 24 hours of coding, problem-solving, and innovation.
Problem Statement: Develop AI models for anomaly detection in a simulated space station environment.
Tools Provided: FalconEditor, Cloud VMs, AI training resources.
Deliverables: AI Model, Documentation, and Final Presentation.
Registration Fee for Shortlisted Teams:
Shortlisted 25 teams will pay ₹499 per team for the final offline round.
This fee covers event logistics, food, and necessary resources for the hackathon.

Rules & Regulations:
Each team must have Max 4 members.
Participants must bring their own laptops and chargers.
All development must be done during the hackathon timeframe.
Teams must strictly adhere to the problem statement and guidelines.
Final submissions should include working AI models, proper documentation, and a presentation.
The decision of the judging panel will be final and binding.

Judging Criteria:
Model Accuracy & Performance (30%)
Innovation & Uniqueness (25%)
Feasibility & Scalability (20%)
Technical Implementation & Documentation (15%)
Presentation & Communication (10%)

Exciting Rewards & Perks!
Prizes for the Top Teams:
1st Place: ₹40,000 + Trophy + Goodies.
2nd Place: ₹10,000 + Trophy + Goodies.
3rd Place: Goodies + Perks.

Additional Perks for All Participants:
Certificates for every participant.
Hands-on experience with cutting-edge AI tools.

Accommodation & Food Details:
Food: Free for all participants throughout the event.
Accommodation:

Available at a reasonable price for participants who arrive a day before the hackathon or need to stay after the event.
This ensures a comfortable stay for those traveling from different locations.
Additional Event Details:
Registration Launch Event: March 5 2025.
Venue: KVG College of Engineering, Karnataka.

Don’t miss out on this opportunity to innovate, collaborate, and build the future of AI-powered space safety!

Register now and be a part of KVGCE Hackwise 2025!
location: K.V.G. College of Engineering, Kurunjibhag, Dakshina Kannada, Karnataka, India

# 🚀Code. Create. Conquer. | 24-Hour Hackathon Challenge!

Are you ready to push the limits of your creativity, code, and caffeine intake? Welcome to **Zenith 4.0**, the ultimate 24-hour hackathon where developers, designers, and innovators come together to build, break, and brainstorm their way to the next big thing!

📅 **Dates:** April 25-26, 2025
📍 **Venue:** J.C. Bose University of Science & Technology, YMCA, Faridabad
🌐 **Mode:** Online Ideation + 24-Hour Offline Hackathon

## **Why Participate?**
Exciting cash prizes and in-kind rewards for top teams.
Networking and industry exposure.
Goodies, swags, and premium courses for participants.
Free meals throughout the event.
A high-energy, fun-filled atmosphere with music, creativity, and collaboration.
Jamming session to unwind and connect with fellow hackers.

## **How It Works:**
1️⃣ Register and submit your project idea.
2️⃣ Top teams will qualify for the 24-hour offline hackathon.
3️⃣ Build, showcase, and win exciting prizes!

This is your chance to network, learn, and innovate in a high-energy environment. Join us in shaping the future of technology!

## **Hackathon Guidelines**

### **Eligibility:**
Open to undergraduate students from any recognized university or institution.
Inter-college and inter-specialization teams are welcome.
Each team must have 2-4 members.

### **Hackathon Format:**

1. Registration Phase:
     -  Teams must register through the official portal before the deadline.

     -  Only selected teams from this round will move forward to the final offline round.

3. Final Hackathon (Development Phase):
     - Duration: 24 hours.
     - Develop your prototype within the given timeframe.
     - Mentorship sessions will be available to guide teams.

4. Final Presentation & Demo:
     - Teams will showcase their working prototype to a panel of judges.

## **Prizes & Perks**
Prize Pool of Rs. 1,00,000+
Exciting cash prizes for top-performing teams.
Certificates and swags for the winners.
A chance to connect with tech leaders and gain industry exposure.

desc:
**HackO'Clock**: Where Innovation Meets Impact!
Get ready for **HackO'Clock**—**an electrifying 24-hour hackathon that brings together brilliant minds to solve real-world challenges through technology!**
Whether you're a coder, designer, or problem-solver, this is your chance to innovate, collaborate, and compete in a fast-paced environment. Showcase your technical expertise, creativity, and teamwork while building solutions that make a difference.

**Date: April 24, 2025**
**Hackathon Theme: Solve for the 17 Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)**
HackO'Clock challenges participants to create innovative solutions aligned with the **United Nations’ 17 Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)**. Your project can leverage technology to address global challenges and contribute to a sustainable future.

Learn more about the **17 SDGs** here: [https://sdgs.un.org/goals](https://sdgs.un.org/goals)

**Why Participate?**
Exciting cash prizes and in-kind rewards for top teams.
Multiple opportunities, including internships, networking, and industry exposure.
Google goodies, swags, and premium courses for participants.
Free meals throughout the event.
A high-energy, fun-filled atmosphere with music, creativity, and collaboration.
Jamming session to unwind and connect with fellow hackers.
**Hackathon Guidelines**
**Eligibility**:
Open to undergraduate and postgraduate students from any recognized university or institution.
Inter-college and inter-specialization teams are welcome.
Each team must have exactly **four members**.
**Hackathon Format**:
**1. Registration Phase**:
Teams must register through the official portal before the deadline.
**2. Round 1(Shortlisting Round)**:PPT Submission
Submit a brief proposal detailing your problem statement, solution approach, and technology stack.
**Submission Deadline: April 20th, 2025.**
Here is the [Google Form link](https://forms.gle/vgEtvn8GpN82Qbf29) for PPT submission.
Only selected teams from this round will move forward to the final offline round.

Participants must use the provided PPT Submission Template for idea submission. The template can be accessed here: [PPT Template](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1q094KLbMvogtC5JFJeg2MVBbgDDGXk4B).
 

**Final Hackathon (Development Phase)**:

Duration: 24 hours.
Develop your prototype within the given timeframe.
Mentorship sessions will be available to guide teams.
**4. Final Presentation & Demo**:
Teams will showcase their working prototype to a panel of judges.
Time Limit: 10 minutes for the presentation + 5 minutes for Q&A.
**Rules & Regulations**
All projects must be developed during the hackathon (no pre-existing work).
Open-source tools and frameworks are allowed (plagiarism is strictly prohibited).
Proper documentation and code repositories must be provided.
Respect the time limits and deadlines for each phase.
Judges' decisions are final and binding.
Any form of misconduct, including cheating or harassment, will result in immediate disqualification.
**Judging Criteria**
Innovation & Creativity – 25%
Technical Implementation – 25%
Feasibility & Scalability – 15%
Presentation & Communication – 15%
Use of Google Technologies – (Bonus points for integrating Google tools and APIs effectively)
**Prizes & Perks**
Exciting cash prizes for top-performing teams.
Certificates and internship opportunities for winners.
A chance to connect with tech leaders and gain industry exposure.

For any queries, reach out to the organizing team at hackoclock.gdgiilm@gmail.com

name: HACKTONIX 2K25
desc:
Hacktonix is the 4th edition of the in-person grand hackathon under Phoenix'25,  the annual techno-management fest of the Future Institute of Engineering and Management, organized by Team Xplorica.

This event is all about working in teams, using your brains, and blending up all your ideas to come up with an innovative and out-of-the-box project. This is a 24-hour-long in-person hackathon aiming to bring young creative minds together.

Prove your worth in these 24 hours by ideating, innovating, and hacking meaningful solutions to real-life problems.

**Hacktonix will be divided into two rounds:**

-   1st Round (Date: 12th March to 31st March 2025)
    -   Register your team on Devfolio portal and submit your idea.
    -   Submission of your Idea following the provided sample .ppt.
    -   Shortlisting (Date: 2nd April 2025)
    -   Shortlisted top 30 teams will be proceeding to the next round.
    -   **If your team is shortlisted you have to fill up a google form which will be provided to you via a confirmation mail, where you have to pay an amount of Rs. 200/- per team ASAP. Failing will lead to disqualification of the team.**
    -   Those teams will be informed by mail on 2nd April, 2025 at EOD and teams will have to confirm their participation for the offline hackathon before 4th April, 2025 by e-mail.
-   In-Person Final Round (Date: 12th April to 13th April, 2025)
    -   24 hrs In-Person Hackathon on FIEM Campus where they will have to build the project over the idea that they have submitted previously.
    -   Teams will be presenting their project in front of the judge’s panel.

**Hacktonix Topics:**

-   Web3 & Blockchain
-   Gen AI
-   Cloud
-   Health-Tech
-   Ed-Tech
-   Fin-Tech
-   Agriculture-Tech
-   Open Innovation

**Note:**
-   The shortlisted participants will have to bear their own snacks and travel expenses.
-   Accommodation will only be provided on the day of the hackathon.
-   Wi-Fi & two plug points will be provided by us. If needed teams are advised to bring their own extension cords.

Get ready for an electrifying **24-hour offline hackathon!** Rota-TechX, the flagship event of the Rotaract Club of Sri Venkateswara College of Engineering, is back—bigger and bolder than ever. 🔥 24 hours of intense coding & creativity

🏆 Exciting prizes, networking & internship opportunities
🎉 Fun-filled sessions to keep the energy high

Participants must submit an abstract detailing their proposed solution.

# **Hello World Hacks Themes :**

> 🚀 **AI for Good** focuses on building AI-powered solutions that address societal challenges like accessibility, sustainability, and education.  

> 🔗 **Decentralized Future: Blockchain & Web3** explores secure, transparent, and decentralized applications using blockchain technology.  

> 🏥 **HealthTech & Wellness** aims to develop applications improving healthcare accessibility, mental well-being, and fitness.  

> 🌱 **Green Tech & Sustainability** leverages technology to combat climate change, promote sustainability, and protect the environment.  

> 🏦 **FinTech & Smart Transactions** drives innovation in financial solutions to enhance accessibility, security, and automation in banking and payments.  

> 🎮 **Gamified Learning & EdTech** enhances education through interactive, AI-driven, or gamified learning experiences.  

> 🛡️ **SafeTech+** emphasizes predictive safety and autonomous response through AI and decentralized networks for proactive security.  

> ✈️ **Smart Tourism & Cultural Tech** revolutionizes tourism through AI, AR/VR experiences, and smart travel planning, enhancing exploration and accessibility.

name: Cepheus
tagline: 🚀 Code the Stars, Create the Future! 🌠
desc:
# 🚀 Cepheus 2025 🌌  

Welcome to **Cepheus 2025**, a **24-hour Hackathon** where **innovation, creativity, and collaboration** take center stage!  
This hackathon is a **beacon for developers, designers, and problem-solvers** looking to push the boundaries of technology and create groundbreaking solutions.

## 📅 Event Details  
- **Date:** April 10-11, 2025  
- **Location:** AIT Campus  
- **Hosted by:** GDG on Campus AIT & Code Club  

Cepheus provides a **platform to innovate, learn, and connect** with **industry leaders, mentors, and fellow tech enthusiasts**.  
Whether you’re a **seasoned hacker** or a **first-time participant**, this is your **chance to turn ideas into reality**!

---

## 💡 Why Join Cepheus Hackathon?  
✅ **Code & Innovate** – Tackle real-world challenges with cutting-edge tech.  
✅ **Network with Experts** – Interact with industry mentors, sponsors, and like-minded innovators.  
✅ **Showcase Your Talent** – Compete for exciting prizes and recognition.  
✅ **Exclusive Sponsor Sessions** – Learn from tech giants and industry pioneers.  
✅ **Internship Opportunities** – Stand a chance to gain valuable internships.

---

## 📍 Roadmap to Cepheus Hackathon 2025 🚀  

- **🔹 February 10th, 2025** – Registrations Open 🎉  
- **🔹 March 30th, 2025** – Announcement of Selected Teams begins 📢  
- **🔹 April 4th, 2025** – Registrations Close ⏳  
- **🔹 April 10th & 11th, 2025** – The Ultimate Hackathon Experience Begins! 💻🔥  

✨ Get ready to **code, innovate, and make an impact**! 🌟  

---

## 🎯 Themes & Problem Statements  

At **Cepheus Hackathon 2025**, we aim to drive **innovation** by tackling some of the **most pressing challenges** in society. Participants will work on real-world problems across various domains, crafting scalable and impactful solutions.

> 💡 **All solutions must incorporate AI** in some form, whether for **automation, optimization, decision-making**, or **enhancing user experience**, ensuring **cutting-edge** and **future-ready** innovations. 🚀  

---

## 📝 Detailed Problem Statements

### 🤖 AI & Education (Sponsor Track)
- **Problem:** Revolutionizing Student Education with AI-Generated Video Content  
  Creating educational content manually is time-consuming and limits scalability. AI-powered automation could personalize and scale content creation, making education more accessible.
- **✅ Objective:** Develop an AI-driven solution that generates engaging, high-quality educational video content, providing personalized learning experiences across multiple disciplines.  
  **Note:** Those who select the Sponsor problem statement will be eligible for a potential internship, and if their solution is good enough, they are eligible to earn an additional prize.

---

### 🌐 India Stack
- **Problem:** Leveraging India's Digital Transformation for Inclusive Innovation  
  India Stack, a comprehensive suite of open APIs, has revolutionized India's digital infrastructure, enabling seamless, presence-less, paperless, and cashless service delivery.
- **✅ Objective:** Develop solutions that leverage both established and emerging components of India Stack—including Aadhaar, eKYC, UPI, DigiLocker, eSign, Bharat Bill Payment System, BharatQR, UMANG, Open Credit Enablement Network (OCEN), Open Network for Digital Commerce (ONDC), Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission, DigiYatra, and Government e Marketplace (GeM)—to address real-world challenges. Participants are encouraged to create applications that enhance financial inclusion, streamline digital identity verification, improve healthcare delivery, and promote secure, efficient digital transactions, thereby contributing to India's digital transformation.

---

### 🌍 Healthcare for All
- **Problem:** Lack of Access to Healthcare in Underserved Communities  
  Many rural and remote communities lack access to basic healthcare services, leading to preventable diseases and reduced quality of life. Barriers include poor infrastructure, medical professional shortages, and limited awareness of preventive care.
- **✅ Objective:** Develop scalable, sustainable, and tech-driven solutions to improve healthcare access in underserved areas. Your solution should align with UN SDG 3: Good Health and Well-being.

---

### 🌾 AgriTech & Sustainability
- **Problem:** Harvesting the Future – AI Solutions for Smallholder Farmers  
  Smallholder farmers lack access to advanced agricultural technologies, leading to low crop yields, inefficient resource use, and climate vulnerability. With AI-powered solutions, farmers can make better decisions and improve productivity.
- **✅ Objective:** Design an AI-based system that assists farmers with real-time crop monitoring, pest detection, and resource optimization, ensuring affordable and scalable solutions for developing regions.

---

### 🎓 AI for Academic Excellence
- **Problem:** Students often struggle with keeping track of tasks, setting clear goals, and organizing study content, making regular revision and preparation overwhelming.  
- **✅ Objective:** Develop an AI-powered solution that streamlines task tracking, goal management, and content organization for students, enhancing their ability to prepare and revise effectively.

---

### 💧 Smart Water Management
- **Problem:** Inefficient water distribution and management lead to wastage and supply issues in both urban and rural areas. Traditional systems lack automation and real-time adaptability.  
- **✅ Objective:** Create an automated water distribution system using AI to optimize water management, detect leaks, predict demand, and improve overall efficiency.

---

### 🧱 3D Modeling: From Imagination to Reality
- **Problem:** Converting creative visions into tangible 3D models can be a labor-intensive and complex process, often requiring advanced technical skills and precision.  
- **✅ Objective:** Develop an AI-assisted tool that empowers users to craft detailed and precise 3D models by hand, bridging the gap between imaginative ideas and physical design.

---

### 🏗️ AI for Construction Efficiency
- **Problem:** The construction industry faces significant challenges in accurate cost estimation and maintaining strict safety standards, often leading to budget overruns and compromised safety.  
- **✅ Objective:** Create an AI-powered solution that delivers precise construction cost estimations while simultaneously ensuring safety compliance through real-time data analytics and predictive modeling.

---

### 📈 AI-Enhanced Digital Marketing Strategy
- **Problem:** With the rapid evolution of technology, traditional digital marketing strategies are losing their edge, making it difficult for well-known brands to remain competitive.  
- **✅ Objective:** Develop a comprehensive, AI-driven digital marketing strategy that leverages advanced analytics and creative automation to redefine a brand’s marketing approach for the next decade.

---

### 🌍 Open Innovation (Wildcard Track)
- **Problem:** Have a unique, groundbreaking idea outside these problem statements?  
  This is your chance to innovate freely! Bring your own problem statement and build something revolutionary.
- **✅ Objective:** Solve a pressing issue of your choice using technology and innovation.

---

## 🏆 What’s in it for You?  

🏅 **Exciting Prizes & Swag** – Compete for top-tier rewards and exclusive goodies.  
📢 **Pitch Your Idea** – Present your project to a panel of esteemed judges.  
🤝 **Networking Opportunities** – Meet developers, designers, and industry leaders.  
🛠 **Tech Stack Support** – Get mentorship and hands-on support for your project.

---

## 🎯 Who Can Participate?  

🔹 **College Students (UG & PG)**  
🔹 **Developers, Designers & Innovators**  
🔹 **Anyone passionate about building tech-driven solutions**  

No matter your experience level, **Cepheus Hackathon** is the place to **learn, innovate, and grow**!

Let’s **build the future together** at **Cepheus Hackathon 2025!** 🌠

name: Bio x AI Hackathon 2025
tagline: Shape the Future of Agentic Science
desc:
# [Join the Discord!](https://discord.com/invite/bioxyz)

# Bio x AI Hackathon: Build the Future of Science with AI

**Subheadline:** Be part of the open-source revolution at the convergence of biotechnology and artificial intelligence. Develop AI-driven tools to accelerate scientific discovery through knowledge graphs.

**Why Participate?**

* **Shape the Future of Science:** Contribute to the development of digitally native systems that reimagine how scientific knowledge is created, shared, and utilized.
* **Solve Real-World Challenges:** Focus on building tools that organize scientific information, generate meaningful connections between research, and produce novel hypotheses.
* **Work with Cutting-Edge Technology:** Leverage the power of AI, knowledge graphs, and potentially blockchain to transform basic and translational research.
* **Collaborate with Experts:** Connect with researchers, developers, and BioDAO community members. Receive mentorship from expert judges in MetaScience, AI, DeSci, and BioTech.
* **Build Plugins for Eliza:** Develop self-contained software pieces that solve specific scientific problems, connect to the Eliza AI framework, and work together in a larger ecosystem.
* **Win Prizes:** Compete for a share of the \$125,000 prize pool across multiple challenge categories, including Scientific Outcomes and CoreAgent Development.
* **Be at the Forefront of DeSci:** Help build the infrastructure for a more open, transparent, and efficient research ecosystem.

**Hackathon Focus:**

The Bio x AI Hackathon focuses specifically on scientific outcomes derived from knowledge graph creation and utilization. We aim to empower developers to build tools that:

* Organize scientific information.
* Generate meaningful connections between disparate research.
* Produce novel hypotheses that can advance scientific discovery.

Projects should leverage the power of AI to extract, structure, analyze, and derive insights from scientific data, with a particular emphasis on basic and translational research.

**Key Challenges:**

* Transforming Scientific Systems: Envisioning and building digitally native systems for science that transcend legacy constraints.
* Addressing the Research Funding Challenge: Developing innovative solutions to maximize resources and accelerate discovery.
* Harnessing AI for Good: Building robust systems to track and verify scientific claims, preserve research context, and enhance reproducibility.

**Expected Outcomes:**

You'll be developing "plugins" for the Eliza AI framework, an intelligent scientific assistant. These plugins are self-contained pieces of software that:

* Solve a specific scientific problem or provide a particular capability.
* Connect to Eliza through standardized interfaces.
* Can be developed independently but work together in the larger ecosystem.

**Open Source Commitment:**

All submissions must be open source to foster collaboration and innovation:

* MIT License Requirement
* Public Repositories (e.g., GitHub)
* Clear Documentation
* Structure for Community Contribution

**Important Dates:**

* April 8-10: Hackathon Kickoff (In Person: [https://lu.ma/BioAIHackathonApply](https://lu.ma/BioAIHackathonApply) & Virtual: [https://lu.ma/bio-agents](https://lu.ma/bio-agents))
* April - June: Virtual Hacking Phase
* June 10-11: Hackathon Closeout

**Prize Structure**

The hackathon has three main prize pools:

* **\$75,000 - Scientific Outcomes:** This track focuses on projects that generate meaningful scientific outputs, emphasizing information organization, knowledge graph generation, and hypothesis generation.
* **\$35,000 - CoreAgent Development:** This prize is dedicated to projects that address specific challenges faced by bioDAOs. Hackers will be given scoped problem statements defined by the founders and operators of BioDAOs and asked to solve the problems.
* **\$15,000 - Discretionary Prizes:** This portion of the prize pool will be allocated at the discretion of Bio.XYZ to recognize various valuable contributions.

**Judging Criteria:**

**Purposeful Flexibility in Evaluation**

We have intentionally designed the prize criteria with a degree of flexibility to allow judges to exercise their expert judgment. The scientific process is inherently creative and multifaceted, and we believe that prescriptive evaluation metrics might inadvertently constrain innovation or miss breakthrough approaches that don't fit neatly into predefined boxes.

Judges have the autonomy to identify and reward excellence as you see it in your domain of expertise. That said, we do provide the following general guidelines to help frame your project:

**General Evaluation Guidelines (subject to change)**

1.  **Scientific Impact**
    * Potential to meaningfully advance scientific research or knowledge
    * Novelty and originality of the approach to knowledge graph creation or utilization
    * Quality of insights or hypotheses generated
    * Anticipation of future scientific research needs in the age of AI
2.  **Technical Implementation**
    * Quality and robustness of the knowledge graph model or architecture
    * Appropriate use of AI techniques for knowledge extraction and connection
    * Technical sophistication and innovation
    * Data handling and processing methods
3.  **Usability and Accessibility**
    * Ease of use for scientific researchers
    * Clear and intuitive visualization or presentation of complex data
    * Documentation quality and comprehensiveness
    * Potential for adoption by the broader scientific community
4.  **Sustainability and Scalability**
    * Potential for continued development and improvement
    * Ability to scale to larger datasets or different scientific domains
    * Approach to maintaining data quality and accuracy over time
    * Open-source commitment and community engagement potential

**Ready to Build the Future of Science? Learn More at:**
* [ai.bio.xyz](ai.bio.xyz)
* [About the Vision](https://www.bio.xyz/blog-posts/bioagents-pioneering-decentralized-science-with-ai-agents)
* [Docs](https://ai-docs.bio.xyz/)
* [Join the Telegram for updates](https://t.me/bioagentbuilders)
* [Join the Discord to start building!](https://discord.com/invite/bioxyz)

> **NOTE** - All Team Members have to submit this form with 1 idea 1 PPT and all have to submit the same.

**DevsHouse ‘25** an **Major League Hacking (MLH)** partnered event is a national level physical hackathon in which students from various colleges from across the country will be participating. We intend to carry it out utilizing a variety of tech stacks that are innovative in nature. 

As a part of the hackathon, participants will have 36 hours of hacking time to brainstorm and develop creative solutions to challenges in the real world during this 48-hour event. This hackathon aims to foster invention, teamwork, and collaboration. 

# Eligibility Criteria:
1.Submission of ideas must strictly adhere to the provided template for the PPT: [DevsHouse PPT](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1SeZJgo6eDeWyfPyGQdSuHQf16G_AERVg/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=110739729685634590613&rtpof=true&sd=true)
2. Participants should form a team with a minimum of 2 and a maximum of 4 members.
3. All participants need to submit their idea, as part of a team, only then their team shall be considered.
# Submission Rules
1. Round 1 will be conducted entirely online.
2. Participants are required to submit their ideas for any problem statement within the domains before the deadline of March 2nd.
3. Participants should adhere to the submission template found on Devfolio.
4. The selected teams should RSVP within 2 days of the Round 1 result announcement by (March 9th). The team will not be considered for the finals if not RSVPed.
5. Participants who are shortlisted for Round 2 should develop their solution only during the offline round. The days can be used for planning their solution, researching existing solutions, etc., but the core development should take place during the hackathon only.
6. Participants should not bring existing projects from previous hackathons. If found without prior disclosure, the team will be disqualified.
7. The duration for the on-site Hackathon is 36 hours, and power supply/internet connection for the participants will be provided.
8. A Jury Panel consisting of external judges, sponsors and tech experts will be assigned to judge the idea based on standard metrics of innovation, implementation, impact factor, feasibility, and presentation.
9. Jury Panel Decision is Final.
10. Members can be from different colleges, provided they are pursuing a degree.
11. Team changing or shuffling will not be entertained.

## **What is the Seoulana Hackathon 2025?**

Seoulana Hackathon 2025 is a dynamic three-day Solana hackathon set in Seoul, bringing together global innovators to build cutting-edge decentralized applications. With up to $100,000 of prizes and support from industry leaders, this event offers a unique opportunity for builders to shape the future of blockchain technology.

## **Why Participate?**

- **Build and Win** : Compete for $100,000 of prizes across General Track and Special Track.
- **Innovate on Solana** : Build cutting-edge DApps leveraging Solana's robust SDKs, tools, and developer-friendly ecosystem.
- **Mentorship & Networking with Solana Ecosystem Leaders :** Access regular office hours and connect with Solana ecosystem leaders and industry experts.

## **How does it work?**

**Tracks and Prizes**

- Multiple tracks with $100,000 of prize pools
- Rewards distributed among top projects in each track
- Additional bonus pool for outstanding integrations

**Rules**

- Participate individually or in teams (1-5 members)
- Winners must complete KYC and provide payment details for prizes

**Logistics**

- Projects evaluated by Solana ecosystem experts and sponsors
- Registration, submissions, and payouts managed through Devfolio
- Regular mentorship and support throughout the hackathon

## Get Started

- **March 4**: Registration opens. Complete the application form via Devfolio.
- **April 4**: Attend the Opening Ceremony. Hackathon officially begins and submissions open.
- **April 4-6**: Participate in workshops, mentoring sessions, and office hours. Receive ongoing support via our Discord channel.
- **April 6**: Submission due & Winner announcement. Projects will be evaluated by a panel of track sponsors and ecosystem experts.
