name: HashHacks 7.00
desc:
**What will I do at HashHacks?**

One task. One team. 24 hours. Break free of all bounds and develop something exciting. Something innovative. Something which has the ability to create a better world!

Code your way through this 24 hours hackathon where you focus your time, energy, and enthusiasm on building a product or service which can help create change. Because, using good software feels good. But building one feels even better!

**What is HashHacks?**

HashHacks is CIC's flagship hackathon, conducted under Convoke, CIC's annual Tech Fest. You would be surprised to know that CIC is Delhi University's only engineering college, and it is an amazing place for coders, musicians, researchers, and even photographers! HashHacks and Convoke are being organized after 3 whole pandemic years, and we promise, you won't go back disappointed.

**Why should I join?**

Join us offline for prizes valued at over Rs. 20 Thousand, free snacks, FREE COFFEE, and unlimited FUN + LEARNING! We hope to see you at CIC, DU's only engineering college!

**What about the theme and the mode?**

HashHacks will be conducted in a offline mode! HashHacks is also open theme, that is, we will accept a diverse range of projects!

**How will the projects be judged?**

The projects will be judged on the basis of the following criteria:

**Innovation:** How can someone not think of innovation while building a project in the Cluster Innovation Centre? We will be judging how innovative your project is. Does your project already exist somewhere on the internet? If yes, how is it different from the existing ones? Is it solving a problem more efficiently? Or is it a completely new idea?

**Originality:** How original is your project idea? We all copy code from the internet, but does your project consist only of copied code?

**Social impact:** How about helping humankind with your project? Is your project limited to programmers or will it be impacting our society in a positive way? Everyone loves projects which are aimed at social good.

**Technicalities:** We will obviously be judging your project on how technically great it is. Maybe you created a CI/CD pipeline for your project? Or, binded Rust with Python? Or, used Docker in the deployment process?

**Market readiness:** We know, it is quite impossible to create a project that is market ready in 24 hours, but, this will earn you extra points! Created a website? DEPLOY IT! An Android application? ADD THE RELEASE APK FILE TO GITHUB RELEASES!

**How much did you learn?:** Is this your first hackathon and you ended up creating a full stack project with an automated deployment pipeline? Or, is this your nth hackathon and you created a project that you are very familiar with? Learning always pays off, and we don't want beginners to feel intimidated by experienced hackers!

**Project guidelines**

We all copy code, and it is totally fine to copy someone else's code. But, you must attribute the copied code in the README file of your project. Should you attribute documentation? No. Should you attribute a logic written by someone else as a StackOverflow answer? Yes!

You must maintain a realistic git commit history. We will be going through your commit history to catch any malpractices. Did you commit the complete code in one go? That is very suspicious and we might disqualify your project. You made 100 commits with a really messed up commit history? Now that sounds like a realistic development cycle!

Your project must have a README.md file explaining bits and pieces of your project.

Your project must be open-sourced on GitHub.

Your project must be submitted through Devfolio.

**Rules**

Follow the [Code of Conduct](https://convoke.in).

name: Sustainovate'25
desc:
# **Sustainovate Hackathon 2025**

Sustainovate is a **48-hour hackathon** organized by **NexIntel Synergy**, a recently founded startup specializing in innovative tech solutions for a sustainable future. This event brings together tech enthusiasts, developers, and problem-solvers to create impactful, sustainable solutions using technology.

The hackathon is open to all skill levels, providing participants an opportunity to work on real-world challenges. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced developer, this is your chance to learn, collaborate, and showcase your abilities in the field of sustainability.

---

## **Eligibility:**

- **Open to all skill levels:** Beginners, intermediates, and pros are encouraged to join.
- **Solo Participation:** This is an individual hackathon; team submissions will not be accepted.
- **Inter-college Participation:** Students from any college or institution are welcome.
- **Inter-specialization Participation:** Open to all fields (Engineering, Science, Design, etc.).
- **Age Limit:** No age restrictions.

---

## **Hackathon Format:**

### **Problem Statements:**

- The hackathon will feature multiple problem statements related to sustainability and technology.
- Participants will select one challenge to work on and develop a solution within the event timeline.
- The challenges will test creativity, technical skills, and the ability to build sustainable solutions with a positive impact on society and the environment.

### **Event Structure:**

1. **Problem Statement Release:** The hackathon begins with the release of problem statements.
2. **Solution Development:** Participants will have **48 hours** to develop their solutions.
3. **Final Submissions & Presentations:** Participants must submit their projects before the deadline. Judges will review all submissions, and top solutions will be selected.

### **Platform & Tools:**

- The hackathon will be hosted on the [Sustainovate website](www.sustainovate.tech), where updates, submissions, and communication will take place.
- Participants can use any programming language, frameworks, or tools, but all work must be original.

---

## **Latest News & Gift Reveals:**

Stay updated on news, gift announcements, and event details by following:
- **[Sustainovate Website](www.sustainovate.tech)**
- **[Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/nexintel_synergy/)**
- **[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/nexintel-synergy-pvt-ltd/)**

Exciting perks such as swag items and additional surprises will be revealed soon!

---

## **Rules & Guidelines:**

- **Solo Participation:** Team submissions will not be accepted.
- **Original Work:** Participants must ensure that their work is original. Any plagiarism or copying will result in disqualification.
- **Google Form Registration:** All participants must fill out the [registration form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSe_L5DOWdlbEzebWWVbU1Mhl1_t4oQeIpQJquadCaL1ThBdxQ/viewform).

### **Project Submission Requirements:**

- **GitHub Repository:** Submit a GitHub link with your project code.
- **Demo Video:** Provide a short video demonstrating your solution.
- **Deployment (If Possible):** If feasible, deploy your solution and submit the live demo link.
- **Use of External Libraries & Tools:** Open-source libraries and frameworks are allowed, but the core development must be done individually.
- **Submission Deadline:** Late submissions will not be accepted.

---

## **Judging Criteria:**

| **Criteria**          | **Description**  |
|----------------------|----------------|
| **Innovation**       | Originality and creativity of the solution. |
| **Technical Complexity** | Depth of technical implementation and problem-solving. |
| **Sustainability Impact** | Environmental or social impact of the solution. |
| **Functionality**    | How well the solution works. |
| **Demo Video**       | Clarity and quality of the final presentation. |

### **Mentorship:**

- Mentors will be available throughout the event to assist participants with technical and conceptual questions.
- Direct collaboration or sharing of solutions between participants is not allowed.

### **Disqualification:**

- Any form of cheating, plagiarism, or rule violation will result in disqualification.

---

## **Prizes & Benefits:**

### **Prizes for Winners:**

- Exciting goodies, swag, and **T-shirts** for top performers.
- **Internship Opportunity** at NexIntel Synergy for winners, offering a chance to work on sustainability projects.

### **Participation Certificates:**

- All participants who submit a valid project before the deadline will receive a **Participation Certificate** from NexIntel Synergy.

### **Networking Opportunities:**

- Connect with **industry leaders, mentors, and fellow tech enthusiasts** in sustainability and technology fields.

---

## **How to Participate:**

1. **Sign-Up on Unstop:** Register on Unstop to secure your spot.
2. **Choose a Problem Statement:** Select a challenge from the available problem statements.
3. **Start Coding:** Develop your solution within the **48-hour** time frame, ensuring adherence to the rules.
4. **Submit Your Solution:** Ensure your submission includes:
   - **GitHub Repository Link**
   - **Demo Video** (uploaded on YouTube, Vimeo, etc.)
   - **Deployment Link** (if applicable)

5. **Follow Us:** Stay updated via our social media:
   - **[Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/nexintel_synergy/)**
   - **[LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/nexintel-synergy-pvt-ltd/)**

---

## **Additional Information:**

For queries or clarifications, reach out via our **official website** or **social media handles**. We can't wait to see your innovative solutions—join us in making a difference!

### 🚀 **Sankalp 2025 – The Ultimate 24-Hour Hackathon!**  
📅 **March 19-20, 2025** | 📍 **Vel Tech University**  
🔗 **Register & Submit Your PPT:** [sankalp.veltech.edu.in](https://sankalp.veltech.edu.in/)  

---

## 🎉 **Welcome to the Ultimate Code Battle!**  
Think you’ve got what it takes to **code for 24 hours straight**? 🤯  
Are you ready to **build, break, and innovate** at lightning speed? ⚡  

Join **Sankalp 2025**, the **wildest, most intense hackathon** where brilliant minds **compete, collaborate, and create** something extraordinary—ALL IN JUST 24 HOURS! 🏆  

With **top mentors, expert judges, and crazy cash prizes**, this is your chance to show the world what you're made of!  

---

## 🚀 **The Hackathon Mission**  
🔎 **Find a real-world problem**  
💡 **Crack the best solution**  
👨‍💻 **Code it from scratch**  
⚡ **Win prizes & bragging rights!**  

BUT… **No Open Innovation!** 🚫  
Your project **must align** with the hackathon themes, available at:  
🔗 [sankalp.veltech.edu.in](https://sankalp.veltech.edu.in/)  

---

## 📜 **How It Works**  

### 🏁 **Phase 1: Choose Your Challenge & Submit PPT**  
- Pick a **problem statement** from the official themes.  
- Submit a **4-slide PPT** with:  
  1️⃣ **Problem Understanding & Approach**  
  2️⃣ **Your Killer Solution**  
  3️⃣ **Tech Stack & Feasibility**  
  4️⃣ **Expected Impact & Future Scope**  

📌 **Deadline:** **March 10, 2025** (Don't be late or you’re OUT! ⏳)  

### 🎯 **Phase 2: The Big Shortlist**  
- We’ll **review your PPT** and **pick the best teams** to compete.  
- **Results Announced:** **March 12, 2025** 🎊 (Check your inbox!)  

### 💻 **Phase 3: The Ultimate 24-Hour Hackathon**  
- Shortlisted teams will **code their brains out** for 24 hours.  
- **All development starts from ZERO** at the venue—NO PRE-CODED STUFF! 🚫💀  
- Submit your **working prototype** + documentation before the timer runs out.  

### 🏆 **Phase 4: Judging & Finals**  
- Round 1: **Prototype review & feedback** 🔍  
- Final Round: **Top teams pitch to expert judges** 🎤  

---

## ⚠️ **Official Hackathon Rules**  

### 👥 **Team Formation**  
- **2-4 members per team** (No solo warriors, teamwork makes the dream work!).  

### 🛠 **Project Development**  
- **No pre-built projects!** Everything must be coded **LIVE** at the venue.  
- **Open-source AI, APIs, & tools are allowed** (but give proper credit!).  

### 🤖 **AI & Tech Usage**  
- **AI models & APIs? YES!**  
- **Just make sure to document them in your submission.**  

### 🎤 **Final Submission & Demo**  
- Submit a **working prototype** & a **killer presentation/demo**.  
- Judges will look for **innovation, execution, feasibility, and impact**.  

### 🚨 **Code of Conduct**  
- **Play fair, be ethical, and stay professional.**  
- Any **plagiarism, misconduct, or tampering = INSTANT DISQUALIFICATION!** 🚫  

---

## 💰 **What’s in it for You? (Besides Glory!)**  

🥇 **Winner:** Cash Prize + Certificate + Ultimate Bragging Rights 💰🏆  
🥈 **Runner-Up:** Cash Prize + Certificate 🎉  

🎁 **BONUS for All Participants:**  
✅ **Certificate of Participation** (Proof you survived the madness)  
✅ **Networking with Industry Experts** 🤝  
✅ **Access to Mentorship & Workshops** 💡  

---

## 🍕 **Fuel for the Fight!**  
💸 **Registration Fee:** ₹299 per team (Only for shortlisted teams!)  
🍽️ **Free food, snacks, tea & coffee** – because caffeine = life! ☕🔥  

### ⏳ **Hackathon Venue & Stay**  
🚀 **Non-stop 24-hour coding zone!**  
💺 **Comfortable seating available for all participants.**  
🏨 **No separate accommodation needed—STAY AT THE VENUE & CODE AWAY!**  

---

## 📤 **How to Submit Your PPT & Enter the Battle**  

🔗 **Step 1:** Visit [sankalp.veltech.edu.in](https://sankalp.veltech.edu.in/)  
🔑 **Step 2:** Click **"Login with Google"**  
🔍 **Step 3:** Find the **"24-Hour Hackathon"** card  
📤 **Step 4:** Upload your **4-slide PPT** (PDF/PPTX format)  
📩 **Step 5:** Submit before **March 10, 2025**  

🚀 **Results for shortlisted teams will be announced on March 12, 2025!** 🎉  

---

## 🎯 **Why You NEED to Participate!**  
💡 **Solve Real-World Problems** – Create solutions that make a difference.  
🔥 **Push Your Limits** – 24 hours of **non-stop innovation**.  
💼 **Build Your Tech Portfolio** – Impress recruiters & mentors.  
🏆 **Win Exciting Prizes & Recognition** – Get the spotlight you deserve!  

---

💻 **So… Are You In?**  
This is **YOUR** chance to make a mark. **No excuses, no limits—just pure innovation!**  

🔗 **Register NOW!** [sankalp.veltech.edu.in](https://sankalp.veltech.edu.in/) 🚀

name: ETHSF Hackathon 2025
desc:
The ETHSF Hackathon is a week-long building sprint in the ultimate builder hub, San Francisco.
This is where builders, developers, and creatives come together to decentralize tech and unite the future of innovation. 
   

### **Events Schedule**
* **March 10 – Opening Ceremony & Kickoff**  
  Kick off ETHSF with key insights, sponsor and mentor meetups, and the first look at this year’s problem statements: the opening sets the stage for a high-impact week ahead (invite-only, register [here](https://lu.ma/44jyq38p)).
* **March 10 to 14 – Official ETHSF Co-working & Hackathon Venue**  
  A dedicated co-working space at the Celo Office for ETHSF hackers, offering free daily lunch, an onsite barista, and networking opportunities. Register [here](https://lu.ma/v9edixh6) and join their [Telegram channel](https://t.me/celoethsf) to learn more.  
* **March 15 – Hackathon Judging (Online)**  
  On March 15, both the Main Track and Sponsor Track judging sessions will be conducted online. Our panel of expert judges will evaluate all Main Track projects and select the top projects based on creativity, real-world impact, execution, and presentation. Concurrently, Sponsor Track entries will be reviewed to award prizes to the standout projects.  
* **March 16 – Demo Day & Closing Ceremony**  
  This is where everything comes to life\! Teams will showcase their projects to the ETHSF community, judges, and sponsors. You’ll get to explore game-changing ideas, meet the builders, and celebrate the hard work that went into them.
   

### **Prizes**
**Total Prize Pool: 6 ETH**
* 1 ETH Award Each: Awarded to the top three projects.  
* 3 ETH Award for [Quadratic Voting](https://devfolio.co/blog/introooducing-quadratic-voting-on-devfolio/) (QV): The ETHSF community decides who gets a share.
   

### **Track Eligibility Guidelines**
* **Main Track:** The top teams that are shortlisted after project submission, **must be present in-person on the Demo Day** to be eligible for the Top 3 awards. The Demo Day venue (in San Francisco) will be disclosed to the finalists prior to the event.  
* **Sponsor Tracks:** Build from SF or anywhere worldwide with no requirement to be physically present at the hackathon venue.
 

***Note: The judges and organizers will only consider your Devfolio project submission before shortlisting the top teams and finalists for main and sponsor tracks. 
Please make sure your project submission is as complete as possible (with demo videos, high quality screenshots, and well-written descriptions and problem statements)***
   
 

### **Why ETHSF?**

Nestled between [**ETHDenver**](https://ethdenver2025.devfolio.co/) and industry-defining events like Nvidia’s GTC and GDC, the ETHSF Hackathon bridges the blockchain, AI, and gaming worlds.  

* Gain insights from leading voices in the Ethereum community.  
* Get mentorship from Ethereum leaders, access to technical workshops, and cross-pollination opportunities from nearby conferences.   
* Demo your hacks to industry experts, with prizes, funding opportunities, and ecosystem support for standout teams.  
* Enjoy an intimate setting that fosters creative collaboration, far from crowded conference halls.

### Beyond the Hackathon

Explore other events happening during the ETHSF week including [Community Day at Stanford](https://lu.ma/6413z5j6), the [Stanford Blockchain AI Summit](https://lu.ma/s21qt3bn), and [D/acc Day at UC Berkeley](https://lu.ma/o99rcou9). Learn more and register here: [https://www.ethereumsf.org/](https://www.ethereumsf.org/)

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/c4720882f13b439699eddbb48ce83b61/7ae80721-da60-41d3-98db-3ea25bb00c17.png)

Build, learn, and launch in Ethereum’s most dynamic week on the West Coast.

As part of the hackathon, participants will be given **36 hours** to brainstorm and develop creative solutions to address global challenges across six domains: healthcare, edtech, agritech, fintech, Web3 & crypto, and open innovation. This hackathon aims to inspire innovation, foster teamwork, and encourage hands-on learning.

4. Participants who are shortlisted for Round 2 should develop their solution only during the offline round. The days can be used for planning their solution, researching existing solutions, etc., but the core development should take place during the hackathon only.

7. A Jury Panel consisting of external judges, sponsors and tech experts will be assigned to judge the idea based on standard metrics of innovation, implementation, impact factor, feasibility, and presentation.
8. Jury Panel Decision is Final.
9. Team changing or shuffling will not be entertained.

desc:
# Solvex – The 24-Hour Innovation Challenge: An Initiative Under Solutions 2k25

Innovation, problem-solving, and collaboration take center stage at **Solvex**, a 24-hour offline innovation challenge conducted under "**Solutions 2k25**", the annual technical fest of **Army Institute of Technology (AIT), Pune**. This flagship event provides a platform for aspiring innovators, developers, and problem solvers to tackle real-world challenges through technology-driven solutions.

Event Format & Selection Process:

Solvex is structured into two key phases:

# Preliminary Screening – Online Idea Pitching Round (Last Date: March 16th, 2025):

The challenge problem statement is attached.
Teams will submit a detailed proposal outlining their idea, technical approach, and impact potential.
Submissions will be reviewed based on feasibility, innovation, and scalability.
The list of finalists (top 12 teams) will be uploaded on March 18th, 2025.
The selected teams will be invited to the final round at AIT Pune.
# Final Round – 24-Hour Hackathon (April 5th – 6th, 2025 | 10:00 AM onwards):

The top 12 selected teams will participate in a non-stop, 24-hour innovation sprint, where they will build a working prototype of their solution.
At the end of 24 hours, each team will present their solution to a panel of judges, followed by a Q&A session.
# How to Participate:

Step 1: Register Your Team
Step 2: Submit Mid-Submission Report (Deadline: March 16th, 2025):
Share a brief proposal of your project, including:
Problem statement
Approach & methodology
Tech stack & tools used
Step 3: Final Submission (For Finalists):
Upload the following:
GitHub Repository with well-documented code.
YouTube Video (3-5 min) explaining:
Overview of the project
Key features and functionality
Workflow Explanation (A live demo is NOT necessary, but teams should clearly explain how their solution would function.)
Our panel of judges will evaluate projects based on:
Innovation – Originality and uniqueness of the idea
Impact – Practical benefits and real-world applications
Feasibility – How achievable and scalable the solution is
Execution – Code quality, performance, and completeness
Prizes & Industry Support:

With a total prize pool of ₹1.5 lakhs, Solvex recognizes and rewards top-performing teams for their ingenuity and problem-solving skills.
Industry & Platform Partners:
**Accops and MRO Corp – Official Industry Partners **providing insights and mentorship.


**Why Participate in Solvex:**

Real-World Problem Solving: Work on industry-driven challenges with hands-on implementation.
Networking & Mentorship: Learn from leading experts, mentors, and industry pioneers.
Recognition & Rewards: Win cash prizes and gain visibility among tech companies and recruiters.
Showcase Talent: Compete against the best minds in a high-intensity innovation challenge.
Join the Innovation Sprint:

Solvex is more than just a competition – it’s an opportunity to innovate, create, and make an impact. Are you ready to push your limits?
Mark your calendars! Join us on *April 5th-6th, 2025*, at AIT Pune for an electrifying 24-hour hackathon experience!

Problem statements can be found on the Prizes track as well as in the Hackathon website

name: Lisk Builders Challenge: Round One
desc:
# **Let's Build! Your Opportunity Awaits**

[Lisk](https://lisk.com/) and [BlockDevId](https://blockdev.id/) are thrilled to bring you the Lisk Builders Challenge! This is your chance to turn your innovative blockchain ideas into reality. Whether you're a seasoned developer or just starting your blockchain journey, this hackathon provides the platform and resources you need to succeed.

# **Your Journey to Demo Day**
The challenge will run for 3 months, giving you ample time to develop your project. During this period, we'll host online workshops and provide mentorship to guide you. We will select the 10 best projects to compete in the final round. The final Demo Day will be held in Jakarta (hybrid), featuring live project presentations, judging, and networking opportunities.

- Hackathon Start: March 8, 2025
- Kickoff AMA: March 12, 2025
- [Workshop by Pelita Bangsa Academy](https://lu.ma/2147738w): March 19 - April 30, 2025
- Mentorship by Pelita Bangsa Academy: March 19 - May 16, 2025
- Submission Deadline: May 17, 2025
- Judging: May 19 - 23, 2025
- Announcement of Finalists: May 24, 2025
- Finalists Coaching: May 26-30, 2025
- SocMed Challenge Cutoff Time: May 29, 2025 | 18:00 (GMT+7)
- Most Fav Project Voting Cutoff Time: May 29, 2025 | 18:00 (GMT+7)

- Demo Day (Jakarta - Hybrid): May 31, 2025


# **Building the Blockchain Ecosystem in Indonesia**

Our mission is to foster the growth of the blockchain ecosystem in Indonesia. We aim to empower developers and builders to create impactful projects that leverage blockchain technology's potential. By encouraging innovation and collaboration, we strive to position Indonesia as a leading hub for blockchain development.

# **Unlock Prizes, Mentorship, and Opportunities**
- Compete for a total prize pool of up to USD 6,800 in development challenges!
- Gain knowledge and enhance your skills from [workshops](https://lu.ma/2147738w) led by industry professionals and experts.
- Showcase your project to a wide audience through social media and partner promotions.
- Enjoy exclusive perks and resources from our sponsorship partners.

# **Powering Your Projects with IDRX**
A core requirement of this round is the integration of [IDRX](https://home.idrx.co/en), a stable token pegged to the Indonesian Rupiah, which ensures your projects are built on a foundation of stability and real-world relevance. Explore the diverse use cases of IDRX and demonstrate its potential within your application.

# **Feeling a little lost on what to build?**
No worries! The IDRX Team has put together a [dApp Idea Bank](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/15IA1lBTDvrUlMRvDnKr5PPYVnrT5XtN6AfEQzdHxnAM/edit?usp=sharing) to spark your imagination! Now, while it's packed with cool suggestions, don't feel like you have to stick to it. If you've got a brilliant idea in your mind, we absolutely want to see it! We are open to any creative dApp Ideas that align with the builders challenge's theme to be submitted for the Lisk Builders Challenge. 😄

# **Add Xellar Wallet to Your dApps Easily!**
Integration of [Xellar Kit](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@xellar/kit) is also a key part of this hackathon, enabling users to create wallets with social logins native to your application. Our infrastructure supports instant DeFi integration, connecting your application to decentralized finance platforms without added complexity.

# **Project Submission Guidelines**
All submissions must meet the following requirements:
1. Smart Contract(s) deployed on [Lisk Sepolia Testnet](https://docs.lisk.com/user/connecting-to-a-wallet#lisk-sepolia-testnet) or [Lisk Mainnet](https://docs.lisk.com/user/connecting-to-a-wallet/#lisk-mainnet) and verified on [Blockscout Explorer](https://sepolia-blockscout.lisk.com/).
2. Integrate your dApp with [IDRX Stablecoin](https://home.idrx.co/en) on [Lisk Mainnet (0x18Bc5bcC660cf2B9cE3cd51a404aFe1a0cBD3C22)](https://blockscout.lisk.com/address/0x18Bc5bcC660cf2B9cE3cd51a404aFe1a0cBD3C22) or [Lisk Sepolia Testnet (0xD63029C1a3dA68b51c67c6D1DeC3DEe50D681661)](https://sepolia-blockscout.lisk.com/address/0xD63029C1a3dA68b51c67c6D1DeC3DEe50D681661)
3. Build your dApp with [Xellar Kit](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@xellar/kit)
4. Project Name
5. Live Project URL
6. Detailed Project Description
7. Public Project Repository on GitHub
8. Instructions on how to interact with your application
9. Pitch Deck (PDF)
10. Presentation Video (YouTube Unlisted Video URL)
11. Project Screenshot (PNG)

# **Judging Criteria**
To ensure a fair and comprehensive evaluation, please see the following evaluation metrics:
- DApp Use Case Impact towards the Lisk Ecosystem (30pts)
- Innovation & Uniqueness (20pts)
- Technical Implementation (20pts)
- UI/UX & Usability (10pts)
- Project Documentation & Code Quality (10pts)
- Pitch & Presentation Quality (10pts)

Commitment to launch the project on Lisk Mainnet will be a huge plus and become a consideration when selecting the winners.

# **Complete these steps to submit your project**
1. Begin by ensuring you have registered an account on Devfolio.
2. Proceed to submit your application for the hackathon.
3. Upon application approval, remember to check-in.
4. Whether you are participating individually or as a team, you may create a new team or join an existing one
5. Finally, submit your project. Please refer to the [participation guidance](https://guide.devfolio.co/hackers/participate) for further information.

# **Get Ready for the Challenge**

1. Join the BlockDevId [social media](https://linktr.ee/blockdev_id?fbclid=PAZXh0bgNhZW0CMTEAAab5aM-O-jTaLpZRMKckRUqNAEnifsXhREuEZNjLS8gJp5u1zLANNDhlm6Y_aem_AQFx_ujnu065_4F5F463ng) channels for the latest updates, announcements, and community discussions.
2. Participate in our series of preparatory sessions, where we'll cover essential topics, provide technical guidance, and answer your questions. Don't miss the Kickoff AMA session on [ID BUIDL Twitter Space!](https://x.com/IDBUIDL)

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/554566d3cf114ee5a11f921fe215c62b/e3165451-21db-4cc8-ad44-1a84eb50cc16.png)

# **Get to know Lisk**

[Lisk](https://lisk.com/) is a growing Ethereum L2 built for high-growth markets with near-zero fees. Follow our Indonesian Social Media Channels - [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/liskindonesia) and [TikTok](https://www.tiktok.com/@lisk.indonesia) to stay connected. Also, check out our [docs](https://docs.lisk.com/) for in-depth technical information and helpful guides about the Lisk blockchain.

# **Get to know BlockDevId**

BlockDevId is a community that helps developers in Indonesia to learn and develop web3 and blockchain technology through collaboration and experience sharing. Its goal is to build a new blockchain-based economy in Indonesia by facilitating faster adoption of web3 technology. This community is open to anyone who wants to be involved in the development of web3 and blockchain technology in Indonesia. Find us on [social media](https://linktr.ee/blockdev_id?fbclid=PAZXh0bgNhZW0CMTEAAaa4YF_CQ9eeem1d6pkB_Rx65e3iRmAjEO6eDhaUbftyaABZSDASClFR1Jg_aem_vUwDeNKPAcjOxvXGtXU13g) to stay connected.

# **Get to know Pelita Bangsa Academy**

[Pelita Bangsa Academy](https://pelitabangsa.co.id) is an EduTech Startup with a mission to Upskill and Reskill Indonesian Tech Talents in Blockchain Technology so we can compete globally. We provide intensive Blockchain Developer Bootcamp. We are chosen as the Education Partner for Lisk Builders Challenge Round One where we will provide 6-session workshop and mentoring guiding your web3 development journey! Find us on [social media](https://linktr.ee/pelitabangsa.co.id) to stay connected.

# **What is IDRX?**
IDRX is a stable token pegged to the value of the Indonesian Rupiah). As a cryptocurrency, [IDRX](https://home.idrx.co/en) offers users the benefits of blockchain technology, including security, transparency, and decentralized control. At the same time, as a stable token, IDRX offers price stability by maintaining a fixed exchange rate with the IDR, Indonesia's national currency. Connect with us on [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/idrx.co/?hl=en) and [X](https://x.com/idrx_co).

# **Learn about Xellar Wallet**
[Xellar](https://xellar.co/) is a pioneering global Web3 infrastructure company providing a wide range of digital asset banking services, including Wallet Kit, Wallet-as-a-Service, Custodian, and Crypto asset management. Check us out on [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/xellarworld/) and [X](https://x.com/XellarWorld).

desc:
Hack the Winter 2.0. Win the season.

Welcome to the epicenter of innovation and collaboration – the D4 Community's Hackathon at CGC Jhanjeri!

**What We Are:**
D4 Community is proud to present an exhilarating hackathon hosted at CGC Jhanjeri, where we bring together budding tech enthusiasts, aspiring innovators, and problem solvers under one roof. With a passion for technology and a drive for innovation, we're dedicated to fostering an environment where bright minds can thrive.

**Who can join**
Open to all 

**Our Mission:**
Our mission is simple yet profound: to challenge participants to harness their creativity, coding skills, and teamwork to solve real-world problems. We believe in the transformative power of collaboration and coding, and we aim to inspire the next generation of tech leaders.

**What to Expect:**
Expect an adrenaline-fueled 24 hours of non-stop coding, brainstorming, and networking. Participants will tackle exciting challenges, engage in workshops, and have the opportunity to win fantastic prizes.

# Hackathon Themes:

> **HealthTech Innovation:** Dive into the world of healthcare and wellness by developing solutions that can improve medical services, patient care, or health monitoring.

> **EdTech Revolution:** Revolutionize education with technology. Create tools and platforms that enhance the learning experience, making education more accessible and engaging.

> **Smart Cities and IoT:** Innovate for the future of urban living. Build IoT solutions that can make cities smarter, more efficient, and better connected.

> **Agriculture and AgriTech:** Explore innovations in agriculture. Build tools or systems that can improve crop yield, farm management, or address food security challenges.

> **Blockchain and Cryptocurrency:** Dive into the world of blockchain technology and cryptocurrencies. Work on projects related to decentralized finance (DeFi), NFTs (Non-Fungible Tokens), or blockchain-based voting systems.

> **Robotics and Automation:** Explore the possibilities of robotics and automation. Build robots or automated systems that can assist in various industries, from manufacturing to healthcare.

> **E-Commerce Enhancement:** Explore ways to enhance the e-commerce experience. Develop solutions for better online shopping, personalized recommendations, or streamlined supply chain management.

> **Open Theme:** Don't see a theme that fits your idea? No problem! You're welcome to participate in any tech-related project that excites you.


**Why Join Us:**
Join us to broaden your horizons, sharpen your skills, and make lifelong connections with like-minded individuals. Whether you're a seasoned coder or just getting started, the D4 Community's Hackathon at CGC Jhanjeri is the place to be.

**Stay Tuned:**
Stay tuned for updates, registration details, and exciting announcements as we gear up for an unforgettable hackathon experience. Together, let's push the boundaries of innovation and make a positive impact on the world through technology.

# Food and accommodation are free 
For Dinner 28th feb, 1st March Lunch n Dinner, 2nd March Breakfast + Extra Tea and snacks can be provided based on availability on 1st March night (Not mandatory).

Mark your calendars and get ready to code your way to success with D4 Community's Hackathon!

desc:
**CodeZen Hackathon 2025** is a **36-hour innovation-driven coding marathon** organized by **CodeGeeks**, the official coding society of Guru Tegh Bahadur 4th Centenary Engineering College (GTB4CEC). This highly anticipated event will take place from **February 28 to March 1, 2025**, and is designed to inspire creativity, foster collaboration, and push the boundaries of technology.  

#**What Makes CodeZen Special?**  
This year’s hackathon is uniquely **Squid Game-themed**, combining the thrill of intense competition with the excitement of solving real-world challenges. It is more than just a coding event – it is a platform for **developers, designers, and innovators** to come together, share knowledge, and turn their ideas into impactful solutions.  

#**Tracks**  
Participants will have the opportunity to explore challenges across a diverse range of tracks, including:  
- **Web3 and Blockchain**: Build decentralized applications and explore the future of the internet.  
- **AI and Machine Learning**: Develop cutting-edge solutions powered by artificial intelligence.  
- **IoT and Automation**: Create smart systems to optimize everyday processes.  
- **Game Development**: Design innovative gaming experiences and mechanics.  
- **Supply Chain and Logistics**: Solve complex problems in logistics and supply chain management.  

#**Who Can Participate?**  
The hackathon is open to **students, professionals, and tech enthusiasts** from all backgrounds. Whether you’re a seasoned developer, a budding designer, or a first-time hacker, CodeZen Hackathon 2025 provides a welcoming environment for everyone to showcase their skills and learn something new.  

#**Why Participate?**  
- **Innovate**: Collaborate with like-minded individuals to create solutions that make a difference.  
- **Learn**: Gain hands-on experience and access to expert mentorship in diverse fields.  
- **Network**: Connect with industry leaders, potential collaborators, and a vibrant tech community.  
- **Win**: Compete for exciting prizes, including cash rewards, merchandise, and exclusive opportunities.  

#**Event Highlights**  
1. **Workshops and Mentorship**: Engage in pre-hackathon workshops led by industry experts to sharpen your skills.  
2. **Keynote Sessions**: Hear from inspiring speakers about the latest trends in technology and innovation.  
3. **Networking Opportunities**: Interact with sponsors, judges, and fellow participants to build meaningful connections.  
4. **Exciting Challenges**: Solve real-world problems provided by our partners, with a chance to work on cutting-edge technologies.  

#**Prizes and Rewards**  
CodeZen Hackathon 2025 offers **exciting rewards** for winners across all tracks. In addition to cash prizes and exclusive merchandise, participants will also receive opportunities for internships, networking, and access to industry-leading tools and platforms.  

#**Sponsors and Partners**  
CodeZen Hackathon 2025 is supported by an incredible lineup of **industry-leading sponsors and partners**, ensuring a seamless and enriching experience for all participants.  

#**How to Register**  
Registration is open to all tech enthusiasts. Form a team of **2-4 members** or participate solo, and embark on this thrilling journey of innovation. Spots are limited, so register early to secure your place!  

Join us for an unforgettable experience where creativity meets technology. Together, let’s redefine what’s possible at **CodeZen Hackathon 2025**.

name: ETHDenver 2025
tagline: Largest and Longest Running #BUILDathon in the World 🦄🦬🏔️
desc:
## REGENERATES ASSEMBLE!

ETHDenver is the world’s largest and longest running blockchain-powered #BUIDLathon (FKA hackathon). Every year, more than 25,000+ innovators from over 125 countries converge to create a week-long festival of innovation. ETHDenver is a world renowned gathering place where developers, creators, and visionaries come together to address critical challenges and bring groundbreaking ideas to life in the fields of blockchain and distributed computing.

### Have You Been Accepted to Attend ETHDenver?

To participate in the #BUIDLathon, [apply for your ETHDenver ticket here before completing the #BUIDLathon application on Devfolio](https://www.ethdenver.com/tickets).



> **IMPORTANT**: When submitting your BUIDLer application on Devfolio, **use the same email you provided when registering for ETHDenver**.



![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/c4720882f13b439699eddbb48ce83b61/10d0801e-a43e-40fe-856f-897b87f21f49.png)

### A Global Stage for Trailblazing Ideas and Funding Opportunities

ETHDenver is more than a competition— it's a launchpad for success. With **up to $1,000,000 in sponsor bounties and prizes** and **up to $10,000,000 in grants and investments**, ETHDenver provides the support needed to turn visionary ideas into reality.

### A Legacy of Success and Community Impact

ETHDenver’s impact extends beyond the event. Our alumni have collectively raised over **$300 million** in funding (excluding undisclosed grants and early-stage investments). Past #BUIDL teams— such as 1Inch, POAP.xyz, Huma Finance, Harpie, and others— have evolved from humble beginnings at ETHDenver into key players and contributors to the blockchain ecosystem. Some have even become sponsors, partners, and integral contributors to the ETHDenver Community Innovation Festival.

### Join the Best Blockchain Innovators

Join the next wave of over 1,000 teams of #BUIDLers at ETHDenver 2025! This is your opportunity to connect with a global community that’s not just watching blockchain innovation unfold but actively driving its future.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/c4720882f13b439699eddbb48ce83b61/30edc973-0f14-48b7-a81d-1d2338a89401.png) 

## Prepare to BUIDL

- [Join the ETHDenver community on Discord](https://discord.com/invite/sporkdao) and head to the #BUIDL channel for the latest announcements, news, opportunities to connect with potential teammates, and rapid access to mentor support throughout the main event! Feel free to start bouncing project ideas around and take your time getting to know fellow BUIDLers who you may want to team-up with.
- **Join Pre-Event Virtual Meetups**
We're hosting a series of sessions to equip you with everything you need to excel, whether you're looking to fill open spots on your team or build one from scratch! Each session will be recorded for on-demand viewing, and we’ll offer them at various times to accommodate live attendance across all time zones. Check out the [schedule tab](https://ethdenver2025.devfolio.co/schedule) for more. 

---

### We’re Taking the BUIDLer Experience to a Whole New Level

- **BODEGA:** This year, we’re massively upgrading the food and beverage experience with enhanced staffing and a wider selection of options available throughout the day and into the evening.
- **COFFEE/TEA CART:** Our barista coffee service was a hit, so it’s back for 2025! We’re also adding new flavors and complimentary snacks to really help you get in the zone.
- **INTERNET:** Our IT Stewards made significant infrastructure upgrades in 2024, but we're not stopping there. We’re going all out to provide the best connectivity for ETHDenver 2025:  
• **Enhanced Core Infrastructure** to prevent dropped connections.
• **Expanded NAT Pool** to prevent service throttling and improve connection distribution.
• **Increased Access Point Density** in BUIDLHub to reduce equipment overload and improve coverage.
• **Real-time Monitoring and Tactical Deployment** to address wireless dead zones during the event.
• **Hardwired Connectivity Options** through network switches deployed at each row. And if you forget your Ethernet cable, we’ll also have a free “Build Your Own Ethernet Cable” Station in the MakerSpace which is moving into the BUIDLHub!
- **VIBE:** This year’s BUIDLHub will take over the same spacious arena but we’ll be packing in way more vibe. You’ll find diverse seating options, more lamps and adjustable lighting, and a new festival inspired layout.
- **DJ CHILL ROOM:** This year’s experience will be legendary DJ chill zone featuring a 33 foot projection mapped dome featuring creative art from the local and international community. We’ll be bringing back the call for DJs with live sets taking place all week long. If you ever need a change of pace, this space will most definitely be your jam.
- **MAKERSPACE:** This year’s MakerSpace will have an expanded support team ready to help you integrate physical tech into your software projects. As you brainstorm project ideas for this year’s BUIDLathon, consider how phygital connections that bridge blockchain with the real world could take your ideas to the next level. We’ve invited several projects for you to connect with and gain firsthand insights. They’ll be demoing their innovations, showing how they’re leveraging blockchain-powered phygital tech to create real-world impact.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/c4720882f13b439699eddbb48ce83b61/b0cb75a2-de80-4b43-953f-b045c2a7d554.png)

### Review Our Code of Conduct

All attendees must adhere to the [Code of Conduct](https://nsb.dev/ethdenver2025-terms-of-service) to ensure a safe, inclusive, and productive environment for everyone.

---

**Get Registered, Get Connected on Discord and Get Ready to #BUIDL like never before.**



**SEE YOU SOON REGENERATES!**

prizes.name: Total Bounty
prizes.desc:
The prize pool distribution has 4 possible triggers: 

* If one or more valid Low severity findings are found, the total distributed pot size is $5,000 

* If one or more valid Medium severity findings are found, the total distributed pot size is $15,000 

* If one or more valid High severity findings are found, the total distributed pot size is $45,000 

* If one or more valid Critical severity findings are found, the total distributed pot size is $100,000 



Severity Definitions: 

Critical Severity 

* Triggered if a vulnerability in the “core” results in 50%-100% losses of total TVL across all major chains. 

High Severity 

* Triggered if a vulnerability in the "core" results in 5%-50% losses of total TVL across all major chains. 

* Triggered if a vulnerability in one of the "incentive hooks" results in 50%-100% losses of total TVL across all major chains. 

Medium Severity 

* Individual losses impacting at least 5% of individual users, where each loses at least 5% of their deposited funds. 

* The ability for an attacker to take the majority of incentive rewards from an incentive hook without providing a proportional LP position investment. 

Low Severity 

* Any individual losses of at least 5% of deposited funds. 

* A DoS attack that prevents access to more than 5% of TVL for over 5 minutes, with an execution cost lower than the value of the affected funds. 



Incentive Hook Scope: 

Only the following trading pairs are considered: 

* ETH-WBTC 

* ETH-USDC 

* ETH-USDT 

* ETH-DAI 

* USDC-USDT 

* USDC-DAI

name: HackWithGenesis
desc:
The **HackWithGenesis** Hackathon is set to be the biggest Web3-focused hackathon of the year, and it's happening at SRM Institute of Science and Technology on February 22nd-23rd, 2025. This thrilling event is designed to bring together some of the brightest minds in the Web3 space, offering a unique opportunity to collaborate, innovate, and build groundbreaking solutions in the decentralized ecosystem.

# What is HackWithGenesis?
HackWithGenesis is not just another hackathon—it's an all-encompassing challenge where developers, blockchain enthusiasts, and innovators will come together to create the next big thing in Web3. Whether you’re interested in DeFi, NFTs, Blockchain development, or building on smart contracts, this hackathon provides a platform for all creators to showcase their skills and learn new technologies.

# Why You Should Participate
**Global Recognition**: This event is expected to attract top-tier talent from around the globe, making it the perfect place to gain exposure and recognition in the Web3 world.
**Incredible Prizes**: The prize pool is massive! Winners will walk away with exciting rewards that could significantly boost their careers or projects.
Networking Opportunities: You’ll have the chance to connect with leading experts in the Web3 space, mentors from top Web3 companies, and like-minded innovators. It’s a fantastic opportunity to expand your professional network.
**Workshops and Sessions**: HackWithGenesis offers insightful workshops and technical sessions led by industry leaders to ensure you have the tools and knowledge to bring your ideas to life.
**Collaboration**: Working alongside other brilliant minds, you'll have the chance to build, experiment, and test new ideas in a highly collaborative environment. Whether you're a solo hacker or prefer teamwork, there's space for everyone.
# Event Details
**Dates**: February 22nd - 23rd, 2025
**Location**: SSRMIST
Delhi NCR Campus,
Ghaziabad UP
**Track Areas**:
DeFi (Decentralized Finance)
NFTs (Non-Fungible Tokens)
Smart Contracts
Blockchain Infrastructure
Web3 Development & more!
# Who Can Join?
**Developers**: If you’re skilled in Web3 technologies, smart contracts, blockchain protocols, or any other aspect of decentralized systems, this is your chance to shine.
Designers: Whether you're working on UI/UX or visualizing new decentralized applications, your expertise is valuable here.
**Entrepreneurs**: Got an innovative idea for the Web3 space? You’ll be able to test and prototype your concept during this hackathon.
**Beginners**: If you're new to blockchain or Web3, don’t worry! Workshops and mentor sessions will help guide you through the process.

# Conclusion
HackWithGenesis at SRMIST Delhi NCR Campus,
Ghaziabad UP on February 22nd-23rd, 2025, promises to be an epic Web3 hackathon that will inspire and challenge participants to push the boundaries of decentralized technology. Whether you're a seasoned Web3 developer or just diving into the space, this is an event you don’t want to miss. Get ready to innovate, create, and shape the future of Web3!

Register now and get ready to be part of the future of decentralized innovation!
location: SRM Institute of Science and Technology NCR Campus, Modinagar, Uttar Pradesh, India

name: KrackHack 2.0
desc:
# **# KrackHack 2.0 – IIT Mandi’s Premier Hackathon**

Welcome to **KrackHack 2.0**, IIT Mandi’s flagship hackathon, a 48-hour coding marathon where innovation meets execution. Whether you’re a seasoned hacker or a first-time participant, KrackHack is your chance to turn ideas into impactful solutions, collaborate with brilliant minds, and get mentorship from industry leaders.

# **# 🔥 The Vibe – Code, Innovate & Break Barriers!**

•	Not just a competition, but an experience! Think midnight debugging sessions, spontaneous idea pivots, and adrenaline-fueled problem-solving.
•	The event isn’t just about winning—it’s about building, learning, and pushing your limits.
•	Food, swag, and tech talk sessions keep the energy high, while mentorship ensure your project goes beyond just an idea.

# **#🚀 Why Participate?**

✅ Real-World Impact – Solve pressing tech challenges and build projects that matter.
✅ Networking & Mentorship – Connect with tech mentors, and fellow developers.
✅ Career Growth – Impress recruiters, get noticed by startups, and enhance your resume.
✅ Swags & Prizes – Cool merchandise, cash rewards, and much more.

# **# 📝 How to Participate?**

Step 1: Register Your Team

📌 Head to Devfolio and register your team (max 4 members).

Step 2: Submit Mid-Submission Report

📌 Share a brief proposal of your project, including problem statement, approach, and tech stack.

Step 3: Final Submission

📌 Upload the following:
	•	GitHub Repository with well-documented code.
	•	YouTube Video (3-5 min) demonstrating your project, its features, and how it works.

📌 Our panel will evaluate projects based on innovation, impact, feasibility, and execution.

# **# 🌍 Community Impact – Build for a Better Tomorrow**

At KrackHack 2.0, we believe in the power of technology to create meaningful change. This isn’t just about coding—it’s about building solutions that impact real lives.

**💡Solve Real-World Problems** – Address challenges in healthcare, sustainability, education, accessibility, and more with innovative tech solutions.

🤝 **Open-Source & Knowledge Sharing** – Contribute to open-source projects, collaborate with like-minded developers, and make your work accessible to a global community.

KrackHack is more than a competition—it’s a movement of thinkers, builders, and changemakers who believe that technology should work for everyone.

**🌟 Get Ready to Crack the Hack!**

Whether you’re a coder, designer, or problem solver, KrackHack 2.0 is where you prove your mettle.
Bring your A-game, fuel up on caffeine, and let’s build something amazing! 💡⚡

See you at KrackHack 2.0! 🚀

This year, we’re introducing **two tracks** for Hackanova 4.0:

- **Software Track**: Focusing on innovations in **AI, ML, and Blockchain**.
- **Hardware Track**: Where participants can create innovative **hardware solutions**.

## How to Apply
* Your Idea should be related to AI, ML, Blockchain, or Hardware-based solutions. It can be a mobile app, a web app, or any hardware-based project you find relevant to the theme.
* Use the [Idea Submission Template (Software Track)](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1GoVRMfhw8Aew31h3YA6L76vGGOMeqN1M/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=106299849577897965203&rtpof=true&sd=true) to prepare a PPT for your idea (Software Track).
* Use the [Idea Submission Template (Hardware Track)](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1VKfmag5Hsj4z0j7UMjqI5d9KFzY-N2Tg/edit#slide=id.g117fe1c4100_1_0) to prepare a PPT for your idea (Hardware Track).
* All team members must upload the same PPT to the application form.
* The team leader must also fill this form:  

   - **For Software Track**: [Software Track Leader Form](https://forms.gle/dbhGpivE2QXDg9Tg8)  
   - **For Hardware Track**: [Hardware Track Leader Form](https://forms.gle/f6uHAc4dNSew4peq6)  

* The team leader should **Create a Team** and share the invite code with their teammates.
* Once all team members have joined, they can submit their application.

**Note**:  
1. Individual applications will not be entertained. Kindly apply in a team of minimum 2 members and maximum 4 members.  
2. There will be a different set of problem statements in the final offline round.

name: Cartesi X EigenLayer
desc:
INVITE ONLY HACKATHON

Welcome to this experimental hackathon featuring the newly built Cartesi Coprocessor leveraging EigenLayer! This week is not only about building—it's also a stress test for the technology and documentation. Expect to explore, experiment, and provide valuable feedback.

# What is Cartesi
Cartesi’s virtual machine brings a proper operating system to Ethereum and beyond.  Decades of existing libraries, languages, and tooling.  The simplest path to building the next generation of onchain applications.

# What is EigenLayer 
EigenLayer provides developers with access to the Ethereum staked capital base and decentralized validator set. Access to this trust network can make previously impossible mechanism designs possible.

# About Experiment Week
This event is designed to emphasize experimentation and building to explore new possibilities. It’s a unique opportunity where we put our solutions to the test, resonating deeply with the developer journey by building with our own infrastructure. This hackathon is primarily invite-only, but we welcome seasoned developers eager to dive deeper into the technology. If you're up for the challenge, we’d love to have you on board!

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)
EigenLayer's restaking technology is revolutionizing how blockchain applications can leverage Ethereum's security and scale, while Cartesi's Coprocessor is the only virtual machine capable of running Linux in the blockchain space.
![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)
The combined Cartesi and EigenLayer stack opens up infinite possibilities: sophisticated DeFi applications, verifiable AI inferences, and countless other use cases that require the security and scalability benefits of restaking, combined with complete compatibility with the mainstream software industry.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)
Experiment Week is about bringing those possibilities to life, with core protocol developers and community members from both projects rolling up their sleeves, pushing the limits of their own tech, and inspiring builders to explore new possibilities that unlock Web3’s true potential.


# The Challenge
Participants are tasked with creating innovative PoCs and dApps that leverage the combined features of Cartesi and EigenLayer or tools and frameworks that enhance the developer experience and unlock new possibilities with the Coprocessor. These projects should:
![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)
**1. Address meaningful use cases in Web3:**
- Solutions that tackle current problems like scalability, interoperability.
- Showcase how the Coprocessor infrastructure, securely offloading complex computations to the Cartesi Machine, brings innovation to the web3 space.

**2. Explore untapped horizons within decentralized technology.**
- New use cases that are enabled by the combination of Cartesi and EigenLayer: AI Integration, Games, Data-Driven Applications, DeFi Innovations.
- Create new frameworks, and tools that allow users and developers to do more and have a better experience.

**3. Have clear delivery of the solution:**
- Bonus points for projects deployed on testnet. 
- Demonstrate end-to-end interaction between all components of your solution.
- Provide clear documentation and instructions for testing and replicating your solution.

# Documentation
[Here is a full comprehensive guide to leveraging the Cartesi Coprocessor using EigenLayer.](https://docs.mugen.builders/cartesi-co-processor-tutorial/introduction)
![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)
# Submission Requirements & Demo Day Invite
To submit your project, you must upload a 1-minute video that includes:
![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)
- A brief explanation of your project.
- A demo showcasing its functionality.
- Your submission and video will be reviewed to determine if you will be invited to present your project on Demo Day, scheduled for Monday, February 17, at 4 PM UTC. Please keep an eye on your email for any communication from Cartesi. 
NOTE: You may speed up the demo portion for efficiency, but the spoken explanation must remain at normal speed for clarity.

name: Base Onchain AI Hackathon Weekend | London
tagline: 📣 TLDR: Join us for the Base Onchain AI Weekend: London, a two-day buildathon dedicated towards building autonomous onchain agents on Base with awards for top builder submissions!
desc:
## What is Onchain AI Weekend? 

​Onchain AI Weekend is happening from Feb 1st to 2nd across three cities: San Francisco, London and Bangalore. We want to enable today’s builders with the tools to create the onchain AI agents of tomorrow.

​Have an idea for an AI agent for a social, trading, Defi, chat, gaming or another use case? Come build it. 

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

## ​The Prompt

​The goal is to create innovative, unique experiences that push the status quo of what’s possible using onchain apps. We’re looking for projects with practical value that leverage the benefits of being onchain, the programmability of MPC Wallets, and the customizability enabled through streamlined API calls. Feel free to integrate AgentKit!

​If you’re looking for ideas, here’s a few to get started: 

- ​A **social agent** that attracts attention and builds a following.

- ​A **trading agent** that implements automated trading logic based on user defined parameters.

- ​A **Defi agent** that can help users understand protocol opportunities and risks.

- ​**Chat agent** that can help people find useful information.

***​Submissions must be built on Base***

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

## Why Participate

​The Buildathon is open to all **physical attendees** and winners will receive over **$10k in prizes** (more details be announced). Plus all winners will receive: 

- **​Marketing & Distribution:** All winners will be featured on Base social channels (X, Warpcast and get to present live on Base Cafe)

- ​**Network:** Connections with some of the most prolific Base builders in your region, with direct access to the Base team.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

## 👉 How it Works

​In order to be eligible, the projects must follow the below rules:
- Must submit one project per team.
- Teams can be 1-3 people
- Must be built on Base 
- Must satisfy the prompt described above
- ​Must include a functioning onchain app at a publicly accessible URL
- ​Agent must have an associated X account where demos, links to repos and other info is posted.
- ​Must include an open-source GitHub repository for all source code in the app.
- ​Integrating Basenames and Smart Wallet is strongly recommended; they make it easy for anyone to get onchain.
- ​Must submit proof of 1+ transactions on Base mainnet or Base Sepolia testnet.
- ​The entry must be in a working format with a loom video posted to social media by the Sunday afternoon deadline.
- ​Must be code complete by the Sunday deadline. 

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)


## ​🥇 Evaluation Criteria

- **​Technicality:** Functions as pitched
- **Originality:** Innovation/originality to solve problems
- **Practicality:** Usable and accessible by anyone
- **Wow Factor:** Primarily measured on how well it performs its utility and intended purpose
![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)
## ​📒 Builder Resources 

- [​Getting Started on Base](https://www.base.org/build)
- [Base Documentation](https://docs.base.org/)
- [Basenames](https://www.base.org/names) ([OnchainKit](https://docs.base.org/docs/basenames-tutorial-with-onchainkit/), [Wagmi](https://docs.base.org/docs/basenames-tutorial-using-wagmi/))
- ​[Coinbase Developer Platform](https://docs.cdp.coinbase.com/)
- [Faucets](https://docs.base.org/docs/tools/network-faucets/) ([CDP](https://portal.cdp.coinbase.com/products/faucet), [thirdweb](https://thirdweb.com/base-sepolia-testnet))
- ​[OnchainKit](https://onchainkit.xyz/)
- ​​[Smart Wallet](https://www.smartwallet.dev/why)
- [​Based AI AgentKit](https://docs.cdp.coinbase.com/learn/docs/based-ai-agents)
![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

*​Event Photo Release: By attending this event, you agree to be included in photographs and/or footage that may be taken and used by Coinbase for marketing and publicity purposes, on its website, blog and in social media or in any third party publication.*

name: Base Onchain AI Hackathon Weekend | Bangalore
tagline: 📣 Join us for the Base Onchain AI Weekend: Bangalore, a two-day buildathon dedicated towards building autonomous onchain agents on Base with awards for top builder submissions!
desc:
## What is Onchain AI Weekend? 

​Onchain AI Weekend is happening from Feb 1st to 2nd across three cities: San Francisco, London and Bangalore. We want to enable today’s builders with the tools to create the onchain AI agents of tomorrow.

​Have an idea for an AI agent for a social, trading, Defi, chat, gaming or another use case? Come build it. 

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

## ​The Prompt

​The goal is to create innovative, unique experiences that push the status quo of what’s possible using onchain apps. We’re looking for projects with practical value that leverage the benefits of being onchain, the programmability of MPC Wallets, and the customizability enabled through streamlined API calls. Feel free to integrate AgentKit!

​If you’re looking for ideas, here’s a few to get started: 

- ​A **social agent** that attracts attention and builds a following.

- ​A **trading agent** that implements automated trading logic based on user defined parameters.

- ​A **Defi agent** that can help users understand protocol opportunities and risks.

- ​**Chat agent** that can help people find useful information.

***​Submissions must be built on Base***

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

## 🎤 Co-Presenters 

**​Hosted by Base and Antler India**

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

## Why Participate

​The Buildathon is open to all **physical attendees** and winners will receive over **$10k in prizes** (more details be announced). Plus all winners will receive: 

- ​Marketing & Distribution: All winners will be featured on Base social channels (X, Warpcast and get to present live on Base Cafe)

- ​Network: Connections with some of the most prolific Base builders in your region, with direct access to the Base team.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

## 👉 How it Works

​In order to be eligible, the projects must follow the below rules:
- Must submit one project per team.
- Teams can be 1-3 people
- Must be built on Base 
- Must satisfy the prompt described above
- ​Must include a functioning onchain app at a publicly accessible URL
- ​Agent must have an associated X account where demos, links to repos and other info is posted.
- ​Must include an open-source GitHub repository for all source code in the app.
- ​Integrating Basenames and Smart Wallet is strongly recommended; they make it easy for anyone to get onchain.
- ​Must submit proof of 1+ transactions on Base mainnet or Base Sepolia testnet.
- ​The entry must be in a working format with a loom video posted to social media by the Sunday afternoon deadline.
- ​Must be code complete by the Sunday deadline. 

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)


## ​🥇 Evaluation Criteria

- **​Technicality:** Functions as pitched
- **Originality:** Innovation/originality to solve problems
- **Practicality:** Usable and accessible by anyone
- **Wow Factor:** Primarily measured on how well it performs its utility and intended purpose
![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)
## ​📒 Builder Resources 

- [​Getting Started on Base](https://www.base.org/build)
- [Base Documentation](https://docs.base.org/)
- [Basenames](https://www.base.org/names) ([OnchainKit](https://docs.base.org/docs/basenames-tutorial-with-onchainkit/), [Wagmi](https://docs.base.org/docs/basenames-tutorial-using-wagmi/))
- ​[Coinbase Developer Platform](https://docs.cdp.coinbase.com/)
- [Faucets](https://docs.base.org/docs/tools/network-faucets/) ([CDP](https://portal.cdp.coinbase.com/products/faucet), [thirdweb](https://thirdweb.com/base-sepolia-testnet))
- ​[OnchainKit](https://onchainkit.xyz/)
- ​​[Smart Wallet](https://www.smartwallet.dev/why)
- [​Based AI AgentKit](https://docs.cdp.coinbase.com/agentkit/docs/welcome)
![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

​​***Disclosure:*** 

*By submitting your information in the form, you agree that Coinbase can contact you about participation in the hackathon.*

*​Event Photo Release: By attending this event, you agree to be included in photographs and/or footage that may be taken and used by Coinbase for marketing and publicity purposes, on its website, blog and in social media or in any third party publication.*

​*Coinbase Data Use Notice: By registering for an event, you agree that any information you provide, including but not limited to your name, email, and wallet address, may be used by Coinbase for purposes of supporting the event and contacting you for event follow-up. Additionally, wallet address information may be used by Coinbase to view public blockchain activity for purposes of gathering onchain insights and trends.*

tagline: Largest and Longest Running #BUILDathon in the World
desc:
# **REGENERATES ASSEMBLE!**

# **ETHDenver: The Largest and Longest Running #BUIDLathon in the World!**

ETHDenver is the world’s largest and longest running blockchain-powered #BUIDLathon (FKA hackathon). Every year, more than 25,000+ innovators from over 125 countries converge to create a week-long festival of innovation. ETHDenver is a world renowned gathering place where developers, creators, and visionaries come together to address critical challenges and bring groundbreaking ideas to life in the fields of blockchain and distributed computing.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/acb0ed71-a0fd-4663-a9ba-0a3306ce7ce4.png)

## **Have You Been Accepted to Attend ETHDenver?**

To participate in the #BUIDLathon, [**apply for your ETHDenver ticket here before completing the #BUIDLathon application on Devfolio**](https://www.ethdenver.com/tickets).

IMPORTANT: When submitting your BUIDLer application on the [ETHDenver 2025 Devfolio page](https://ethdenver2025.devfolio.co/), **use the same email you provided when registering for ETHDenver**.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/acb0ed71-a0fd-4663-a9ba-0a3306ce7ce4.png)

## **A Global Stage for Trailblazing Ideas and Funding Opportunities**

ETHDenver is more than a competition— it's a launchpad for success. With **up to $1,000,000 in sponsor bounties and prizes** and **up to $10,000,000 in grants and investments**, ETHDenver provides the support needed to turn visionary ideas into reality.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/acb0ed71-a0fd-4663-a9ba-0a3306ce7ce4.png)

## **A Legacy of Success and Community Impact**

ETHDenver’s impact extends beyond the event. Our alumni have collectively raised over **$300 million** in funding (excluding undisclosed grants and early-stage investments). Past #BUIDL teams— such as 1Inch, POAP.xyz, Huma Finance, Harpie, and others— have evolved from humble beginnings at ETHDenver into key players and contributors to the blockchain ecosystem. Some have even become sponsors, partners, and integral contributors to the ETHDenver Community Innovation Festival.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/acb0ed71-a0fd-4663-a9ba-0a3306ce7ce4.png)

## **Join the Best Blockchain Innovators**

Join the next wave of over 1,000 teams of #BUIDLers at ETHDenver 2025! This is your opportunity to connect with a global community that’s not just watching blockchain innovation unfold but actively driving its future.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/acb0ed71-a0fd-4663-a9ba-0a3306ce7ce4.png)

## **Prepare to BUIDL at ETHDenver 2025: Year of the Regenerates**

- [**Join the ETHDenver community on Discord**](https://discord.com/invite/sporkdao) and head to the #BUIDL channel for the latest announcements, news, opportunities to connect with potential teammates, and rapid access to mentor support throughout the main event! Feel free to start bouncing project ideas around and take your time getting to know fellow BUIDLers who you may want to team-up with.
- **ETHDenver 2025 Pre-Event Virtual Meetup Schedule [Coming Soon!]**
    
    We're hosting a series of sessions to equip you with everything you need to excel in the ETHDenver 2025 BUIDLathon, whether you're looking to fill open spots on your team or build one from scratch! Each session will be recorded for on-demand viewing, and we’ll offer them at various times to accommodate live attendance across all time zones.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/acb0ed71-a0fd-4663-a9ba-0a3306ce7ce4.png)

## **We’re Taking the BUIDLer Experience to a Whole New Level for ETHDenver 2025!**

**BODEGA:** We heard you! You want more fresh, hot food options, not just snacks and occasional drops—consider it done! This year, we’re massively upgrading the food and beverage experience with enhanced staffing and a wider selection of options available throughout the day and into the evening.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

**COFFEE/TEA CART:** Our barista coffee service was a hit, so it’s back for 2025! We’re also adding new flavors and complimentary snacks to really help you get in the zone.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

**INTERNET:** Our IT Stewards made significant infrastructure upgrades in 2024, but we're not stopping there. We’re going all out to provide the best connectivity for ETHDenver 2025:

- **Enhanced Core Infrastructure** to prevent dropped connections.
- **Expanded NAT Pool** to prevent service throttling and improve connection distribution.
- **Increased Access Point Density** in BUIDLHub to reduce equipment overload and improve coverage.
- **Real-time Monitoring and Tactical Deployment** to address wireless dead zones during the event.
- **Hardwired Connectivity Options** through network switches deployed at each row. And if you forget your Ethernet cable, we’ll also have a free “Build Your Own Ethernet Cable” Station in the MakerSpace which is moving into the BUIDLHub!

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

**VIBE:** This year’s BUIDLHub will take over the same spacious arena but we’ll be packing in way more vibe. You’ll find more diverse seating options, different levels of light in each area, more lamps and adjustable lighting, and a new festival inspired layout to replace the old rows of tables.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

**DJ CHILL ROOM:** This year’s experience will be Legen… dary… featuring a 33 foot projection mapped dome featuring creative art from the local and international community. We’ll be bringing back the “call for DJs” with live sets taking place all week long. If you ever need a change of pace, this space will most definitely be your jam.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

**MAKERSPACE:** This year’s MakerSpace will have an expanded support team ready to help you integrate physical tech into your software projects. As you brainstorm project ideas for this year’s BUIDLathon, consider how "phygital" connections  that bridge blockchain with the real world could take your ideas to the next level. We’ve invited several projects for you to connect with and gain firsthand insights. They’ll be demoing their innovations, showing how they’re leveraging blockchain-powered phygital tech to create real-world impact.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/acb0ed71-a0fd-4663-a9ba-0a3306ce7ce4.png)

## **Review Our Code of Conduct**

All attendees must adhere to the [**Code of Conduct**](https://nsb.dev/ethdenver2025-terms-of-service) to ensure a safe, inclusive, and productive environment for everyone.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

**Get Registered, Get Connected on Discord and Get Ready to #BUIDL like never before.**

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

**SEE YOU SOON REGENERATES!**
