name: ZK Online Hackathon for Web3 Builders
tagline: Build Web3 Apps with Advanced ZK Proofs
desc:
# ZK Online Hackathon for Web3 Builders - Jan 27th to Feb 13th 2025

The zkVerify Foundation is excited to announce our second online hackathon for ZK builders from January 27th to February 13th\! 
\
Our first ZK online hackathon was held in November 2024, and was very successful \- see winning projects here: [zkVerify ZK App and Infra Builders - Projects](https://zkverify-zk-application-and-infrastructure-buildin.devfolio.co/projects) 
\
We’re inviting developers with experience in building ZK and Web3 dApps to create innovative and impactful web3 projects on Open Campus and Arbitrum with advanced ZK proofs using zkVerify’s public, permissionless ZK proof verification system.
\
With zkVerify set to launch on mainnet in Q1 2025, we’re eager to support the development of applications that demonstrate the power of our platform. 
\
There will be a follow-on incubator and grants program to assist projects in turning their ideas into fully functioning dApps after zkVerify mainnet and TGE.
\
Open Campus Protocol is a community-driven initiative that harnesses the power of blockchain technology to create a fairer education system. AI and DeSci initiatives are an important focus for Open Campus, and there are specific awards for these technologies.
\
Arbitrum makes it possible for projects to leverage Ethereum's security to build next-gen apps. Arbitrum has advanced Web3 technology with Stylus, an EVM extension that enables builders to integrate Rust and C++ code into their web3 applications alongside Solidity.
\
zkVerify is a key layer in the tech stack, enabling powerful, cost-effective applications that incorporate proofs for transparency and trust. Whether you’re working on provable randomness, fair gaming, AI training data verification, or secure private communications, zkVerify lets you achieve public proof verification quickly and affordably.

## Basic Hackathon Timeline

# Timeline

December 20 

* Announcement   
* Developers start forming teams on zkVerify Discord  
* Explore Technical Stack  
* Ask questions of the zkVerify team

January 9 - Registration Opens

January 14 \- Feb 6  
Workshops, Presentations, AMA's, X spaces

* Introduction to Sponsors and Prizes  
* zkVerify Architecture Overview and Developer tools   
* How to build Web3 Smart Contract dApps with zkVerify  
* Introduction to new ZK verifiers and how to use  
* Business Discussion Livestream with special guests and Q\&A  
  * Building a business that scales  
  * How to craft your first product  
  * Finding, engaging, and keeping users  
  * Pros and cons of accepting investment  
  * Path of Hackathon project to self-sustaining product  
* Technical AMA session 

January 27 \- Hackathon officially starts
Feb 13 \- Project Submission Deadline  
Feb 14 \- 20 Judges Voting on Projects  
Feb 21 \- Live Award Presentation

# Prize Descriptions

## Prize Categories

### $10,000 Grand Prize from zkVerify Foundation

* Best overall application using zkVerify  
* Must be web3 smart contract application on one of these blockchains  
  * Arbitrum  
  * EDU Chain

### $10,000 Open Campus Prize Track

* All \- Web3 dApps on EDU Chain using zkVerify  
* dApp using AI   
* dApp for DeSci \- Decentralized Science

### $10,000 Arbitrum Prize Track

* All \- Web3 dApp on Arbitrum using zkVerify  
* Up to 5 individual prizes for specific categories

### More Sponsor Joining this Hackathon Soon\!

Prize award notes:

* zkVerify Foundation will be awarding Main Prize Pool prizes in USDC  
* Prizes will be paid to teams/individuals meeting the rules of the contest  
* Each Main Prize is awarded to a unique project, and must meet minimum requirements based on the scoring system described below to be eligible.  
* Sponsor prizes can be combined with Main Prize Pool prizes.  
* Sponsor prizes awarded by Sponsors in native token or USDC, at Sponsor's choice.

**Why Use zkVerify?**

1. **Use many different types of ZK Proofs:** Zero Knowledge research is moving fast. zkVerify lets you use new technology proving systems for your specific use case. If you don't see a verifier for your proof, it can be added\!  
2. **Cost Reduction**: By using zkVerify, developers can significantly cut down on the costs associated with proof creation and verification by using new and faster ZK proofs.  
3. **Speed**: Improved verification speed means quicker transaction times and better user experience. zkVerify is a dedicated proof verification blockchain.  
4. **Innovation**: Opportunity to innovate in fields like finance, gaming, identity verification, and more, using zero-knowledge proofs.


**The zkVerify Hackathon**  
To catalyze the integration of these proofs into real-world applications, the zkVerify Foundation is launching a hackathon with a prize pool of up to $30,000. This initiative is aimed at developers eager to:

* Upgrade their existing projects with ZK enhancements.  
* Create new applications leveraging ZK proofs for enhanced privacy and efficiency.


# Application Scenarios for ZK Proofs in Web3

zkVerify is the single platform where any application that needs public proof verification on a decentralized and permissionless system can get their proofs verified. This makes zkVerify the main network hub for the rapidly growing ZK proof application space.

See more information at our blog post [ZK Online Hackathon for Web3 Builders](https://blog.zkverify.io/posts/zk-online-hackathon-for-web3-builders)

name: OLabs Hackathon
desc:
# Hackathon Timeline

Registration & Idea Submission Period: 12.01.2025 to 10.02.2025
Result Announcement: 15.02.2025 onwards
Grand Finale: 28.02.2025 to 01.03.2025

# Event structure 

1. Idea Submission: Teams must submit a PPT (maximum 5 slides, excluding team details) with the following details:
Slide 1: Team Information
Slide 2: Domain and Theme Focus
Slide 3: Problem and Proposed Solution
Slide 4: Technical Details and Scalability
Slide 5: Concise Summary and Impact
Details are provided here-
Round 1: Abstract Framework for OLabs Hackathon Idea Submission

(180-250 words)

Slide 1: Team Information
• Track: Student / Professional
• List team name, team members, their roles, and mention the team lead first.
Slide 2: Domain and Theme Focus
Domain and Theme Alignment (20-30 words)
• Mention the theme you are focusing on (e.g., AI-Powered Virtual Labs, Blockchain for Lab
Integrity, etc.).
• Briefly explain how your idea fits into the chosen theme.
Slide 3: Problem and Proposed Solution
Problem Statement (30-50 words)
• Clearly describe the problem your idea aims to solve in the context of the OLabs platform.
• State the challenges such as accessibility, security, functionality, or user experience in virtual
education and labs.
Proposed Solution (40-60 words)
• Provide an overview of the solution you are proposing.
• Mention how your idea leverages technology (e.g., AI, VR, blockchain) to enhance the
OLabs platform, improve functionality, and solve the identified problems.
Slide 4: Technical Details and Scalability
Technical Approach (30-40 words)
• Outline the technical steps or tools you'll use to implement your solution.
• Mention the technologies or methodologies (e.g., AI models, data analytics, IoT) involved in
the development.

Scalability (30-50 words)
• Discuss the scalability of your solution and how it can be expanded or applied across various
educational settings.
• Highlight the potential impact your solution can have on the OLabs platform, including
improvements in accessibility, engagement, or learning outcomes.
Slide 5 - Concise Summary and Impact

Conclusion (20-30 words)
• Summarize the core benefit of your proposed solution.
• Reinforce the expected positive impact on OLabs and virtual education.
Instructions:
• Abstracts should be submitted in PDF or Word format via Devfolio.
• The organizers will evaluate the abstracts based on their relevance to the theme, originality,
feasibility, and potential impact.
• The best ideas will be awarded prizes and may receive further support for development and
implementation.
 
2. Prototype Building: Shortlisted teams will develop their solutions in offline finale round at the Amritapuri  (Kerala) campus.

Judgement: All the shortlisted eContent will be judged. 

# About Olabs

Watch this overview video: [https://youtu.be/lhqWK96qg7A?si=fqVRRZZGS_yGMcL4](url) 


💡 #  About OLabs Hackathon

The OLabs Hackathon is a prestigious national-level technology event jointly organized by **Amrita School of Computing** and **ACM Chapter**, and **Amrita Center for Research in Analytics, Technologies & Education (Amrita CREATE)**, **Amritapuri**. 

💻 **Core Goal:** Enhancing Olabs with creative, practical, scalable, technological solutions.

# Problem Statement

Design and develop innovative, scalable, and technology-driven solutions to enhance the OLabs platform, addressing key challenges in virtual education. Focus on improving the accessibility, functionality, and effectiveness of virtual labs while ensuring security, reliability, and data integrity.

# Themes

Participants can explore and contribute to a diverse set of themes, such as:
1. **AI-Powered Virtual Labs:** Leveraging artificial intelligence to improve lab experiences.
2. **Cybersecurity in Virtual Labs:** Ensuring secure and safe online learning environments.
3. **Blockchain for Lab Integrity:** Using blockchain technology to maintain data authenticity and integrity.
4. **OLabs Development or/and Integration of Virtual Reality (VR)/Augmented Reality (AR):** Developing OLabs simulations, games, and VR/3D experiences for any school subject, including Sciences, Mathematics, and other disciplines; or/and enhancing existing virtual labs with immersive technologies. 
5. **Data Science & Analytics for Virtual Labs:** Applying analytics to optimize and personalize lab usage.
6. **Collaborative Learning:** Building features that enable peer-to-peer and group learning.
7. **IoT and Virtual Labs:** Integrating IoT devices to expand lab functionality.
8. **Large Language Model (LLM):** To enhance the OLabs platform with NLP features.

# Subject Areas

Participants can develop solutions related to:
• Science, Physics, Chemistry, and Biology
• Computer Science and Programming
• Entrepreneurship Development
• Indian Sign Language

# Who can Participate?
• Secondary and Higher secondary school students (8th to 12th grade)
• College students (UG and PG (including PhD))
• Professionals

# Why Participate?
• Create, innovate, and develop solutions to enhance OLabs 
• Make a difference in the virtual lab experience across subjects
• Collaborate with brilliant minds
• Win exciting prizes and recognition
• Network with seasoned experts

# Rules
• **Registration:** Registration must be completed via the designated website. Each team must participate through a single account.
• **Team Structure:** Teams of 2-4 members, all from either school or college or industry (no mixed-category teams). You can only be part of one team. Team changes are not allowed after the idea submission phase.
• Content should be in English.
• Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham will retain a copy of all entries, and the submitted eContent may be used for educational purposes, including dissemination through 
online and offline modes.
• Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham reserves all rights to modify the rules and dates.

**HACKSAGON** was first launched in 2020 as a collaborative initiative to bring together innovative minds from across the nation. The inaugural edition was successfully organized by ABV-IIITM IEEE Student Branch in partnership with six IIITs.

Building upon the robust foundation of its inaugural edition, **HACKSAGON 2025** aims to elevate innovation and collaboration to new heights by rewarding the innovators with an overall prize pool of ₹2,50,000+. 

## 🏆 Prize Pool :  ₹2,50,000+

## 📌 Features :  
 - **HACKSAGON 2025 showcases 10 exciting tracks, divided into two categories:**  

   - **Software Tracks:**  
     - Mobile App Development  
     - Web Development  
     - Data Science & Machine Learning  
     - Blockchain & Cryptography  
     - Open Innovation  

   - **Hardware + Software Tracks:**  
     - Smart Cities & IoT Solutions  
     - IoT-Enabled Healthcare & Assistive Technologies  
     - Smart Wearables for Safety  
     - Disaster Management & Emergency Response  
     - Agritech & Rural Innovation  

For more details about Tracks: [Click Here](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1TZhi2bnYIAcB7WOmZAUh6_Ce-4oHOuw7/view?usp=sharing)  

## 🗓️ Rounds :  
The hackathon will be conducted in **three rounds:**  

  - **Round 1 – Ideation Phase**  
    - **Mode:** Online submission of project ideas  
    - Submit a detailed project idea based on the given themes according to the format provided.  
    - **Template:** [Click Here](https://bit.ly/hacksagon-template)  

  - **Round 2 – Idea Presentation**  
    - **Mode:** Virtual/On-site presentation  
    - PPT presentation of your idea to the panel of judges  

  - **Round 3 – Final Prototype Round**  
    - **Mode:** 36-hour on-site hackathon at ABV-IIITM, Gwalior

name: ISTD Hackathon
tagline: Revolutionizing Workplace Learning, One Innovation at a Time
desc:
**The Future of Work and Learning: Embracing Learning 4.0**

[ITM Skills University](https://isu.ac.in/) presents ISTD Hackathon organised by [LetsUpgrade](https://letsupgrade.in/), powered by [Lisa](https://lisaapp.in/)

Welcome to the ISTD Hackathon 2025, a transformative event designed to drive innovation in workplace learning and development. As part of our exploration into Learning 4.0, this hackathon invites participants to design cutting-edge, tech-enabled solutions that empower individuals and organizations to thrive in a dynamic, fast-changing world.

## Hackathon Overview

**Prizes**
1. 1st Place: INR 60,000
2. 2nd Place: INR 40,000
3. 3rd Place: INR 25,000

All Participants will get a Certificate of Participation.

**Application Process**
1. Only the team leader is required to apply in this form. 
2. Please make sure to select the correct team size and fill all necessary details of each member in the application form
3. Only the leader shall receive automated communications. 4. Please make sure to inform your team members.
5. You all shall soon be added to a Group post Approval.

**Objectives**
1. Design innovative solutions for personalized workplace learning.
2. Integrate emerging technologies like AI, AR/VR, and gamification into corporate training.
3. Develop practical tools to address upskilling and reskilling challenges in the Industry 4.0 era.
4. Create scalable frameworks that align organizational goals with effective learning methodologies.

## Tracks
1.**AI and Personalization** -  Build adaptive learning platforms that customize experiences for individual learners.
2.**Immersive Training** - Design AR/VR-powered simulations for hands-on, immersive employee training.
3.**Gamification in Learning** - Develop engaging, game-based learning frameworks that boost participation and knowledge retention.
4.**Analytics and ROI** - Create tools leveraging data analytics to measure the effectiveness of training programs and improve ROI.

## Hackathon Format

**Team Size**
> Minimum: 2 participants
> Maximum: 4 participants

**Timeline**
Part 1: Online Hackathon
> Start: 10th January 2025, 10:30 AM
> End: 11th January 2025, 12:30 PM

**Part 2: Final Presentations by Top 10 Teams**
> Date: 12th January 2025
> Venue: Online
> Time : 10 AM to 1 PM

**ISTD Conference and Prize Distribution Ceremony**
> Date: 17th January 2025
> Venue: Novotel, Andheri, Mumbai

## Hackathon Agenda

### Part 1: Online
> **Day 1: 10th January 2025**
>> 10:30 AM: Keynote Address
>> 11:00 AM: Rules and Tracks Explanation + Presentation and Demo Briefing
>> 11:30 AM: Hacking Begins
>
> **Day 2: 11th January 2025**
>> 12:00 PM - 1:30 PM: Submission Window
>> 2:00 PM - 5:00 PM: Judging Round
>> 5:00 PM: Announcement of Top 10 Teams
>> 5:30 PM: Closing Ceremony

### Part 2: Online Presentations

> 1 .Top 10 teams will present their projects (5 minutes each) in front of a jury on 12th January from 10:00 AM to 1:00 PM.
> 2. Top 3 teams will win free passes to the ISTD Conference for the prize distribution ceremony

name: UniDAO (IIT Roorkee)
tagline: Around 3-4 weeks in the month of December. This will be after the End Term examinations and before the start of the next semester. For 1y, this a time they can preapre for club recruitments and hackathons like StackTooDeep.
desc:
UniDAO is a cohort of a dozen students who will be taught blockchain and ethereum development concepts from scratch. This is similar to a fellowship like The Season of Code by MDG or Winter of Code by SDSLabs. This is in partnership with Devfolio who provide whatever support nessecary from logistics to funding (if required).

The exact structure can be different from year to year, but a basic understanding of frontend, backend and smart contract developement and their integrations would be expected at the end of the cohort. Courses like LearnWeb3 DAO or Speedrun Ethereum can be used for the entire duration.
The following topics must be clear at the end of the cohort:

What is blockchain?
Bitcoin v Ethereum
What are smart contracts?
Solidity development on remix (cryptozombies)
Ethersjs
ERC20, ERC721, IPFS (pinata)
DAOs and DeFi
After the cohort they should have enough skills to take part in a hackathon and build a fully functional end to end project.

name: zkVerify ZK App and Infra Builders
tagline: Build Apps and Infra with the newest ZK Proofs!!
desc:
The zkVerify Foundation is thrilled to announce an online hackathon for builders\! 

We’re inviting developers with experience in building ZK applications and infrastructure to create innovative and impactful projects using zkVerify’s public, permissionless ZK proof verification blockchain.

zkVerify is in testnet, and is optimized for ZK Proof Verifications of many types of ZK Proofs, including:

  * Groth16 with either BN-254 or BLS-12-381 curve  
  * UltraPlonk version 31  
  * Space and Time Proof of SQL on BLS-12-381 curve  
  * RiscZero STARK version 1.0.1

With zkVerify set to launch on mainnet in Q1 2025, we’re eager to support the development of applications that demonstrate the power of our platform. We expect to have a Grants program after mainnet launch.

This hackathon offers cash prizes for individuals and teams building Web2 and Web3 applications that leverage zkVerify for zero-knowledge proof verification. We also welcome tools and improvements that enhance zkVerify itself\!

zkVerify is a key layer in the tech stack, enabling powerful, cost-effective applications that incorporate proofs for transparency and trust. Whether you’re working on provable randomness, fair gaming, AI training data verification, or secure private communications, zkVerify lets you achieve public proof verification quickly and affordably.

## Timeline

15 November 

* Announcement   
* Developers start forming teams on Discord  
* Explore Technical Stack  
* Ask questions of the zkVerify team

19 Nov \- 5 Dec  
Workshops, Presentations, AMA's, X spaces

* 19 Nov \- zkVerify Overview and Example Use Cases  
* 21 Nov \- zkVerify Architecture Overview and Developer tools   
* 25 Nov \- How to Use zkVerify as decentralized proof verifier for Web2 games   
* 26 Nov \- Partner panel \- Hyperbridge and others  
* 27 Nov \- How to Integrate zkVerify with EVM Smart Contract dApp   
* 3 December \- zkVerify zkHack presentation   
* 5 December \- Technical AMA session 

10 December \- Project Submission Deadline  
11 December \- Sponsors Voting on Projects  
12 December \- Live Award Presentation

## Technical Stack

The zkVerify Hackathon provides developers with a robust technical framework:

* **zkVerify Blockchain**: At the core of this hackathon is the zkVerify blockchain, constructed on the Substrate framework. This blockchain integrates specialized verifier pallets that enable rapid and cost-effective verification of zero-knowledge proofs. These proofs, once verified, are:

  * **Posted to the Blockchain**: Making them publicly available and accessible via an API or blockchain explorer for transparency and auditability.  
  * **Aggregated Verifications**: Periodically, these verifications are batched and forwarded to zkVerify smart contracts deployed on multiple EVM testnets like Ethereum Sepolia, Apchain Curtis,  Horizon EON, and Arbitrum Sepolia, ensuring compatibility and interoperability.  
* **Project Diversity**: The applications leveraging zkVerify can span a broad spectrum:  
  * **Web2 Applications**: These can include centralized applications that require proof of computation, like ensuring the fairness of a raffle or the randomness in a game through verifiable randomness.  
  * **Web3 Smart Contract dApps**: Here, ZK proofs enhance smart contract functionalities, particularly for privacy-focused applications like:  
    * Private messaging systems  
    * Secure and anonymous voting or polling mechanisms  
    * Darkpool trading   
    * NFT trading  
* **Development Tools**:  
  * **zkVerify JS**: A JavaScript library available on NPM, designed to streamline the integration of ZK proofs into your applications, making development more accessible and efficient.

## Definition of Complete Application for Submittal

* Submitted to Devfolio before the deadline of 10 Dec midnight UTC

## General Rules

* Projects must be created by the individual or team entering them in the contest.  
* No project that was submitted for an award in a previous zkVerify hackathon is qualified.  
* No project that re-uses code with a non-permissive license.  
* Project code must be created after the hackathon start date of 15 Nov 2024\.  
* Project code should show regular commit history during the hackathon.  
* Must integrate zkVerify for ZK proof verification with any of the verifiers available as listed at   
  * Groth16 with either BN-254 or BLS-12-381 curve  
  * UltraPlonk version 31  
  * Space and Time Proof of SQL on BLS-12-381 curve  
  * RiscZero STARK version 1.0.1  
  * Any others added during the hackathon available on zkVerify

### Web2 Applications

* The Application should be functional with the end user should only required interact with the application frontend   
* The user can be required to have funds on a zkVerify wallet and connect their wallet to use the Application  
* Submit source code via a public GitHub repository  
* A clear README file with a short description of:  
  * How to set up and use the dApp  
  * A clear use cases for ZK proofs  
  * Team and background  
* Optional Architectural diagram  
* Example: zkMastermind game [https://zkmastermind.zkVerify.io/](https://zkmastermind.zkverify.io/) 

### Web3 dApps

* The dApp must be built on Ethereum Sepolia, EON Gobi, or ApeChain Curtis  
* The smart contract should interact with the zkVerifyAttestation contract instance deployed on that chain in order to verify proof of correctness.  
* The dApp should be functional in one of two ways:  
  * Preferred \- abstract the use of zkVerify  
    *  the end user should only interact with the dApp frontend and shouldn't be required to have funds on zkVerify or a Substrate wallet.  
    * The dApp backend should take care of submitting the zk-proof to zkVerify and handling the event emitted by zkVerify upon successful verification.  
  * Optional \- require user to have both EVM and zkVerify wallet to use dApp  
* Submit source code via a public GitHub repository  
* A clear README file with a short description of:  
  * How to set up and use the dApp  
  * A clear use cases for ZK proofs  
  * Team and background  
* Optional Architectural diagram

### zkVerify Tools and Improvements to existing zkVerify Code

* Code that makes integrating applications with zkVerify easier for developers. Examples  
  * This can be an abstraction front end for zkVerify  
  * Can be a library that makes zkVerify easier to use.  
  * Can be an integration into a Domain Specific Language development framework  
  * Can be an upgrade to web3 development tools to make it easy to integration zkVerify into a web3 application  
  * Another useful improvement that makes developing with zkVerify more straightforward.  
* Submit source code via a public GitHub repository  
* A clear README file with a short description of:  
  * How to set up and use the dApp  
  * A clear use cases for ZK proofs  
  * Team and background  
* Optional Architectural diagram

# Judging Standards

Judging will be done by a panel of judges drawn from the zkVerify project and Co-sponsoring projects

* Functionality (25%)  
  * Does the project successfully achieve its intended purpose using zkVerify?  
  * Is the zkVerify integration sound and working correctly?  
  * Is the project bug-free and stable during testing?  
* Innovation & Creativity (25%)  
  * How innovative is the project in terms of utilizing zero-knowledge proofs?  
  * Does it push boundaries or introduce novel approaches to privacy and trustless interaction?  
  * Does it solve a new problem or offer a unique application for ZKPs?  
* Technical Complexity (20%)  
  * Did the team overcome significant technical challenges in the project?  
  * Is there a balance between sophistication and efficiency (e.g., how computationally intensive the solution is)?  
* Usability & User Experience (10%)  
  * Is the project easy to use and accessible to its target audience (e.g., developers or end-users)?  
  * Does it have a clear and simple user interface (UI) ?  
  * How well does it document how others can use or implement the solution?  
* Team Collaboration & Presentation (10%)  
  * How well did the team work together to complete the project?  
  * Was the project’s presentation clear, and did it effectively communicate the technical features?  
  * Is the project well-documented for potential future development?

name: Save The Stray Challenge
desc:
Save The Stray 🐾: "Innovating Road Safety for Stray Animals" 🚗🐄

We invite you to be part of an exciting and impactful hackathon aimed at solving a critical road safety issue: accidents involving stray animals. 🛣️ This challenge brings together IoT, Machine Learning, Architectural Design, and App/Web Development to create innovative solutions that can detect, manage, and mitigate the risks posed by animals on roads. 🐾🚶‍♂️

This hackathon is an opportunity to combine technology and infrastructure in novel ways, addressing a real-world problem with high social impact. 💡 Whether you're working on sensor-based systems, AI-driven predictions, or user-friendly apps/web platforms, your solutions could make a tangible difference in improving road safety for both drivers and animals. 🐕💻

Join us as we collaborate to create safer roads, smarter cities 🌆, and a better future for all. 🌍

Problem Statement 🚨
Accidents caused by stray cattle 🐄 and other animals 🦊 on roadways present significant dangers, often resulting in injuries, fatalities, and property damage. 🏥🚑 The challenge is to create innovative solutions that integrate technology and infrastructure to detect animals on the road, alert drivers, and manage animal movement effectively. Potential solutions could involve the use of sensors, GPS tracking, driver notification systems, and physical deterrents. The ultimate goal is to enhance road safety, reduce accidents, and safeguard both drivers and animals. 🦺

Expected Solutions 🛠️
Animal Detection and Warning Systems 🐄🔍

Infrared Sensors & Cameras: Install thermal sensors and cameras to detect animals based on heat signatures, even in low light. 🌙
AI Animal Recognition: Use AI to analyze real-time footage from cameras and trigger alerts when animals are detected. 🤖
Ultrasonic Deterrents: Deploy sound-emitting devices to keep animals away from roads, without disturbing humans. 🔊🐾
GPS Tracking & Geofencing 📡

GPS Collars for Animals: Attach GPS collars to monitor animals and send alerts if they approach restricted road areas. 🧭
Predictive Models: Use machine learning to predict high-risk areas and times for animal movement, enabling targeted interventions. 📈
Driver Alert Systems 🚘⚠️

In-Vehicle Alerts: Integrate animal detection systems with vehicle alerts for real-time notifications to drivers. 🚨
Roadside LED Displays: Install dynamic displays to warn drivers of animal sightings ahead. 🖥️
Physical Infrastructure & Barriers 🚧

Animal Overpasses/Underpasses: Build designated animal crossing structures to prevent road entry. 🌉🐾
Reflective Markers: Use reflective road markers to deter animals from crossing. ✨
Speed Breakers & Signage: Install speed bumps and warning signs at known animal crossing zones. ⚠️🛑
Community Awareness & Involvement 🏘️

Reporting Apps: Develop apps for citizens to report stray animals, alerting authorities for swift action. 📱
Local Awareness Campaigns: Educate communities on animal crossing hotspots and safe driving practices. 🦺
Mode of the Challenge 🌐
Online

Registration Fee 💸
Free Registration

Submission Guideline 📝
Participants are expected to create a Github Repository and include a readme file explaining everything. 💻📂 Finally, participating teams must provide the proposed solution in a DOUBLE COLUMN IEEE FORMAT. Download the format from the link below:
👉 IEEE Format Template

Let’s work together to create safer roads, smarter cities, and a future where both humans and animals can coexist in harmony! 🐾🌍

desc:
🌟 **Hack with GDG Season 2 - 24-Hour Hackathon!** 🌟

🚀 **Calling all developers, designers, and innovators!**
We're back with **Hack with GDG Season 2**, the most exciting 24-hour hackathon organized by **Google Developer Student Club - KSR Institute for Engineering and Technology.** After the huge success of last year’s **Hack with GDSC**, we’re ready to make it bigger and better, now with **two rounds** of innovation and coding challenges!

🔥 **Event Overview:**
**1. Round 1:**
Submit your **project ideas** in the form of a PPT. If you already have a prototype, feel free to include it! The best, most innovative ideas will be shortlisted, and those teams will move on to Round 2.

**2. Round 2 (24-Hour Offline Hackathon):**
Shortlisted teams will be invited to KSR Institute for Engineering and Technology for a **24-hour coding marathon** where they will bring their ideas to life.
**On-the-Spot Project Creation:** Teams will brainstorm, design, and develop their project prototypes within 24 hours.
**Exciting Prizes:** Winners will receive **cash prizes** along with **extra surprise prizes!**

These events are open to all participants separately, whether you’re attending offline or online!

**4. Non-Technical Events:**
Recharge your energy and have some fun with engaging non-tech events to keep the creativity flowing.

**5. Workshops & Networking:** 
Meet industry professionals, interact with mentors, and learn through hands-on workshops.


🏆 **Prizes:**
**Cash rewards** and **Special Surprises** for winning teams .
**Certificates** for all participants.

🎯 **Who Should Join?:**
**Developers:** Whether you're a beginner or a pro, this event is for you.

**Innovators:** Have a big idea? This is your chance to bring it to life!
**Tech Enthusiasts:** Anyone with a passion for coding, solving real-world problems, and meeting like-minded techies.

💡 **Why Attend?:**
**Collaborate and Innovate:** Work in teams, brainstorm new ideas, and develop real-world solutions.
**Build Your Portfolio:** Gain experience working on a project under pressure, and add something valuable to your resume.
**Learn and Grow:** Attend workshops, receive guidance from experts, and unlock your potential.
**Networking Opportunities:** Meet other passionate coders, developers, and professionals.

🌍 **About Us:**
The **Google Developer Groups (GDG)** at KSR Institute for Engineering and Technology is South India’s premier student-led club, recognized for hosting large-scale events like the **Indo-Malaysian Hackathon** and the first-ever **24-hour hackathon in Namakkal**. name: GODAMLah! Hackathon 2024
desc:
**GODAMLah!** is an inaugural hackathon organized by Datasonic Group Berhad and powered by UniLah Sdn Bhd. The Hackathon is designed to empower university students across Malaysia to create innovative solutions for real-world challenges. This event brings together talented young minds to develop impactful, secure, and scalable technologies that address critical issues in areas like digital identity along with the government initiative on MyDigitalID. Through **GODAMLah!**, participants will have the opportunity to apply their skills in building cutting-edge solutions that can shape the future of Malaysia’s digital landscape.

**Challenge Areas:**
**1. Secure Digital Identity Verification Systems**
Participants are challenged to develop advanced, reliable systems that verify user identities online. These systems should ensure privacy while providing robust security for e-commerce platforms, financial services, and government transactions.

**2. AI-driven Cybersecurity Solutions**
Create innovative AI-driven solutions that can detect, prevent, and respond to cyberattacks in real-time. This could include tools that identify phishing attempts, malware, or any form of unauthorized access to sensitive systems.

**3. Secure Online Platforms**
Develop secure digital platforms for education, healthcare, or government services. The platforms should prioritize user data privacy, ensuring that personal information remains protected during online interactions.

**4. Blockchain-based Solutions for Secure Data Sharing**
Design blockchain-powered solutions that allow secure, transparent data sharing between institutions or users. This can be applied to anything from financial transactions to secure document storage and retrieval, ensuring that data remains tamper-proof and protected from unauthorized access.

name: Aligned Builders Hackathon
tagline: A virtual hackathon with up to $50,000 in prizes
desc:
The inaugural Aligned Builders Hackathon is a product-focused hackathon for ZK apps and services that verify ZK proofs using Aligned's Fast Mode.

# Judging criteria and project requirements

This is a product-focused hackathon, with an emphasis on creating usable, functional projects that can make an impact. 

Judges will be reviewing submissions asynchronously. Submissions, especially documentation, must be clear enough to explain the project without being able to present it.

We require a clear README.md file in the project repository as well as a recorded video presentation explaining and demonstrating the project. This must give an overview of:
1. What you built
2. What you have achieved so far
3. What else needs to be added to make the project production-ready

Feel free to include anything else that lets the judges fully understand the state of your project. Failure to do so may result in the judge marking your project as incomplete.

Submissions must use Aligned to verify ZK proofs on Ethereum’s Holesky testnet, and will be judged based on several key criteria:

**Technical Implementation**
1. Does the code work? 
2. Is it well-documented and reliable?

**Innovation and Impact**
1.Does the project showcase a novel use of ZK?
2. Is it solving an important problem or poised to draw in users?

**Design and User Experience**
1. Is the project intuitive, accessible, and user-friendly?

**Readiness**
1. How developed is the project?
2. Is there a roadmap for taking it into production?

**Community Contributions**
1. Has the team actively contributed to the developer community by sharing resources, advice, or support for other participants?

# Additional project requirements

**Projects must also fulfill the following requirements:**
1. **Execution:** Projects must compile and execute successfully. Incomplete submissions won’t qualify.
2. **Open Source License:** Submissions must use an open-source license (MIT, Apache 2, or GNU GPL).
3. **Documentation:** A README.md file should be included with:
-A project description and rationale.
-Background information on the team members.
-An overview of the challenges faced during development and key design considerations.
-Deployment and execution instructions.
-A project roadmap.

**Additional Materials:** 
Submissions must include a GitHub repository (with the README.MD described) as well as a video presentation and demo.

name: Reclaim Opensource Hackweek
desc:
# Reclaim Protocol Hackathon: Empowering Data Ownership

Our hackathon is an exciting part of Hacktoberfest, focusing on building innovative solutions using the Reclaim Protocol. This 7-day event is your opportunity to dive into the world of data ownership and privacy control while collaborating with the vibrant open-source community.

## Event Details

- **Duration:** 7 days of online hacking
- **In-Person Event:** 2-day gathering in Bangalore on October 26-27, 2024
- **Focus/Theme:** Build anything around or with Reclaim Protocol

## Why Participate

- **Innovation:** Be at the forefront of data privacy and user-centric technology.
- **Learning**: Gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge protocols and SDKs.
- **Networking**: Connect with like-minded developers, privacy advocates, and industry experts.
- **Impact**: Contribute to open-source projects that can shape the future of data ownership.
- **Recognition**: Showcase your skills and win prizes for your innovative solutions.
- **Career Growth:** Enhance your portfolio with real-world projects in a high-demand field.

## Who It's For

- **Developers**: Whether you're a seasoned coder or a passionate beginner, there's a place for you to contribute and learn.
- **Privacy Enthusiasts**: If you're passionate about data rights and user privacy, this is your chance to make a difference.
- **Blockchain Innovators**: Explore the intersection of blockchain technology and data ownership.
- **UI/UX Designers**: Help create user-friendly interfaces for complex data management solutions.
- **Data Scientists**: Apply your skills to analyze and optimize data flows in privacy-preserving systems.
- **Open Source Contributors**: Engage with a vibrant community and make meaningful contributions to important projects.
- **Students**: Gain practical experience and network with industry professionals.

## Hacktoberfest Contributions

As part of Hacktoberfest, we invite you to contribute to our open-source repositories:

- [circom-symmetric-crypto](https://github.com/reclaimprotocol/circom-symmetric-crypto)
- [reclaim-js-sdk](https://github.com/reclaimprotocol/reclaim-js-sdk/)
- [docs](https://github.com/reclaimprotocol/docs)
- [attestor-core](https://github.com/reclaimprotocol/attestor-core)

Your contributions can help shape the future of data privacy and user-centric technology!

## About Reclaim Protocol

Reclaim Protocol provides SDKs that simplify the process of integrating user activity, reputation, and identity from external websites into your platform. Our SDKs support web, mobile, and on-chain platforms, enabling you to build applications with access to users' data from across the internet.

### Key features:

- Import user data from popular websites
- Enable off-chain data usage in blockchain economics
- Perform KYC using national IDs
- No need for users to install additional apps or browser extensions

Join us in this exciting journey to revolutionize data ownership and privacy!

## Special Activities and Rewards

- Visit [Hacker Haweli](https://maps.app.goo.gl/qNQKp46hQDkkjSeb8) during the Hackweek and interact with the team members - Tee
- Hoodie - Contribute a PR to one of our repositories
- Backpack - Demo a RFPs

name: ETH Pura Vida
tagline: ¡El hackathon web3 mas grande en Costa Rica!
desc:
Bienvenidos al ETH Pura Vida Hackathon, donde la innovación, la colaboración y la pasión por Web3 convergen para crear soluciones de impacto. Este evento único en su tipo no es solo una competencia; es una experiencia inmersiva diseñada para llevar a los participantes desde la idea hasta un prototipo en un ambiente de apoyo y creatividad.

### **Un Viaje de Innovación:**

El hackathon comienza con una serie de workshops introductorios que te sumergirán en el proceso de ideación, formación de equipos y comprensión de los desafíos más apremiantes del ecosistema Web3. Aquí, no solo conocerás a tus compañeros de equipo, sino que también recibirás orientación de expertos para definir y refinar tus ideas iniciales.

### **Trabajo Presencial Intensivo:**

El 19 de octubre, nos reuniremos en la Sede Interuniversitaria para un día de colaboración intensa. Este es el corazón del hackathon: una jornada dedicada a la creación, donde trabajarás junto a tu equipo, recibirás feedback en tiempo real de mentores experimentados y podrás participar en workshops adicionales. Es la oportunidad perfecta para convertir tus ideas en un prototipo tangible, mientras te conectas con otros innovadores y expertos de la industria.

### **Semana de Cierre:**

En la semana final, recibirás soporte continuo a través de office hours con mentores, quienes te ayudarán a pulir cada detalle de tu proyecto. Aquí, te enfocarás en el desarrollo final, y la preparación de tu pitch. Todo esto culmina en la entrega final el 24 de octubre, donde presentarás tu trabajo en video ante un panel de jueces expertos.

### **Demo Day y Premiación:**

El 26 de octubre es el gran día. Los finalistas presentarán sus proyectos en un emocionante Demo Day, seguido por una sesión de preguntas y respuestas. Aquí se elegirán los ganadores, quienes serán anunciados en la ceremonia de premiación en el evento de ETH Pura Vida.

Únete a nosotros en este viaje de descubrimiento y creación. Ya sea que estés buscando aprender, construir algo nuevo, o simplemente conectar con otros apasionados por Web3, el ETH Pura Vida Hackathon es tu plataforma para dejar tu huella en el futuro de la tecnología.

Objective: Reward the creation of unique escrow mechanisms that extend Trustless Work’s core functionalities. Examples include time-based escrows, privacy-focused escrows, or cross-chain/multichain escrow solutions.
Criteria: We want to see ideas or working prototypes that extend the capabilities of our platform by adding novel features to escrow contracts. This could mean leveraging technologies like Chainlink to create time-based escrows that release funds on specific dates, Scroll to add privacy elements that ensure sensitive transaction details remain confidential, or bridges that make Trustless Work compatible with other blockchain networks beyond Stellar.

Your product should demonstrate how our escrow API can simplify, secure, and add transparency to transactions, while also battle-testing the features of our platform. We are especially interested in ideas that could provide immediate value and tackle real-world problems in securing payments or establishing trust in financial transactions.

prizes.name: Alum Track (Development): SyncWave
prizes.desc:
The Task: 🌟

Imagine trying to sync music with friends on different devices and experiencing slight delays or de-syncs that ruin the listening experience. Whether it's a party or a shared listening session, having synchronized music playback is essential. Your task is to develop a solution that **minimizes latency, handles de-sync**, and provides a simple, user-friendly interface for connecting peers and syncing music seamlessly.

What We Need from You: 🌟🌟
We need a **Proof of Concept (POC)** for a music synchronization tool that ensures real-time playback across multiple devices with **minimal latency and handles any de-sync** that may occur. The focus should be on seamless peer connection and effortless sync management for users.

prizes.name: Alum Track (Development): SubtitleSensei
prizes.desc:
The Task: 🌟

Your task is simple enough and one to put a rest to one of great annoyances of mankind. Have you ever downloaded a movie or show using torrent, and to your dismay found that the download didn’t contain subtitles. You do the obvious thing go to my-subs.co and download the first subtitles but to your horror you see that they are off by just half a second or 1 second or maybe some are on time, some come a little before and maybe a little after.

You can download another but where’s the fun in that. What you need to do is develop a Solution that automatically corrects this offset.

What We Need from You: 🌟🌟

A basic POC (Proof of Concept) of this project will be that given a 5 minute video and its subtitles (may or may not be +/- offset by an arbitrary amount < 3 seconds), your project can correct the subtitles file (basically fix the timestamps) so that both are in sync.

prizes.name: Alum Track (Development): GameCast
prizes.desc: A background gameplay recording tool that captures player inputs with a configurable buffer of 1 to 5 minutes. On demand replays are generated using stored input data, recreating the gameplay experience without relying on saving the current game state. Demonstrations can be made available with games like Super Mario Bros, Pong, or a custom game. May be made customizable for analyzing gameplay, debugging, or creating tutorials.

**🌟 Introducing Hackatron: Central India's Largest Hackathon, Unleashing the Power of Collaboration & Innovation!**

🚀 Join us for an unparalleled tech adventure at Hackatron, the ultimate hackathon hosted by ABV-IIITM Gwalior. Dive into the heart of innovation and creativity as we redefine the essence of technology-driven solutions.

🗓️ **Event Schedule:**

- Registration Deadline: 9th October 2024
- Shortlisting Round: 10th October 2024
- Final Onsite Round: 18th - 20th October 2024
📍 Venue for Final Rounds: ABV-IIITM Gwalior Campus

💰 **Prize Pool**: Worth INR 75,000+

**Theme:**
The theme of Open Innovation in our hackathon is all about fostering creativity, collaboration, and boundary-pushing ideas. It encourages participants to think beyond conventional solutions and explore new, innovative ways to solve real-world problems. With this theme, you have the freedom to choose any problem that inspires you, whether it’s in sustainability, healthcare, education, or technology. The goal is to empower participants to leverage their skills and creativity to create impactful solutions that can shape the future across diverse industries and societal challenges.

**Shortlisting Round:**
In the shortlisting round of Hackatron, participants are required to submit their proposed solution to a problem statement of their choice under the Open Innovation theme.

How it Works:
- Choose Your Problem: Select any real-world problem you would like to solve using technology.
- Submit Your Solution: Propose a solution by outlining your approach, the core technologies you plan to use, and why it’s feasible and impactful.

What to Include in Your Submission:
- Problem Statement: Briefly describe the issue you’re addressing.
- Proposed Solution: Explain your idea, its technical approach, and how it solves the problem.
- Feasibility: Highlight the practicality of your solution (time, resources, etc.).
- Impact: Discuss the potential impact of your solution.

Submission Guidelines:
- You will submit your proposed solution while registering, which will be shared on 1st October,2024.

Evaluation Criteria:

- Innovation: How original and creative is your idea?
- Feasibility: Is the solution realistic and achievable?
- Impact: How significant is the potential outcome of your solution?

All submissions must be completed by the specified deadline. Only shortlisted teams will move forward to the next round.

🎯 Engaging Activities:
Immerse yourself in live project presentations, elevate your ideas through pitching sessions, and stand out before our esteemed panel of judges. Plus, gear up for a fun-filled games round with exciting prizes up for grabs!

🔥 Hosted by ABV-IIITM Gwalior, Hackatron, Central India's largest hackathon, serves as a launchpad for tech enthusiasts to showcase their talents and unleash their full potential. With a perfect blend of competition, learning, and groundbreaking innovation, Hackatron promises an unforgettable journey for all tech enthusiasts.

desc:
A global virtual hackathon, jointly organized by **AltLayer** and **EigenLayer**, for builders in the EigenLayer ecosystem and beyond to come up with new kinds of AVSs that can either serve other AVSs or end users. 

Utilize AltLayer’s [**Wizard**](http://wizard.altlayer.io/) during the hackathon to drastically reduce the deployment and management time of AVSs from months to minutes! Hyper-accelerating the rate of AVS innovation through faster experimentation.

### 💻 **Hackathon format:**
- **Form a Team**: Assemble a team of up to 5 members.
- **Hack Period**: Teams will have until October 31st, 2024, to develop their projects. This hack period will be supported by online workshops and mentorship.
- **Submission Deadline**: Teams will submit their project public GitHub links (for both AVS smart contract and node software codebase) and a brief explainer video (max 5 minutes) by October 31st, 2024 (23:59 UTC).
- **Evaluation**: A panel of experts will review and evaluate all entries and decide the main prize pool winners by November 5th, 2024. Additionally, each bounty issuer will also determine the winner of their individual tracks.
- **Winners Presentation at Rollup Day Thailand**: Top three winning teams will present their projects at Rollup Day Thailand on November 13th, in Bangkok during the much anticipated Devcon week.



### ✅ **Hacker's guide:**
- Find all resources and related information in the [**Hackers' Guide**](https://alt-research.notion.site/AVSthon-Hackers-Guide-11ad3246cc8c80ac8daffc889d83f89a?pvs=25).

- Join the hackathon participant Telegram group to ask both general and technical questions [**HERE**](https://t.me/+QuX_DONeNFk3ODBl).

### 🧾Submission Criteria

1. Open sourced AVS smart contract codebase on GitHub
2. Open sourced AVS node software codebase on GitHub
3. Deployed AVS smart contract code on Holesky testnet
4. One operator (yourself or Hosted Operator Service) running the AVS node software code
5. Demo video (max. 5mins long) showcasing your AVS workflow

### 🧑‍⚖️Judging Criteria

- **Shared Security**: The AVS project leverages Shared Security provided by EigenLayer well
- **Technicality**: The AVS project functions as pitched
- **Originality**: The AVS project is innovative in the way it solves its problems statement
- **Practicality**: The AVS project is useful in solving real world problems
- **Presentation**: The AVS project demo video is concise and presented well within the time limit

name: Sahamati BuildAAthon 2024
desc:
As part of the prestigious *SamvAAd 2024*, the annual Account Aggregator Community Event, we are pleased to present this year’s *Sahamati BuildAAthon*. The hackathon aims to build innovative solutions based on RBI’s revolutionary Account Aggregator (AA) framework, empowering individuals and businesses by giving them greater control over their data.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/acb0ed71-a0fd-4663-a9ba-0a3306ce7ce4.png)

The Sahamati BuildAAthon invites participants to leverage the AA ecosystem to build innovative financial products and services. The BuildAAthon is an exciting platform for young entrepreneurs, builders, and technology enthusiasts to envision the future of Open finance in the country. The AA ecosystem is poised to catalyze the next wave of financial innovation and inclusion in India. Don’t miss out on the chance to be part of this movement!


![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/acb0ed71-a0fd-4663-a9ba-0a3306ce7ce4.png)

## **Event Highlights:**

- **Masterclasses**: Gain insights from renowned industry leaders.
- **Networking Opportunities**: Interact with a diverse group of developers, entrepreneurs, and industry stakeholders.
- **Exciting Awards**: Compete for recognition and prizes.
- **Panel of Esteemed Judges**: Present your innovations to experts in the field.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/acb0ed71-a0fd-4663-a9ba-0a3306ce7ce4.png)

## **Themes**:

1. **Democratizing Insurance and Investment Advisory for Indians**
2. **Empowering Customers to Leverage their Digital Footprints**
3. **Risk Management Solutions for the Ecosystem**

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/acb0ed71-a0fd-4663-a9ba-0a3306ce7ce4.png)

## **Hackathon Format:**
- **Form a Team:** Assemble a team of up to 5 members and register for the AA Hackathon [here](https://sahamati-buildaathon-2024.devfolio.co/). Each hacker must provide their individual details, but you can submit your application as a team (size 1-5).
- **Registration Confirmation:** After registering, teams will receive a confirmation email to start hacking.
- **Launch Event:** Join the online kickoff on October 4th, 2024, featuring demos and sessions by industry experts. You can find the schedule [here](https://sahamati-buildaathon-2024.devfolio.co/schedule).
- **Hack Period:** Teams will have until October 27th, 2024, to develop their projects. This hack period will be supported by online masterclasses and mentorship.
- **Submission Deadline:** Teams will submit their project prototypes and a brief explainer video (max 5 minutes) by October 27th, 2024.
- **Evaluation:** A panel of experts will review and evaluate all entries.
- **Final Presentation:** The top five entries from each theme will present to the jury in the first week of November, 2024. You can find the schedule [here](https://sahamati-buildaathon-2024.devfolio.co/schedule).
- **Winners Presentation at SamvAAd 2024:** Three winning teams will present their projects at Samvaad 2024 on November 19th, in Mumbai.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/acb0ed71-a0fd-4663-a9ba-0a3306ce7ce4.png)

## **Hackers' Guide**
Find all resources and related information in the Hackers' Guide: [https://nsb.dev/sahamati-buildaathon-guide](https://nsb.dev/sahamati-buildaathon-guide)

Join us for Sahamati BuildAAthon 2024 and be part of a movement that, much like UPI’s success, will reshape the future of India’s financial landscape.

prizes.name: 🥈 1st Runner-up
prizes.desc:
## 🔍 Judging Criteria

Judges grade all projects on six main criteria described below. All criteria are listed in the order of most weightage to least:

1. **Technical Implementation:** This criteria evaluates the skilful execution of The Graph protocol within the project. Judges will closely examine how effectively the subgraph has been utilized to gather and present data. A project that demonstrates a deep understanding of the protocol's technical intricacies and implements it seamlessly will receive higher scores.
2. **Design:** Quality of the dapp user interface and user experience (UI/UX) of the decentralized application (dapp) are pivotal to its success. Judges will assess the design's aesthetics, intuitiveness, and overall usability. A well-designed dapp not only attracts users but also enhances their interaction with the platform, making it a key factor in the evaluation process.
3. **Quality of Idea:** Quality of the idea/use-case/problem statement. A project that introduces a novel solution or tackles a previously unaddressed problem will be favorably regarded. Judges will consider how innovative and relevant the idea is to the blockchain and decentralized technology landscape.
4. **Impact on Ecosystem:** Impact on society/community/target audience will be assessed here. Judges will weigh the positive changes the project brings to its ecosystem and the potential benefits it offers to its users. Projects that foster community growth, contribute to the advancement of decentralized technologies, or solve real-world problems will excel in this criteria.
5. **Project Sustainability:** The quality of the project's documentation, roadmap, and long-term viability will be analyzed. Judges will scrutinize the clarity and comprehensiveness of the project's documentation, ensuring that it facilitates seamless understanding and collaboration. A well-structured roadmap that outlines future development stages and potential challenges will further enhance a project's appeal.
6. **Vision Alignment:** Holistic approach and vision alignment with the principles of decentralization. Judges will evaluate whether the project's objectives and approach resonate with the ethos of decentralization, blockchain technology, and fostering a more open and inclusive digital ecosystem.

prizes.name: Create a simple cross-chain integration between Internet Computer Protocol (ICP) and an Ethereum DeFi protocol using ICP's chain fusion technology
prizes.desc:
**Prize Pool: $5,000 In $ICP (split among qualified submissions)**

**Challenge:**
Create a simple cross-chain integration between Internet Computer Protocol (ICP) and an Ethereum DeFi protocol using ICP's chain fusion technology.

**Objective:**
Build a basic application that allows users to interact with an Ethereum DeFi protocol (e.g., Uniswap, Aave, or Compound) from the Internet Computer.

**Requirements:**
- Implement a canister on ICP that interacts with an Ethereum smart contract.
- Use ICP's chain fusion to facilitate cross-chain communication.
- Create a simple user interface for cross-chain interactions.
- Demonstrate a basic cross-chain transaction (e.g., query balance, initiate a swap).

**Judging Criteria:**
Functional implementation (40%)
Effective use of chain fusion (30%)
Code quality and documentation (20%)
User interface (10%)

**Submission Guidelines:**
- GitHub repository with clear README
- Short demo video (2-3 minutes) explaining your solution
- Brief write-up of your approach and challenges faced

No prior ICP experience is required. We encourage Ethereum developers to explore ICP's unique features and learn about chain fusion technology.
Join us in exploring the potential of ICP and Ethereum integration. Let's build bridges between blockchains!
#ICPHackathon #ChainFusion #EthereumBridge #LearnICP

name: Infinia 2024
desc:
# Infinia Hackathon: Igniting Innovation

## Event Description

As part of **"Infinia: Where Imagination meets Technology,"** the hackathon will be the pinnacle of this three-day international flagship event at Sahrdaya College of Engineering and Technology. This hackathon is designed to bring together creative minds from various engineering and technological fields to collaborate, innovate, and create solutions that push the boundaries of technology.

## Details

- **Duration:** 24 hours of non-stop innovation
- **Participants:** Students, professionals, and tech enthusiasts
- **Teams:** Up to 6 members per team
- **Tracks:**
  - **AI:** Explore the limitless possibilities of artificial intelligence.
  - **Blockchain/Web3:** Innovate in the decentralized world of blockchain and Web3 technologies.
  - **General Track:** Tackle any challenge and bring your unique ideas to life.
  - **Circuit Showdown:** Create groundbreaking hardware or IoT solutions that connect the world.

## What's in Store

- **Collaborative Environment:** Work alongside peers from diverse backgrounds, fostering an atmosphere of creativity and teamwork.
- **Mentorship:** Receive guidance from industry experts and seasoned professionals to help refine your ideas and projects.
- **Workshops:** Participate in pre-hackathon workshops to equip yourself with essential skills and knowledge.
- **Prizes:** Compete for exciting rewards for the most innovative and impactful solutions.
- **Showcase:** Present your project to a panel of esteemed judges and industry leaders.

## Why Participate?

- **Network:** Connect with like-minded individuals, industry leaders, and potential mentors.
- **Learn:** Gain hands-on experience and practical knowledge in cutting-edge technologies.
- **Innovate:** Turn your ideas into reality and solve real-world problems.
- **Grow:** Enhance your professional skills and boost your career prospects.

**Note:** Participants must be registered for the three-day on-site flagship event, **Infinia**, to take part in the hackathon. **

**Register Now:** [https://infinia.ieeesahrdaya.com/](https://infinia.ieeesahrdaya.com/)

Even though the hackathon on campus will span 8 hours, students can start developing their ideas from the 22nd September itself, allowing your team to bring well-thought-out solutions to the event.

Join us at the Infinia Hackathon and be part of a transformative experience where imagination truly meets technology.
location: Sahrdaya College of Engineering and Technology(Autonomous), College Road, Kodakara, Kerala, India

name: Based LatAm
tagline: Build a better world onchain, starting with your local community.
desc:
### WHAT IS BASED LATAM?
Base is for everyone who wants to build a better internet, and we’re calling all builders in LatAm, from Mexico to Argentina, to solve real challenges in your community by building onchain. 
![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)
From instant payments, access to financial services, and getting rewarded for creativity, going onchain is improving the lives of people around the world — but that's just the beginning. We’re looking to you to start building a better future onchain, starting right where you are.
![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)
See a problem in your community? Solve it. Have an idea? Build it. Every app you create brings us closer to an onchain world where everyone thrives.
![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)
Based LatAm is part of the Based Around the World regional Buildathon series in [Africa](https://based-africa.devfolio.co/), [India](https://based-india.devfolio.co/), [Southeast Asia](https://based-sea.devfolio.co/), and [LatAm](https://based-latam.devfolio.co/). These regions have unstoppable builder energy. We can’t wait to see your creativity, onchain.

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/acb0ed71-a0fd-4663-a9ba-0a3306ce7ce4.png)

### THE PROMPT
**Build an onchain app that solves a challenge in your community
![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)
OR 
![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)
Use existing onchain tools to create real-world impact in your community by bringing them onchain.**
![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)
If you’re looking for ideas, here are a few places to start:
- Help people come together, connect, and collaborate more easily — onchain or IRL
- Unlock access to social and educational resources
- Build tools that provide easier access to the onchain economy
- Create localized social or e-commerce apps
- Create platforms that empower creators to share their work (or, if you're a creator yourself, share your own)
- Make a blog, write a blog post, create a YouTube or TikTok video, or other content showing how you're making an impact and bringing your community onchain

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/acb0ed71-a0fd-4663-a9ba-0a3306ce7ce4.png)


### CO-PRESENTERS
We’re excited to co-present the Buildathon with [Base LatAm](https://baselatam.com/) and [Buenbit](https://buenbit.com/).

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/2bb4411c-5636-4a8d-ae0c-7fd5dbe844b7.png)

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/acb0ed71-a0fd-4663-a9ba-0a3306ce7ce4.png)

### WHY PARTICIPATE?
The Buildathon is open to anyone from these four regions. Each region will have a prize pool of 25 ETH (for a total of 100 ETH), with 2 to 8 winners selected from each region. In addition, [Talent Protocol](https://www.talentprotocol.com/) will contribute 10B $BUILD, split evenly across all winners.
![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)
Each winner gets:
- **Rewards:** 3.125 to 12.5 ETH from Base and $BUILD from Talent Protocol. 
- **Marketing & Distribution:** All winners will be highlighted at a Base meetup event in-region with Jesse Pollak, and featured on Base social channels (X, Warpcast).
- **Network:** Connections with some of the most prolific Base builders in your region, with direct access to the Base team. 

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/acb0ed71-a0fd-4663-a9ba-0a3306ce7ce4.png)

### HOW IT WORKS

In order to be eligible, the projects must follow the below rules.
- Must submit **one project** per team
- Must include a functioning onchain app at a publicly accessible URL
- Must include an open-source GitHub repository for all source code in the app
- Must include a video, with a minimum length of 1 minute
- Integrating Basenames and Smart Wallet is strongly recommended; they make it easy for anyone to get onchain.
- Must submit proof of 1+ transactions on Base mainnet or Base Sepolia testnet
- Apps built before the Buildathon are eligible for submission, but **must clearly delineate what new feature or product was built during the Buildathon.**

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/7d5daaee-df15-44db-8273-d928a66bfb33.png)

**Evaluation Criteria**
- **Onchain:** Built on Base
- **Technicality:** Functions as pitched
- **Originality:** Innovation / originality to solve problems
- **Practicality:** Usable and accessible by anyone
- **Aesthetics:** Intuitive, easy-to-navigate
- **Wow Factor:** Remarkable impact within time frame
- **Local Impact:** Solves a clear challenge in the community

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/acb0ed71-a0fd-4663-a9ba-0a3306ce7ce4.png)

### BUILDER RESOURCES
- [Getting Started on Base](https://www.base.org/getstarted)
- [Base Documentation](https://docs.base.org/)
- [Basenames](https://base.org/names) ([OnchainKit](https://docs.base.org/docs/basenames-tutorial-with-onchainkit/), [Wagmi](https://docs.base.org/docs/basenames-tutorial-using-wagmi/))
- [Coinbase Developer Platform](https://docs.cdp.coinbase.com/)
- [Faucets](https://docs.base.org/docs/tools/network-faucets) ([CDP](https://portal.cdp.coinbase.com/products/faucet), [thirdweb](https://thirdweb.com/base-sepolia-testnet))
- [OnchainKit](https://onchainkit.xyz/)
- [Smart Wallet](https://smartwallet.dev/)

By accessing our services, you attest that you are not subject to any sanctions and are not on any OFAC lists, and we reserve the right to block transactions or interactions involving individuals, entities, or countries that are subject to U.S. sanctions.*

- **Collaborative Environment**: Work in teams of 1-4 to create something amazing.

Don't miss this opportunity to learn, innovate, and grow. Turn your ideas into reality and make a difference in the tech world!.

For more details or to contact us, visit [ITS-A-Hack](https://itsahack.netlify.app/).

Institute of Information Technology and Management (IITM) is affiliated to prestigious GGSIPU.IITM has established a strong foundation for academic excellence.IITM is committed to promoting value-based, high-quality education with a motto of 'Nurturing Excellence.' In its relentless pursuit of excellence and commitment to maintaining the integrity of the mission.

InternWare - Internship Cell of IITM is dedicated to providing valuable opportunities for students. We organize a wide range of events focusing on multiple skills and domains. These competencies empower students to get the ideal internship.

# **ABOUT MATRIX 2.0**
MATRIX 2.0 is a Tech Fest crafted for tech explorers. This event serves as a vibrant hub of innovation, where tech wizards can demonstrate their skills, gain insights from industry experts, and connect with fellow learners. Taking place on September 20-21, 2024, MATRIX 2.0 features a wide array of competitions across different tech fields, providing a platform for exploration, experimentation, and excellence. 
  
The event name MATRIX is inspired by the iconic pill scene from the Hollywood movie "The Matrix." In the film, the scene represents a choice between embracing reality or remaining in a simulated world. Similarly, the MATRIX event symbolizes a decision to dive into the real world of technology, offering participants the opportunity to explore cutting-edge innovations and make meaningful connections. It's about choosing to awaken your tech potential and see how deep the rabbit hole of technology goes.


# **Who can participate in MATRIX 2.0?**
●	Beginners eager to start their tech journey.
●	Students from all educational levels, including college and school.
●	Participants from both technical and non-technical backgrounds are welcome, as the event features a diverse range of sub-events.

# **Why should you participate in MATRIX 2.0?**
●	If you’re passionate about hackathons and other tech events, MATRIX 2.0 is the perfect opportunity for you! Here’s why you should be a part of it:
●	Certificate of participation for every participant.
●	Winners will be awarded with cash prizes and trophies.
●	Entry to the Hackathon is free, perfect for beginners to shine and make their mark!


# **Judging Criteria**
Projects and submissions will be evaluated based on the following criteria:
● **Technicality**: Is the project functional? Does it justify the duration of the competition?
●	**Originality**: How innovative is the project? Does it bring a fresh perspective or solution?
● **Practicality**: Is the project useful and accessible (Mobile App, Web App, Desktop Application)?
●	**Aesthetics**: How is the UI/UX of the project? Is it intuitive and user-friendly?
●	**Wow Factor**: Does the project have a unique aspect that makes it stand out, even if it lacks in other criteria?
location: Institute of Information Technology and Management (IITM), Janakpuri Institutional Area, Janakpuri, New Delhi, Delhi, India

prizes.name: 11. Problem statement shared by RateGain
prizes.desc:
![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/a1f504bee74b4f19be305d409aa4fc16/533ae3c2-5927-4beb-880e-41374a1d2fe1.png)
**Background:**
Hotels often struggle to maintain high occupancy rates, especially during seasonal low periods when bookings decline. Maximizing room occupancy is crucial for sustaining revenue and operational efficiency. However, the current approach to driving occupancy relies heavily on manual processes, where Hotel Revenue Managers, Sales & Marketing teams, and General Managers (other external agencies on their behalf) must analyze data, determine the optimal timing for campaigns, and create targeted marketing content.


<details><summary>Read More</summary>

**Challenge:**
The manual nature of these tasks results in inefficiencies, missed opportunities, and delayed campaign launches. Moreover, creating and deploying the right content to the right audience at the right time is critical but challenging, especially without the aid of automation. To remain competitive, hotels need a streamlined, automated solution that can dynamically trigger campaigns, optimize their timing, and tailor the content based on real-time data.
 
**Problem Statement:**
How might we develop an automated solution that enables hotels to trigger marketing campaigns at the optimal time during low booking periods and generate customized content that targets the right audience with the appropriate offers? This solution should empower Hotel Revenue Managers, Sales & Marketing teams, and General Managers to maximize occupancy with minimal manual intervention.
 
Participants in this hackathon are tasked with creating innovative, automated solutions that address the challenge of optimizing campaign timing and content creation, ultimately driving higher occupancy rates during low periods.
</details>

City AI Engine: Develop a Gen AI powered system, City AI Engine that aims to revolutionize urban planning and management at scale, by leveraging AI to address challenges related to data disconnect, and limited public engagement that seep into outdated processes. 

<details>
 <summary>Read more</summary>
City AI Engine: Develop a Gen AI powered system, City AI Engine that aims to revolutionize urban planning and management at scale, by leveraging AI to address challenges related to data disconnect, and limited public engagement that seep into outdated processes. The proposed engine would integrate diverse data sources from multiple formats to create a data first- digital twin of the city, and provide AI-driven analysis for informed decision-making. These prototypes aim to enhance transparency, engagement, and data-driven decision-making in urban development. prizes.name: 5. Problem statement shared by Blume Ventures
prizes.desc:
![image](https://assets.devrel.in/content/1fffc06858624722919d45e8a1c48701/884aeb36-0d60-4dea-a170-6d063a51e05f.png)


Develop a Gen AI powered tool to make a teaching assistant to teach a student using the Socratic teaching method. The Socratic method is where the assistant asks probing questions and leads the student to the answer instead of revealing the answer. 

<details><summary>Read More</summary>Given this is a hard problem, we want to restrict it to one particular topic viz. Learning of Data Structures and Algorithms. Feel free to narrow it down even further if it helps make a high-quality assistant e.g. only for Algorithms of Sorting. That is a topic that should be familiar to most software engineers working on this. As an example, if a test-case times out, the assistant shouldn’t just say: “It timed out because it was a large input size”. It should first pick the right question to ask the student e.g. “What can you say about the difference between this test-case and the other test-cases that passed?” Then depending on what answer the student gives, ask the next relevant question, eventually making the student see that this test-case is quite large and some particular section of their code timed out processing that size. Hence that section needs to be optimized. Several studies have shown that the Socratic method of teaching is very effective for learning, but it is very challenging to scale for any commercial viability anywhere in education, because of a. limited supply of effective teachers who can do this and b. it is not very effective in 1xMany teaching, needing it to be 1x1. AI assistants have the potential to overcome both of these challenges.</details>

prizes.name: 17. Problem statement shared by Central Cyber Security Agency
prizes.desc:
Develop an AI-driven solution that can autonomously detect, analyze, and respond to cybersecurity threats in real time at end user level. 

<details><summary>Read more</summary>The solution should leverage machine learning models to detect unusual patterns and anomalies in network traffic, user behavior, or system logs that could lead to a cyber-security incident. The solution should be capable of processing vast amounts of data, identifying unusual patterns or anomalies indicative of potential security breaches, and automating response actions to mitigate threats before they cause significant damage. prizes.name: 15. Problem statement shared by Jio Finance Limited
prizes.desc:
**Revolutionize SDLC with GenAI-Powered Development Platform**

**Problem Statement:**
The traditional software development life cycle (SDLC) is often a long, complex process involving multiple stages and teams. This challenge seeks to leverage the power of GenAI and Low-Code-No-Code (LCNC) platforms to streamline SDLC and accelerate product development.

<details><summary>Read More</summary>Challenge Objective:
Develop a GenAI-powered development platform that can directly translate product requirements into functional code, automating much of the development process.

How and Why This is Possible:
LCNC Platforms: The rise of LCNC platforms has significantly reduced the need for manual coding. These platforms allow users to visually design applications by dragging and dropping components, with code being generated automatically in the background.
GenAI Code Generation: Generative AI models have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in understanding natural language and generating code snippets across various programming languages and platforms.
By combining these two technologies, we can envision a future where GenAI can directly interpret product requirements, generate the necessary code, connect front-end and back-end components, and even ensure adherence to security standards.

Guidelines:
The contestants can select the LCNC and the technology stack [along with the version] which are cloud native.
The LLMs can be trained on this target stack so that the code generated is in line with the version of the tech chosen.
The code generated may be integrated with the CICD pipeline to demonstrate the deployment to UAT environment.</details>

prizes.name: 16. Problem Statement from Netcore
prizes.desc:
Revolutionizing Marketing Campaigns: A Multi-Agent Gen AI Approach to Personalized Content Creation.

The traditional marketing campaign process often lacks personalization, efficiency, and real-time adaptability, impacting both customer engagement and ROI for businesses. Can a multi-agent Gen AI system be leveraged to create hyper-personalized, data-driven campaigns that anticipate customer preferences, streamline content creation, and adapt to market dynamics?

<details><summary>Read More</summary>Challenge: Develop innovative solutions that address the following:
Enhance audience segmentation: Create AI agents that analyze customer data to identify and understand distinct audience segments with specific preferences and behaviors.
Generate tailored content: Design AI agents capable of producing personalized creative content that resonates with each identified segment, adhering to brand guidelines.
Optimize campaign scheduling and delivery: Develop AI agents that determine the best timing, frequency, and channels for content delivery to maximize engagement and conversions.
Adapt in real-time: Create a system that continuously monitors campaign performance and makes data-driven adjustments to improve results.

Goal: Create a cutting-edge multi-agent Gen AI system that sets a new standard for personalized, efficient, and high-performing marketing campaigns, with the potential to transform how businesses connect with their audience across various industries.</details>

prizes.name: 12. Problem statement shared by Croma
prizes.desc:
**Transforming Retail Inside and Out - for a multi-brand electronics and appliances retailer**
 
Today most retailers are tackling issues at multiple fronts in trying to keep up with customer expectations while optimizing their internal operations. There is also an increasing level of complexity in operations as retailers become omnichannel. For an electronics and appliances retailer, further complexity is added as products can be high involvement, high value and/or bulky. How can we leverage technology to ensure a seamless customer experience across the customer’s end-to-end journey, while optimizing key internal operations?


<details><summary>Read More</summary>

**Challenge:**
 
Develop innovative and effective solutions that can address the following:
