Leveraging Generative AI to Accelerate DPI Adoption in India: Develop a GenAI product/model/platform that promotes the adoption and maximizes the benefits of Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) in India. 

<details><summary>Read More</summary>This could involve creating user-friendly interfaces, developing educational tools, or building AI-powered solutions that integrate with existing DPI components. The goal is to make DPI accessible and beneficial to a wider population, thereby accelerating India's digital transformation and driving economic growth.

The proposed GenAI solution should address the following key aspects:

- Accessibility: The solution should be designed to be accessible to users with limited literacy and technical knowledge, considering the diverse languages spoken in India. This could involve incorporating multilingual support, intuitive user interfaces, and simplified onboarding processes.

- Education and Awareness: The solution should include features that educate users about the benefits of DPI and guide them on how to effectively utilize DPI components in their daily lives. This could involve interactive tutorials, personalized recommendations, and user-friendly documentation.
- Integration and Interoperability: The solution should seamlessly integrate with existing DPI components, such as Aadhaar, UPI, and DigiLocker. It should also be designed to be interoperable with other digital platforms and services, ensuring a smooth user experience.
- Innovation and Scalability: The solution should leverage the power of GenAI to develop innovative features and use cases that maximize the benefits of DPI. It should also be scalable to accommodate a growing user base and evolving DPI ecosystem.</details>

ConsumeWise: Develop a Gen AI powered tool, ConsumeWise to enhance transparency and trust in consumer goods (food, personal care) by providing verifiable & personalised information about their impact on health, the environment, and society. 

<details><summary>Read More</summary>ConsumeWise is a Public Information System designed with the motivation to promote conscious consumption and encourage the production and mainstream adoption of healthy, sustainable products. The areas of focus for building such a system are: 1) How to get accurate data (publicly available or from producers) , and how to verify it. 2) Designing a system for a credible, bias free and decentralised system for defining what is good or bad when it comes to health & sustainability. 3) Making the information user friendly - providing them an actionable insight that is personalised without causing cognitive load and at a point in their shopping journey where they can be nudged. For consumers, price sensitivity, convenience, and lack of awareness are significant barriers. ConsumeWise aims to tackle these issues by starting with awareness, setting a foundation for change through reliable data collection, verification, and updated measurement standards. It also ensures accessibility through personalized interfaces tailored to India's diverse population. The outcome of the ConsumeWise solution is creating a world where customers have easy access to product information listed on e-commerce sites as to which products are healthy and environmentally sustainable. This awareness can then prompt behaviour change towards making better consumer choices.</details>

prizes.name: Best Project on Zircuit - ETHWarsaw 2024
prizes.desc:
The best project that deploys on Zircuit will win this prize. The code should be well engineered, tested, and have a compelling use case. These gems are the projects that will inspire future hackathon projects because of their outstanding quality. Remember: deploying on Zircuit is as easy as changing your endpoint in your favorite development framework. As long as the contracts are deployed on Zircuit and verified, the project is eligible.

A successful submission will include a functional prototype that solves the problem it’s intended to address. It will showcase some innovation/creativity, either through technological or UI improvements. It may be complete and solve a long-standing open problem or introduce something with a lot of potential for future development. Either way, it has an impact on the Zircuit ecosystem.

Winning projects should have a user-centered design that makes it easy for the target audience. This can be end users or developers integrating the project into their own codebase. The best may also include clean and consistent visual designs.

Any interesting blockchain applications are welcome. Novel ideas are more impressive than clones of existing projects, though there are certainly times where clones include significant improvements. Those that are very technical may impress the judges if done correctly but simpler ideas may be easier to do well. This bounty will be judged based on completeness, execution, and creativity.

**Qualification Requirements**

- Project contracts must be deployed on the Zircuit Mainnet or Testnet and verified via the Zircuit Explorer.
- A GitHub repository containing the project artifacts (contracts, tests, documentation) and a solid README or short video demo of the project. The README should include:
- a clear short one-sentence description of your submission
- a short description of what you integrated Zircuit with and how
- short description of the team and their backgrounds
- clear instructions for testing the integration
- feedback describing your experience with building on Zircuit
- optionally, a short video demo or slide deck.

The scope is broad, so if you’re looking for inspiration, take a look at https://x.com/Aleph__Zero to see what we’ve been up to recently!

### Other projects:

If you have a great project that doesn’t quite fit the “Mass Adoption” bounty description, don’t worry! Our primary focus are great projects, regardless of their label. Any project utilizing Aleph Zero technology and relevant to the Aleph Zero ecosystem is welcome to be submitted.

### Judging criteria:

**Fit for the Aleph Zero ecosystem:** we are looking for solutions that will help our ecosystem grow and become more diverse. We require the solutions to either have the potential of becoming products deployed on the Aleph Zero chains, help create such products or showcase the abilities of the network in some way.

**Innovation & uniqueness:** we value projects that are not mere copies of well known ideas but are an effect of the team’s creative spark and collaboration

**Usability:** even the most ingenious solution will not be a success if it’s not encouraging its usage. Note, however, that a user might mean very different things: an end user, a developer, a company, etc.

**Correctness and technical ingenuity:** we are a bunch of technical people and therefore are fascinated by elegant solutions to problems. Additionally, especially in the blockchain space, correctness and safety is absolutely crucial.

That said, please remember that except for the first criterium, we will accept solutions that sacrifice one of the points to shine in the others. For example: if you have an amazing technical solution but don’t have the time to make it convenient for the users, don’t hesitate to submit it anyway!

Solana Superteam Malaysia is back with another Solana Hackfest to the ecosystem. This time, the event will take place in Monash University Malaysia.

name: Skate’s Stateless Innovation Program - SSIP#1
tagline: Ready to join the Stateless Revolution?
desc:
# What is Skate

Skate is pioneering the development of the infrastructure for Stateless Apps, enabling applications to operate across thousands of chains (both EVM and non-EVM) with a single unified state. This innovative approach unlocks new possibilities for blockchain apps, enabling them to create new primitives that were previously unfeasible. 

# Skate’s Stateless Innovation Program (SSIP)

Skate is excited to launch its first cohort of Skate’s Stateless Innovation Program — SSIP#1, designed to empower individuals or teams to develop groundbreaking applications and solutions.

# Why join?
**Grants:** Up to $10k USDC and 10M Ollies in prizes.
**Access to network of VCs and angels:** the best submissions will have a chance to present their ideas for 5 minutes in front of our network of VCs and angels who are eager to fund innovative stateless applications.
**Work closely with industry experts:** a chance to work closely with the Skate team and our partners.

# Cohort #1 Submission Rules

1. Create a document with your innovative idea for a Use Case that leverage the unique functionality of Skate.
2. Your submission document should follow the format, length, and depth of this submission (https://docs.skatechain.org/main/use-cases/case-study/worldcoin) to be eligible for prizes.
3. Beyond that, your submission must also consider the following points:

**Problem Solved:** Clearly define the problem your idea addresses and the implication for stateless apps.
**Skate integration:** Describe how your idea integrates with Skate’s infrastructure.
**High-Level Architecture:** Provide an overview of the architecture of your use-case. You can use as template this use-case study on Worldcoin stateless approach.
**Target Users:** Identify who will benefit from your solution.

We welcome applications from all fields of type of use-cases, and there are no restrictions on the types of ideas we consider.

# Prize Breakdown

Grants will be allocated as follows:

**Top 5 Entries:** 2k USDC each
**Top 20 Entries:** 250k Ollies each
**20–50:** 100k Ollies each
**50–100:** 40k Ollies each

# Helpful Resources

**Skate 101:** https://x.com/skate_chain/status/1803034831322058880

**Skate Docs:** Skate Documentation

**Stateless App Cookbook:** https://docs.skatechain.org/developers/stateless-app-cookbook

**Other Use Case Ideas:** https://www.notion.so/Skate-simple-use-cases-99b91ef52f5a46cb88dcf97d00b53284?pvs=21

tagline: Shaping the Future, one block at a time!
desc:
## Who is this Hackathon for?

-  Beginners who are planning to start their Web 3.0 journey
- Anyone planning to innovate freely with Blockchain and Web 3.0 Projects
- All participants of [web3ssh](https://web3ssh.dev/) summer school

## Problem Statement

Open Innovation! Build anything on Blockchain. You must satisfy, the requirements given by Sponsored Tracked to be eligible for their prize pool.

For more details visit: [web3ssh.dev/hackathon](https://web3ssh.dev/hackathon)

## Why Participate?

- Free career guidance session for all hackathon participants
- Certificate of Participation for all teams with a valid project submission
- Cash Prizes, Tshirts and Stickers for Winners
- 1 year [GeeksforGeeks](https://web3ssh.devfolio.co/) Premium Access worth ₹ 9k

## What is [web3ssh](https://web3ssh.dev)?

- Summer School Dates: 29th July to 3rd August
- Hackathon Dates: **7th August to 9th August**

*web3ssh*, or **Web 3.0 Summer School and Hackathon**, is an intensive, week-long program designed to immerse participants in decentralized technologies and blockchain innovation. This event combines expert-led keynote sessions, hands-on workshops, and collaborative projects, offering attendees a comprehensive learning experience in Web 3.0. From blockchain fundamentals to practical smart contract development, participants will gain in-depth knowledge and practical skills needed to excel in the rapidly evolving field of decentralized technologies.

**[View web3ssh brochure](https://web3ssh.dev/brochure)**

The program culminates in a **high-energy hackathon**, where attendees can put their newfound knowledge to the test. This event is not just about coding; it’s about fostering a vibrant community of learners, innovators, and future leaders in the Web 3.0 space. By bringing together students, industry professionals, and thought leaders, web3ssh aims to bridge the gap between theoretical knowledge and real-world application, paving the way for the next generation of Web 3.0 pioneers.

## Organizer

[web3ssh](https://web3ssh.dev/) is organized by the [Dept. of CSE, IIIT Sri City](https://www.iiits.ac.in/)

### Ecosystem Partner

[Blockchained India](https://www.blockchainedindia.com/) is India's premier community of entrepreneurs, developers, and web3 enthusiasts. They strive to put Indian web3 innovation on the world map.

### Hackathon Partner

## Judging Criteria

Projects are evaluated based on the following criteria as [laid out by Devfolio](https://guide.devfolio.co/introduction/judging#judging-criteria):

**Technicality**: Is the project functional? Does it justify the hackathon duration?

**Originality**: How innovative is the project? Does it bring a fresh perspective or solution?

**Practicality**: Is the project useful and accessible (Mobile App, Web App, Desktop Application)?

**Aesthetics**: How is the UI/UX of the project? Is it intuitive and user-friendly?

**Wow Factor**:  Does the project have a unique aspect that makes it stand out, even if it lacks in other criteria?

# **What is "Build the New Internet" Hackathon? 🛜**

We are rallying up developers to [**build the New Internet**](https://walletconnect.com/blog/walletconnect-manifesto), with $50K in prizes in collaboration and support with [1inch](https://1inch.io/), [Coinbase](https://www.coinbase.com), [Safe](https://safe.global/), and [Magic](https://magic.link/).

# **The 'Why'**
The hackathon aims to encourage and support web3 developers in building apps integrating WalletConnect’s AppKit's latest features: [Email and Social Login](https://walletconnect.com/blog/appkit-social-login), [Universal Wallets](https://walletconnect.com/blog/appkit-universal-wallets), [On-Ramp](https://walletconnect.com/blog/appkit-onramp), and [Swaps](https://walletconnect.com/blog/appkit-swaps). **A Chance to Innovate:** Utilize the latest AppKit features to create groundbreaking solutions. Your ingenuity can shape the future of web3.

**Access to Industry Experts and Leaders**: Teams from WalletConnect, sponsors, and other ecosystem builders will review each track. You will also get opportunities to interact during regular office hours throughout the hackathon.

# **How does it work?**

There are four tracks and a total prize pool of $50,000. Each track varies in terms of how rewards will be distributed.

**Rules**

Each team may consist of 1-5 members, and can submit one project (to one track).

Team members for winning projects will need to KYC and provide their payment details to receive their prize money.

**Logistics**

The hackathon will be spearheaded by WalletConnect, with sponsors and mentors to support.
All items related to registration, submissions, and final payouts will be managed by the Devfolio team.

desc:
## What is FOSS Hack? 🛠️

FOSS Hack is a yearly hackathon organized by the [FOSS United Foundation](https://fossunited.org/) to promote Free and Open Source Software (FOSS). The event brings together professionals and students to build or extend FOSS projects. Each year, a prize pool of ₹10 lakhs is created for the winners.

FOSS Hack is a hybrid hackathon where participants can either hack online or join one of the local hosts to work on their projects alongside other participants.

### Localhosts 🧑‍💻

FOSS Hack Localhosts are localized, in-person editions of the broader hybrid FOSS Hack 2024. Hackers can choose to participate at a local host in their region. Several local hosts are organized across the country. 

One of the editions is hosted at the **Devfolio Office in Indiranagar, Bangalore.**

\

desc:
Hack to the Future, organized by IEEE SB MUJ, is a 36-hour online hackathon focused on sustainability. Participants will tackle advanced challenges and pioneer transformative tech solutions for the future.

 Event Flow

The event flow for Hack to the Future includes three rounds: Round 1, Ideation (8 hours), where teams submit their ideas through PowerPoint presentations, with the most promising ideas advancing to the next round. Round 2, Prototype Development (24 hours), involves selected teams developing functional prototypes based on their ideas and present it in the form of recordings. In Round 3, Presentation, shortlisted teams pitch their prototypes to a panel of judges, with winners selected based on comprehensive judging criteria.

 Judging Criteria

The judging criteria for Hack to the Future include functionality, design, code quality, presentation clarity, prototype demonstration, engagement, Q&A, and problem statement focus.

Why Participate?

Participating in Hack to the Future offers the opportunity to tackle cutting-edge challenges and pioneer sustainable tech solutions. Enhance your skills in ideation, prototyping, and presentation, while connecting with like-minded innovators and industry experts. Stand a chance to win exciting prizes and gain recognition for your innovative solutions.

prizes.name: BTCPay Server Additional Optimizations
prizes.desc:
11 XMR

**Multiple teams can work together on this bounty taking on different optimizations. Message MoneroKon organizers for coordination.**

BTCPay Server (https://btcpayserver.org/) is one of the most-used programs for accepting Monero payments.

There are a few important optimizations to be made for the existing implementation, which can be found here: https://github.com/btcpayserver/btcpayserver-docker/blob/master/docker-compose-generator/docker-fragments/monero.yml

Optimize RPC commands:
a. Restrict external access
b. Remove unnecessary commands
c. Optimize subaccount/subaddress lookaheads (default should be only 1 account; we don't use the rest)
d. Map commands to variables so they can be changed in the UI
Allow specifying a remote node in the UI, to connect to an external node instead of running a local node
Allow custom commands for monerod and monero-wallet-rpc in UI (for advanced users, so they don't need to dig through Docker each time a change is needed)
Allow updating Monero software versions in the UI
Allow a different Monero wallet per store, not only 1 wallet per server
Allow replacing Monero wallet/keys via web interface, not CLI only

## Welcome EAS Builders!
This is an independent track for the **Top 5 attestation-BASED builders** that use attestations in a unique and impactful way during Onchain Summer. 

**☀️ Attention Onchain Summer Builders ☀️**
This hackathon is independent of the Onchain Summer Buildathon hosted on Devfolio where you can choose tracks from only those listed on [https://onchain-summer.devfolio.co/prizes](https://onchain-summer.devfolio.co/prizes). Using EAS does not qualify you for the Buildathon tracks, however, attestations may simplify your development and enhance your submission.

## Why use Attestations this summer?
As an open-source primitive, **[Ethereum Attestation Service (EAS)](https://attest.org)** can be used across all [8 Onchain Summer tracks](https://onchain-summer.devfolio.co/prizes) in unique ways. 

Attestations are digital signatures on structured data used to build trust online and onchain. You can use attestations in just about any project at varying degrees of integration, offchain or onchain. From simple attestations for community access to more complex systems entirely built on attestations. Read the docs to learn more.

We're excited to see how builders use attestations to build more trust online and onchain. If you use attestations during Onchain Summer, **submit your project**! 

## Dev Tools to Build Faster
Our mantra is to help builders build faster. Here are some tools to help you get started:
* **[Github](https://github.com/ethereum-attestation-service)** - All the core contracts and repos
* **[Docs](https://docs.attest.org)** - Comprehensive and easy-to-read docs
* **[SDK](https://docs.attest.org/docs/developer-tools/eas-sdk)** - Start building faster
* **[Indexer](https://github.com/ethereum-attestation-service/eas-indexing-service)** - Create your own indexer
* [Attestation Explorer](https://base.easscan.org/) - Discover & verify attestations
* **[GraphQL API](https://base.easscan.org/graphql)** - Query attestations on Base

### Contracts to Use
EAS is a part of the [**core Base Contract list**](https://docs.base.org/docs/base-contracts/#base-mainnet) both on Sepolia & Mainnet.

* **EAS**:  0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000021
* **EASSchemaRegistry**: 0x4200000000000000000000000000000000000020

name: Onchain Summer Buildathon
tagline: Build the next generation of the internet
desc:
## WHAT IS THE ONCHAIN SUMMER BUILDATHON?

We’re inviting builders around the world to join the Onchain Summer Buildathon, with 200 ETH in total prizes, and sponsors including Stripe, Shopify, Farcaster, Zora, Fleek, thirdweb, Nouns, Aerodrome, and Synthetix. Help shape the next generation of the internet across payments, commerce, social, creators, and more.

## WHY PARTICIPATE?

- **Build and be rewarded:** Compete for 200 ETH in prizes across tracks
- **Bring your creativity onchain:** Choose from eight tracks including gaming, payments, trading, creators, community engagement and more
- **Expert judging**: Teams from Base, sponsors, and other ecosystem builders will review each track
- **Mentorship access:** Regular office hours during the Buildathon

![Onchain Summer](https://assets.devrel.in/OnchainSummer.gif)

## HOW IT WORKS?

There are 8 tracks in the hackathon, with a prize pool of 20 ETH each. In each track, 20 ETH in total rewards will be split between 2-10 winning teams. In addition to the track rewards, there will be a bonus pool of 40 ETH in rewards for successful product integrations (see more below).

**Hackathon Rules**

- You can participate as an individual or a team
- Every team or individual can submit one project, to one track
- In order to receive prizes, team members for winning projects will need to provide their KYC information and payment details


**Logistics**

- Teams consisting of Base, sponsors, and other ecosystem builders will review the submissions for each track
- Registration, submissions, and payouts are managed directly by Devfolio

**Get Started**

- Fill out the registration application here on Devfolio
- Follow the next steps, including staking 0.002 ETH (you will get this back after successfully submitting your project)
- May 31: Hackathon open for submissions—start building your project! Throughout June, you’ll have access to regular office hours and support from the Base team
- June 30: Submissions due
- July 8 - 30: Judging: Each track will be judged by a panel consisting of track sponsors, and other Base and community builders who are plugged into the respective space
- July 1 - July 20: Community review period (winning projects are reviewed to ensure no plagiarism or fraudulent submissions)
- August 1st: Winners announced

**Disclaimer**
*By using our services, you acknowledge and agree that all IP addresses and Ethereum wallet addresses are subject to screening against U.S. Department of the Treasury’s Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) lists. By accessing our services, you attest that you are not subject to any sanctions and are not on any OFAC lists, and we reserve the right to block transactions or interactions involving individuals, entities, or countries that are subject to U.S. sanctions.*

**Terms and Condition for the Buildathon**
Read the T&C for the Buildathon here: [https://nsb.dev/ocs-buildathon-terms-conditions](https://nsb.dev/ocs-buildathon-terms-conditions)

desc:
This hackathon is open to all! Newbies and pros, you all are most welcome to join the 'Hack with MLSA-IGNOU' AI using AI!

This hackathon will run for 20 days where you will get a chance to attend sessions on Azure AI, participate in Quiz, unlimited learnings and at last you will reach towards a mini product/project for your startup! Don't miss the meme war during the journey! :)

name: 한국 ICP 미니 콘테스트
desc:
# 개요

✖ **장소**: [논스](https://naver.me/xAtWZc3K)
🗓️ **일자**: 5월 17일 금요일\*\*
⏰ **시간**: **18:00 - 21:00 (오후 6시 - 9시)**
💻 **주제**: **타입스크립트 캐니스터 기반 프로젝트 발표 및 심사**
❓ **진행 방식**

* 프로젝트 제출: 미션 제출을 통한 프로젝트 제출 리스트 등록
* 프로젝트 승인: 프로젝트 승인 심사 기준에 의거한 프로젝트 승인 여부 결정
* 프로젝트 승인 심사: 프로젝트의 최소 완결성 및 기타 저촉 사유 판단을 통한 승인 여부 공표
* 프로젝트 발표 및 심사: 5월 17일 18:00 - 21:00에 진행되는 프로젝트 발표 및 심사

🏆 **보상**

* **프로젝트 승인: 프로젝트 당 100 $USDT 상당의 $ICP**
* **수상:** **프로젝트 당 2000 $USDT 상당의 $ICP 및 인턴쉽 기회 (최대 3팀)**
* **보상과 관련된 상세 내용은 하단의 보상 관련 참고 사안을 참고한다**

## 심사 기준

### **1 프로젝트 승인**

* **최소 완결성 충족**: 제출된 프로젝트의 소스 코드, 설명 등이 최소한의 완결성을 갖추고 있는가?
* **악의적 차별 여부**: 특정 성별, 나이, 인종, 종교, 외모 등에 대한 악의적 차별 혹은 비하 요소를 포함하고 있는가?
* **사회 적절성 여부**: 제출된 프로젝트가 사회 통념 관점에서 심각한 물의를 일으킬 요소를 포함하고 있는가?
* **표절 여부**: 제출된 프로젝트가 다른 프로젝트의 지적 재산권, 코드 도용과 같은 표절 요소를 포함하고 있는가?

### **2 발표자 심사**

* **기술 구현성(Technicality)**: 프로젝트에 적용된 기술이 완벽하게 구현되었는가? 해당 기술의 구현 수준은 어떠한가?
* **독창성(Originality)**: 프로젝트에 혁신적인 요소가 반영되어 있는가? 새로운 적용 방법 혹은 아이디어를 제시하고 있는가?
* **실용성(Practicality)**: 다양한 디바이스를 통해 프로젝트 접근이 가능한가? 다른 프로젝트에 적용 가능한 요소를 포함하고 있는가?
* **심미성(Aesthetics)**: 프로젝트의 UI/UX 설계는 어떠한가? 편안한 디자인과 사용성을 제공하는가?
* **스타성(Wow Factor)**: 다른 요소를 차치하고서라도 프로젝트에 이목이 끌릴만한 특수한 요소를 포함하고 있는가?

* [** 발표자 선정 기준은 Devfolio의 심사 기준을 기반으로 판단한다**](https://guide.devfolio.co/introduction/judging)

# 트랙

* **어플리케이션 제작:** ICP의 캐니스터 배포를 통한 사용자 어플리케이션 제작 
* **라이브러리 및 툴 제작**: ICP 개발자의 개발 환경, 편의성 증대를 위한 인프라, 라이브러리, API 및/혹은 기타 개발자 도구 제작
* **오픈 독스 개선**: 체인 키 서명, CDK(Canister Development Kit), HTTP Outcall을 비롯한 ICP 기술의 발전을 위한 연구,
* **기타**: 위에 제공된 트랙 이외에 ICP의 활용 방안 제안


* [트랙은 ICP 개발자 그랜츠 프로그램](https://dfinity.org/grants)을 기반으로 작성되었다.

# 보상 관련 참고 사안

* 프로젝트는 승인 기준에 따라 최소 완결성, 악의적 차별성, 사회 적절성, 표절성을 판단한다. 프로젝트 제출 이후 **승인이 거부된 프로젝트는 데브폴리오 상의 이메일로 개별적 통보**가 보내진다.
* 한국 ICP 미니 콘테스트의 **최대 수상팀은 3팀**이다. 그러나 심사위원의 재량에 따라 충분히 유의미한 프로젝트가 부족하다고 판단될 시 **수상팀이 없을 수도 있다**.
* 수상 3팀에게 보상은 인턴쉽의 형태로 지급된다. 수상시 **50%(1000 $USDT 상당의 $ICP)가 즉시 지급**되며 **후속 금액은 30-60일 사이의 성과를 기반**으로 지급된다.
* 보상과 관련된 자세한 사안은 담당자와 확인한다.
    * 루디움: [contact@ludium.community](mailto:contact@ludium.community)
    * ICP Korea Hub: [jake@icpkor.com](mailto:jake@icpkor.com)

prizes.desc:
**AI-Driven Product Recommendations for Saudi Pet Retailer**

Problem Statement :

Our Saudi-based client, a leading pet product retailer with 40+ stores across Riyadh, Jeddah, and Dammam, seeks a machine learning solution to optimize customer interactions. They require a system that integrates with their in-store kiosks to provide tailored product recommendations based on customer queries, enhancing the shopping experience.

Key Requirements:

1. **Machine Learning Integration** : Develop or identify a machine learning solution to analyze customer queries and offer personalized product recommendations.

2. **Smart Answer Generation** : Generate intelligent responses to customer questions, suggesting suitable pet products.

3. **Seamless Integration** : Ensure smooth integration with the company's existing kiosk system for effortless implementation.

4. **Scalability** : The solution should be scalable to accommodate the company's extensive retail network and future growth.

5. **User-Friendly Interface** : Design an intuitive interface for both customers and employees to interact with the system and access recommendations easily.

**Outcome :**

Implementing this solution will revolutionize customer engagement, driving sales, enhancing satisfaction, and solidifying the company's position as an industry leader in pet retail.

prizes.name: Upto 5000 Diam Token
prizes.desc:
**Payment Solutions**: Diamante primary use case is for payment processing and remittances. dApps can be built to facilitate fast, low-cost cross-border payments, making it ideal for remittance platforms, micropayments, and peer-to-peer transfers.

**Asset Tokenization**: Diamante allows users to create custom tokens representing real-world assets such as currencies, commodities, or securities. dApps can tokenize assets and enable the issuance, transfer, and trading of these tokens on the Diam network.
 
**Loyalty Programs**: Diam can be used to create loyalty programs where businesses issue tokenized rewards to customers for their purchases or engagement, fostering customer loyalty and engagement.
 
**Stablecoin Issuance**: Stablecoins pegged to fiat currencies or other assets can be issued on the Diam network, providing a stable medium of exchange for users while benefiting from Diamante fast and low-cost transaction capabilities.
 
**NFT Minting & Marketplaces** : Developers can create decentralized applications on Diam for minting, buying, selling, and trading NFTs. Artists, content creators, and collectors can tokenize unique digital assets such as art, music, videos, collectibles, and more on the Diam blockchain.
 
**Decentralized Exchanges (DEX)**: Developers can build decentralized exchanges on Diam, allowing users to trade various assets directly peer-to-peer without the need for intermediaries. Diamante built-in decentralized exchange feature facilitates the trading of any token issued on the network.

desc:
Join us for an online buildathon dedicated to a critical milestone in the history of Story Protocol - the v1.0 protocol release on Sepolia. Be one of the first to build amazing things with it. 

Story Protocol is building a protocol to make the legal system for creative Intellectual Property (IP) more efficient by turning IP "programmable". That is, creating an API-like system where people or programs alike can license, remix, and monetize IP according to transparent terms set by creators themselves.

This buildathon is dedicated to three verticals: creator tools, DeFi and AI. There’s $15,000 in prizes for the top submissions within the time period, but ALL projects that satisfy the requirements will have prioritized access to our builder program which includes opportunities for grants and further funding.

**What is a buildathon you ask?** A hackathon focused on product feedback and opportunities for follow on grants and funding for *serious teams* building *serious projects*.

The [Department of Computer Science](https://cs.du.ac.in) is organizing HackDUCS, a hybrid inter-university hackathon as part of its 20th Annual TechFest - [Sankalan 2024](https://sankalan.ducs.in). 

Cash prizes worth more than ₹60,000 and prizes worth more than ₹18,00,000 to be won across events at Sankalan 2024. Check out [https://sankalan.ducs.in/](https://sankalan.ducs.in/) to register.

Note: This is a hybrid hackathon. Main Tracks will be released soon. Teams need to present their ideas in a virtual meeting to a panel of judges in order to be accepted for the hackathon. Qualified teams not from New Delhi, India may join virtually.

**Hackathon Tracks:**
- AI for India 🇮🇳 - Innovate for India and present unique ideas that inspire the nation’s AI journey. Focus on empowering the Indian society with toolkits to promote citizen participation in vernacular languages.
- Human-Centred Design 🤖 - Develop and design solutions that address complex and everyday socio-technical problems with tools like accessible design, GenAI and XR.
- Sustainable Technology 🌱 - With focus on low-carbon footprint, come up with solutions to enable and monitor sustainable development at the grassroot level.
- Sponsor Track: Polygon 🔗 - Build solutions on Polygon that democratize Web3.
- Sponsor Track: ETHIndia 🔗 - Build an innovative project on the Ethereum blockchain.

**Prizes:**
- Cash Prizes: INR 8,000 for the winning team; INR 4,000 for each runner-up team (2)
- Wolfram Award: One year of Wolfram|One Personal Edition plus a one-year subscription to Wolfram|Alpha Pro. The value of each individual award is $375.00. This award is for all members in winning and runner-up teams.
- Interview Cake Award: Full access to coding interview prep course. The value of each individual award is $60.00. This award is for all members in winning and runner-up teams.
- Gen XYZ Award: .XYZ domain which will be free for the first year. This award is for all members in winning and runner-up teams.
- Axure Award: One year license to Axure RP Team Edition worth approximately USD 500.00. This award is for the winning team.
- Polygon Track Award: USD 200.00 for the best hack built on Polygon, Eligibility to apply for internship/full-time roles and seed funding of up to 5,000 USD for winners!
- ETHIndia Track Award: Winner of this track receives USD 100.00 in prizes from ETHIndia.
- Complimentary Access to 30 days of Wolfram|One for all participants.

For detailed rules, schedule and updates, refer to [hack.ducs.in](https://hack.ducs.in) and [sankalan.ducs.in/updates](https://sankalan.ducs.in/updates).

desc:
Hacknology is a data science hackathon brought to you by WiCyS club @ Hofstra University.

Get a chance to challenge yourself, collaborate with others, win cool prizes, and, of course, have fun!

# IMPORTANT
*please read the information below before applying*


**Hackathon is limited to Hofstra University undergrad and grad students!**
**All prizes will be given out in-person**

**Introduction**
WiCyS club is thrilled to announce Hacknology 2024, an online Data Science Hackathon designed to inspire innovation and cultivate the analytical talents of Hofstra students. This fully remote event allows participants to dive into the dynamic world of data science and emerge with practical, impactful solutions.
Event Details
- Dates: April 19th - April 22nd, 2024 - Venue: Online (Fully Remote)
- Hacknology Opening Ceremony:
- When: 04/19
- Where: PLAZA middle & east
- Time: 6:00 PM – 7:30PM
- Results – TBA (a week from last day of competition, approximate date: 04/29)

**Eligibility**

- Open exclusively to Hofstra University students (undergraduate and graduate, any major). - Beginners are encouraged to participate.
- Teams can consist of 1 to 3 members.

**Requirements**

- Projects must be functional to be eligible for prizes.

**Participation Rules**

- The WiCyS club reserves the right to extend both the submission deadline and the winner announcement date.
- Only Hofstra University students are allowed to participate. No external entries will be considered.

**Code of Conduct**

- Participants must maintain a respectful and professional demeanor at all times. - Harassment of any kind will not be tolerated.

**Intellectual Property**

- All submitted work must be original. No plagiarism or use of unauthorized materials will be tolerated.
- Participants retain ownership of their projects, but by entering the hackathon, they grant WiCyS club the right to use their projects for promotional purposes.

**Judging Criteria**

Creativity: Novelty of the idea and approach.
Execution: Functionality and technical implementation. Impact: Potential real-world applicability and usefulness. Presentation: Clarity and persuasiveness of the pitch.

**Technical Requirements**

- Projects must be developed during the hackathon period. Pre-existing projects are not permitted. - Use of open-source libraries is allowed, provided they are properly credited.

**Team Collaboration**

- Participants must work in their registered teams. No switching teams mid-event. - Collaboration among teams is not permitted.

**External Assistance**

- Teams are not allowed to outsource work to non-team members.
- Mentors will be available, but they can only provide guidance, not direct code contributions.

**Code of Ethics**

- Participants must commit to ethical hacking practices. Projects designed to cause harm, violate privacy, or engage in illegal activities will result in immediate disqualification.
- Follow ACM code of ethics as well ( https://www.acm.org/code-of-ethics )

**Compliance with University Rules**

- Participants must also adhere to all Hofstra University policies regarding student conduct, especially those related to online behavior.
 
**Emergency Situations**
- In the event of technical diBiculties or unforeseen circumstances, participants should immediately notify the organizers.

**Disqualification**

- The organizers reserve the right to disqualify any team that breaches the rules or engages in behavior deemed unethical or unfair.

**Prizes**

*1ST BEST OVERALL*
- HP Laptops
- Backpacks
- $25 Amazon Gift Card
*2ND BEST OVERALL*
- Smart Bottle
- Portable Charger (Power Bank) - $25 Amazon Gift Card

***SPECIAL TRACK PRIZES***

- $25 Amazon Gift Card

*HEALTH HACK*
- Sunrise Alarm Clock
- $25 Amazon Gift Card

*TRAVEL HACK*
- Amazon Fire Tablet
- $25 Amazon Gift Card

*FINANCE HACK*

- $25 Amazon Gift Card

# Get ready to code, create, and compete for these exciting rewards!

For more information and to sign up, please refer to the attached poster and scan the ǪR code for direct access to the registration and detailed event guidelines. Embrace this chance to showcase your skills, learn from your peers, and possibly walk away with not just new insights, but fantastic prizes as well. We can’t wait to see what innovative solutions you bring to the world of data science!

name: Digitalization for Disruptive Technologies
tagline: Unleash Creativity: Transforming Industries through Digital Disruption
desc:
In an age characterized by relentless technological progress, the ability to recognize disruptive technologies is paramount for businesses aiming to maintain their competitive edge. These breakthrough innovations are poised to revolutionize numerous sectors, spanning from healthcare and energy to social media. Hacking embodies the ethos of creating solutions that have yet to be realized—a process of envisioning and tirelessly pursuing ideas. It entails embracing failure as an opportunity for growth, continuously iterating and refining concepts. Hacking encourages experimentation, fostering a culture of learning through hands-on experience. Collaboration lies at its core, as individuals come together to cultivate innovative solutions. Ultimately, hacking is synonymous with becoming a proficient problem solver and a more adept technologist. Embracing this ethos, the Energy Institute Bengaluru, in collaboration with NASSCOM, is proud to announce an online hackathon—Digitalization for Disruptive Technologies. We cordially invite all enthusiasts to join us in this exciting and immersive event.
The primary objective of this hackathon is to stimulate the advancement of disruptive technologies in crucial sectors such as healthcare, energy, and social media, leveraging the collective expertise of industrial entities. Central to this endeavour is the notion of disruption, wherein participants are encouraged to approach challenges in novel and innovative ways, with a particular emphasis on leveraging information and communications technology. Key technological domains include IoT/Hardware, Big Data, Design, FinTech, Machine Learning, HealthTech, AR/VR, Future Mobility, and Blockchain technologies. Winning hackathon teams will have the opportunity to develop a tool in these domains, guided by industry judges who will also propose problem statements for the hackathon.  For industrial partners, supporting this hackathon presents an exceptional opportunity to showcase their capabilities and products, as well as to engage with promising young professionals by offering judgement and industry practicums.

name: Code Ninjas
desc:
Calling all creative technologists!  This challenge is for you to build a full-fledged End-to-End SaaS Platform that leverages cutting-edge AI to streamline report analysis.

Objective:  Develop a user-friendly platform that allows users to:

Signup and Login seamlessly using their LinkedIn or Github credentials.
Upload PDF Reports: The platform should seamlessly accept and process user-uploaded PDF reports.
AI-powered Summarization: Here's where the magic happens! Integrate your chosen AI solution (OpenAI, Google Bard, ChatPDF, Lliama 2) to analyze the uploaded PDF and generate a concise, one-page PowerPoint presentation (PPT) capturing the key points.
Data Visualization Powerhouse: The generated PPT should include compelling graphs with data labels and clear headings, effectively presenting the extracted information.
Tech Stack:

Frontend: ReactJS
Backend: Choose one (NodeJS or PHP)
Database: No database required for this challenge (data will be processed in-memory)
Bonus Points:

Implement additional functionalities like user profile management, report history, or downloadable PPT presentations.
Integrate with cloud storage services (e.g., AWS S3) for scalable file storage.
Ensure a user-friendly and intuitive interface for a seamless user experience.
Who should participate?

This challenge is perfect for developers with a passion for AI and web development.  It's a great opportunity to showcase your skills in:

AI Integration (OpenAI, Google Bard, ChatPDF, Lliama 2)
Web development (ReactJS, NodeJS/PHP)
Data visualization
Ready to take on the challenge?  Get coding!

prizes.name: Web3 AI Agents
prizes.desc:
# Bounty: Create a dApp with AI Integration

**Sponsored by:** CMT Digital

## Overview
Design and develop a decentralized application (dApp) that incorporates an AI agent or a multi-agent system to deliver a novel solution or service.

## Bonus Points

- **On-chain Verification:** Utilize zkML (zero-knowledge Machine Learning) or opML (open Machine Learning) for on-chain verification of AI inferences.
- **Interoperability:** Demonstrate how your solution can work within the web3 ecosystem, showcasing features like cross-chain functionality or integration with other dApps and protocols.

## Potential Use Cases

- **Smart Contract Interaction:** Enable agents to transact, engage with DeFi platforms, and manage assets via blockchain smart contracts.
- **DAOs:** Automate decentralized governance, including voting and resource management, through agents.
- **Oracles:** Use agents to incorporate real-world data from oracles for blockchain decisions, adapting strategies as needed.
- **DApps:** Involve agents in automated trading, liquidity provision, and managing assets across multiple chains.
- **Tokenomics:** Motivate agents with tokens to contribute to networks and complete tasks.

## Judging Criteria

- **Innovation and Originality (30%):** How original is the application, and how innovatively does it use AI agents or zkML in smart contracts?
- **Impact and Usefulness (30%):** What potential impact does the solution have on its target domain or problem area, and how practical and useful is it?
- **Technical Implementation (30%):** Assessing the technical complexity, technological utilization, execution quality, and the robustness and security of the smart contracts.
- **Presentation and Documentation (10%):** The clarity and comprehensiveness of both the pitch and the technical documentation.

## Deliverables

- A working prototype of the dApp, deployed on a testnet.
- Detailed technical documentation outlining the architecture, technologies used, and setup and deployment instructions.
- A pitch presentation detailing the problem, solution, and potential impact on the chain or protocol it interfaces with.

name: FOSSASIA 2024 Hackathon
desc:
FOSSASIA partners with Devfolio to host a digital hackathon in the days leading up to our annual FOSSASIA Summit. Sponsored by ChainLink.

📅 When: 5 - 7th April 2024
🌎 Where: Online
💻 What: FOSSASIA Hackathon with up to $5000 in prizes, credits and Devcon ticket giveaways!

The online hackathon will run from the 5 - 7th of April, hosted on Devfolio. Prizes will be presented in person, on the third day of the FOSSASIA summit. 

We invite hackers from across the world to come and build important infrastructure and tooling using Chainlink, a web3 oracle, which solves data availability across blockchain. 

# **Build something awesome using Chainlink!**

Anything that came from the Chainlink Documentation counts - using CCIP, Functions, Price Feeds, Data Streams, PoR, VRF or Automation

You can see examples of successful implementations of Chainlink services [here](https://blog.chain.link/smart-contract-use-cases/).

**Functions use cases - examples:**
- Generative AI NFTs using Chainlink Functions
- Censorship-resistant news headline aggregator that uses - Chainlink Functions and prominent news APIs
- Verifiable AI: Can use Functions to verify the output of an AI LLM, & get an attestation that the output is correct & what the LLM actually outputted

# **Requirements:**
Each project must use Chainlink in some form to make a state change on a blockchain, otherwise it will not be eligible. This means that a front end simply reading from Chainlink Data Feeds doesn't count. Using Chainlink inside your smart contracts is required.

While all project submissions are evaluated holistically, there will be bonus points given to projects that use Chainlink services together in a meaningful way.
Please let us know how you use Chainlink in the project description.

It must be possible for the judges to find the Chainlink use in your code. Only the intention to use is not valid.

# **Judging criteria:**

***UI/UX/DX*** - How useful is your application? Is it visually appealing?

***Blockchain technology application*** - How valuable this project is for decentralization and adoption of Blockchain and Web3

***Wow Factor***- Anything not covered above! This is if you blow us away in some other way.

# **Resources:**
You can get started with any resources by checking out the [hackathon resources page](https://docs.chain.link/resources/hackathon-resources) and the newest [Developer Hub](https://dev.chain.link/).
You’ll find:
* [The Chainlink CCIP documentation](https://docs.chain.link/ccip)
* Smart Contract Starter Tutorial
* [Documentation](https://docs.chain.link/?utm_medium=referral&cnid=7ewfjg425mq6) for all the Chainlink features
* Best practices utilized by top protocols like Aave and Synthetis
* [Hardhat Starter Kits](https://github.com/smartcontractkit/hardhat-starter-kit)
* [Brownie Starter Kits](https://github.com/smartcontractkit/chainlink-mix)
* [dApp Tools Starter Kit](https://github.com/smartcontractkit/dapptools-starter-kit)


# **How to get involved**
1. Sign up for the hackathon here.
2. Submit a video and github link to your work through devfolio. 
3. Winners will be announced digitally during FOSSASIA Conference.

Join us and hack the future!

tagline: 알레오 생태계 발전에 기여하는 프로젝트 선별을 위한 온/오프라인 콘테스트
desc:
# 개요

1. 설명: 알레오 콜리지움 콘테스트 참여자가 제출한 프로젝트 내용 1차 심사 및 최종 발표를 통한 수상자 선정
2. 일시: 3월 4일 - 4월 6일 
3. 진행 방식
    * 프로젝트 제출: 미션 제출을 통한 프로젝트 제출 리스트 등록
    * 프로젝트 승인: 프로젝트 승인 심사 기준에 의거한 프로젝트 승인 여부 결정. 최초 승인 10팀 보상 지급
    * 발표자 심사: 제출된 프로젝트 내용을 기반으로 발표자 선정 심사 기준에 의거한 서면 심사. 4월 1일부터 프로젝트 발표 10팀 선정 예정
    * 발표자 공표: 4월 5일까지 개별 공표
    * 프로젝트 발표: 4월 6일 발표자 10팀의 발표 및 심사
    * 최종 심사: 4월 6일 발표자 중 수상 3팀 선정

## 심사 기준

**1 프로젝트 승인**

* **최소 완결성 충족**: 제출된 프로젝트의 소스 코드, 설명 등이 최소한의 완결성을 갖추고 있는가?
* **악의적 차별 여부**: 특정 성별, 나이, 인종, 종교, 외모 등에 대한 악의적 차별 혹은 비하 요소를 포함하고 있는가?
* **사회 적절성 여부**: 제출된 프로젝트가 사회 통념 관점에서 심각한 물의를 일으킬 요소를 포함하고 있는가?
* **표절 여부**: 제출된 프로젝트가 다른 프로젝트의 지적 재산권, 코드 도용과 같은 표절 요소를 포함하고 있는가?

**2 발표자 심사**

* **기술 구현성(Technicality)**: 프로젝트에 적용된 기술이 완벽하게 구현되었는가? 해당 기술의 구현 수준은 어떠한가?
* **독창성(Originality)**: 프로젝트에 혁신적인 요소가 반영되어 있는가? 새로운 적용 방법 혹은 아이디어를 제시하고 있는가?
* **실용성(Practicality)**: 다양한 디바이스를 통해 프로젝트 접근이 가능한가? 다른 프로젝트에 적용 가능한 요소를 포함하고 있는가?
* **심미성(Aesthetics)**: 프로젝트의 UI/UX 설계는 어떠한가? 편안한 디자인과 사용성을 제공하는가?
* **스타성(Wow Factor)**: 다른 요소를 차치하고서라도 프로젝트에 이목이 끌릴만한 특수한 요소를 포함하고 있는가?

**[** 발표자 선정 기준은 Devfolio의 심사 기준을 기반으로 판단한다](https://guide.devfolio.co/introduction/judging)**

# 트랙

* **프라이버시 어플리케이션**: LEO 언어에 기반하여 상호 작용한 프라이빗 어플리케이션 제작
* **오픈 독스 개선**: SnarkOS, SnarkVM, LEO를 포함한 AleoHQ 깃헙 닥스에 유의미한 개선 제안
* **라이브러리 및 툴 제작**: 프론트엔드, 파이썬 코드 트랜스파일링, LEO 도구를 포함해 알레오 개잘자 경험 개선에 도움이 되는 모든 라이브러리 및 도구 
* **교육 자료 제작**: 루디움 교육 자료 개선 제안 및 추가 미션 제공
* **기타**: 위에 제공된 트랙 이외에 알로에 체인과 LEO의 활용 방안 제안

# 보상

**1. 프로젝트 승인**

desc:
# Welcome to Ureck-a-thon 4.0!

Prepare to embark on a journey of innovation, collaboration, and boundless creativity at Ureck-a-thon, the flagship event of **URECKON - the Annual Techno-Management Fest of the University of Engineering and Management Kolkata.** 

Ureck-a-thon is not just a hackathon; it's an experience like no other, designed to push the boundaries of what's possible in the realm of technology and problem-solving. Over the course of 48 intense hours, participants from across India will come together to form teams of 1-4 individuals, armed with their skills, passion, and determination to tackle some of the most pressing challenges of our time.

But Ureck-a-thon is more than just a competition. It's a platform for learning, growth, and personal development. Through engaging guest speaker sessions featuring industry experts and thought leaders, participants will have the opportunity to gain insights, knowledge, and inspiration that will propel them forward in their careers and endeavors.

At Ureck-a-thon, we believe in the power of collaboration. Whether you're a seasoned coder, a budding entrepreneur, or simply someone with a passion for technology, Ureck-a-thon offers something for everyone. It's a place where ideas are born, friendships are forged, and dreams are realised.

And of course, no Ureck-a-thon would be complete without rewards and recognition for outstanding achievement. Prizes will be awarded to winners in several categories, celebrating excellence, creativity, and innovation.

So join us at Ureck-a-thon 4.0, where the future is waiting to be written, and together, we'll redefine what's possible.

prizes.name: zkApps Enhancing ETH-MINA Interoperability with Ethereum Primitives
prizes.desc:
### Description:


Embark on a pioneering journey to bridge the Ethereum and Mina ecosystems by developing zkApps that enhance the interoperability between Mina and Ethereum.

For example you can look at:

* Storage proofs
* Merkle Patricia Trie
* BLS signatures 
* Other primitives


This challenge is an open call to innovators keen on exploring the vast potential of zero-knowledge proofs within the Ethereum ecosystem, aiming to enhance privacy, security, and scalability through ETH<>MINA solutions.

Your application should creatively combine Ethereum’s core components with Mina's zk-SNARKs to address blockchain challenges or unveil new decentralized functionalities.

The winning entry, which best demonstrates the use of Ethereum primitives in a zkApp will be rewarded with $4,000.

**DISCLAIMER: If the projects do not meet our criteria, we reserve the right to utilize only a part of the funds, or to leave the first or second placements null.**

prizes.name: Best overall Mina application or library built using Protokit framework
prizes.desc:
### **Description:** 

Step into the innovative realm of the Mina Protocol and the [Protokit](https://protokit.dev/) framework (a modular and privacy enabled application chain development framework for the MINA ecosystem.) Build an application or library that reshapes privacy in finance or social networking. 

This challenge seeks projects that harness Mina's lightweight blockchain to redefine secure transactions and interactions. By leveraging Protokit's frameworks - privacy-enabled modules, succinct zkVM, and seamless wallet integration, your creation should offer a new practical utility. 

The winner will earn $4,000 and recognition for contributing significantly to advancing privacy and security using Mina's groundbreaking technology.

**DISCLAIMER: If the projects do not meet our criteria, we reserve the right to utilize only a part of the funds, or to leave the first or second placements null.**

prizes.name: 'Chewing glass' - most technically challenging achievement (or partially successful attempt
prizes.desc:
### **Description:**  

Join the "Chewing Glass" challenge to showcase your most technically demanding or innovative project using the Mina Protocol. We're looking for submissions that push the boundaries of blockchain and zero-knowledge proofs, from zkApps and development tools to frameworks and integrated environments.

Whether it's a complex game, a sophisticated identity verification app, or groundbreaking tooling for developers, your project should demonstrate advanced technical skills and creativity within the Mina ecosystem.

Ideal submissions could range from intricate zkApps like privacy-preserving consumer services, to essential tooling that simplifies zkApp development, even libraries that expand Mina's capabilities. This is an open challenge where you can highlight your project's technical innovation, or even a brave attempt that didn't fully succeed.

The winning entry earns $2,000 and spotlights your hard work and talent in pushing the tech envelope with Mina Protocol.

**DISCLAIMER: If the projects do not meet our criteria, we reserve the right to utilize only a part of the funds, or to leave the first or second placements null.**

name: Quasar 2.0
desc:
**For uploading your presentation, click **[here](https://forms.gle/V7sPZKRbEdk3TdPE8)**!**

**A sample PPT template for the idea submission stage is given** [**here**](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/10-quUuvZnW6ezcKtB5pDeuYl7jpxpg0O/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=107847640342351175174&rtpof=true&sd=true).


Quasar 2.0 is the flagship annual 24-hour hackathon organized by Vasantdada Patil Pratishthan's College of Engineering & Visual Arts wherein young innovators and developers from all over the country come together to find alarming problems in various sectors and brainstorm their solutions to said problems and showcase their true potential to the alarming problems of the region & the world. It is completely organized by a team of dedicated students and also consists of a series of workshops and other fun activities to make the stay memorable.

We are excited to announce our upcoming first rendition of Quasar 2.0 to be in a hybrid mode, designed for beginners with a passion for innovation and sustainability. Our event will feature multiple themes, allowing participants to submit their ideas in the given PPT format and showcase their creativity offline in VPPCOE&VA.

**For uploading your presentation, click **[here](https://forms.gle/V7sPZKRbEdk3TdPE8)**!**

# **Dates:**
27th January - 6th March, 2024. (Registration)
Till 10th March, 2024. (Online Phase 1)
16th March - 17th March, 2024. (Offline Hackathon)

# **Prizes:**
We have a prize pool worth **₹80,000** and more to offer!

# **Sectors:**
**Agriculture/Rural Development:** Whether you're interested in creating tools for better crop management or finding ways to increase access to markets for small-scale farmers, this sector offers a wide range of possibilities for you to showcase your skills and make a positive impact on the world.

**Smart Education:** This sector provides an opportunity for you to explore innovative solutions for the education industry, from improving access to quality education for all, to developing cutting-edge educational technologies.

**MediTech/BioTech:** Whether you're interested in using AI for disease diagnosis or creating wearable devices for monitoring health, the possibilities for innovation in this sector are endless.

**Smart City:** In this sector, we're looking for innovative ideas that can make our cities more sustainable, connected, and efficient. Whether it's developing smart traffic management systems, enhancing public transportation, or creating solutions for waste management, we're looking for solutions that can improve the quality of life for citizens.

# **Phase Details:**
**Phase 1:** Based on the 4 sectors given to you, the participants need to choose a sector and based on that sector, the team to formulate the problem statement and the technology solution to the chosen problem statement. As part of this problem statement and the technology solution, the team has to prepare a PowerPoint Presentation and submit the same during the process of registration. Once your registration is complete, you will receive a mail stating that we have received your registration. After registration, the participating teams have to submit a video stating the reason of your participation and why you have chosen this sector and particular problem statement.

**A sample PPT template for the idea submission stage is given** [**here**](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/10-quUuvZnW6ezcKtB5pDeuYl7jpxpg0O/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=107847640342351175174&rtpof=true&sd=true).

**Phase 2:** We will evaluate your problem statement and solution and after that the participating teams will be given confirmation of your participation on March 8, 2024. Means, at this juncture you will officially become a part of Quasar 2.0.

**Phase 3:** This phase will start with your presence at the venue on March 16, 2024 at 2.00 p.m. To begin with, the judges will look into your problem statement and technology solution to it. The judges will suggest some implementation changes in your stated technology solution. You need to incorporate the changes suggested by the judges into your solution in the next 24-hours, means till March 17, 2.00 p.m.

**Phase 4:** Based on the judges’ perspective and decision, some teams will be shortlisted for the final round. After that, before the jury, problem statement, its technology solution and the implementation will be bound in a business idea. The best teams shortlisted from your business ideas will be declared as winners of the hackathon.

# **Venue:**
Vasantdada Patil Pratishthan's College of Engineering & Visual Arts, Sion, Mumbai - 400022, Maharashtra.
location: Vasantdada Patil Pratishthan's College of Engineering and visual arts, Rahul Nagar, Chunabhatti, Sion, Mumbai, Maharashtra, India

name: DevsHouse '24
desc:
> **NOTE** - All Team Members have to submit this form with 1 idea 1 PPT and all have to submit the same.



**DevsHouse ‘24** is a national-level physical hackathon in which students from various colleges nationwide will participate. We intend to carry it out utilizing a variety of tech stacks that are innovative. 

As a part of the hackathon, participants will have 36 hours to brainstorm and develop creative solutions to challenges in the real world during this 48-hour event. This hackathon aims to foster invention, teamwork, and collaboration. 

# Eligibility Criteria:
1.Submission of ideas must strictly adhere to the provided the template for the PPT: [DevsHouse PPT](https://stdntpartners-my.sharepoint.com/:p:/g/personal/amritansh_sharma_studentambassadors_com/EaT1RJrRrIZKiXEADTUo_ecBjNQwUmVKsVK25ZGo7XqrCQ?rtime=_v3bExkf3Eg)
2. Participants should form a team with a minimum of 2 and a maximum of 4 members.
3. All participants need to submit their idea, as part of a team, only then their team shall be considered.
# Submission Rules
1. Round 1 will be conducted entirely online.
2. Participants are required to submit their ideas for any problem statement within the domains before the deadline of February 19th.
3. Participants should adhere to the submission template found on Devfolio.
4. The selected teams should RSVP within 2 days of the Round 1 result announcement (February 28th - 29th). The team will not be considered for the finals if not RSVPed.
5. Participants who are shortlisted for Round 2 should develop their solution only during the offline round. The days can be used for planning their solution, researching existing solutions, etc., but the core development should take place during the hackathon only.
6. Participants should not bring existing projects from previous hackathons. If found without prior disclosure, the team will be disqualified.
7. The duration for the on-site Hackathon is 36 hours, and power supply/internet connection for the participants will be provided.
8. A Jury Panel consisting of external judges, sponsors and tech experts will be assigned to judge the idea based on standard metrics of innovation, implementation, impact factor, feasibility, and presentation.
9. Jury Panel Decision is Final.
10. Members can be from different colleges, provided they are pursuing engineering.
11. Team changing or shuffling will not be entertained.

desc:
# Objective :
To harness the power of Generative AI to solve real-world challenges and drive innovation in the Fintech sector.
The hackathon serves as a creative hub where Openers explore the potential of Generative AI to drive innovation, resulting in tangible advancements with a positive impact on SME/Fintechs.

# Key Dates :
1. Registration : 31 Jan - 5 Feb.
2. AWS 1st Workshop - 6 Feb.
3. Group Selection - 9 Feb.
4.Project Synopsis Submission By Teams - 16 Feb
5.Project Synopsis Review by Organizing team - 23 Feb.
6.AWS 2nd Workshop - 27 Feb.
7 . Hackathon Day - 13 , 14 & 15 March.
8. Closing Ceremony - 15 March.

# Generative AI Themes :
**1.Generative AI for intelligent financial decision making on Open**
Sample for Theme 1 : Automated Insights and Reporting
Develop generative AI tools that automatically analyze platform data and generate insightful reports to aid businesses in decision-making.
**2.Revolutionizing Developer Experience with Generative AI in Fintech**
Sample for Theme 2 : Smart Code Generation
Develop generative AI tools that assist developers by automating code generation for common fintech functionalities, such as payment integrations or data processing.
**3.Using Generative AI in Financial & Banking Sector**
Sample for Theme 3 : 
Behavioral Biometrics for Authentication
Explore generative AI models to analyze user behavior patterns, such as typing dynamics or mouse movements, for enhanced biometric authentication in financial applications.

# Judging Criteria :
1.Business Impact - What is the business impact this brings will be judged. Will it revolutionise an existing feature , Is it going to be a new viable feature to market , Does it address current customer problems.
2. Technology - Assess based on Engineering Skill , Code Quality , Design , User Interface .
3.Wow Factor -How innovative or inspiring is the idea , Is easily deployable , Scalable 
4.Presentation -Clarity on thoughts & Oral presentation will be considered
5.Direct Benefits -Quantity with Cost , Efforts ,Timelines or Process benefit if any.

desc:
## About Us
The Indian Society for Technical Education (ISTE) is the leading National Professional nonprofit making Society for the Technical Education System in our country with the motto of Career Development of Teachers and Personality Development of Students and overall development of our Technical Education System operating in association with All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) and other International Projects. **We are the Oldest Students’ Chapter of Eastern India.**

## Hackathon
We are excited to present "**NITDGP Hacks 1.0**", an offline hackathon with a prime focus on college going students in and outside NIT Durgapur. This event promises to be a great learning and immersive experience, combining live coding, brainstorming, and building with the team in a very short span. Unlike many hackathons where there’s an unfair advantage to those having a vast hackathon experience, we aim to set a platform for freshmen to learn and spark their curiosity in hackathons, by making this one of their best first-hackathons. This highly acclaimed offline event of our society, is open to students across all streams in and out of NIT Durgapur.

> **Note**
> At the moment we are not sponsoring accommodation and travel for students outside the campus, but they are welcome arranging on their own or joining virtually. We expect to change this in the upcoming editions as we grow bigger. Thanks!

## Tracks
+ AI for Social Good
   > Develop AI solutions to tackle social issues like healthcare access, environmental sustainability, or education equality.
+ Web3 Track
  > Utilize Web3 tools to solve challenges from other tracks, integrating decentralized technologies like blockchain, smart contracts, or decentralized finance.
+ HealthTech Solutions
  > Develop tech to improve healthcare delivery, patient care, disease prevention, or mental wellness.
+ Fintech Innovation
  > Revolutionize finance with apps, blockchain solutions, digital wallets, or algorithmic trading tools.
+ Cybersecurity Challenges
  > Design solutions to safeguard data, privacy, networks, or systems from cyber threats.
+ Open Innovation Challenge
  > Work on any project of choice, fostering creativity, experimentation, and interdisciplinary collaboration.

name: HashHacks 6.0
desc:
# What will I do at HashHacks?
One task. One team. 24 hours. Break free of all bounds and develop something exciting. Something innovative. Something which has the ability to create a better world!

Code your way through this 24 hours hackathon where you focus your time, energy, and enthusiasm on building a product or service which can help create change. Because, using good software feels good. But building one feels even better!

# What is HashHacks?
HashHacks is CIC's flagship hackathon, conducted under Convoke, CIC's annual Tech Fest. You would be surprised to know that CIC is Delhi University's only engineering college, and it is an amazing place for coders, musicians, researchers, and even photographers! HashHacks and Convoke are being organized after 3 whole pandemic years, and we promise, you won't go back disappointed.

# Why should I join?
Join us offline for prizes valued at over Rs. 20 Thousand, free snacks, FREE COFFEE, and unlimited FUN + LEARNING! We hope to see you at CIC, DU's only engineering college!

# What about the theme and the mode?
HashHacks will be conducted in a offline mode! HashHacks is also open theme, that is, we will accept a diverse range of projects!

# How will the projects be judged?
The projects will be judged on the basis of the following criteria:

**Innovation:** How can someone not think of innovation while building a project in the Cluster Innovation Centre? We will be judging how innovative your project is. Does your project already exist somewhere on the internet? If yes, how is it different from the existing ones? Is it solving a problem more efficiently? Or is it a completely new idea?

**Originality:** How original is your project idea? We all copy code from the internet, but does your project consist only of copied code?

**Social impact:** How about helping humankind with your project? Is your project limited to programmers or will it be impacting our society in a positive way? Everyone loves projects which are aimed at social good.

**Technicalities:** We will obviously be judging your project on how technically great it is. Maybe you created a CI/CD pipeline for your project? Or, binded Rust with Python? Or, used Docker in the deployment process?

**Market readiness:** We know, it is quite impossible to create a project that is market ready in 24 hours, but, this will earn you extra points! Created a website? DEPLOY IT! An Android application? ADD THE RELEASE APK FILE TO GITHUB RELEASES!

**How much did you learn?:** Is this your first hackathon and you ended up creating a full stack project with an automated deployment pipeline? Or, is this your nth hackathon and you created a project that you are very familiar with? Learning always pays off, and we don't want beginners to feel intimidated by experienced hackers!

# Project guidelines
We all copy code, and it is totally fine to copy someone else's code. But, you must attribute the copied code in the README file of your project. Should you attribute documentation? No. Should you attribute a logic written by someone else as a StackOverflow answer? Yes!

You must maintain a realistic git commit history. We will be going through your commit history to catch any malpractices. Did you commit the complete code in one go? That is very suspicious and we might disqualify your project. You made 100 commits with a really messed up commit history? Now that sounds like a realistic development cycle!

Your project must have a README.md file explaining bits and pieces of your project.

Your project must be open-sourced on GitHub.

Your project must be submitted through Devfolio.
location: Cluster Innovation Centre, University of Delhi, GC Narang Road, Delhi, India

desc:
Welcome to the epicenter of innovation and collaboration – the D4 Community's Hackathon at CGC Jhanjeri!

**What We Are:**
D4 Community is proud to present an exhilarating hackathon hosted at CGC Jhanjeri, where we bring together budding tech enthusiasts, aspiring innovators, and problem solvers under one roof. With a passion for technology and a drive for innovation, we're dedicated to fostering an environment where bright minds can thrive.

**Who can join**
Only for undergraduate students

**Our Mission:**
Our mission is simple yet profound: to challenge participants to harness their creativity, coding skills, and teamwork to solve real-world problems. We believe in the transformative power of collaboration and coding, and we aim to inspire the next generation of tech leaders.

**What to Expect:**
Expect an adrenaline-fueled 24 hours of non-stop coding, brainstorming, and networking. Participants will tackle exciting challenges, engage in workshops, and have the opportunity to win fantastic prizes.

**Hackathon Themes:**

> **HealthTech Innovation**: Dive into the world of healthcare and wellness by developing solutions that can improve medical services, patient care, or health monitoring.

> **EdTech Revolution** :  Revolutionize education with technology. Create tools and platforms that enhance the learning experience, making education more accessible and engaging.

>**Smart Cities and IoT**: Innovate for the future of urban living. Build IoT solutions that can make cities smarter, more efficient, and better connected.

> **Agriculture and AgriTech** :  Explore innovations in agriculture. Build tools or systems that can improve crop yield, farm management, or address food security challenges.

> **Blockchain and Cryptocurrency**: Dive into the world of blockchain technology and cryptocurrencies. Work on projects related to decentralized finance (DeFi), NFTs (Non-Fungible Tokens), or blockchain-based voting systems.

> **Robotics and Automation**:  Explore the possibilities of robotics and automation. Build robots or automated systems that can assist in various industries, from manufacturing to healthcare.

> **E-Commerce Enhancement**: Explore ways to enhance the e-commerce experience. Develop solutions for better online shopping, personalized recommendations, or streamlined supply chain management.

> **Open Theme**: Don't see a theme that fits your idea? No problem! You're welcome to participate in any tech-related project that excites you.

**Why Join Us:**
Join us to broaden your horizons, sharpen your skills, and make lifelong connections with like-minded individuals. Whether you're a seasoned coder or just getting started, the D4 Community's Hackathon at CGC Jhanjeri is the place to be.

**Stay Tuned:**
Stay tuned for updates, registration details, and exciting announcements as we gear up for an unforgettable hackathon experience. Together, let's push the boundaries of innovation and make a positive impact on the world through technology.

Mark your calendars and get ready to code your way to success with D4 Community's Hackathon at CGC Jhanjeri!

desc:
# Welcome Ideators & Enthusiasts 

Introducing to you **IdeaGem 1.0 : a strategic and creative ideathon** that invites all the bright and talented minds in the nation to demonstrate their genius, talent, and inventiveness while putting their problem-solving and strategy-building abilities to the test. So, hold your breath as you create prototypes to solve a given problem-statement on a given theme, all without the need for coding!!

### NOTE: Final Offline Round Will Be On 29th February 2024

We have something really interesting in store for you, so do not think of it as just another ideathon or coding event! This contest will be nothing less than a cerebral war for participants from all different fields! 

- Join us on this journey of innovation and creativity with a group of 3 or 4 people. 

- **Individuals:** You do not have a gang? No need to worry; simply register as an individual and we will assist you in finding your other comrades.

Additionally, a secret superpower, the tech stack, and the theme will all be available on the day of the event.


## What is the role of “ACM Coins” here?

> "ACM Coins" are the feature of the event that makes it noteworthy. Depending on how you use them strategically, these will be your win tokens. 

> Each team will receive **100 ACM Coins,** which will function as a voucher that can be used to alter themes, upgrade tech stacks, or simply buy extra time. 

## **Coins Weightage**              
>>            X 2 coins          - 	1 Minute
>>            X 30 coins        - 	Change of Tech-Stack
>>            X 30 coins        - 	Change of Theme/Domain

## Now, the question is, how?

- Imagine that you are about to submit your work but have not finished it yet due to a few minor errors. Do not worry; you can buy yourself some extra time with these coins if you would like. Isn’t this cool? 

- One minute can be purchased with two coins. That is, **if you want an extra 15 minutes, you can spend 2 x 15, or 30 coins, to buy it.**

You can trade **30 coins to change your tech-stack** and another 30 to **change your theme** in addition to time.


However,
Remember! Survival is always assured to the one who knows how to save. So the more coins you save, the more points you will receive at the end of the contest to add up to your total points and determine your success!




## Your future will be determined by the following elements, so prepare yourself and focus on these factors to generate ideas appropriately:
- How solid your concepts are
- Your points earned in the judging round.
- The PowerPoint presentation you have prepared 
- The improvements you make following the mentorship round
- The coins you have saved. 

The top three teams will receive the greatest scores in this IdeaGem 1.0, and they will also receive many fantastic prizes!

So buckle up and prepare to embark on an exhilarating journey with us as we use our superior intelligence and strategy-building skills to take you off the ground and redefine possibilities while you wittily navigate all the obstacles in your path!

HackMOL is the flagship annual 30-hour hackathon being organized by Google Developer Student Club (GDSC) of NIT Jalandhar wherein Young coders & developers from all over the country join together to build projects & solutions to the alarming problems of the region & the world. It is organized at the end of the Month of Learning (MOL), a series of workshops & seminars focused and centered around the latest technologies.

Over the years HackMOL has established itself as the Biggest Hackathon of Punjab with an awe-inspiring attendance of over 700+, 1100+, 1800+ & 3200+ hackers in successive editions but this year HackMOL has advanced to another level with anticipation of over 4000+ hackers joining us.

We are excited to announce our upcoming hackathon in **Hybrid Mode** designed for beginners with a passion for innovation and sustainability. 

The participants must develop an idea and submit the PPT on the Devfolio Platform. The selected student would be invited to join Round 2 taking Place offline at NIT Jalandhar.

#Team Entry is Suggested.

# Structure of Hackathon
The Hackathon is going to be conducted in Two Phases - 
1. PPT Submission Round: 26 Jan - 10 Feb 11:59 PM
2. Offline Hackathon (for Top 50 Teams): 24-25 Feb

Follow this Template for PPT Submissions
[Template Link](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1XVHNmnDQ3Ioq3CgXTPmLQeHQuJ47kXN_/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=109133811280111214940&rtpof=true&sd=true)

# Facilities Provided for Offline Hackathon
1. Full-night stay with proper bedding
2. Internet Facility 24/7
3. Proper temperature-controlled rooms.
4. Food and Refreshment for the whole Hackathon period
  
# Themes you can choose from 
(but not limited to the following)

1. **Green Technology**
2. **Blockchain/Decentralized app(Dapp) Development (Web3)**
3. **Agriculture and Rural Development**
4. **MedTech/Healthcare**
5. **Machine Learning / Artificial Intelligence**
6. **Smart Education**
7. **CyberSecurity**
8. **Internet of Things (IoT)**
9. **Open Innovation**

NEW IDEAS ARE WELCOMED

name: ETHDenver 2024
tagline: Largest and Longest Running #BUIDLathon in the World
desc:
# Welcome to ETHDenver: The Largest and Longest Running #BUIDLathon in the World!

ETHDenver is the world’s largest and longest running blockchain-focused #BUIDLathon (aka hackathon). Here, we bring together a vibrant mix of over 25,000 innovators from more than 120 countries, creating a hub of innovation. ETHDenver is where developers, creators, and visionaries gather to tackle critical challenges and bring to life groundbreaking ideas in blockchain and distributed computing.

**Have you been accepted to attend ETHDenver?**  
Make sure you [apply to attend ETHDenver](https://ethdenver.com/apply) **BEFORE** completing the #BUIDLathon application on Devfolio. 

This application is tokengated by [tokenproof](https://tokenproof.xyz). You must use the same wallet address and email address as tokenproof in your devfolio application. IF things are not the same, you may miss out on exclusive #BUIDLer airdrops.

# A Global Stage for Trailblazing Ideas and Funding Opportunities

ETHDenver is not just about competition; it's a launchpad for success. With over **$1,000,000 in sponsor bounties, prizes prizes, and up to $10,000,000 in grants and investments**, ETHDenver offers substantial support to help turn visionary ideas into reality.

# A Legacy of Success and Community Impact

The impact of ETHDenver extends well beyond the event. Our alumni have collectively raised over $300 million in funding, not counting undisclosed grants and early-stage investments. Many of our past #BUIDL teams include 1Inch, POAP.xyz, Huma Finance, Harpie, and Bankless, and more have grown from humble beginnings at our hackathon to become key sponsors, partners, and integral contributors to the Community Innovation Festival at ETHDenver.

# Join the Blockchain Innovation

As ETHDenver continues to expand its horizons, we invite you to be among the next wave of 7,000+ #BUIDLers at our upcoming event. This is your opportunity to join a community that is not just witnessing but actively shaping the future of blockchain technology.

# Your Journey with ETHDenver Awaits

# [ETHDenver 2024 #BUIDLathon Information & Best Practices](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eN9hZexuloQ). 
Make sure to watch this before arriving.

# What Will The Internet Look Like For ETHDenver 2024
The IT team for ETHDenver 2024 has performed a comprehensive assessment of the state of the IT infrastructure for the upcoming show, this included 2 site visits, review of internal communications about issues, and collection of explicit feedback from stakeholders. During this assessment the IT team identified the following major pain points and have taken steps to remediate:
• Undersized core infrastructure which likely resulted in dropped connections when the firewall state table filled up
• Undersized NAT Pool causing throttling to various services due to an uneven distribution of connections
• Lack of access point density in the BUIDLHub resulting in dropped connections and overloaded equipment

Throughout the venue the IT team is taking steps to identify wireless dead zones and improve coverage proactively, they have developed reactionary plans to resolve reported dead zones in real time, during the event through tactical deployment of equipment. No more than 20-25 clients per access point. After careful consideration, they have decided to deploy network switches at each row to provide optional hardwired connectivity.
