name: Genesis III
desc:
# **WELCOME**
The GDXR (Game development and Extended Reality) club of Army Institute of Technology dispense before you GENESIS III , the funkiest and beginner friendly game jam of the year. The game jam will include a theme (to be disclosed at the start of the event) around which the participants must build a game or a prototype. 
The game should revolve around the theme and participants are given the freedom to interpret the theme however they want though in a limited period of time. The worthy will be chosen from each category and three conquerors will take away the overall fame and will receive prizes from a total pool of 55K+. the game jam will aim to  provide a great game development experience.
# **THEME**
     The theme for the event is PORTAL

![image](https://assets.devfolio.co/content/17711fb9406a48d8a843a2e41a4eaf17/73d1189c-bf53-42f8-bfab-6a8a215fa4a9.png).

# **ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA**
Event is open for all.
Students studying at any college/university are eligible.
Any sign of plagiarism will lead to direct disqualification from the event.
# **GAME JAM RULES AND GUIDELINES** 
[RuleBook](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1bYPk2Kzk1x6HOrFNSCq4b_TtVfEc3dSj/view)
 
# Team Size and Participants
No limit on the number of teams per college.
Team size can range from 1 - 3 members.
Participants can take part in only one team.


# Game Jam Structure
The Game Jam consists of two rounds: 
Round 1 - Online Mode.
Round 2 - Offline Mode.
   **Round 1(Online Mode):** 
It will be hosted on itch.io.
The jam will last for 7 days.
Top 13 teams shortlisted from Round 1 will be invited for Round 2.
Teams are required to make a game around a theme.
   **Round 2(Offline Mode):**
The shortlisted teams will compete in round 2 at AIT Pune Campus.
Teams will be given a **SURPRISE ELEMENT** that they had to integrate to their existing games. 
 
# Game Parameters
Your game should be made within the stipulated time.
The game should be relevant to the theme for it to be considered for evaluation. 
The game must not be a copy of any existing game, it should be unique.  
Teams can use any game engine as long as it meets the following requirements. 
The game must be published and submitted through itch.io page.
The game can be played by a wide variety of audiences without installing any kind of software other than the game itself. 
The game can be distributed to the audience without violating any licensing or Terms and conditions of the game engine or the assets used.


# Assets Usage
Participants are allowed to use individual assets.
Usage of full scenes or pre-made game prefabs is not allowed.
Usage of Copyrighted assets and content will lead to disqualification.


# Round 2 at AIT Pune
The teams will be given a Surprise Element, which they have to integrate in their games.
The teams will be given 24 hours to make required modifications and integration of the surprise element to their game.
All selected teams should reach AIT Pune campus for this event on or before the given date.
Failing to reach will result in disqualification from the event.
All teams are required to bring their own laptops/setups for the final round.           
                                        
# Judgement Criteria
   **Round 1:**
Concept and Complexity of the Game.
Innovative Approaches to the Theme.
Art, Audio, and Graphics.
Innovative Approach towards Game Mechanism.
Enjoyment factor for players.
Effectiveness of narrative and storytelling.    
   **Round 2:**
Enhancement of overall gameplay by the modifications made by adding the Surprise element.
The changes made add to the betterment of the game mechanics and narration.
Integration of the Surprise element with the existing game. 


# Submission Process
The first round is online and teams are required to publish their games on the itch.io page.
Games must be submitted within the designated duration.
Provide a concise and engaging overview of your game, including its title, genre, and a brief description of the gameplay for the online submission, also include screenshots or gameplay videos to showcase the visual aspects of your game.
Highlight any unique and distinct art style or design element in your game.
   **Controls and User Interface:**
Provide the control scheme for your game.
   **Technical Details:**
Provide technical information about the game engine, tools, and technologies used in development. 
Mention any performance optimizations and stability measures.
   **Contact Information:** 
Provide clear and up-to-date contact information in case the reviewers have questions or need further details.

name: K! Hacks
desc:
K! Hacks is a National-level Hackathon organized by the CEG Tech Forum. It invites participants to solve real-world challenges in domains like AI, IoT, BlockChain, and AR/VR. The hackathon has two rounds: an online phase for innovative solutions and an offline phase for hands-on problem-solving. The top teams win prizes and showcase their projects at Kurukshetra 2024. It's a chance to network with industry leaders and gain tech insights.
Tracks:
1. Assistive Technology
2. FinTech
3. Health Tech
4. Logistics
5. Space Tech 
6. Sports Tech

 
**ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA:**

1) Participation is exclusively open to engineering students.
2) All participants are required to join the K! Hacks Discord server.
[Join K! Hacks Discord Server](https://discord.gg/hyN28N2u)
3) Submission of ideas must strictly adhere to the provided Submission Template.
[Submission Template](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1vP83bAdedim-dtoivmv86-e7V5TydA0Q/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=112130288616745043892&rtpof=true&sd=true)

**Submission Rules**

**Round 1:**

1. Round 1 will be conducted entirely online.

2. Participants are required to submit their ideas for any problem statement within the domains limited to assistive technology, fintech, healthtech, logistics, space-tech, and sports-tech before the deadline of January 20th.

3. Participants should adhere to the submission template found on Devfolio, or they can access it [here](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1vP83bAdedim-dtoivmv86-e7V5TydA0Q/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=112130288616745043892&rtpof=true&sd=true).

4. The top 25 teams with the most compelling theme-related ideas will be selected. The shortlisted teams will be announced between 1st - 4th February, 20 days prior to the hackathon.

5. Results of Round 1 will be announced before 15-20 days of Round 2 to ensure participants from different states/countries can plan their journey ahead.

6. The judging of Round 1 will be conducted by multiple panels of sponsors and professors, and the respective teams will be evaluated.

7. The selected teams should RSVP within 2 days of the Round 1 result announcement (February 4th - 6th). The team will not be considered for the finals if not RSVPed.

**Round 2:**

1. The 24-hour hackathon will take place offline on 17th - 18th February at Anna University, Chennai.

2. A new set of problem statements will be released within the domains limited to assistive technology, fintech, healthtech, logistics, space-tech, and sports-tech by the organizing committee by 8th February, 10 days prior to the hackathon.

3. Participants should choose a problem statement provided by the organizing committee for the finals; submissions on any other statements will not be entertained.

4. Participants should develop their solution only during the offline round. The 10 days can be used for planning their solution, researching existing solutions, etc., but the core development should take place during the hackathon only.

5. Participants should not bring existing projects from previous hackathons. If found without prior disclosure, the team will be disqualified.

6. Each team should bring their own laptops/electronic components.

7. The duration for the on-site Hackathon is 24 hours, and power supply/internet connection for the participants will be provided.

8. A Jury Panel consisting of sponsors and professors will be assigned to judge the idea based on standard metrics of innovation, implementation, impact factor, business values, feasibility, and presentation.

9. Jury Panel Decision is Final.

**Team Rules:**

1. Participants can form a team with a minimum of 2 and a maximum of 4 members.

2. All team members, including the team leader, should be current students studying in an engineering college in India.

3. Members can be from different colleges, provided they are pursuing engineering.

4. Team changing or shuffling will not be entertained.

**Accommodation:**

1. Accommodations will not be provided.

2. Food and refreshments will be provided throughout the hackathon.

**Organizers' Decisions:**

The organizers' decisions regarding team selection and problem statement selection will be final. Participants can contact the organizers using the information provided below.

name: DevRev Forge
desc:
DevRev Forge, the year's **first must-build AI hackathon**, challenges you to crack the **Multi-Channel Voice of Customer (VoC)** data conundrum using **LLMs**.

In today's digital landscape, **customer feedback and sentiments are dispersed across various channels** such as LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Twitter, Email, App Reviews, Instagram, Facebook, and more. Collating this Voice of Customer (VoC) data is pivotal for organizations to understand customer needs, pain points, and preferences. 

However, the diverse sources and unstructured nature of this data pose challenges in processing, denoising, and **extracting actionable insights** effectively.

The challenge is to develop an AI-powered solution that uses [snap-ins](https://docs.devrev.ai/snap-ins/concepts) to seamlessly aggregate VoC data from multiple channels. This solution should **leverage the capabilities of the DevRev platform**, utilizing its APIs for **data ingestion and an omnichannel inbox** for displaying actionable items to internal teams.

## Key Objectives
- **Multi-Channel Data Ingestion:** Create a robust system capable of ingesting unstructured data from diverse channels and formats (email, Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram, forums, etc.) using DevRev APIs.
- **Data Denoising and Preprocessing:** Implement AI-driven algorithms to clean, preprocess, and denoise the collected data, removing irrelevant information, noise, and duplicates.
- **AI-Driven Clustering:** Develop machine learning or natural language processing models to cluster the denoised data into meaningful categories or themes based on sentiment, topic, or customer intent. Be as creative as you can!
- **Actionable Insights Generation:** Translate the clustered data into actionable items or insights that can be readily understood and acted upon by internal teams within organizations.

Application Process:

- Fill in the application form to apply for the hackathon. 
- Go to the [hackathon website](https://devrev.notion.site/DevRev-Forge-2024-c071661e94594ac1b51ee75075d8c6b0) to get more details on the hackathon, and go through the resources to help you get up to speed.
- Attend the opening ceremony (more details on this to follow soon).
- Once the hackathon starts, fill the [access request form](https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScAP4KBay5wB23fAuijnmTrAt2IM7Zn6sLvH2vJWvgzOlanEw/viewform?usp=sf_link) to request any access/credits that you require for your submission (to paid APIs or LLMs).

The top 5 teams will be felicitated in DevRev's annual conference, [DevRev Effortless](https://devrev.ai/events/effortless-mumbai?utm_source=hackathon), hosted at Grand Hyatt BKC, Mumbai on 13th March 2024.

name: Hack This Fall 2024
desc:
# ​🍁 About Hack This Fall

​Hack This Fall is one of the most welcoming, inclusive, and thriving hacker communities in India. It was started in 2020 with a mindset of encouraging new hackers to build unique projects regardless of the technology or field. The primary focus of Hack This Fall is to create meaningful experiences using technology and enjoy the process of building them while solving societal and environmental issues through the projects.

​We aim to help hackers succeed in their professional journey by giving them a platform to showcase their skills, meet like-minded people, learn in public, and grow together. The Hack This Fall community strongly embodies the values of inclusivity and diversity at its core and reflects these values across all its community events.

​Join us for the fourth edition of Hack This Fall Hackathon. It is a 36-hour in-person hackathon. You can find more information below.

# ​⚡️ Hackathon Details

​We initiated the Hack This Fall Hackathon with the goal of fostering a beginner-friendly environment where people of diverse backgrounds can collaborate and create meaningful projects, offering a true hackathon experience.

​With three successful seasons of our flagship event in the bag, we are thrilled to welcome hackers from all backgrounds and skills at Hack This Fall 4.0 powered by Orkes!

tagline: Annual flagship hackathon of IEEE IGDTUW under WIEmpower.
desc:
🌟 Registration Open for **WIEgnite** - The Ultimate Hackathon Experience! 🌟

**Join Discord for Hackathon updates and doubts**  : [Discord](https://discord.gg/gx5ECmfE)

Get ready to ignite your creativity and innovation at **WIEgnite**, a week-long hackathon by **IEEE IGDTUW**! 🚀

🗓  **Date** : *February 5th - February 12th, 2024*

 **WIEgnite **is more than just a hackathon; it's a week-long celebration of innovation, collaboration, and problem-solving. Whether you're an experienced coder, a budding entrepreneur, or a visionary designer,** WIEgnite** is the platform for you to shine and showcase your talents to the world. 🌐

🎟 Tracks:-
✨ AI/ML
✨ AR/VR
✨ App development
✨ Web development
✨ Web3/Blockchain**

👥 Team Size:- *1-4 Members*

The hackathon will take place in three phases:

1)**Development Phase**      Online: 5 - 9 February 2024
Participants have to make submissions on Devfolio. Participants can work on their own ideas or refer to the problem statements mentioned in Problem Statements-WiEgnite.
[Sample Problem Statements](https://docs.google.com/document/d/11T5brKWmWuJK37yM5YUHw63pyzK__Dz2zJGDSNN-V6Q/edit#heading=h.xdt2zyrjy9co)

Top 30 teams will be shortlisted to the next round.
Basis of Evaluation for Development phase will be:
- Innovation
- Practicality and Resourcefulness of project
- Originality and Creativity
- Technical execution of idea
The submission will be evaluated on the basis of idea of implementation, but a prototype/code will give an edge.


**Submission Guidelines For Development Phase:**
The submission at Devfolio must include a PPT describing the project. The key headings that need to be addressed in presentation are: Problem Statement, Key features, Future Scope, Tech Stack,and Team Details. It should not be more than 6 slides.
Submission of the Demo Video of your project of not more than 3 minutes.
A prototype / github code file is not mandatory but will be considered as a bonus point.
The evaluation will be based on how well and uniquely the team/participant has targeted the problem statement and its practicality.


**2) Mentorship Phase ** :   Online: 10 - 11 February 2024
Top 30 teams from the previous round will be mapped with mentors for open evaluation and feedback. A complete project will be evaluated in this round.
Each team will be given 5 mins to demonstrate their implementation to mentors, followed by 3 mins of QnA/Feedback. It will be an eliminatory round with emphasis on the project implementation.

**3) Final Pitching ** : Offline : 12 February 2024 at Auditorium, IGDTUW
Top 15 teams will proceed to final offline pitching at Auditorium, IGDTUW.
Each team will be given 4 mins of presentation and 4 mins of QnA (Total - 8 mins/team) with an esteemed panel of judges. 

Ready to embark on the adventure of a lifetime? Don't wait any longer – register now and let your creativity ignite at WIEgnite! 🚀

name: CYBER SHADEZ TECHATHON 2024
tagline: A TechFest for students to showcase their technical skills
desc:
Cyber Shadez is a technical event for undergraduate and graduate students, featuring the "TECHATHON" event. Participants are free to use any technology or equipment they choose in the implementation process. The competition requires students to demonstrate the functionality and societal impact of their idea through multiple rounds of competition. Join us at Cyber Shadez to showcase your skills and innovation in the Software development!

Join the Cyber Shadez Techathon for a chance to win big! With prizes worth Rs 50,000 up for grabs.

# Rules
- The Techathon is open to all students currently enrolled in a UG or PG degree program at any college or university approved by appropriate regulatory authorities.

- Teams can have a minimum of 1 and a maximum of 5 members.

- All the team members must COMPULSORY register for the Techathon via the Devfolio platform.

- The code developed during the Techathon must be original and cannot be taken from external sources.

- The code developed during the Techathon must be hosted using an open source platform.

- The external libraries or frameworks (if any) used in the submission must be properly credited.

- The final submission will be evaluated by judges at the end of the Techathon.

- All team members must be present during the evaluation.

- The required work must be completed within the allotted time frame of the Techathon.

- The judges decision will be considered as final in determining the winners of the Techathon.

- The top 10 submissions will be invited to present their work offline in-campus events happening on 10th Feb 2024.

- Plagiarism or cheating of any kind will not be tolerated and will result in immediate disqualification.

- By participating in the Techathon, teams give CodeCrafters Club and FCAIT, GLS University the right to use, distribute and change any materials produced during the event.

- CodeCrafters Club and FCAIT, GLS University holds the right to modify the above rules as and when needed.

name: DeFy24
desc:
# DeFy24: A 36-Hour Hackathon for the Future

Calling all web3 enthusiasts and aspiring entrepreneurs! DeFy24 is a 36-hour hackathon that will challenge you to think outside the box and create innovative web3 startups. Unlike traditional hackathons, DeFy24 isn't just about coding; it's about disrupting the status quo and reimagining the future. Join us and help us create a world where decentralization and future yield go hand in hand.

**Round 1 : Ideation Round**

The online ideation round provides an ideal platform to unleash your creativity and present innovative ideas. Participants are encouraged to thoroughly review the provided document to grasp the expectations and guidelines for crafting a successful submission.

**The [Product Proposal Link](https://scratch-slash-7b5.notion.site/Submission-for-Ideation-Round-d2ae16cb2df94e408945fd3096f5bb90) must be submitted during the registration. You can edit the Notion link anytime before the deadline i.e 15th Jan, 2024.**

The participating teams will be evaluated on both their technical and business acumen. The top 30 teams from the three main tracks will advance to the second round based on the mentioned selection criteria.

**Round 2: In-House Hackathon and Business Pitch Competition**

Get ready for the next stage of DeFy24, the in-house hackathon! The top 30 teams from Round 1 will be invited to participate in this exciting event, where they will have the opportunity to further develop their ideas, learn and compete for a share of the ₹1L prize pool. 

Two top teams from each track will be selected based on the judgment criteria to advance to the business pitch competition.

**Business Pitch Competition:** Present your innovative business pitch to a panel of judges and compete for the top prize.

Don't miss this incredible opportunity to take your DeFy24 journey to the next level! Join us for the hackathon, learn from experts, and showcase your entrepreneurial spirit.

Together, let's defy the status quo and shape the future of Web3 and Business!

# About Inco Network Hackathon

## Welcome to the Epic Tech Showdown!

Get ready for an extraordinary tech challenge across 20 cities in India! Minds will collide, and innovations will spark as brilliant individuals gather to tackle privacy issues on the blockchain. This hackathon, powered by Inco Network and leveraging Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE), invites participants to build groundbreaking solutions with a chance to win over $2,000 USD in prizes.

## Event Details

- **Duration:** January 15th to March 15th
- **Prizes:** 20 prizes, each worth $100
- **Eligibility:** Open to both college and online students
- **Special Bounties:** 10 exclusive bounties reserved for students participating in Web3Utsav

## How to Participate

1. **Registration:** Sign up for the hackathon to be part of this thrilling journey.
2. **Focus Area:** Build something cool on top of Inco using Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE).
3. **Bounty Distribution:** A total of 20 prizes will be awarded for outstanding contributions.
4. **Web3Utsav:** Students participating in Web3Utsav have 10 exclusive bounties waiting for them.

## Collaboration with Blockchain Communities

We are excited to collaborate with leading blockchain communities, including web3samaj, Blockchain SRM, and more. This collaboration aims to create a vibrant online presence, fostering quality submissions over quantity.

name: Reckon 5.0
desc:
RECKON 5.0 is sun city's most innovative hackathon, where developers, entrepreneurs, and technology enthusiasts get an opportunity to create the best possible solutions within 24 hours to emerging issues via this platform 
## **How to get ourselves Registered At Reckon 5.0?**
**Step1:** Register yourself by clicking on the **Apply Now** button and fill in all the required details.
**Step 2:** Create your own team or join an existing team(as this is a team-based event).
**Step 3:** The Reckon 5.0 team will accept your registration and then will give an RSVP link to the registered mail ID then after all the steps are completed as mentioned in the mail, you will be able to submit a solution on any problem statements.
## **Why Should I join?**
Reckon 5.0 some say is the same as others, but What’s different from its previous versions,
 So here it is, This time we are Aiming and motivated to give our participants not only a hackathon but a journey from which they’ll get a  life-long learning experience,  where you’ll meet a large number of tech-Savy such as profound developers, designers, entrepreneurs and especially students and professionals, who are interested in technology and problem-solving as much as you are. For many of us, it will be a Once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to visit the royal city Of “MARWAR”, and get a chance to grab your hands on the Immense prize pool of 5 lakhs !!! and much more.
So, what are you waiting for register yourselves today and be a part of this Looming Journey Of CREATION?
## **How will the projects be judged?**
The projects will be judged based on the following criteria:

**Innovation:** How can someone not think of innovation while building a project in the Cluster Innovation Centre? We will be judging how innovative your project is. Does your project already exist somewhere on the internet? If yes, how is it different from the existing ones? Is it solving a problem more efficiently? Or is it a completely new idea?

**Originality:** How original is your project idea? We all copy code from the internet, but does your project consist only of copied code?

**Social impact:** How about helping humankind with your project? Is your project limited to programmers or will it be positively impacting our society? Everyone loves projects which are aimed at social good.

**Technicalities**: We will obviously be judging your project on how technically great it is. Maybe you created a CI/CD pipeline for your project? Or, binded Rust with Python? Or, used Docker in the deployment process?

**Market readiness:** We know, it is quite impossible to create a project that is market ready in 24 hours, but, this will earn you extra points! Created a website? DEPLOY IT! An Android application? ADD THE RELEASE APK FILE TO GITHUB RELEASES!

**How much did you learn?:** Is this your first hackathon and you ended up creating a full stack project with an automated deployment pipeline? Or, is this your nth hackathon and you created a project that you are very familiar with? Learning always pays off, and we don't want beginners to feel intimidated by experienced hackers!
## **What’s Free…?**
The main question is what’s not, almost everything is “FREE OF COST” We aim to truly give our participants the “Hassle-free” experience for whom they registered for 
Starting with the FREE Accommodation, and FREE Food including all the main course meals, starters, snacks, Energy drinks, and much more. And last but not least the “WorthWhile” Experience Which we all deserve.
## **Where can I find the Problem Statements?**
So, this is the most important question, you can find all the Problem Statements under the prize section above ⬆
## **Hackathon Details -**
Reckon 5.0 will be held in two phases-
### **PHASE 1: Solution Submission Round (Online)**
it's going to be an online round where you will register your team and submit a solution for any of the listed problem statements
## **—---------------(Top 100 Teams  Will Be Shortlisted)------------**

### **Phase 2: 24-hour Hackathon(offline)**
It's the final round of the hackathon, this will be a physical round at JIET Jodhpur, The Top 100 Shortlisted teams will be called here in offline mode to compete in a 24-hour-crazy hackathon.

**Final Judgment round** - Final Participants will go through 3 judgment rounds based on specific criteria, evaluated by industry experts and domain specialists. It's important to note that no team will be eliminated until the completion of the 2nd judgment round.

prizes.name: Ed Tech
prizes.desc:
#  Implementation of AI/ML in the Field of Education
**Description** Today our education system faces a lot of issues like lack of proper
transportation to school, basic infrastructure, qualified teachers, quality of education, low awareness of importance of education, etc are just a small portion of challenges which hold back the development.
Develop an AI/ML model which can tackle these problems and improvise the education system.

prizes.name: Health Tech
prizes.desc:
# eHealth Portal
**Description:** To design an AI based chat system for providing health related information through eHealth portal for state of Kerala.

prizes.name: Miscellaneous
prizes.desc:
# RAM dump collection tool
**Description:**  Design and develop a technological solution that can collect RAM Dump from any Windows, Linux or Mac based operating system. 
The solution may be in the form of an Auto Executable/Lite Version that can be run/executed from any USB storage device without installation at the target computer system.

prizes.name: AI & ML
prizes.desc:
#  Smarter Surveillance System
**Description:** Explain the general problem statement in simple terms.
i) At present, a lot of man hours are spent on physical patrolling of border areas and
compounds.
ii) Fencing wires are not reliable and easy to breach, in large areas it is difficult to be available at all locations, and if someone is breaching in absence of guard, guard will know only when they reach the breach site. Also it takes a lot of time to cover the compound walls if the area is large.
iii) For smarter India, we need Smarter Surveillance system, which can be developed through Modular design which is easy to assemble at onsite. 
The users of this system are two-fold: Any Security agency who is securing a larger area can install an unmanned area and can track through a single control room.
Develop a Technology that can address this issue partially or completely.

prizes.name: AI & ML
prizes.desc:
# Network Security Prediction System 
**Description:** As technology is growing, hackers are getting smarter as well, and
cybersecurity has become one of the major issues. Your task is to design a
model which predicts how safe a system is and suggest improvements to
increase security, to ensure the data of users is safe. Datasets:

prizes.name: Green and Clean Technology
prizes.desc:
# Groundwater Analysis
**Description:** Data analytics to provide complete solution for groundwater management for the country.
Groundwater is the major source of freshwater for drinking, irrigation and industrial purposes and has always been a hidden treasure because of its dynamic nature. The health of the groundwater system is reflected in the groundwater levels of the region. There is a need to develop a robust application to understand the groundwater scenario and its resources of the regions.
Representative groundwater level data needs to be analysed using statistical and arithmetical solutions along with the groundwater resources of the country to identify the blocks/district/state which has been critical compared to previous decade.

prizes.name: AI & ML
prizes.desc:
# AI Assistant StudyPat
**Description:** A study assistant for students that would help them in increasing their productivity by using AI-powered tools. One of the tools could be posture detection and correction. Students tend to have a bad posture after long durations of studying. An AI study assistant is a software application designed to help students improve their productivity and efficiency while studying. It uses artificial intelligence tools and algorithms to provide personalized support and guidance to students.
The end goal of this problem statement is to improve the productivity of the student using (but not exclusively limited to) AI-based solutions.
Application Requirements
● The model should be integrated with a web or mobile application.
● The system should be personalized to the student over time.
● Study material recommendation: The AI study assistant can analyze a student's learning style, preferences, and previous performance to suggest personalized study materials, increasing the effectiveness of the study process.
● Adaptive Learning: An AI system that can analyze a student's learning pace, strengths, and weaknesses, and adapt to their individual needs, providing personalized content and exercises.
● Time Management: An AI tool that can help students plan their time more effectively by identifying the most important tasks, prioritizing them, and allocating time more efficiently.
● Writing Assistance: An AI tool that can help students improve their writing by offering suggestions for grammar, spelling, and tone.
● Posture Detection and Correction: An AI tool that can detect and correct a student's posture in real-time, helping them maintain a healthy posture while studying.
● Note: The requirements for this PS are not mandatory and are only suggestions

prizes.name: Green and Clean Technology
prizes.desc:
# Geo Tracking of Waste
**Description:** Geo Tracking of Waste and Triggering Alerts and Mapping Areas with High Waste Index.
We do have waste lying in cities which makes it hard for cleaning staff to know which area requires attention and urgent garbage, waste pickup. Identifying Waste across in the City. Cameras attached to Govt or Public Vehicles while driving can capture video and identify garbage areas and upload images (image /video scanning). Ability to capture images of garbage and upload, images will automatically have GEO location position of the image. Viewing the high waste areas.

prizes.name: Ed Tech
prizes.desc:
# A qualitative and quantitave analysis of the unemployment of graduates
**Description** After graduating from higher educational institutions students are facing unemployment and usually go to various training institutes who promise them training and employment. One needs to take a deep dive into the matter analysing why this phenomenon has taken so much momentum and find out the gaps in the system responsible for such an occurrence employing various qualitatively and quantitatively methods.

prizes.name: AI & ML
prizes.desc:
# AI based crop identification mobile application
**Description:** Develop a mobile application that can identify crop using only field photo of a crop. The team must target at-least 10 different crops for demonstration.
The application will allow the user to take photos and automatically identify the crop. The photo and crop information along with geolocation information should be stored in an internal database which can be exported/emailed.

prizes.name: Green and Clean Technology
prizes.desc:
# Eco-Quest
**Description:** The current problem scenario is that many people struggle to adopt sustainable habits and reduce their impact on the environment. Despite increasing awareness of the importance of sustainability, many people find it difficult to make changes in their daily lives that support this goal. This can be due to a lack of information, a lack of motivation, or simply because it can be challenging to know where to start. To address this issue, there is a need for new and innovative solutions that can make reducing waste and promoting sustainability more accessible, engaging, and achievable for everyone.

Requirements.:-
Tracking and recording: The app must be able to track and record the user's daily actions related to reducing waste and promoting sustainability.
Gamification: The app must incorporate elements of gamification, such as challenges, rewards, and progress tracking, to make the experience of reducing waste and promoting sustainability engaging and fun.
Sustainable habits: The app must provide information and resources to help users adopt sustainable habits, such as reducing plastic usage or using eco-friendly products.
● User accounts: The app must allow users to create an account and track their progress over time.
● Easy-to-use interface: The app must have a user-friendly interface that is intuitive and easy to use.
● Notifications and reminders: The app must provide notifications and reminders to help users stay on track and make sustainable choices.
● Social features: The app should include social features, such as the ability to share progress and compete with friends, to encourage community involvement and support.

prizes.name: AI & ML
prizes.desc:
# Artificial Intelligence based solution which may calculate the probability of future market trend on the basis of past years data and suggest a suitable pricing model for sale of cotton
**Description:** Cotton is a commodity, which is perhaps the most volatile among all the agricultural commodities traded. Due to high volatility in cotton prices, it is very difficult to predict the future market trend and accordingly sales strategy so as to compete in the market and increase the volume of the corporation for sustainable growth. Thus, Artificial Intelligence based solution which may calculate the probability of future market trend on the basis of past years data and suggest a suitable pricing model for sale of cotton.

prizes.name: Green and Clean Technology
prizes.desc:
# Optimizing Food Recycling
**Description:** Everyday, tonnes of food in urban cities is thrown away because they could not be consumed before expiry. Food wastage not only has a big impact on the environment, but also could have been better used to feed communities in need.

Solution Needed: Create a platform that connects food suppliers (restaurants, grocery stores, catering services) with local food banks and non-profit organisations. The platform should use data analytics to optimise food rescue routes, minimize transportation costs, and maximize benefits to communities in need. Instead of throwing away food that is close to expiry, or has been cooked but not consumed, can we organise rescue efforts for these food items so that they can be redistributed to those in need? Collection and redistribution logistics are key, and the app should optimise timing and route transport so as to minimize transport costs while ensuring food does not sit around and spoil while waiting to be re-distributed to those in need. Transport distances also cannot be too far for the same reasons.

prizes.name: Agriculture, FoodTech & Rural Development
prizes.desc:
# An unique solution that would help to include informal vendors in the public space development without compromising on the Urban Design
**Description:** Public spaces are key element of individual and social well-being, the places of a community’s collective life, expressions of the diversity of their common, natural and cultural richness and a foundation of their identity. Key obstacles to inclusive approaches to street vending management in cities are the perceptions and misconceptions of the role that street vendors play. Informed by and responding to the common set of arguments used to exclude street vendors. Street vendors may contribute to congestion and grime but so do pedestrians, vehicles, the general public – and city governments that fail to regulate traffic and provide sanitation services. While informally traded food and drink can pose public health risks, vendors would welcome more hygienic working conditions to attract customers and to ensure the safety of their goods. Moreover, where public sanitation services are not available, vendors often clean their areas of operation. In many cities, street vendors self-monitor and self-manage their vending sites to reduce congestion, crime, grime, and public health risks. Even after all these things they have to compromise on the Urban design and face a lot of things. The main objective of this task is to help the street vendors to get included in the public space development without compromising on the urban designing. Students are expected to suggest more improvised and redefined solution for conserving and reusing the rain water and reduce the water demand at source.

prizes.name: Agriculture, FoodTech & Rural Development
prizes.desc:
# Automatic regulation of valves for release of water based upon soil moisture availability in the root zone of the crop, using artificial intelligence, in a piped and micro irrigation network of irrigation system
**Description:** In modern agricultural practices, efficient water management plays a critical role in achieving optimal crop yields, conserving water resources, and maintaining ecological balance. However, existing irrigation systems often lack the precision required to deliver water tailored to the actual needs of crops, leading to water wastage, suboptimal plant growth, and environmental degradation. This problem is particularly pronounced in piped and micro irrigation networks, where traditional methods of manual control fail to adapt dynamically to varying soil moisture conditions within the root zone of crops. The core issue lies in the absence of an automated mechanism that can regulate the release of water based on real-time soil moisture availability. The inconsistency in water distribution and the inability to synchronize irrigation with crop water requirements result in detrimental outcomes for both the agricultural yield and water conservation efforts. To address this problem, there is a compelling need for an innovative solution that leverages artificial intelligence (AI) to enable the automatic regulation of valves for water release in piped and micro irrigation networks. By incorporating AI-powered soil moisture monitoring and decision-making processes, this solution aims to bridge the gap between water supply and crop demand, while also optimizing resource utilization and minimizing environmental impact. Key Challenges: Dynamic Water Demand: Crops have varying water requirements influenced by factors such as growth stage, weather conditions, and plant type. Developing an AI system capable of accurately predicting these dynamic water demands is a complex challenge. Real-time Data Integration: Integrating real-time soil moisture data from multiple sensors across a field into a centralized AI system requires robust data collection, transmission, and processing mechanisms. Algorithm Precision: Designing AI algorithms that can effectively analyze soil moisture data, historical trends, and other relevant parameters to make accurate decisions about water release timing and quantities. Valve Control Mechanism: Developing an automated valve control mechanism that can respond swiftly and accurately to the AI's recommendations while considering the physical characteristics of the piped and micro irrigation network. Adaptability: Ensuring that the AI system can adapt to changing environmental conditions, crop types, and variations in soil properties over time. User-Friendly Interface: Designing a user-friendly interface that allows farmers and irrigation managers to monitor and intervene in the system as needed, while also trusting in the AI's autonomous decisions. Economic Viability: Balancing the potential costs of implementing an AI-driven system with the expected benefits in terms of increased crop yield, water savings, and operational efficiency.

# To develop new ways of Waste water management system in rural areas
**Description:** To save the water for the secure future the waste water management should be maintained properly in the process of recycling them and reusing it again for multiple purposes in order to ensure that the water gets saved for future. In rural areas, the provision of utilities to drain sewage in a safe way lags behind the provision of water for household activities, including drinking water. This creates severe contamination to the environment of the various villages and reduces the impact of water on the improvement of health. Since the water supply for domestic purposes in rural areas has improved considerably over the years, the quantity of wastewater that is disposed has also increased. Hence, effective wastewater management systems need to be introduced in the rural areas to mitigate the problem of contamination.Wastewater treatment is interconnected with the water chain, and thus affects the environment. Water used by rural homes gets converted to sewage or gets contaminated chemicals and other pollutants. It must be treated before it is released back to the environment. While nature is able to process and cope with a small amount of wastewater, imagine the huge volume produced every day before being released back to the environment. Health and environment are two major reasons to have an urgent focus in this soft-neglected area: health. A contaminated water chain can have disastrous effects on human health, agriculture, marine life, wildlife, and our food chain, to name a few.The aim is to identify and innovate a process of managing and treating waste water in the rural areas and to be able to reduce the wastage and improve the reusability of the water by treating it.

prizes.desc:
# Smart Buffer Stock Solution
**Description:** Background: In 2017, the government was struggling to keep prices of the essential vegetable affordable as retail prices had crossed Rs 60 per kg in Delhi. Then Union Food Minister had expressed his helplessness in controlling onion prices and blamed reduction in the area of cultivation and hoarding by traders for the shortage. The government was forced to take measures such as procuring onions from local markets and discouraging exports to bring the prices down. In order to keep a watch on the hoarders, the government has roped in various agencies to keep a check on the hoarding activities over the period of time. Also, with predictions of a ""below average"" monsoon in the year 2019, the Central government asked procurement agencies to store at least 50,000 tons of onions to ensure that market prices remain under control in case of shortage. The buffer stock would be used to control prices in case there is a shortage of onions in the market. Fluctuating weather and decreasing monsoon, causes decrease in crop (onion) output which in turn creates a demand supply gap hence leading to increase in prices or inflation. Summary: Reports from across the country indicate there has been an unnatural spike in the prices of vegetables, disrupting the carefully planned kitchen budgets of millions. An all-India survey on the retail price of vegetables like onions and tomatoes between November 18 and 28 showed that most households in big tier-1 cities forked out around Rs 100 for a kilo, while the average payout in tier-2 and tier-3 cities was Rs 80 per kg. Even the prices of sturdier staple vegetable—potato are up about 20%. Unseasonal rains all over the country have ruined vegetable crops and disrupted market operations, creating a shortage. High diesel prices too have added to the woes of consumers as they bear the increased transport costs. The crash and spurt in prices of these essential veggies has unfortunately become an acceptable cycle. For instance, last year saw a high in onion prices in September and a huge spurt again was witnessed this February on account of unseasonal rains. Then followed a sudden spurt in production by mid-March triggering a 30-40% fall in prices. In Lasalgaon, India’s onion hub, farmers were in tears as prices crashed from Rs 4,000 a quintal to a low of Rs 2,500. The government had to take last-minute measures like banning onion exports as soon as prices soar. One of the reasons prices of potatoes are relatively stable compared to other vegetables is because they use 90% of the warehousing cold storage space and do not rot easily. Similar cold chain/ storage infrastructure for other important veggies, with central support, will give better returns to farmers and provide stable prices to consumers. The more perishable onions and tomatoes can be processed and stored, as is done in many advanced countries. Objective: The Department wishes to create buffer stock of onions in the harvest season and keep the buffer stock intact with its food value, moisture and taste for at least a period of six months from date of storage. We would want the technical solution to be proposed for the following:- (a) Storage of onions in the traditional storage systems and warehouses available in the country. (b) Technical solutions for storage of onions in temperature controlled storage systems, warehouses.

prizes.name: Ed Tech
prizes.desc:
# Blended Learning to overcome inadequate infrastructure
**Description** Once the class size passes a certain point, the teachers are bound to 'fail' because the demands on their time cannot be met. In essence, the root of this problem is not the number of children in a classroom but rather the inability for each child to receive adequate attention. Combining modern technology and 1:1 tuition, students could perform far beyond other students who were being taught in more conventional ways. By combining blended learning (where face-to-face teaching is combined with online learning) with real-time data, we can get rapid feedback in classrooms and use that feedback to further enhance the quality of education. As an example, consider a classroom of 30 students. Ten students with similar abilities may work closely with the teacher, another ten may work through lectures and online tasks using computer terminals, and the final ten may work together on a group project. In the next lesson, students are rotated so they can learn in different ways throughout the course. This kind of approach enables the teacher to focus more closely on fewer children at once. The teacher can also tailor the learning approach for each student based on how well each one works for the individual. Meanwhile, the software on the computer is advanced enough to tailor the content to each student as well. By collecting real-time feedback on each child's results, the course contents can be adapted per student and make it as if they were receiving a one-on-one tuition. This approach allows each student to have their own learning path that's customized to their needs. By doing this, teachers can easily see which students are falling behind and offer more individualized teaching to those students. If more schools were to adopt a similar approach, where some responsibilities could be handled by tech-aided learning methods, more of the teachers' time could be freed-up to give more attention where it's needed the most, even in larger classroom sizes. Further the objective is to come up with ways and means to make meaningful digital application's that can use this information and generate knowledge, spread massive awareness, and support education delivery effectiveness of students into educational ecosystem and generate insights based on data it collected. The objective of this problem statement solution is also to come up with innovative solution which may use digital and physical medium together to make sure specially abled students who are slow learners are identified, their progress is monitored and right alarms and notifications are generated to assist keeping their education on track with elevated motivation. The solution may use technologies like Artificial intelligence, machine learning and internet of things and blockchain to ensure specially abled children are given right systems and interfaces to learn and grow. This solution's objective is to make sure learning becomes seamless and peaceful with right insights and aids for the children.

Supply Chain Transparency and Traceability :

Develop an system to enhance traceability and transparency in the industrial supply chain. Utilize technologies like blockchain to ensure the authenticity of components and raw materials, thereby improving overall supply chain integrity.

Create a system that uses artificial intelligence to analyze lab data, patient histories, and medical images to help medical practitioners diagnose medical disorders.



Customized App for Health and Wellbeing:

Provide a way to give individualized health and wellness suggestions based on a person's lifestyle, interests, and health data, possibly with the help of machine learning.

 

Cash Flow Management:

The idea is to help people view and study their overall spend analysis by developing a mobile app to analyze all the purchases made by scanning a receipt. Use optical character recognition (OCR) to simply click an image of a receipt and track payments.Using AI and machine learning, the app should be able to group items category-wise, for example, food, clothes, fuel, etc. The app should prompt users when they overspend or make repeat purchases.



Optimal Waste Management:

Set up an extensive platform for controlling and observing intelligent waste management systems. Real-time information on trash levels, segregation status, and system health should be available on the platform. Give authorities the ability to remotely monitor and improve the routes used for collecting rubbish, guaranteeing a smooth and effective waste management procedure.



Cybersecurity and Data Privacy:

Zero-Trust Network Architecture :

Design a software solution for implementing a zero-trust network architecture. Develop a framework that ensures strict access controls, continuous monitoring, and dynamic authentication to enhance cybersecurity, especially in remote work environments.

 

Behavior-Based Threat Detection :

Create a software system that employs behavior-based threat detection techniques to identify and mitigate cybersecurity threats. Utilize advanced algorithms to analyze user behavior, network patterns, and system activities, providing real-time threat detection and response.



Smart Home Security System :

Develop an IoT-based smart home security system that ensures the protection of residents and their assets. Integrate sensors, cameras, and smart devices to monitor and respond to security threats, enhancing the overall safety of residential spaces.

name: FHE Confidential DApps
desc:
Welcome to the first Inco hackathon!

​Join us for the inaugural Inco Hackathon, a two-day event during India Blockchain Week in the vibrant city of Bangalore.

​Experience the revolutionary integration of Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) in blockchain with the leading FHEVM network, Inco. Collaborate with fellow enthusiasts and gain insights from our seasoned FHE mentors.

​Utilize our cutting-edge technology to deploy confidential smart contracts with our fully homomorphic encrypted virtual machine (fhEVM). Solidity knowledge is all you need, as our fhEVM streamlines the cryptography complexities.

Top projects will compete for a $6K prize pool.

**1st prize: $2,000
2nd prize: $1,200
3rd prize: $800
4th-8th place: $500 each**

​The top 3 projects will be invited to present their project in front of an audience on December 7th at 3:30 pm. Winners will be notified ahead of time.

**​Kickoff on the 5th:**
​9:30 am - Doors Open
​9:30 am-10:30 am - Networking
​10:30 am - 11:30am - Presentation
​11:30 am - 1:00 pm - Team formation

**​Rules:**
​Team of 5 people max. Some of your team members can be remote, but you need at least 1 person who is in Bangalore and can present on the 7th in case your team is selected to present.

​The submission cut-off is 10:00 am on December 7th. Winning teams will be notified before 1:00 pm to present at 3:30 pm. Submission format:
-​List of team members
-​Video demo (5min max)
-​GitHub
-​Clickable demo (optional)
-​Short description of project and components leveraging FHE
-Feedback

​The projects will be judged based on completeness (bonus if there’s a UI), creativity, and clever utilization of confidentiality and/or randomness to enable use cases that aren’t feasible on regular EVMs.

​Here are some fhEVM ideas you can get inspiration from: https://fhevm-explorers.notion.site/fhevm-explorers/fhEVM-Novel-Use-Cases-c1e637b0ca5740afa7fe598407b7266f

​Use our discord channel to find a team or share your idea: https://discord.gg/N4Ghgk3zE3

​Technical Support: https://discord.gg/eN8KmSm2Rh

​Previous notable projects include:
- ​Fully on-chain mafia game ([Website](http://framed.gg/), [Github](https://github.com/joeyiny/FRAMED/blob/main/contracts/mafiaFHE.sol))
- ​Battleship game ([Github](https://github.com/battleship-fhevm/battleship-hardhat/blob/main/contracts/Battleship.sol))
- ​Slot Machine within Telegram ([Demo](https://t.me/inco_slots_demo_bot?game=slots), [Github](https://github.com/Inco-fhevm/IncoSlots))

​More code examples: https://docs.inco.network/getting-started/example-dapps

**​About Us:** Inco Network is the leading EVM protocol with on-chain confidentiality (using fully homomorphic encryption). Our fhEVM (FHE + EVM) makes it possible to write private smart contracts and perform computations on top of encrypted data without requiring its decryption. fhEVM can safely and painlessly enable multi-party use cases such as private voting or card games because the encrypted states are directly stored and managed on-chain, and it is compatible with the Solidity language and existing toolsets (ex: Metamask, Hardhat, and Remix).

**​Website: **https://inco.network/
**​Documentation: **https://docs.inco.network/
**​Demo examples:** https://demos.inco.network/
**​Faucet:** https://faucetdev.inco.network/
location: Oakwood Residence Whitefield Bangalore, 62, Whitefield Main Road, Whitefield, Prestige Ozone, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560066, India

name: DevHack 2023 by DeFiChain
desc:
Get ready for the ***most intense DeFi hackathon this year***! We present to you **DevHack 2023** – a groundbreaking, DeFi only event for developers and hackers to create solutions for the DeFiChain ecosystem and re-DeFi-ne the future!

---

**About DeFiChain:**
DeFiChain, the largest DeFi blockchain in the Bitcoin ecosystem with over $200 million in Total Value Locked (TVL), is your gateway to fast, secure, and transparent DeFi services. With users spanning the globe, it’s revolutionizing DeFi one wallet at a time. The next step of DeFiChain’s evolution is the launch of its MetaChain **(EVM)** layer, which offers users the security of UTXO with the world-building of EVM. To celebrate this launch, DeFiChain Labs is excited to kick off its inaugural DevHack. 

**DevHack 2023**
DevHack, is a ***DeFi-focused hackathon***, where we want to give our participants the tools and resources for building the **NEXT BIG THING IN DEFI!**

**Event Highlights:**

- 🏟️ **Offline** **Kickoff in Bengaluru:** Join us in the vibrant city of Bangalore on November 25th to start the hackathon with a bang! 
Engage with industry leaders, network with fellow developers, and soak in the fun of developing together! ***(PS. Registration for the offline event is restricted to Bangalore developers only, and you can register for it after you finish registering for the online event first.)***
- 🛠️ **10 Days of Innovation:** *From November 25th to December 5t*h, we invite developers and hackers to build and shape the DeFiChain ecosystem.
- 🏗️ **In-Person** **Winner Announcement + Mixer:** After a sprint of sleepless nights spent building, come and relax

---

**Tracks and Bounties:**
Compete in six exciting prize track categories, with a total prize pool of $25,000 up for grabs! Show your skills, make your mark, and claim your reward.

Additionally, as our event sponsor, AWS will award all participants of this hackathon with AWS credits worth $5k! 

Join us in defining the future of decentralized finance at DevHack 2023. Whether you're a seasoned coder or a curious developer, there's a place for you in the DeFiChain revolution.

desc:
🚀 About BlockBinge Web3 Hackathon

Welcome to the BlockBinge Web3 Hackathon, a one-of-a-kind event organized by the MLSA Student Chapter! 🌐🔗

At BlockBinge, we're on a mission to bring together blockchain enthusiasts, developers, and innovators from around the world to create, connect, and change the game. 🌍💡

🛠️ What We're All About

BlockBinge is not just a hackathon; it's an exhilarating journey into the world of web3 technologies. Here, you'll have the opportunity to:

👩‍💻 Dive into the depths of blockchain development.
🤖 Experiment with decentralized applications (dApps).
🚢 Explore the exciting world of NFTs.
🤝 Collaborate with fellow pioneers and visionaries.
🏆 Compete for amazing prizes and recognition.

🌟 Why Participate?

Organized by the MLSA Student Chapter, BlockBinge is your chance to:

🚧 Break boundaries.
🧠 Unleash your creativity.
🚀 Launch your career.
💡 Learn from the best.
🌐 Shape the future.

So, what are you waiting for? Join us in this one-of-a-kind journey to explore, innovate, and embrace the future of web3 technology. It's time to make your mark on the blockchain! 🌠👩‍💻🚀

🚀 **BlockBinge Online Hackathon - Rules and Guidelines**

1. **Project Documentation:**
   - Prepare your project with a detailed README file.
   - Include information on features, use cases, and the tech stack used.
   - Clear and concise documentation will help our judges understand the brilliance of your project.
   - Upload your GitHub repository link to the Devfolio and make sure to make it a public *repository*

2. **Tezos Track:**
   - Projects for the Tezos track must be implemented on the Tezos Blockchain.
   - Prize Money: $500 for the winner in this track.
   - Ensure your project leverages the unique features of Tezos to stand out.

3. **Push Track:**
   - Projects for the Push track must be implemented on the Push Protocol.
   - Prize Money: $100 for the winner in this track.
   - Showcase your creativity and innovation in building on the Push Protocol.

4. **Open Innovation Track:**
   - Participants in this track can present a working prototype using any tech stack.
   - Winners in the Open Innovation track will receive premium incentives such as LinkedIn Premium subscriptions and goodies.
   - Encourage out-of-the-box thinking and the use of cutting-edge technologies.

5. **Presentation Guidelines:**
   - Presentation is crucial! Make sure to showcase your project in the best possible manner.
   - Use visuals, images, videos, and if possible, provide a deployed version of your project.
   - A compelling presentation will help convey the value and uniqueness of your project.

6. **Judging Criteria:**
   - Creativity and Innovation: How unique and innovative is your project?
   - Implementation: How well is your project executed and functional?
   - Tezos/ Push Integration (for respective tracks): How effectively does your project utilize Tezos Blockchain or Push Protocol?
   - Documentation: The clarity and completeness of your project documentation.
   - Presentation: How well you present your project during the submission.

7. **Submission Deadline:**
   - All projects must be submitted by 30th November to be considered for judging.

9. **Prize Distribution:**
   - Winners will be announced on our social media platforms.
   - Prize money and incentives will be distributed accordingly.

10. *Have Fun and Learn:**
    - BlockBinge is not just a competition; it's a learning opportunity. Enjoy the process, connect with fellow developers, and let your creativity flow!

Good luck, and may the best projects shine at BlockBinge! 🚀🏆

name: GenAI TinkHack
desc:
Welcome to TinkHack - The Ultimate Developer Challenge!
TinkHack is gathering the brightest minds in the developer community to participate in a challenge like never before.

Do you have what it takes? Keep an eye out for this!

The 24-hour hackathon will push the boundaries of your coding skills as you attempt to solve some of the most pressing problems in developer tools and automation that have intrigued developers worldwide.

The winners of TinkHack - The Ultimate Developer Challenge will receive a prize pool that includes **cash worth 1 Lakhs INR!**

The problem statements have been revealed now!

**Challenge 1: Next-Gen Developer Tools**

Create groundbreaking developer tools that harness the power of AI to automate coding tasks, identify and rectify errors, conduct code refinements, optimize performance, and streamline the software development workflow.

**Challenge 2: Revolutionize Fintech**

Unlock the potential for financial innovation in the Fintech track. Develop AI solutions that address real-world financial challenges, push technology boundaries, and showcase your creativity and problem-solving skills in the financial sector.

**Challenge 3: Productivity & Automation**

Create AI-driven solutions to optimize processes, automate assignments, improve communication, simplify data retrieval, and increase efficiency in a wide range of sectors and industries.

**Challenge 4: Creativity Tools**

Design AI-driven solutions catered to artists, photographers, designers, musicians, and creative professionals. These tools boost artistic expression, simplify intricate processes, and ignite innovation.

**Challenge 5: Smart Cities and Urban Innovation**

Explore urban innovation in Smart Cities. Develop AI solutions to tackle challenges, redefine city planning, and demonstrate your creativity in building smarter, sustainable cities.

**Challenge 6: Open Innovation**

Embrace the ethos of innovation and venture into uncharted territory with this open-ended track. Create pioneering AI solutions that tackle real-world issues, push the frontiers of technology, and demonstrate your ingenuity and aptitude for problem-solving.


All decisions made by the organising team will be final.

prizes.name: Aleo Bounty Pool
prizes.desc:
About
     Aleo (https://www.aleo.org/) is a new Layer-1 blockchain and developer platform that leverages zero-knowledge technology to enable builders to create private and programmable web applications. It is designed from the ground up and comprised of a decentralized operating system (snarkOS), a zero-knowledge virtual machine (snarkVM), and a zero-knowledge DSL and complier (Leo).

Prize Description:
Aleo will be awarding a $5k prize split equally amongst the Top 5 teams building applications using Leo, based on one of the following categories:
a) Gaming
b) Identity & Authentication
c) ZeFi (zero-knowledge DeFi)
d) zkML (zero-knowledge machine learning)
e) Voting & Governance

All application ideas are valid. We are primarily looking for feature-complete dApps that have a user interface. We understand this is a hackathon, so even a simple application is ok. Please note that Aleo is still in Testnet. This means some functionality is still under development. It is essential to consider this when building your application.

Below you can find a list of the features/functionality that is currently in progress:
Multi-execution transaction types
Arrays (in the Leo programming language)
AleoBFT (consensus mechanism)

Submission Requirements:
a) Your GitHub repo must be public and contain a .leo and/or .aleo file
b) Your repo must contain a folder with the following information: 
1. Description of your application and why it would add value to the ecosystem
2. Instructions on how to execute your application
3. A description of parameters, functions, etc. This should be in a README file
c) You must provide a demo video
d) Your submission should have some minimum UI/UX
e) Please provide information on any challenges or roadblocks you faced

Judging Criteria:
a) Novelty - How unique is the application? Does it not exist on Aleo currently?
b) User Experience - How easy is the application to understand and use?
c) Engineering - How well engineered is the dApp given Aleo's current state?
d) Functionality - What can you do with the application?

prizes.name: Implementing a Monolith verifier using Circom
prizes.desc:
Monolith is a hash function that is being fast in native CPU computations and short and low-degree describable inside a circuit (hence being easy to recurse on it), hence achieving being an incredible candidate for SNARK-related applications. In this bounty we aim for the second aspect: describing the Monolith inside a circuit using CirCom, a DSL for describing arithmetic circuits in a low-level manner. The objective is to provide a description of Monolith using CirCom that is not only sound (i.e., there are no missing constraints) but also that is succinct (i.e., that the number of R1CS constraints is as low as possible).

Requirements:
Writing a Circom program that successfully calculates the output of hashing at least two inputs using Monolith hash function.

Judging criteria:
Performance: Does the circom properly calculate a Monolith hash given two inputs? Does it work for more than two?
Soundness: Are there any missing constraints?
Succintness: Are there any extra constraints?
Bonus: Use latest circom features such as anonymous components or tags to improve the readability / security of the circuit itself
Bonus: Generalise the verifier to work on different prime fields

「Rebuild Ownership」as a series global hackathon, is designed to gather the pioneer protocols in the space and offer hackers a holistic experience of tackling on internet privacy using web3 technologies. We are thrilled to have partners like Filecoin, Fhenix, etc.

name: Developer Augmentation Hackathon
desc:
⭐ [Quine](https://quine.sh/?utm_source=devaug) is organising its first Developer Augmentation Hackathon. A 2-day event where developers come together to build LLM-powered tools to make us better, faster, and stronger! We will accept submissions in a wide range of categories.

1. **Automated workflows**:  How can LLMs help you automate your software development workflow? Perhaps they can assist in writing cleaner commit logs or extremely clean Pull Requests.

2. **Code generation** :There are already many code assistants in existence. However, they may not solve all of your problems. You can develop new tools that assist developers in writing code more efficiently. These tools could include auto-completion suggestions, code translation, test generation, or even converting natural language descriptions into functional code.

3. **Synthetic Documentation** :  Is it possible for you to create new tools that can enhance the documentation of existing projects, identify any gaps in documentation, or assist in multilingual communication to overcome potential cultural barriers?

4. **Educational Tools and Tutorials**: As a coder, it's important to be able to learn new things quickly! Can you develop LLM-powered applications that facilitate learning paths or journeys for developers?

5. **Innovation Track**: While not all-inclusive, any app or tool that increases developers' efficiency is fair game for this Hackathon.

desc:
Join us for an exhilarating two-day hackathon on October 28th and 29th! This event promises to be a thrilling experience for tech enthusiasts, innovators, and problem solvers alike. Whether you're a seasoned coder or a beginner looking to dive into the world of programming, this hackathon is the perfect platform to showcase your skills and collaborate with like-minded individuals.

### Day 1: October 28th

The hackathon kicks off on the first day with an energizing opening ceremony, where participants will be introduced to the event's theme and objectives. This year, we have chosen the theme "Building a Sustainable Future" to encourage participants to develop innovative solutions that address pressing environmental and social challenges.

Following the opening ceremony, participants will have the opportunity to form teams and brainstorm ideas. This is a crucial step in the hackathon process, as it sets the foundation for the projects that will be developed over the next two days. Whether you have a specific idea in mind or are looking to join a team, this is the perfect time to network and collaborate with fellow participants.

Once teams are formed, the hacking begins! Participants will have access to a wide range of resources, including mentors, workshops, and technical support, to help them bring their ideas to life. Throughout the day, there will be various checkpoints where teams can showcase their progress and receive feedback from industry experts.

### Day 2: October 29th

As the sun rises on the second day, teams will continue their coding journey, refining their projects and adding the finishing touches. The atmosphere will be buzzing with excitement and determination as participants work tirelessly to meet the deadline.

In the afternoon, teams will present their projects to a panel of judges, who will evaluate their creativity, technical implementation, and potential impact. This is the moment to shine and demonstrate the hard work and dedication put into the project. 

Finally, the hackathon will conclude with a closing ceremony, where the winners will be announced and celebrated. Prizes will be awarded to the top teams, recognizing their outstanding achievements and contributions to the hackathon. Additionally, all participants will receive certificates of participation, acknowledging their commitment and dedication throughout the event.

This two-day hackathon is not just about competition; it's about fostering a collaborative and inclusive environment where participants can learn, grow, and make a difference. So mark your calendars for October 28th and 29th, and get ready to embark on an unforgettable journey of innovation and creativity. We can't wait to see what you'll create at this exciting event!

Minus Zero is bringing together the brightest minds in AI under one roof, competing for a challenge like never before.

**Do you think you have what it takes? Keep an eye out for this.**

The two-day challenge in Bangalore will push the boundaries of your acumen as you attempt to solve some of the most pressing problems in AI that have intrigued the brains of the best in AI research across the globe.
For 36 hours, the brightest of teams will face two mind-grilling problem statements, competing for coveted prizes and an opportunity to take that up in scale with Minus Zero. Research, coding, invention, or even re-invention may be required, but it might still not be enough.

**The winners of the {-1} The Ultimate AI Challenge will be getting prize pool cash worth +4Lakhs (Including cash prize of INR 3 Lakhs and Gaming PC + Interview Opportunity)**

**The problem statements have been revealed now!**

**CHALLENGE-1:** 
**Generating Synthetic Dataset of Indian Roads**
Develop an algorithm which produces photorealistic and context-informed synthetic images of Indian driving scenarios. The algorithm will need to be controlled by visual or textual prompts or any novel control method.



**CHALLENGE-2:** 
**Generating Temporally Consistent Synthetic Videos**
Develop an algorithm which can convert a given reference video into a novel video while maintaining the spatiotemporal consistency. The algorithm will need to be controlled by visual or textual prompts or any novel control method.

name: Nexus
desc:
**Where Innovation Meets Reality!**
Get ready for an electrifying 36-hour offline hackathon that will push the boundaries of your creativity and technical prowess. Join us for an unforgettable journey where coding meets camaraderie, and brilliant minds converge to build solutions that can change the world.

**Topics:**
1. Healthtech
2. Edtech
3. Web 3.0
4. Machine Learning / AI

**Prelim Round:** 
Till **October 23rd, 2023** , teams can register and submit their entries for the competition, with teams being shortlisted via Devfolio. Participants are required to submit a 2-3 minute video and a 6-10 slide presentation on the platform. The presentation must include details such as the chosen problem statement, the reason for its selection, the proposed solution, a use case description, future project scope, unique selling points, and team information. Results will be announced on **October 24th, 2023!**

(*if qualified for the final round, the respective team will be notified through mail.)

**What to Expect:**

> **Intense Coding:** Dive headfirst into 36 hours of non-stop coding, problem-solving, and collaboration.
**Real-world Challenges:** Tackle real-world problems and have the chance to make a meaningful impact.
**Expert Mentors:** Access to experienced mentors who will guide and support you throughout the event.
**Networking:** Connect with like-minded individuals, fellow hackers, and potential future collaborators.
**Prizes:** Compete for exciting prizes, recognition, and the chance to turn your ideas into reality.


**Rules and Guidelines**
1) Team should contain at most 6 members.
2) It's a 36 hour long and continuous Hackathon with no separate lunch/snacks and dinner breaks in between. Participants are free to have their own time and take breaks or rest according to their comfort.
3) No extra time will be given to the participants for submitting their projects.
4) No team is allowed to carry their laptops outside the premises for any reason and it is advised that a particular random team member should stay in the premises to guard his/her devices and equipment.
5) Team members do not need to be from the same colleges.
6) Travelling expenses will not be covered by the authorities.
7) Every team will be provided 2 mattresses along with bedsheets. (No pillows or blankets)
8) Plagiarism or re-using of past work is not allowed, only codes prepared during the duration of     hackathon will be accepted.
9) No Discrimination, Abuse or Harassment will be tolerated.
10) No Damage should be done to the college premises.
11) If any violation or suspicious behaviour is found then, the concerned team might be expelled from the hackathon.
12) Any loss or misplacement of one's own property won't be the responsibility of the event or college or anyone related.
13) College reserves the right to revise the rules and regulations of these competitions.

prizes.name: Red Envelope Smart Contract Prize
prizes.desc:
**Prizes**

The top 2 projects will be awarded the following prizes:
● 1st Place: $4000
● 2nd Place: $1000

Participants are encouraged to think creatively, but their solutions should at least include the following functionalities:
● Red Envelope Creation: Participants should design a mechanism to create digital red
envelopes. Red envelopes may contain a specific amount of cryptocurrency, NFTs, or other digital assets.
● Distribution: Implement a secure and transparent method for the distribution of red envelopes. Ensure that red envelopes can be sent to multiple recipients simultaneously via a link, email, etc..
● Randomization: Create a fair and transparent method for randomizing the distribution of red envelope rewards among recipients.
● Claiming Red Envelopes: Develop a user-friendly interface for recipients to claim red envelopes with their web3 wallets.
● Security: Ensure that the smart contract is secure and tamper-resistant, and implement measures to prevent fraudulent activities.
● Transaction History: Maintain an immutable ledger of all red envelope transactions, allowing users to verify past distributions.

**Evaluation Criteria**

● Functionality: How well does the smart contract perform the required functions described
above.
● Security: How robust is the contract against potential attacks or vulnerabilities?
● Innovation: Does the solution innovate from the web2 standard set by WeChat in the example
above.
● User Experience: Is the user interface intuitive and user-friendly for both senders and
recipients?
● Scalability: Can the solution handle a growing number of users and transactions without
performance issues?

**Submission Guidelines**

You need to submit the following while submitting your hackathon solution:
○ Solution presentation
○ Working demo video
○ Git Repo

● All Intellectual property created in this contest will belong to Okto.


**Resources**
○ https://www.fastcompany.com/3065255/china-wechat-tencent-red-envelopes-and-social-money
○ https://blog.wechat.com/2016/02/05/hong-kong-wechat-users-can-now-send-red-packets-for-chinese-new-year/

prizes.name: Compliance friendly web3 wallet
prizes.desc:
**Prizes**

The top 2 projects will be awarded the following prizes:
● 1st Place: $4000
● 2nd Place: $1000

Participants are encouraged to focus on the following key functionalities:
● Wallet creation: Use Account abstraction (AA) technology to create user wallets with a
simple experience. Accounts should be able to make monetary transactions only when
KYC of the wallet has been done.
● User Privacy: The user privacy should not be compromised on-chain. KYC proof can be
given to the AA wallet via Zk proof.
● Tax Deduction: Implement a system for automatic deduction of taxes from DeFi
transactions where the user makes a capital gains profit ensuring tax compliance.
● Transaction Reporting: Develop mechanisms to track and report suspicious transactions
automatically.
● User Experience: Prioritize an intuitive and smooth user interface, ensuring compliance
features do not create friction in the user experience.
Evaluation Criteria:
● Compliance Features: How effectively does the wallet address KYC, tax deduction, and
reporting requirements while ensuring user privacy?
● Security: How well is user data and transactions protected against potential threats or
vulnerabilities?
● User Experience: Is the wallet user-friendly

**Submission Guidelines**

You need to submit the following while submitting your project during the hackathon:
○ Solution presentation
○ Working demo video (doesn’t have to include the front end user experience)
○ Git Repo


● All Intellectual property created in this contest will belong to Okto.


**Resources**

○ Using ZK for KYC: https://0xpolygonid.github.io/tutorials/
○ Taxation guides:
https://www.coindesk.com/layer2/2022/11/14/india-cryptocurrency-tax-laws/?outputType=amp
○ Tools to decode and understand transactions:
https://docs.alchemy.com/reference/how-to-decode-an-eth_call-response
