name: TechMasters
desc:
Tech Masters is an exhilarating and visionary hackathon event that aims to unite individuals deeply passionate about technology, engineering, and innovation. Our primary mission is to foster collaboration and inspire the creation of groundbreaking solutions with the potential to reshape our world for the better.

We firmly believe that inclusivity and cooperation are the driving forces behind pioneering ideas and advancements. Tech Masters is dedicated to creating a supportive and inclusive environment where all participants are encouraged to contribute, regardless of their experience level, technical background, or expertise. Whether you're a seasoned developer or a newcomer to the tech world, there's a place for you at Tech Masters.

Throughout the event, you'll gain access to state-of-the-art tools, abundant resources, and seasoned mentors who will guide you in refining your concepts and transforming them into tangible innovations. You'll collaborate with like-minded individuals who share your enthusiasm and drive, giving you the opportunity to acquire new skills, expand your professional network, and, most importantly, make a meaningful and lasting impact on society.

Tech Masters explores a diverse array of themes, each presenting its own unique challenges and opportunities:

(1) FinTech: Dive into the world of financial technology and revolutionize how we manage and utilize our finances.

(2) Agri-Tech: Innovate within the realm of agriculture and technology, addressing critical challenges in food production and sustainability.

(3) EdTech: Explore the future of education technology, creating solutions to enhance learning experiences and access to quality education.

(4) Health, Fitness & Sports: Take on the challenge of improving human well-being through cutting-edge technological advancements in health, fitness, and sports.

(5) Blockchain & Cybersecurity: Tackle the ever-evolving landscape of blockchain and cybersecurity, safeguarding digital assets and privacy.

(6) AI/ML: Delve into the realms of artificial intelligence and machine learning, developing intelligent systems that push the boundaries of what's possible.

(7) IoT (Internet of Things): Harness the power of interconnected devices to drive innovation across various industries.

(8) Open Innovation: Embrace the spirit of open innovation, collaborating across disciplines and sectors to create solutions that transcend traditional boundaries.

Tech Masters is more than just a hackathon; it's an opportunity to be part of a global community of innovators, dreamers, and problem solvers. Join us in shaping the future and leaving a lasting mark on the world. Together, we are Tech Masters!
location: Jaipur, Rajasthan, India

name: InnoSprint
tagline: Code, Innovate, Conquer: Hacking the Future!
desc:
Welcome to the epicentre of innovation and collaboration – the D4 Community's Hackathon at CGC Jhanjeri!

**What We Are:**
D4 Community is proud to present an exhilarating hackathon hosted at CGC Jhanjeri, where we bring together budding tech enthusiasts, aspiring innovators, and problem solvers under one roof. With a passion for technology and a drive for innovation, we're dedicated to fostering an environment where bright minds can thrive.

**Who can join**
Only for undergraduate students

**Our Mission:**
Our mission is simple yet profound: to challenge participants to harness their creativity, coding skills, and teamwork to solve real-world problems. We believe in the transformative power of collaboration and coding, and we aim to inspire the next generation of tech leaders.

**What to Expect:**
Expect an adrenaline-fueled 24 hours of non-stop coding, brainstorming, and networking. Participants will tackle exciting challenges, engage in workshops, and have the opportunity to win fantastic prizes.

**Hackathon Themes:**

> **HealthTech Innovation**  : Dive into the world of healthcare and wellness by developing solutions that can improve medical services, patient care, or health monitoring.

> **EdTech Revolution** :  Revolutionize education with technology. Create tools and platforms that enhance the learning experience, making education more accessible and engaging.

>**Smart Cities and IoT**: Innovate for the future of urban living. Build IoT solutions that can make cities smarter, more efficient, and better connected.

> **Agriculture and AgriTech** :  Explore innovations in agriculture. Build tools or systems that can improve crop yield, farm management, or address food security challenges.

> **Blockchain and Cryptocurrency**: Dive into the world of blockchain technology and cryptocurrencies. Work on projects related to decentralized finance (DeFi), NFTs (Non-Fungible Tokens), or blockchain-based voting systems.

> **Robotics and Automation**:  Explore the possibilities of robotics and automation. Build robots or automated systems that can assist in various industries, from manufacturing to healthcare.

> **E-Commerce Enhancement** : Explore ways to enhance the e-commerce experience. Develop solutions for better online shopping, personalized recommendations, or streamlined supply chain management.

> **Open Theme** : Don't see a theme that fits your idea? No problem! You're welcome to participate with any tech-related project that excites you.

**Why Join Us:**
Join us to broaden your horizons, sharpen your skills, and make lifelong connections with like-minded individuals. Whether you're a seasoned coder or just getting started, the D4 Community's Hackathon at CGC Jhanjeri is the place to be.

**Stay Tuned:**
Stay tuned for updates, registration details, and exciting announcements as we gear up for an unforgettable hackathon experience. Together, let's push the boundaries of innovation and make a positive impact on the world through technology.

Mark your calendars and get ready to code your way to success with D4 Community's Hackathon at CGC Jhanjeri!
location: CGC Jhanjeri, Sahibzada Ajit Singh Nagar, Punjab, India

name: Hack-Xplode
desc:
Hack-Xplode is a 30-day hackathon event organized by the Department of Artificial Intelligence and Data Science at Chennai Institute of Technology. The primary objective of Hack-Xplode is to foster the development of projects and solutions that address critical issues, both locally and globally. We are thrilled to announce this upcoming hackathon, which will be conducted in a Hybrid mode to accommodate developers who are enthusiastic about innovation and creativity. Our event will feature multiple themes, providing participants with the opportunity to submit their ideas in the specified [PowerPoint (PPT) format](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1LQzM5-R78WPriB-Rz4KBPaRreO8Y99Iu/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=102382156916968305840&rtpof=true&sd=true) and subsequently showcase their creativity in an offline setting on our campus.

# Structure of hackathon
***Hackathon will have two rounds.***

**#Round 1**
The participants are required to come up with an idea and they have  to submit the ppt in the devfolio platform.

**#Round 2**
The selected students would be given the invitation to join Round 2 taking place offline at CIT Chennai.

# Timeline for round 1
1.Registration starts:- 27 August  2023
2.last date for team registration:-  20 Sept 2023
3.Round 1 results:- 23 Sept 2023

# Themes
1.	Health care
2.	Education and Gaming
3.	Agriculture
4.	Cyber-security.
5.	Block-chain
6.	Machine learning and Artificial intelligence
7.	Open Box

# Rules and regulations
1. Each team can have 1 to 3 members.
2.	Team members can be from different colleges and any year and dept.
3.	Participants are required to bring their own equipment. There will be no onsite provisions.
5.	Teams must develop a working model within 30 days and present it on the final day of the hackathon
6.	The jury's decisions are final.
location: Chennai Institute of Technology, Sarathy Nagar, Kundrathur, Chennai, Tamil Nadu, India

name: APUBCC Sparkathon
desc:
# Overview
## Introduction

The APUBCC Sparkathon is a university hackathon for university students to join physically for hacking, networking, learning, and having fun! The hackathon starts online from **22th September 2023** till **30th September 2023 11.59 p.m. MYT** with the opportunity for hackers to come physically to **Asia Pacific University** on the **1st October 2023 (Sunday) for demo day.**  We will also hosting a series of **Workshop** on **22th September - 24th September 2023 & 30th September 2023**.

## Problem Statements
### **AI**

- Utilize blockchain to innovate AI solutions. Merge decentralized AI with web3. Redefine, showcase, and elevate AI in crypto.

### **DeFi and Payments**

- Leave traditional finance behind. design new decentralized applications for a more open financial system. Connect users to crypto. build projects that help everyone pay for things in crypto.

### **Mobile Consumer**

- It's time to build crypto on the go. make your mobile-first web3 project.


## Details

**Date:**
Workshops:
- Date: 22th September - 24th September 2023 
- Time: 10am - 6:00pm
- Venue: Asia Pacific University (APU)

Mentorship Workshop
- Date: 30th September 2023
- Time: 10am - 3pm
- Venue:  Asia Pacific University (APU)

Sparkathon (Demo day):
- Date: 1st October 2023 (Sunday)
- Time: 10am - 6pm
- Venue:  Asia Pacific University (APU)

Sparkathon (Hackathon):
- Date: 22th September - 30th September 2023
- Time: Online

**Resource**
https://jup.ag/
https://station.jup.ag/
https://station.jup.ag/docs/v6-beta
https://twitter.com/JupiterExchange

**Requirements:**
1. Integrate with the Jupiter API (https://station.jup.ag/docs/apis/swap-api)

**Example**
1. A new payments service that allows a retailer to accept any SPL token as payment using Jupiter's pricing and swap APIs.

2. A widget or service that allows a user to pay with any combination of tokens in their wallet to any merchant.

3. Something similar to liquidating an NFT to any token
(https://liquifynft.com/swap)

4. A widget to go from fiat to any SPL token using Jupiter.

name: Worthy Hack 23
desc:
CacheHo presents Worthy Hack 2023, a 24 hour hackathon focused on empowering solutions to real world problems through hardware and/or software.

**Event Highlights:** 🌟 Empowering Solutions: Our hackathon is laser-focused on addressing real-world challenges. Whether it's hardware or software, we're happy to look at your solutions/prototypes.

🌐 **Three Thrilling Rounds:** Brace yourselves for three exhilarating knockout rounds that will push your limits and test your ingenuity.

**Round 1 (Virtual):** Register and Elevate - This round is all about showcasing your potential and the potential of your solution to a real world problem. The promising teams will advance to the next round.

**Round 2 (Virtual):** Expert Engagement - Selected teams from the first round will engage in a virtual meeting with industry experts and the teams will dive deep into their solutions, share their insights, and answer challenging questions. Those who excel in this round will earn a spot in the ultimate challenge.

**Round 3 (On-site):** The Grand Showdown - Reach the pinnacle of innovation with our 24-hour on-site hackathon at Vignan's Institute Of Information Technology, Visakhapatnam. Collaborate, create, and code your way to crafting prototypes or MVPs that have the power to shape the future.

🗓 Mark Your Calendar: The grand finale awaits on September 9th - 10th, 2023. Witness the culmination of creativity, determination, and technological prowess as teams compete head-to-head and present their cutting-edge solutions to a panel of esteemed judges.

* Fintech
* Internet of Things

* Health tech

* AR/VR
* AI/ML
* Robotics
* Drone Tech
* MR/VR/XR
* Web3

* **Open Theme**

name: The Actually Open AI Hackathon
tagline: It's time to build responsible autonomous agents.
desc:
A 6-day virtual hackathon kicking off from Wednesday 6th September. Participants build an exciting MVP for autonomous agents or apps to compete for cash prizes and other incentives provided by us and our partners. 

Partners include Arweave, FirstBatch, Warp Contracts, Community Labs and Stability AI. 

Submissions will be judged by leading VCs from the likes of Faction VC (Lightspeed Crypto), CMT Digital, Hansa, NGC Ventures and more.

As autonomous agents become increasingly sophisticated, what it means to be human on the web is fundamentally changing. We are on the verge of information and ultimately intelligence that is too cheap to meter. 

This creates an unprecedented need for people to account for where that information comes from, how their creations are able to be used by others and how they interact with non-human entities.

It also creates a never-before-seen opportunity to unleash humanity’s creative potential. The generative AI boom will augment the possibilities of any creative mind to put their work out into the world and see it succeed. These creators of the future deserve to be rewarded for this, have provable attestations that it is their work and have that work stored in perpetuity for future generations to look back on in posterity. 

Where the first generation of web3 projects primarily sought to create open, interoperable and composable markets in finance, we believe that this LLM-inspired internet-wide paradigm shift will amplify the importance of decentralised information protocols. Enter Arweave. 

We see Arweave as being the base layer for these autonomous information streams of the future because of its unique offering of all of the following: 

**Model Transparency.** All weights and specs for open-source AI models visible and completely auditable on-chain.  

**Agent Explainability.** A persistent ledger of data that can map outputs to the training inputs that were used to generate them will assist in solving the model explainability problem. 

**Immutability. ** Immutable, persistent storage of model weights and training data on-chain mitigates severe risks including prompt injection and other forms of model tampering.

**Safe & non-invasive access to training data. ** Arweave’s permanent, global data lake will act as the greatest repository of organically generated data in human existence. The composability this allows makes it an unmatched training ground for the development of aligned agents and apps.

**Information provenance & proof-of-humanity.** Proof-of-humanity protocols built on top of Arweave’s immutable ledger of information will act as the great differentiator between human intelligence and machine intelligence.

Projects will be judged on the following criteria:
1) Novelty: How creative is this project? How challenging would it be to replicate? 

2) Virality: Does this project have the potential to onboard millions of users?

3) Practicality: Is the end product useable? Does it solve a real problem?

prizes.name: Image Uploading and Tagging on Arweave
prizes.desc:
This bounty is to create an app for uploading sets of images to Arweave’s global onchain dataset. The key to making data composable is to first make it discoverable. On Arweave this means adding tags to the metadata of each piece of data that is uploaded to the network for easier querying later on.

A way to knock this bounty out of the park would be to allow the uploader to specify UDL tags to describe fees related to derivative works or commercial use. That way uploaders could be compensated for their effort when interested parties discover the content on Arweave via queries.

Extra prizes on offer for best use of:

name: Ethcon Korea 2023
desc:
# PROOF-OF-SHARING
**Let’s share ideas, knowledge, experiences and  deep connections!**

Supporting the open-source movement as a non profit Ethereum developer conference, **Ethcon Korea** have started its journey since 2019. We as organizers believe that Ethereum is more than just a technical solution - it is a community.

**Our mission** is to empower local communities by bridging the gap between Korea and the world through the promotion of decentralized protocols, tools, and culture. Our commitment to fostering innovation and community continues with this Hackathon and conference, and we look forward to supporting the growth of the Ethereum ecosystem here.

# How To Enter 
**Participants visit https://2023.ethcon.kr ("Hackathon website") and enter Buy tickets.**
You must stake USDC to get hackathon tickets.
Please see and follow the How_to_stake guide below.
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1YiLdNfemouVc1qfvaLPl7mvDuP4pOyocaBTAKn60VJA/edit

- Register for the hackathon by staking 79 USDC and getting NFTs to participate in the hackathon. At this time, the staked 79 USDC can be returned by attending the hackathon site, checking in for tickets, and submitting the project within the period. We plan to return it approximately 2-4 weeks after the event ends.
- Meals, late night snacks and drinks will be provided during the hackathon, including vegan and vegetarian options.
- The venue is open for 24 hours and has a chill zone where you can rest, but sleeping and showers are not provided. Please plan your accomodations if necessary.
- Participants in the hackathon agree to the collection and maintenance of their personal information by the sponsor, Devfolio, and Ethcon Korea for the purpose of operating and promoting the hackathon.
location: 254-5 Seongsu-dong 2(i)-ga, Seongdong-gu, Seoul, South Korea

**Total Reward: 1.5ETH (each 0.5 ETH)**
PLEASE NOTE: Using the SDK is not the standard way of interacting with MetaMask that you might be familiar with. Please check our dev guide and  examples page to get familiarized with it. Any project that does not use the SDK will not be eligible for prizes. 
Develop an outstanding decentralized application (dapp) that uses the MetaMask SDK for secure and seamless integration with our mobile wallet. We are interested in any sort of creative solution you could think of, but if you need some ideas things we particularly like are:
NFT/Gaming -Create a project in the realm of NFTs or web3 gaming, which involves innovative utilization of NFTs, enhances wallet interactions within games, or tackles any of the difficulties in the current gaming landscape. You can also check our “Unity SDK” LINK
DeFi - Create a dapp that enhances the DeFi ecosystem, such as new protocols, enhancing existing derivatives, ecosystem tools, application of NFTs in DeFi, better financial inclusion, DAOs.
Social: Create a project that combines social aspects to decentralization, such as p2p messaging dapps, marketplaces, content creators tools, social proof validation.
*If you are building a React application we encourage you to use our React companion libraries for state management, which can be found in our SDK links section.
Your Dapp should demonstrate innovation, functionality, and a compelling user experience . The winning submissions will highlight the potential of the MetaMask SDK and offer compelling solutions within their respective categories.
Beyond your winnings, you have the opportunity to work alongside Consensys post-hackathon to apply for a MetaMask Grant program. We want to build with you, and with a well-fleshed-out submission, we can help you take your idea to the next level, finish those features you couldn’t get to, or take your project to production.

- Use the MetaMask SDK in your code
- Derp:

-- This attention to detail helps us reward genuine effort and identify quality projects. 
- Code needs to be viewable on GitHub
- Each submission should have a short video that describes scope and functionality of the dapp 
- We encourage you to have a detailed README that helps the judge know the details about your project, what technology has been utilized as well as which ConsenSys tools like SDK have been used to what extent.

**Criteria**
- Utility
- Technical sophistication
- Innovation and uniqueness of features within the chosen category.
- Bonus points for number of Consensys products used (nfura, and Linea)

name: DIGIFI BUILDATHON 2023
tagline: Come and build Web3 solutions for the new Brazilian financial system
desc:
Join us on a building journey from September 1st to 11th, where builders from all over Brazil will have a unique opportunity: to explore the potential of Web3 technology in creating solutions for CBDCs (Central Bank Digital Currencies), promoting collaboration, new technologies, and transformations.

Our topics range from the scalability of platforms that combine privacy with public transparency, to the integration of the digital world into traditional finance and the emerging DeFi universe.

Furthermore, we will investigate innovative solutions for tokenization and digital assets tailored to the Brazilian scenario. The "Freestyle" challenge invites you to explore the construction of a Digital Real, without permission restrictions.

**Projects need to align with the tracks below:**

**TRACKS**

1. Scaling a DREX that is private yet publicly transparent.
2. Interoperability: how the digital real world can be used in traditional finance or DeFi (Decentralized Finance).
3. Tokenization solutions and digital assets for Brazil.
4. Freestyle: How to build a Digital Real without the need for permissions.

**RULES FOR HACKERS**

**Team Formation**

- Each team must have a minimum of 3 and a maximum of 6 people;

- If you don't have a team, there will be a [Discord](https://discord.com/invite/jVGzRW4n27) call on September 5th at 7 PM to form teams.

- When forming your team, remember: the more diverse skills your team has, the better. So, try to have people with different skills in your group, such as business, design, marketing, and not just developers.

**To be accepted at the beginning of the Hackathon, the project must have:**

- Project name.
- Registration of all members on the DEVFOLIO platform.
- Inclusion of all members in the project.
- Description.
- GitHub repository must be new, created for the hackathon. Repositories with dates prior to the start of the hackathon will not be accepted.

**Project Submission Requirements**
 - Have a smart contract published on testnet evm
- The date/time of smart contract publication must be after the start of the hackathon.
- Present the public address of the published smart contract.
- Have a smart contract verified with Etherscan.
- Have a published frontend accessible through a public link until the end of the hackathon. The frontend cannot be run only locally.
- Have the source code of all parts of the project in a single public GitHub repository. At a minimum, it should contain the smart contract and the frontend. If there is a backend, it must also be included.
- Have someone outside the team open the GitHub link to confirm its public status.
- Record a video of a maximum of 3 minutes presenting the idea and demonstrating the solution. The video should be published on a video platform like YouTube, Vimeo, or other platforms that allow viewing without downloading.
- The date/time of video publication must be after the start of the hackathon.
- These requirements are mandatory, and the absence of any of them can disqualify the team. 
-They ensure that projects are public, accessible, and verifiable, in addition to facilitating evaluation by the judges. Make sure that participants fully understand the requirements and pay attention to the dates and times established for each stage of the hackathon.

Links to be included in the submission: include in the description field:

**Links that need to be included in the final submission**
dApp link;
Github link;
Video link: pitch presentation + demo

**Final submission - Tuesday (09/11), until 2:00 PM in the afternoon.**

After this time, you CANNOT make any further changes to your project.
If any requirement is missing, the project will be disqualified.

We will not have a live presentation; the presentations will be recorded and made available to the judges, as stated above.

**Tips for the recorded presentation, we hope that you**

Clearly identify the problem your project aims to solve;
Demonstrate your application clearly and succinctly;
Perform a transaction within your project, so we can see its practical functionality;
Be prepared to share your project's source code on the computer for the judges.

## 👀 Descrição do Desafio

### Visão Geral

As blockchains têm o potencial de melhorar a vida das pessoas, especialmente em mercados emergentes, como a América Latina, onde problemas como inflação, acesso limitado a serviços bancários e instituições precárias são comuns. A LaChain está aqui para transformar esse potencial em realidade, oferecendo serviços de blockchain de alta qualidade e baixo custo, juntamente com a infraestrutura necessária para permitir que desenvolvedores criem aplicativos descentralizados (dApps) com espaço dedicado para casos de uso importantes na região, como a liquidação de transações de stablecoins locais, identidades digitais (DID), resolução de trocas locais e muito mais.

### O que é a LaChain?

A LaChain é uma blockchain projetada para resolver os problemas econômicos urgentes comuns na América Latina. A plataforma foi criada para hospedar casos de uso especialmente adaptados para enfrentar as dificuldades específicas enfrentadas por empresas locais e indivíduos.

Queremos possibilitar que pessoas em toda a América Latina interajam com o DREX por meio da LaChain. Aceitamos propostas para projetos DeFi que, por exemplo, recompensem em wDrex, a criação de uma ponte (bridge) ou até mesmo o desenvolvimento de uma exchange descentralizada (Dex) onde seja possível comprar wDrex ou qualquer outra moeda que venha a ser criada na plataforma DREX. Estamos abertos a qualquer projeto que promova a interoperabilidade entre as plataformas, e sua criatividade não tem limites.

É importante lembrar que a LaChain é uma blockchain recente e ainda está em desenvolvimento, incluindo muitos dApps essenciais para a interação de usuários comuns, como Dex, ponte (bridge), staking e um mercado de NFTs. Isso significa que sua proposta pode ser uma oportunidade excepcional para que seu Dapp seja adotado mais rapidamente pelos usuários. No entanto, não se esqueça de que a blockchain também tem a finalidade de ser usada por empresas, então é fundamental definir claramente seu público-alvo.

### Requisitos do Desafio
a) O envio deve ser uma aplicação que conecte a LaChain ao Drex, com o código funcionando;

b) As soluções poderão contemplar integrações com plataforma / solução hyperledger besu de modo geral, uma vez que essa será a base do DREX. É possível subir um node de besu para tal abordagem. 

c) Caso a iniciativa não tenha possibilidade de interface direta com plataforma Besu, o projeto criado deve pelo menos contemplar uso de tokens  erc-20 da rede ethereum;

d) O Dapp precisa ser implantado na mainnet da LaChain;

e) É necessário fornecer uma descrição do projeto, um pitch que inclua uma demonstração, um repositório Github com um README explicativo sobre como executar o projeto e um protótipo funcional;

f) Criatividade e inovação serão recompensadas!

name: T1: Build-Along Workshop
desc:
Join us in building your own E-Paper wearable, T1 by Ampere Works. A nifty little time-keeping device that you make yourself.

https://youtu.be/gQcCSna_INI

**What is the T1?**
T1 is a small network enabled e-paper display that you build yourself from a kit. Now, we intend it to be used as a watch. However, because it's user modifiable, it can be hacked into a display or tracker for anything you want.

**Why do such a thing when a budget smartwatch can run circles around it?**
The reason stems from a simple fact. No one person or group of people (<100) has the requisite knowledge to make a smartphone from scratch. We all use and rely on tech that's pretty much a black box to all of us on some level. This is a testament to the power of human collaboration but also our comfort with abstraction. So here's a device that's laid bare for you to poke around at its inner workings. Over a 3-hour workshop, we will go through some basic electronics, the reasons we selected the hardware that's in the T1, assembly, and programming.

All of this is done to give you an intuitive sense of how your average piece of electronic hardware is constructed and integrated with the software.

The workshop will have a fee of **₹5000 per participant**.

**Where?**
[2586Labs](https://goo.gl/maps/wudNvLHPKoNBWNT28)

**When?**
2:00 - 6:00 PM, Saturday, 19th August, 2023

name: Start-a-thon
tagline: Come with ideas, Leave with Funded Startups
desc:
Organized by **Jamsetji TATA Society for Innovation and Entrepreneurship (JITSIE), IIT Madras**, **Startup Ignition Cell (SIC), RVEI** and **Wadhwani Foundation**, START-A-THON is India’s first-of-its-kind hackathon where participants get an opportunity to pitch their ideas to angel investors, who fund their ideas with real money in exchange for equity. Thus, START-A-THON provides you an opportunity to convert your high-impact ideas into funded startups. 

**Start-A-Thon** comprises mentorship sessions from Wadhwani Foundation, followed by the ideation, prototyping, mock-pitching rounds and finally, the Grand Finale. Participants can participate in teams of 1 to 3 members and work on any problem statement- not limited to domains in sustainability, smart cities, agri-tech, health-tech, fintech, AI-ML, AR-VR, web3, e-commerce and social impact. 

The initial rounds (ideation and prototyping) would be online. The mock-pitch round would be in hybrid mode and the Grand Finale would be offline in Bengaluru where the participants would pitch their MVPs to angel Investors, raise pre-seed/ seed funding and bag some amazing cash rewards and schwags. 

Hackathon Structure:
**Registration (Ideation) Phase → Building (Prototyping) Phase → Online Judging → Finale (Pitching and Fund-Raising)**
 
1. **The Registration and Ideation Phase** will include the interested participants to register themselves on Devfolio, complete their profile and submit their ideas. Based on your domain of idea, we would separate you into two tracks- normal track and Web3 track. In between, we will have talks and sessions by industry experts on Entrepreneurship over the period of one month, mentoring the students on generating and validating ideas and help with pre-incubation.

2. After the Application Review Period **The Building (Prototyping) Phase** would start. This would be a 48 hours hackathon, held in online mode where builders would build a prototype/mvp for their proposed idea. The judges would judge your ideas and prototypes. 

3. **Mock-Pitch Round:** Selected students from the Prototyping round would move forward for the mock-pitch round, where the teams pitch in front of a jury, in online/offline mode to explain their revenue/impact model. Ideas that are scalable and have that spark of becoming a profitable startup, would be taken forward for the Grand Finale to be held in Bengaluru. 

4. **The Grand Finale:** Finalists pitch in front of angel investors (sharks), who invest their money in the ideas in exchange for equity. Thus, Finalists get a **chance to convert their ideas into funded startups.** Finalists also get relevant incubation opportunities. Idea-turned-startups with the highest valuation get cash rewards as well, apart from the pre-seed/seed funding.  

***Disclaimer: Angels invest in ideas, only if they want to. Coming to the Finale, does not guarantee that your idea will get funded (Just similar to Shark Tank). Ideas-turning-into-Startups through this Startathon, would be required to give upto 7% equity to the organizers.***

Come with ideas, leave with funded startups !!!
Happy Hacking :)🚀

Please join the below WhatsApp group for regular updates on the hackathon:
https://chat.whatsapp.com/GNRsVcDyP1A68ofgL6dyQN

tagline: The Web3 Hackfest with $110,000+ prizes is designed for multichain builders with the theme “Unlimited Hacker”
desc:
**Web3 Hackfest** with the theme "Unlimited Hacker" is a large-scale hackathon festival for web2 & web3 startup builders, developers, and creators with a series of multichain developer bootcamps and workshops, sponsored by DevHub, Pagoda, Proximity Lab, Near Foundation, Web3Foundation, QuillAudit,...

Web3 Hackfest is designed for builders of all kinds where global Web3 builders reunite with a source of energy and creativity for all.

# **Web3 Hackfest total prize pool: $110,000**
- $22,000 Native Track Prizes (Defi, NFT, Gaming, Metaverse, DAO,...)
- $23,000 Web3 Code Challenge
- $20,000 Polkadot Track: projects built on substrate framework (SDK by Polkadot)
- $10,000 DEFI Track
- $10,000 Frontend and BOS tools (BOS components and tools, Frontend design on BOS with backend developed on any blockchain (NEAR, EVM,...))
- $5,000 Web2-to-Web3 (promote application ideas to apply blockchain for Web2 niche markets such as education, marketplace, ecommerce, logistic,... and cross-tech (blockchain for AI, IoT, cloud computing, telecom,...))
- $5,000 Multichain and Interdisciplinary solution
- $15,000 Security grant, for top ranked teams in Hackathon ( by QuillAudit)

The event promotes collaboration among multichain ecosystem builders to motivate general ideas and products for Web3 space to solve common issues, create multichain dApps and interoperable solutions.

# **Dates and Timing**
- Registration Period: from July 13th, 2023 to August 20th, 2023 (“Registration Period”).
- Official Hackathon Period: August 7th, 2023 to August 27th, 2023. Source code of projects should be committed and submitted during this time period.
- Submission Deadline: August 21th, 2023 to August 27th, 2023  (“Submission Period”).
- Judging Period: August 27th, 2023 to August 31st, 2023 (“Judging Period”).
- TOP 5 Winners Announcement: On or around September 1st, 2023 (5:00pm WEST).

# **Submission Guidelines**
Please follow the submission guidelines of Devfolio: https://guide.devfolio.co/hackers/participate/project-submission 

What to Submit
- Open source code repository. Provide a URL to your open source code repository for judging and testing. Your code must have an open source license like one of the below:
 MIT - https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT   
Apache 2.0 - https://opensource.org/licenses/Apache-2.0   
3-Clause BSD - https://opensource.org/licenses/BSD-3-Clause    
- Demo Video. Include a video (under 5 minutes) that demonstrates your submission in English. Videos must be uploaded to YouTube, Vimeo, or Facebook Video and made public.
- Pitch deck file
- Select Prize Tracks. Identify which track your project fits into and if you used and sponsor tools.

Note that prizes will be expected to be sent within 60 days from the announced date

prizes.desc:
# Bounty Challenge: Fork, Adapt, and Deploy an EVM Lending Protocol to Mantle Network with API3 data feeds integrated
## Prize: $2500 (5 x $500) and Opportunity to Win a $10k Grant!
Mantle, the all-inclusive, scalable, and interoperable blockchain network, is thrilled to announce an exciting bounty challenge for innovative developers! We are inviting talented developers to fork a leading EVM (Ethereum Virtual Machine) lending protocol and deploy it on the Mantle Network.

The catch? You need to seamlessly integrate dAPIs (Decentralized Application Interfaces) into your solution. Your task is to show a fully functional lending decentralized application (dApp) running smoothly on the Mantle Network. 
### Getting Started
API3 Hacker Repo: https://github.com/vanshwassan/SozuHack
Real-time Market Data: https://market.api3.org/dapis?chains=mantle-goerli-testnet
### Challenge Breakdown:
1. **Fork an EVM Lending Protocol:** Choose a leading, well-established EVM lending protocol and fork it. The protocol should offer robust lending functionalities and maintain a high standard of security.
2. **Deploy on Mantle:** Adapt the forked protocol to be deployable on the Mantle Network. Leverage Mantle's unique capabilities and adapt the code as needed to ensure smooth operation on our network.
3. **Integrate dAPIs:** Incorporate Mantle's dAPIs into your application to facilitate secure, decentralized user interaction. The application's functionalities must be accessible and smoothly operable via these dAPIs.
4. **Launch a Working DeFi protocol:** Your ultimate deliverable will be a live, operational lending dApp that can facilitate loan origination, tracking, and repayment in a decentralized manner.
### Prizes
- **Bounty:** Each winning team will receive a bounty of $500, broken down into five payments of $500 each, upon the successful completion and demonstration of the lending dApp.
- **Grant Opportunity:** Additionally, three outstanding projects will be selected for a $10,000 grant each from Mantle. These grants are designed to support further development and scaling of the project on our platform.
### Evaluation Criteria:
- Quality of the forked code and deployment on Mantle with dAPIs integrated. 
- Interesting concepts for DeFi UX/UI that leverage the unique features of the Mantle Network.
- Some thought into deployment to Mantle and depth of documentation.
- Innovative approach of crypto, forex, equities and commodities data feeds can underpin DeFi markets and services
### Submission Requirements:
- Link to the forked code repository (GitHub preferred), with detail on the code structure and deployment process.
- Some sort of presentation effort, such as screenshots or video walkthrough, that showcases the functionality and features of the lending dApp.
### Important Dates:

- **Winner Announcement:** [Please enter announcement date here]

prizes.name: Utilizing API3 data feeds within zkSync Era's Paymasters
prizes.desc:
A paymaster in zkSync is a contract invoked during the transaction flow that agrees to pay the gas fees of a particular transaction on behalf of the user. Thanks to native account abstraction on zkSync Era, paymasters can be used by EOAs (like Metamask) and Smart Contract accounts. This bounty could involve creating a novel implementation of a paymaster contract within an application flow.
Participants are required to implement a custom API3 zkSync’s paymaster within their projects that can sponsor the gas fee for users’ transactions on their dApps/platforms.

Finally, we’re looking for ***very innovative and creative ideas using Paymasters***. We put together an *inspirational list of ideas;* feel free to go through them below ⬇️

- web3 users; the central ***idea*** here is to create Paymasters that incentivize web3 users to perform actions in return for paying their gas fees.
    1. **Social Media Incentives Paymaster:** Develop a Paymaster contract that interacts with social media APIs to track user engagement. For instance, when a user likes or retweets a specific post, a corresponding call could be made to the contract. This could be achieved by creating an off-chain service that listens to social media events and interacts with the Paymaster contract. Note: Consider privacy and permission issues when accessing user data from social media platforms.
    2. **Email Subscription Paymaster:** You could create a Paymaster that verifies a user's subscription to an email newsletter. You'll need a back-end service that listens for new subscriptions and updates the Paymaster contract accordingly. The Paymaster should then check this list before agreeing to cover gas fees. Email verification methods could be implemented to avoid spam or fake subscriptions.
    3. **Proof of Attendance Paymaster:** In the context of an event, you could create a Paymaster contract that covers gas fees for attendees. This could work by having attendees scan a QR code or enter a code into an application, which then triggers an event that the Paymaster listens for. This event could be tied to a specific wallet address for verification.
    4. **Referral Program Paymaster:** Create a Paymaster contract that tracks user referrals. Whenever a referred user makes a transaction on zkSync, the referring user's gas fees could be covered for a certain period or number of transactions. This could be implemented using unique referral codes tied to each user's wallet address.
    5. **Survey Completion Paymaster:** Develop a Paymaster that covers gas fees for users who complete surveys or provide feedback. You'll need an off-chain service to validate survey completions and inform the Paymaster contract.
    6. **Content Creation Paymaster:** This Paymaster could cover gas fees for users who create and share content about the zkSync network. To implement this, you'll need an off-chain monitoring service that validates content creation and shares this information with the Paymaster contract.
Remember, while implementing these incentives, it's crucial to have safeguards in place to prevent spam or misuse of the system. Ensure that each Paymaster contract verifies the authenticity of actions before agreeing to pay for the gas fees.

**Requirements**:

All paymaster contracts must implement the IPaymaster interface from [zksync-contracts](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@matterlabs/zksync-contracts).

Paymasters must be deployed to the zkSync Era testnet or locally (see local testing info in resources).

Participants are required to implement API3’s dAPIs on zkSync Era testnet within their smart contracts that facilitate a proper DeFi use case.

The project should be open-source with a public GitHub repository for the codebase.

prizes.name: Wallets & Smart Accounts
prizes.desc:
For this bounty, the challenge could be to develop and showcase a wallet that takes full advantage of zkSync Era's account abstraction native implementation.

Examples: This could mean creating a wallet with novel recovery methods, advanced access controls, enhanced privacy measures, or automated features. For example, a wallet might use social recovery methods (trusted friends and family) instead of a seed phrase. Or, a wallet could automate or group certain types of transactions, such as yield harvesting in DeFi, or include privacy features like optional transaction obfuscation.

- We’re looking for very creative ideas for implementing zkSync Era’s native account abstraction. See *an **inspiration list*** following the examples ⬇️
    1. **Spending Limit Wallet:** A wallet could be designed to implement a daily spending limit. By using the capabilities of zkSync's account abstraction, the wallet could be programmed to only allow the user to spend a certain amount (e.g., X ETH) per day. This could help users manage their spending habits more effectively.
    2. **Parental Control Wallet:** Develop a wallet that can be handed over to a child or a less tech-savvy parent. Using account abstraction, the wallet could be designed so that larger transactions need to be co-signed by another wallet holder (the parent or child's guardian). Smaller transactions within a set limit can be approved by the wallet's primary user, providing autonomy for day-to-day transactions while ensuring oversight on significant ones.
    3. **Co-signing Wallet for Teams:** This wallet is similar to the parental control wallet but designed for a team or an organization. All larger transactions have to be co-signed by other team members, while smaller ones can be approved individually. It gives the organization a check and balance system.
    4. **Time-Locked Wallet:** This could be a wallet where transactions need to be approved but only execute after a certain time period. This could be useful for scheduling regular payments or for creating a safety net against hasty financial decisions.
    5. **Privacy Enhanced Wallet:** A wallet that implements optional transaction obfuscation features to protect the privacy of its users. Maybe integrate private on-chain transactions for L3: https://docs.espressosys.com/cape.
    6. **Automated Yield Farming Wallet:** The wallet could automatically harvest yield or rebalance assets for DeFi users. It groups multiple DeFi interactions into a single batched transaction to save gas fees.
    7. **Delegated Wallet:** A wallet where the user can delegate the signing rights to another wallet for a certain period. This could be handy during vacations or when the primary user cannot manage the wallet.
    8. **Customizable Wallet:** A wallet offering customizable features, such as spending limit adjustments, adding/removing co-signers, changing transaction time-lock periods, etc. The customization options could be tailored to the user's needs, creating a more user-friendly experience.

**Requirements:**

All smart contract accounts must implement the IAccount interface from [zksync-contracts](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@matterlabs/zksync-contracts).

Accounts must be deployed to zkSync Era testnet or locally (see local testing info in resources).

prizes.name: Utilizing API3 data feeds within Paymasters
prizes.desc:
The introduction of Account Abstraction to the zkSync Era scaling solution realizes the concept of smart contract accounts (SCAs) for functionality such as social recovery, spending rules and flexible validation.

Paymasters enable gas in ERC20 to be paid from a separate contract, basically enabling gasless transactions. At the moment, the majority of EVM-based Externally Owned Accounts (EOAs) have a self-custody model, meaning they cannot utilize a paymasters contract. However, on zkSync Era paymasters can be utilized by both EOAs and SCAs.

**Use zkSync’s paymaster with dAPIs to power existing dApps on zkSync Era**

dAPIs can be used within zkSync’s Paymaster contract to enable users to pay for gas in any token of their choice on your platform. Within a paymaster, dAPIs can provide price data on-chain for execution.

Participants are required to implement a custom API3 zkSync’s paymaster within their projects that can sponsor the gas fee for users’ transactions on their dApps/platforms.

Participants can follow the [Paymasters with dAPIs on zkSync](https://github.com/vanshwassan/zk-paymaster-dapi-poc) guide to implement your ideas around the same.

**Resources:**

- [Using dAPIs on zkSync Era Testnet](https://vanshwassan.medium.com/using-dapis-on-zksync-era-testnet-30f12efdd95f)

GirlScript is supporting beginners in tech education since 2017 with programs like GirlScript Summer of Code, LetsPy, Tech In Slums, Uplift Project, etc. The foundation has impacted 500,000+ learners and has been featured in Forbes Asia, Tedx, Booking.com Technology Playmaker, ElasticSearch Cause Awards, Women Tech Network Awards, Society of Women Engineers Magazine, etc, and has worked with over 250+ global tech and social good companies like Microsoft, Redhat, Twitter, Atlassian, Filecoin, Polygon, Dapper Labs, Child Rights & You, etc.

The foundation also conducted Web3.0 beginner-friendly boot camps in 52 cities in India impacting 15,000+ learners. To create opportunities with Builders, Organizers, Learners, and Entrepreneurs, GirlScript also conducted Web3 Villa Meetups via Web3 Meetup India in 10+ cities as well as International NFT Day in 12 cities along with Flow Hackathon 2023 with over 7000+ developers and Winter of Blockchain with over 4000 developers.

This year, Our team is all set to welcome the 3000+ Web3.0 enthusiasts in Goa for Web3conf 2023 🎉

**Project Tracks:**
- DeFi
- Community
- Blockchain & Cryptocurrencies
- All Things Dev
- NFT, Art & Gaming

**Submission Rules for Valid Consideration in the Hackathon:**

To ensure fairness and maintain the integrity of the hackathon, please adhere to the following submission rules. Projects will only be considered valid for evaluation if they meet the following criteria:

1. Originality: Submissions must be the original work of the participating team. Plagiarism or the use of pre-existing projects will lead to disqualification.

2. Web3 Focus: Projects should be centered around Web3 technologies, such as blockchain, decentralized applications (dApps), smart contracts, or other relevant areas within the Web3 ecosystem.

3. No Scaffolding: Submissions must not be based on generic or template-based scaffolding projects. Projects should be purpose-built for the hackathon and reflect the team's creativity and problem-solving skills.

4. Working Deployment Link: Each submission must include a working deployment link that allows judges to interact with the project. Ensure that the link remains active and accessible throughout the evaluation period.

5. Demo Video: Provide a demo video that showcases the functionality, features, and user experience of your project. The video should be clear and concise, demonstrating how your project addresses the given problem statement or theme.

6. Deployed Contract Address (if applicable): If your project involves smart contracts, provide the addresses of deployed contracts on the relevant blockchain network(s). This will allow us to verify the functionality of your contracts.

7. GitHub Repository: Include a link to the GitHub repository of your project. The repository should contain all the necessary code and resources related to your project.

8. GitHub Commit History: Maintain a clear and meaningful commit history in your GitHub repository. This will demonstrate the progression and evolution of your project during the hackathon period.

9. Readme Documentation: Provide comprehensive documentation in the project's README file. Include instructions on how to set up the repository locally, dependencies required, and any other relevant details that can help evaluators understand and run your project.

10. No Plagiarism: Ensure that your submission does not violate any intellectual property rights or contain unauthorized use of third-party code or assets. All resources used should be properly attributed and licensed.

name: Filecoin Orbit India Hackathon - MIT Karnataka
desc:
Filecoin Orbit India Hackathon is a 10 day long hackathon organized by Loarr in partnership with the Filecoin foundation with the goal of inspiring and fostering a community of builders promoting technological advancements in the Web3 space.

Packed with amazing sessions by industry experts and workshops, we invite you to grab the opportunity to interact and learn from the leading minds in the ecosystem and build secure and innovative decentralized applications for the future.

In a universe of infinite possibilities, you have 30 days to innovate, brainstorm and show us what you've got!

# **Guidelines for the Filecoin Orbit India Hackathon - MIT Karnataka:**

**Original work**: All submissions must be the original work of the participants. Plagiarism of code or any other form of intellectual property is strictly prohibited.

**Team size**: Each team can consist of a minimum of 1 member and a maximum of 6 members. Teams can be formed in advance or at the hackathon.

**Code of Conduct**: All submissions must comply with Devfolio's Code of Conduct. Any submission that violates the Code of Conduct will be disqualified.

**Filecoin Mainnet**: All submissions must be deployed over the Filecoin Mainnet/Testnet. Participants are encouraged to use the latest version of the Filecoin network for their solutions.

**Submission deadline**: All submissions must be completed and submitted on Devfolio by April 16th. Late submissions would not be accepted.

**Problem statement**: Participants are free to choose any problem statement that they want to solve. However, the solution should be related to Filecoin's decentralized storage network.

**Judging criteria**: The submissions will be judged based on the following criteria:

*Innovation and creativity
Impact and scalability
Technical excellence
Use of Filecoin*

**Prize pool**: The top 3 winners of the hackathon will receive a prize pool of $500 (USD 500) to help them further develop their solutions.

**Rights to solutions**: Participants will retain ownership of their solutions. However, by submitting their solutions, participants grant the organizing committee the right to showcase their solutions to the public.

We wish you the best of luck with the hackathon and hope that you have a productive and enjoyable experience!

name: Hack@BVP5.0
desc:
Get ready to dive into the world of coding with Hack@BVP, the flagship event of the Department of Computer Science & Engineering, designed to give coding enthusiasts an unforgettable experience! We have received overwhelming responses and have seen an array of talented coders come up with innovative solutions to real-world problems. We look forward to yet another thrilling experience with the "HACK@BVP 5.0".

**Stages**

**Round 1:- Abstract Round**
It is an online round where in  participant's problem-solving approach and thought processing would be tested.
Teams will work on the problem statements, mold their solutions accordingly, and design an abstract related to the problem statement.
Judging will be completely based on the abstract submission. 
This round involves: Detailed Abstract submission (150-200 words)

**Round 2 :- Presentation Round **
The teams selected in round 1 are expected to deliver an offline presentation to our esteemed panel of judges. 
The objective of the presentation is to clearly articulate their solution and provide a comprehensive overview of what they are developing. 
The teams should ensure that their presentation encompasses all the essential details of their project, including the problem they are addressing, the proposed solution, and its key features. 
The presentation should be informative and effectively communicate the team's project objectives to the judges

**Round 3:- Business Plan Round **
This is an offline round where the selected teams will have the opportunity to present their projects from a business perspective. 
They will showcase their business plans, highlighting the potential of their projects. 
The judging criteria will prioritize projects with greater business potential, assigning them higher weightage in the evaluation process.

**Round 4:- Final Showcase **
During the “Final Showcase" the selected teams will unveil their final projects and deliver captivating presentations before our distinguished panel of judges. 
Evaluation criteria for this offline round will be revealed on the day of the event, guiding the assessment process.

name: Filecoin Orbit India Hackathon - HackaFIL
desc:
Filecoin Orbit India Hackathon is a 30 day long hackathon organized by Loarr in partnership with the Filecoin foundation with the goal of inspiring and fostering a community of builders promoting technological advancements in the Web3 space.

Packed with amazing sessions by industry experts and workshops, we invite you to grab the opportunity to interact and learn from the leading minds in the ecosystem and build secure and innovative decentralized applications for the future.

In a universe of infinite possibilities, you have 30 days to innovate, brainstorm and show us what you've got!

# **Guidelines for the Filecoin Orbit India Hackathon - HackaFIL:**

**Original work**: All submissions must be the original work of the participants. Plagiarism of code or any other form of intellectual property is strictly prohibited.

**Team size**: Each team can consist of a minimum of 1 member and a maximum of 6 members. Teams can be formed in advance or at the hackathon.

**Code of Conduct**: All submissions must comply with Devfolio's Code of Conduct. Any submission that violates the Code of Conduct will be disqualified.

**Filecoin Mainnet**: All submissions must be deployed over the Filecoin Mainnet/Testnet. Participants are encouraged to use the latest version of the Filecoin network for their solutions.

**Submission deadline**: All submissions must be completed and submitted on Devfolio by April 16th. Late submissions would not be accepted.

**Problem statement**: Participants are free to choose any problem statement that they want to solve. However, the solution should be related to Filecoin's decentralized storage network.

**Judging criteria**: The submissions will be judged based on the following criteria:

*Innovation and creativity
Impact and scalability
Technical excellence
Use of Filecoin*

**Prize pool**: The top 3 winners of the hackathon will receive a prize pool of $500 (USD 500) to help them further develop their solutions.

**Rights to solutions**: Participants will retain ownership of their solutions. However, by submitting their solutions, participants grant the organizing committee the right to showcase their solutions to the public.

We wish you the best of luck with the hackathon and hope that you have a productive and enjoyable experience!

name: Rebuild Ownership
tagline: Rebuild data ownership, take back your identity with the power of Web3.0.
desc:
Welcome to “Rebuild Ownership” hackathon, where everyone can compose various web3 stacks to build user-centric data applications.  

[DataverseOS](https://dataverse-os.com/) is the sovereign data operating system, which coordinates web3 protocols among users and varied applications. It brings an Identity Computer for running storage-based dApps that return data ownership to users. DataverseOS unlocks web-scale use-cases, e.g. content platforms, social networks, cloud storage, AI, tools for thoughts and more.

Our hackathon partners include Lit Protocol, Ceramic Network, Particle Network and BlockPI Network. They will share community prize & bounties and provide web3 infrastructures for rebuilding ownership with easy-to-use SDKs. 

- [Lit Protocol](https://litprotocol.com/) - distributed key management for encryption, signing, and compute. works as ACL layer in DataverseOS
- [Ceramic Network](https://ceramic.network/) - decentralized data network that powers an ecosystem of interoperable Web3 applications and services. works as storage&database provider
- [Particle Network](https://particle.network/) - full-stack web3 infrastructure. works as user identity provider that greatly simplifies the process for users to own a wallet with a MPC solution
- [BlockPI Network](https://blockpi.io/) - distributed multi-chain acceleration layer solving the RPC requests. congestion problem with infinite scalability. provides instant&smooth UX
- [Polybase](https://polybase.xyz/) - a web3 replacement for Firebase, Postgres, and Supabase with native support for wallet-based permissions, token gating, and zk proofs.


**Getting Started**
👀 [Full details on Notion](https://www.notion.so/ownershiplabs/Rebuild-Ownership-Hackathon-521b2bd0394247cf8bd6d63f1af8360c)
🤔 [Hackathon Cheat Sheet](https://ownershiplabs.notion.site/Hackathon-Cheet-Sheet-cb7ff7903ed0469e8d4eee2cef32b510)
🤖 [Dataverse Docs](https://docs.dataverse-os.com/)
⚒️ [Dapp Deploy Framework](https://github.com/dataverse-os/create-dataverse-app)

prizes.name: A Decentralized NFT Marketplace using Polybase
prizes.desc: With dynamic NFT metadata stored on Polybase, you can build new kinds of utility or gaming NFTs that need faster and cheaper NFT metadata updates. For example, you can build a marketplace for software licenses, a marketplace to purchase token-gated educational courses, or even a marketplace to trade and purchase in-game digital assets that can in turn be used in games that are deployed on the blockchain.

prizes.desc: Most creative use of Lit Protocol (open to access control)

prizes.name: A Decentralized exchange on Polybase
prizes.desc: One of the primary use cases for Polybase is to enable developers to build high-performant low-cost decentralized exchanges. DEXs primarily leverage centralized databases because it's expensive to update each transaction on-chain. Since we store data off-chain and generate zk proofs on-chain you would be able to perform high-frequency trading and ensure transparency on your order books.

prizes.desc: Create a comprehensive technical guide that covers the integration between ComposeDB on Ceramic and Lit protocol. Explain how developers building their dApps using ComposeDB on Ceramic can encrypt data using Lit., include code snippets and detailed explanations for each step.

prizes.desc:
Design and implement a dApp using Particle Network SDKs that provides a seamless and user-friendly experience for both Web3 natives and Web2 newcomers. Your dApp should simplify the onboarding process and create an engaging and intuitive user experience. The goal is to enable a user who is completely new to Web3 to use your dApp with as much ease as any traditional Web2 application.

prizes.name: Integration with Chainlink functions
prizes.desc:
Polybase is chain-agnostic and developers can use Polybase as their database layer for dapps built on any chain through an oracle like Chainlink. Ideally, we would expect you to build an integration with Chainlink functions that the Polybase community could leverage for building apps from any chain on Polybase. The project should clearly explain how developers building apps on-chain can leverage Polybase as their database layer.

name: FOSSathon
desc:
# FOSSathon: Unleash the Open Source Power

Welcome to **FOSSathon: Unleash the Open Source Power**, a hackathon organized by the FOSS (Free and Open Source Software) club of VJCET. As part of the exciting "May the FOSS be with you" event, we invite you to join us for an incredible journey into the world of open source innovation.

**FOSSathon** is a free and inclusive hackathon that aims to empower participants to harness the unlimited potential of open source software. Whether you're an experienced developer or just getting started, this event provides a platform to collaborate, learn, and build with the power of FOSS.

Throughout this hackathon, participants will be encouraged to explore various FOSS technologies, tools, and platforms to solve real-world challenges. With a focus on innovation, creativity, and collaboration, FOSSathon offers a unique opportunity to showcase your skills, unleash your creativity, and make a tangible impact in the open source community.

## Why participate in FOSSathon?

Here are some key highlights:

1. **Learn from Industry Experts**: Interact with seasoned professionals and industry experts who are passionate about FOSS. Gain valuable insights, receive guidance, and expand your network.

2. **Collaborate and Network**: Connect with like-minded individuals, form teams, and collaborate on exciting open source projects. Build long-lasting relationships with fellow participants, mentors, and sponsors.

3. **Skill Enhancement**: Enhance your technical skills and gain hands-on experience by working with cutting-edge open source technologies. Engage in workshops, mentorship sessions, and coding challenges that will boost your knowledge and expertise.

4. **Showcasing Talent**: Demonstrate your skills and creativity by developing innovative solutions. Get the chance to present your projects to a panel of esteemed judges and compete for exciting prizes.

5. **Community Engagement**: Become an active contributor to the FOSS community. Learn the importance of open source software, contribute to existing projects, and make a lasting impact in the world of technology.

**FOSSathon: Unleash the Open Source Power** will provide an immersive, inclusive, and supportive environment for participants to explore, create, and collaborate. Join us for an unforgettable hackathon experience and be part of the FOSS revolution.

Register now and let your creativity soar as you harness the power of open source at **FOSSathon: Unleash the Open Source Power**!

desc:
Dates: 5th May '23 - 7th May '23

Hacking for a more inclusive tomorrow!

**SheHacks** is IIITA's premier **women-only tech event**, dedicated to female coding enthusiasts and budding women developers. Organised by women, for women, it aims to inculcate the spirit of learning and promote gender equality among its stakeholders.

Since its inception, SheHacks has grown into a large-scale tech extravaganza- with an overwhelming response from women from all over the country in the field of design and development. Inspired and motivated by the fascinating projects received from participants in the last few years, we are thrilled to present the latest edition of the event- **SheHacks 6.0**, all set to be even bigger and better than all its previous iterations.

Over the course of three days, we at IIITA, will be hosting **tech talks, informative speaker sessions and useful workshops **conducted by leading experts and technocrats for all enthusiasts to upskill, innovate and finally implement their projects in a thrilling, edge-of-your-seat 36 hour hackathon. 

The SheHacks hackathon, which is the focal point of SheHacks, is a fantastic opportunity for all aspiring developers to get a hands-on experience in building tech solutions to real life problems. Hackathons are extremely constructive experiences, where participants not only learn to ideate, but also how to quickly adapt to new tech stacks, efficiently collaborate with team members, manage time and streamline solutions to be as impactful and effective as possible. 

The contributions of women are instrumental to a digitally empowered India. We welcome all female students and invite them to benefit from this, be it by participating and engineering solutions to problems or simply connecting with like minded people and learning from the mentors. So join us and let's get hacking!

name: Code With Consequences
desc:
**Attention all coders!** 
Get ready to participate in a one-of-a-kind hackathon event, worth 18 K - Code with Consequences! This three-phase, web-based competition will challenge your coding skills and creativity and give you a chance to win exciting prizes.

## Our Attractions:
Three exciting rounds with fun and engaging task
Opportunity to showcase your coding skills.
Chance to win cash prizes and cool goodies.
No one leaves empty-handed - participants will receive goodies in every round of the hackathon.

### Phase 1: 1 DAY
Qualifying Round (3 May). Join us for the virtual qualifying round, where you'll be given an easy web-based task to complete. Teams that successfully complete the task will move on to the next round. Don't worry if you don't make it through - you'll still receive some swag!

[Click here to get the tasks](https://github.com/CCube-Club/Code-With-Consequences-prelims/)

### Phase 2: 4 HOURS
In-person Round (5 May). Selected teams will come together for an exciting in-person round where they'll spin a wheel to determine the theme they'll be working on. Teams will have 4 hours to implement a basic UI or the application base and give a small working demo. Teams that advance to the final round will receive cool swags, while those that don't will get t-shirts or mugs for each team member.

### Phase 3: 10 HOURS
Main Event (6 and 7 May). The top teams will compete in the final round of the hackathon, where they'll be given a ‘Consequence’ to work on. The ‘Consequence’ will be unknown and released on 6 May (in person). Teams will have 10 hours to complete their implementation and hand over their final codebase. All team members will receive cool prizes like t-shirts and mugs while the top teams will win cash prizes.

## REGISTRATION DETAILS
The hackathon will be for 10 hours (5 hours for 2 days)
It will comprise three phases – the first will be online while the remaining will be offline.
Minimum number of participants per team – 1
Maximum number of participants per team – 4
The results will be published on 7 May
## Prizes:
First Place: Rs. 10,000
Second Place: Rs. 5000
Third Place: Rs. 3000
EVERY OTHER PARTICIPANT WILL RECEIVE CONGRATULATORY PRIZES.

name: New Hackathon 2.0
desc:
**India's First Account Aggregator Hackathon**

In 2016, **NPCI** launched the **UPI** payments network which took off like a rocket ship; in May 2020, UPI was used by almost **100 million** people, with a total transaction volume of ~**1.25 billion** (greater than American Express globally).

It is now time for the launch of the Account Aggregator (AA) framework. From this month onwards, some of the nation's biggest and most esteemed banks will go live on the AA network.

There is no better time for developers, startups, and engaged citizens to learn more about the potential of this system and to start building on top of it.

For this reason, India's first Account Aggregator Hackathon is being announced - a **4-week** virtual event hosted in partnership with Devfolio.

A link to the official announcement can be found [here](https://sahamati.org.in/blog/first-account-aggregator-hackathon/).

name: ETHIndia Grants 2.0
tagline: Build a thriving Ethereum ecosystem, one project at a time 🌱
desc:
ETHIndia grants program is the ethos of a garden of possibilities. We believe that with the right resources and support, builders can grow and flourish, and their ideas can blossom into something amazing. That's why we're on a mission to help builders build on Ethereum and unlock the full potential of the ecosystem.

💸 Get upto $5k equity-free grants for teams or individuals
🛠 Build decentralized products on top of the Ethereum ecosystem
💲 Access to continuity grants or external funding so that building never stops.

We are looking for projects in areas including **zk tech, next-gen wallets, General Scope (DeFi, DAO, NFT and more), community, and developer education.** However, projects beyond these areas are also welcome to apply.

**Application Process:**
- Fill in the application form on the microsite to apply for a grant.
- Applications are reviewed every two weeks on a - rolling basis.
- If your application is shortlisted, we'll schedule a 30-minute remote catch-up to discuss your project in more detail.
- If your grant application is approved, funds will be disbursed in phases as you complete project milestones.
- Grantees are required to provide regular progress updates after receiving the grant.

So to all the builders out there, we encourage you to dream big, think outside the box, and submit your best ideas to the ETHIndia grants program. We can't wait to see what you will create 💪

name: Awesome Online Hackathon
desc:
As we speak, India is rolling out a work of public digital infrastructure called the National Health Stack. One of the components of this stack is the Personal Health Records (PHR) system.

At its core, the PHR system creates a common standard for managing and sharing health data, all with user consent. This system, which has already been announced by the Prime Minister, will change allow individuals to gain greater security and utility from their own data, and will transform the healthtech industry in India.

At the Healthathon 2020, we want to spread the word about the PHR system so that developers, entrepreneurs, investors, doctors, and other stakeholders from the public sector, private sector, and medical community can take part in this revolution in Indian healthtech,

Whether you are a programmer looking to build on top of the new PHR APIs or a business/medical student who wishes to come up with new business models and use cases for this technology, the Healthathon 2020 will be a great opportunity for you to learn about the PHR system while interacting with some of the best and brightest minds in the world of Indian healthtech.

tagline: Asia's Largest Women Fellowship for Smart Contracts ( Solidity)
desc:
Introducing 100 Girls in Blockchain Fellowship! An exclusive initiative for women to learn web 3.0, and blockchain, and become solidity smart contract engineers. 

This seminal program is run by Web3Learn ( Kiran Dutta) and Workbucks.io ( Priyanka Kamath) in close association with Devfolio, where we will provide comprehensive support in onboarding, execution, and mentoring throughout the program.


Follow through for all details on the fellowship: 

The 6-week curriculum includes:

- Solidity Smart Contract Engineering
- Cohort-Based Courses (Live Sessions, Videos)
- Build with Community (Huddle Sessions, Doubt Clearing Sessions, 24/7 Discord Support, AMA Sessions)
- JavaScript Refresher

Solidity Curriculum (4 weeks)
Week 1:
•	The layout of a Solidity source code
•	Solidity basics
•	Gas
•	Operators
•	Value types
•	Control flow
•	Variables
•	Functions
Week 2:
•	Data Locations
•	Events and Logging
•	Error Handling
•	Interfaces
•	Inheritance
•	Cross Contract Calls
•	Delegate Call and Call functionality
Week 3:
•	Setting up for deploying Smart Contracts (Hardhat/Truffle) 
•	Writing and deploying Smart Contracts 
•	Testing Smart Contracts

Week 4:
•	Gas Optimization 
•	Basics of Smart Contract Audit
•	dApp Design
•	Solidity advanced function usage 
•	Solidity best practices, useful patterns/tips


For more information on the curriculum, please visit: https://web3learn.notion.site/be070fd3b82842b495ba1a36c53ea73e?v=7f5d7eeac5cd479280beb0c5e4040a83

name: No-Code Startup
desc:
The No-Code Startup is a part of Startup Saga, a signature event of I&E Cell AIT, Pune. In No-Code startup participants have to solve the problem statement given to them with **Low/No code**, either they can use No-Code applications by dragging and dropping software programs to create a complete app using the no-code development tools.

No-Code Startup is **not** only about developing a website or application without writing code. It offers problem statements from various domains which are not only restricted to software development but extended to the Development of solid models or simulation of electronic circuits for the desired solution.

The goal of No-Code Startup is to make a profitable business out of our skills with zero investment and direct you to the path of monetizing your skills.

On the given problem statement, the team has to make a MVP (Minimum Viable Product) on the basis of MVP the winners will be declared. 

The term Minimum Viable Product or MVP is a methodology that focuses on establishing businesses and products within a short development lifecycle.

Prize pool worth of **2.4 lakhs+** including exciting goodies and schwags are on the way, all you need to do is just participate in No-Code Startup.

name: Hackerstellar
desc:
Hello Hacktraunauts,

Are you ready to blast off into a galaxy of innovation and creativity? If so, join us for HACKERSTELLAR, a 24-Hour offline coding hackathon where you can turn your stellar ideas into reality.

HACKERSTELLAR is hosted by the Computer Society of India Student’s Chapter at K. J. Somaiya College of Engineering on 15th and 16th April. The theme is Space Exploration, and you can choose from three domains: Web App, AI/ML, or Blockchain.

At HACKERSTELLAR, you’ll get to network with fellow hackers, showcase your skills, and develop cutting-edge technologies that can make an impact in the space sector. You’ll also have a chance to win amazing prizes, including cash prizes, vouchers, and internship opportunities.

Plus, you’ll get to learn from industry experts who will judge your projects and give you feedback. And don’t worry, we’ll keep you fueled with complimentary food, stickers and fun activities throughout the event.

So what are you waiting for? Register now and get ready to launch your hacking journey at HACKERSTELLAR. Stay tuned for more updates and surprises. 

See you there!

name: Hack IT Sapiens
tagline: Reuniting Hacker Sapiens for the Ultimate Hacking Revolution
desc:
**HACK IT SAPIENS** 
HACK IT SAPIENS is a 36-hour-long India’s Student-driven Hackathon that brings hackers from all across the country under one roof for an incredible battle of code, community, and self-improvement!
How To Get Ourselves Registered At Hack It Sapiens?
Step 1: Register yourself by clicking on the Apply Now button and filling in all the required details.
Step 2: Create your own team or join an existing team(as this is a team-based event).
Step 3: Hack It Sapiens team will accept your registration and then will give an RSVP link to the registered mail id then after all the steps are completed as mentioned in the mail, you will be able to submit a solution to any problem statements.
Why Should I join?
Hack IT Sapiens some say is the same as others, but What’s different from other ones?

So here it is,
We are Aiming and motivated to give our participants not only a hackathon but a journey from which they’ll get a life-long learning experience, where they’ll meet a large number of tech-Savy such as profound developers, designers, entrepreneurs, and especially students and professionals, who are interested in technology and problem-solving as much as you are. For many of us, it will be a Once in a lifetime opportunity to visit the “Pink City” aka the “Paris of India”, and get a chance to grab your hands on the Immense prize pool of 4 lakhs !!! and much more.
So, what are you waiting for register yourselves today and be a part of this Looming Journey Of CREATION?
How will the projects be judged?
The projects will be judged on the basis of the following criteria:
Innovation: How can someone not think of innovation while building a project in the Cluster Innovation Centre? We will be judging how innovative your project is. Does your project already exist somewhere on the internet? If yes, how is it different from the existing ones? Is it solving a problem more efficiently? Or is it a completely new idea?
Originality: How original is your project idea? We all copy code from the internet, but does your project consist only of copied code?
Social impact: How about helping humankind with your project? Is your project limited to programmers or will it be impacting our society in a positive way? Everyone loves projects which are aimed at social good.
Technicalities: We will obviously be judging your project on how technically great it is. Maybe you created a CI/CD pipeline for your project? Or, bound Rust with Python? Or, used Docker in the deployment process?
Market readiness: We know, it is quite impossible to create a project that is market ready in 36 hours, but, this will earn you extra points! Created a website? DEPLOY IT! An Android application? ADD THE RELEASE APK FILE TO GITHUB RELEASES!
How much did you learn?: Is this your first hackathon and you ended up creating a full-stack project with an automated deployment pipeline? Or, is this your nth hackathon and you created a project that you are very familiar with? Learning always pays off, and we don't want beginners to feel intimidated by experienced hackers!
What’s Free…?
The main question is what’s not, everything is “FREE OF COST” our Aim is to truly give our participants the “Hassle-free” experience for whom they registered for
Starting with FREE Accommodation, and FREE Food including all the main course meals, starters, snacks, Energy drinks, and much more. And last but not least the “WorthWhile” Experience.

**Hackathon Details** -

PHASE 1: Registration Round (Online)
it's going to be an online round where you will register your team.

—---------------(Top  Teams Will Be Shortlisted)------------

Phase 2: 36-hour Hackathon(offline)
It's the final round of the hackathon, this will be a physical round at Poornima College of Engineering, Top teams will be called here in offline mode to compete in a 36-hour-crazy hackathon.
Final Judgment round - The judgment rounds will be based on some criteria and it will be done by industry experts and domain specialists.

**Hackathon Schedule:**

Offline reporting starts at 3:00 p.m.-7:00 pm on 14 April in Poornima College of Engineering.
The inaugural Ceremony will start from 7:00 p.m.-8:00 on pm 14 April in the “Hackerspace”.
The Idea submission will start from+ 9:00 p.m.-12:00 am on 15 April in the “Hackerspace”.
1st Marking Round will start at 1:00 pm on 15 April in the “Hackerspace”.
2nd Marking Round will start at 10:00 pm on 15 April in the “Hackerspace”.
The Bonus Marking round will start at 4:00 am on 16 April in the “Hackerspace”.
The Final Submission round will start at 9:00 am on 16 April in the “Hackerspace”.
The Closing Ceremony will start at 11:00 am on 16 April in the “Hackerspace”.
