desc:
REVA HACK is an annual tech and innovation fest organized by The Hackathon Club at REVA University, the yearly event has only seen growth year over year since its inception in 2016. Today REVA HACK has become our University's flagship technological event that welcomes over a thousand participants every year. 


REVA HACK 2021 was a landmark event for the club with over 2500+ registered entrants and prices over INR 2.5 Cr. REVA HACK's schedule also accommodates pre-event workshops, learnathons, and semi-formal engagement events like Kahoots, stressbusters, etc. that come with goodies. We expect a huge turnout for REVA HACK 2022, since it's a hybrid event that welcomes both online and offline participants, and the number of offline slots is limited, because these hackers will be on-site for 48 hours, we’ll need to cap the number of offline attendees. However, they can take the advantage of food and accommodation facilities on-site during that time. We have a validation round for offline hackers who intend to avail of these facilities.

>The second part is on-site verification,** Papers Please!!.** Your documents will be verified on-site. The full list of required documents will be emailed to the shortlisted entrants. Discrepancies, if any, shall be handled by the organizers. Their decision will be final and binding.

Please submit your Idea Pitch before **Nov 3, 2022**. A Final list of offline hackers will be revealed two weeks before the hackathon.

name: bob World hAAckathon
desc:
Digital has changed the world of financial services. Cutting-edge technologies and the disruption introduced by on-demand aggregators and marketplaces has brought about a huge shift in consumer expectations of speed, safety, security and convenience.

The Account Aggregator (AA) framework is the next big disruptor and has the potential to change the lending and investment landscape in India. Under the Account Aggregator ecosystem, customers can give their consent to share their financial data with other financial entities in a completely hassle-free and secure manner through the use of APIs. It gives customers greater control over their financial information as well as gives them the ability to share data lying in a disaggregated manner with multiple financial entities with ease, significantly reducing the time and effort when applying for a loan or other services.
  
Bank of Baroda has gone live on the AA platform as both a Financial Information Provider (FIP) and a Financial Information User (FIU).

There are two common pain points faced by financial services institutions in general i.e. Seamless Customer On-Boarding and Customer Engagement. In order to tackle the above pain points with the assistance of the Account Aggregator framework, Bank of Baroda is organising the “**bob Word hAAckathon**”. The aim of the hackathon is to leverage the AA framework to come up with ideas and solutions to solve for the above issues. 

The ideology adopted and prototype designed and developed by the participants should cover the below mentioned parameters:

•	Seamless Customer on-boarding  
•	Deepening Customer Engagement & Increasing Stickiness
•	No Compromise on Security
•	Low Implementation Cost and Time
•	High on Innovation
•	Rich User Interface/ User Experience 
•	Use of Data Analytics to identify target customers 
The best solutions meeting the above mentioned parameters shall be shortlisted by the jury. The top 3 use cases will be adjudged the winners. 

Read more on AA, Sandbox, and API details available for building innovative solutions for this hackathon [here](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1HRGQyyYihkz7yDXRyDSMxjF5lD1U6zxtyNO98U_XBa4/edit?usp=sharing)

name: Ur-Hackathon
desc:
A hearty welcome to all the Hackers for our 48-hour long blockchain Hackathon, which aims to bring all levels of creative and developer minds together to build amazing things on blockchain. There is no problem statement, we are open to every idea that you have. 

- **Everything Happens Here, Join Now:** https://discord.gg/pdzKbzRJjd
- **To get NFTs fill this Form**: https://forms.gle/65MpDsggqs7e8QR5A

# Events Roadmap:
1. We are organizing different Blockchain Workshops, where a beginner can learn and build DApps on different Blockchains.
2. We are also organizing some engagement sessions, where you can win some Cool Swags and Tees from the Sponsors.
3. We are organizing a Pitching Session with some great Panel Members, where you can present your project or business idea to our Panel Members, Public & get Funding. 
To participate in this, make sure you fill the Form: https://forms.gle/DWnYLRgCBeW9bK7Q6
4. We had tie-up with some Web3 companies for Jobs 
& Internships. All Ur-Hackathon Participants are by default Eligible for this. Later, we will shortlist the Potential Candidates based on their Hackathon Project and contact them through our official Email ("teamlearnweb3@gmail.com").
- **👉All Events related Information (date, time, etc) will be available under SCHEDULE section, below Hackathon Timeline.**

# Submission Guidelines:
- Submit the GitHub link of your publicly visible source code of the hack on Devfolio. Submissions with broken links will be marked ineligible for prizes.
- There must be clear description about the working of the hack in the README file. If the hack is live and can be tested, add the relevant links to that in the README file as well.
- Create a short video demo of the hack and upload to YouTube or any video sharing site. Make sure that the person watching the video is fully able to understand what the bot does and what its functionalities are. Share the link on your Devfolio Submission.
- Optionally, submission should include a link of deployed web app or mobile app.

tagline: Create your future... Engineer for Tommorrow
desc:
Dev2Innovate is a month-long online web3 themed hackathon at the national level organized by the students of IIT Bhubaneswar, will act as a platform bringing together designers and developers from across the nation to work on real-life problems and develop Innovative and practical solutions.

# General Guidelines
- Every team can have 1 - 4 participants per team. The members are allowed to belong to different organizations or institutions.
- Any form of plagiarism, which includes copying someone else's code, idea or proof of concept, if reported and found true, will result in immediate disqualification of the team.
- The submitted solution by the team should be in the form of a complete application. Other forms, like static sites, python notebooks etc., will not be accepted as a valid submissions.
- Participants are expected to write code that is robust and reusable.
- Efficiency of the solution is a plus.
- Participants are expected to submit a complete working solution in the form of an application, API, or anything similar by the end of the hackathon. They will always be preferred over ml-notebooks and static sites.
- Participants are advised to categorise their solutions as either non-profit or commercial and brainstorm incentivization models accordingly.
- Participants are encouraged to use a version control system to collaborate on their code in real time.
location: Indian Institute Of Technology (IIT) Bhubaneswar, Argul - Jatni Road, Kansapada, Odisha, India

name: NITSHACKS 5.0
tagline: One of the northeast's largest hackathons
desc:
## Overview

NITSHACKS is the annual hackathon organised by NIT Silchar that promotes team-based competition for developing solutions to different types of real-life problems with the help of tech. It has always provided a platform for budding developers and coders to showcase their talents on a stage with participants of the finest calibre.

**For valid submissions, each team must have 2 - 4 members on Devfolio.** 

**Note: Individual submissions will not be considered.** 

## Tracks

1. Solve a Local Problem
2. Web 3 and Blockchain 
3. Open Innovation

**Note: It is MANDATORY for online teams to join our Discord Server, else the team is not eligible**

### Problem Statements
1. **Solve a Local Problem**
**Title** : Reduce carbon emissions from NIT Silchar Campus
**Description**
There is a multitude of people living on the NIT Silchar campus, be it students, guards or faculties. Naturally, this will generate a lot of waste. Waste is best treated when its properties are known. The management authority wants to obtain data on waste being generated on the
campus as well as be able to provide selective data to third-party corporations who excel in
treating waste.
Develop a solution to help the management authority such that residents of the campus can
share the data of their wastes, like weight, nature, location, time and other such properties, with them, as well as facilitating them to provide selective data to the partnering corporations and help the campus give an impactful contribution in waste management.
Expected output:
 - A web or a mobile application for the residents of the college and another for the
management authorities.
 - Multiple levels of authorization, where residents can only upload or update their entries
of waste, and corporations can only access the data that they will be allowed to by the
management authorities, meanwhile, the management authorities have paramount
control over the data.
Assumptions:
- Corporations will reuse/recycle the waste from the information gained from the
developed solution.
- Residents will upload accurate information about their waste, which can include location,
time, nature, the weight of the waste and even an image of it

2. **Web 3 and Blockchain**
**Title** : Smart Resource Management System using Web
**Description** 
Whenever there is a supply change in the market, the increase in the number of goods
purchased and used is logged by the user. Maintaining a database of requirements and the
transactions necessary to complete those requirements is difficult, tiresome and requires
supervision. The user has to keep a notice on the database and create transactions with the
specific vendor for supplies.
However, Blockchain provides a unique opportunity to automate the entire process of
transactions based on data fed into the system. Design a blockchain-based system, and can
create the transactions necessary for the warehouse to remain at maximum efficiency.
**Expected output**:
- A single-user system with an integrated crypto wallet, where the user can add the
cryptocurrency that will be used whenever a transaction is needed to be completed.
- To account for user approval, the system should implement a 2-factor authentication for
every automated transaction.
- A user page where user can view their current balance, basic details and previous
transactions.
- The system should prioritize purchases based on (in the given order where (a) Is the
highest)
 - The available balance of the user
 - Difference between the Required good quantity and current quantity.
 - The system should not only be able to purchase, but also return the excess from the
warehouse.
- A Warehouse management viewport, where the user can see the warehouse stats.
- A custom transaction portal where the user can manually create transactions as well,
which should recommend necessary goods and warn against excess products.
**Assumptions**:
- Vendors accept cryptocurrencies.
- The user uploads data daily.

desc:
**NeoHacks** is an Open-source focused, beginner friendly hackathon.
The hackathon has an Open theme, that is we encourage you to bring your unique ideas to the table. We have a whole bunch of ideas listed below if you wish to get a starting point. Our goal is to encourage and provide an intellectually exciting university atmosphere for the student body while bridging the gap between industry and students pursuing technology-related subjects. IEEE SB DAIICT seeks to offer the students an interactive platform where they can enhance or acquire their professional and industrial skills while blurring the lines between cliche monotonous and tedious perception of the tech industry and its true immersive and exciting side. Since its establishment, it has been efficient and successful in planning and executing various events with clear aims. With this objective, IEEE SB DAIICT proudly presents its annual Hackathon, Tic-Tech-Toe '22! Tic-Tech-Toe aims to bring creatives and developers together and solve some of the most pressing real-world problems, thus inculcating a culture of product innovation and a problem-solving mindset. The hackathon is open to everyone with a crazy idea and a will to implement it into a working prototype, building an environment of collaborative growth amongst all the participants.
location: DAIICT - Dhirubhai Ambani Institute of Information and Communication Technology, Daiict college, Reliance Cross Road, Gandhinagar, Gujarat, India

name: Ideathon 2022
desc:
“IDEATHON” ,  Online IDEATHON is Organised by TechCom (Computer Science and Engineering), MAIT on 4 -19th October 2022 sponsored by **IIC** & **TPLUS Ventures**. This Ideathon will be based on four tracks: **Cybersecurity, Edutech,  FinTech , and Agritech.**  
 
**Steps for Registration**

1. You can register in teams of 2 to 6 members.
2. The competition will be conducted in two rounds.
3. All the participating teams will receive a certificate of participation.
4. Only submissions done within the deadline will be considered for the competition.
5. It is compulsory that the team leader has an email ID for communication and is mentioned correctly on the form.
6. Form for the submissions will be mailed to you before the deadline for each round.
7. Format of the PPT Slide should (be 6-7 Pages ) and contain the following parameters:
• Introduction
• Problem
• solution
• Business logic
• Revenue model
• SWOT
• CONCLUSION

 Prize: Raspberry Pi 4 Starter Kit 

 Description: Cohere makes Natural Language Processing easy to do with their ready to use online platform. Simply sign-up, claim your free $75 credit, no credit card required, and start training your very own language model directly on the web! You and your teammates can each win a Raspberry Pi 4 Starter Kit by using Cohere in your next hack. Wondering what to build? Cohere is great for text and content generation, text-based search, predictive text and so much more. Check out our software & learn pages for more details!

prizes.name: DeSo
prizes.desc:
Prize Category:Best Use of DeSo 
Prize: $100 worth of $DESO coin and a DeSo branded Tumbler

Description: DeSo is the official Web3 sponsor of the MLH Hackathon League and the first Layer 1 blockchain custom-built for decentralized social media applications. While blockchains like Avalanche or Solana cost $0.50+ to store just a 200-character post, the DeSo blockchain is built with custom indexing and storage optimizations which make it 10,000X cheaper to store social content on-chain! In order to qualify for the contest, you must launch an app that writes to the DeSo blockchain and implements DeSo identity. While social media apps are a great fit for DeSo, you can also build financial apps, marketplaces, and more on the DeSo blockchain. For inspiration on project ideas, you can check out some of the existing 200+ apps already live on DeSo at Bithunt.com as well as our DeSo APIs. The Best Use of DeSo gets $100 worth of $DESO coin & an exclusive DeSo branded tumbler!

name: ETHBerlin³
tagline: ETHBerlin³ is a hackathon, a cultural festival, an educational event, a platform for hacktivism, and a community initiative to push the decentralized ecosystem forward.
desc:
ETHBerlin is known as the hackathon extravaganza, a cultural festival, an educational event, a platform for hacktivism, and a community initiative to push the decentralized ecosystem forward. ETHBerlin³ is the third edition, and we've come a long way since we hosted our first hackathon in 2018.

After successful events in 2018 and 2019, ETHBerlin decided to reaffirm its commitment to the ecosystem and founded the Department of Decentralization. The DoD is responsible for initiatives that go beyond organizing hackathons and seek to also support the projects coming from our events and community. ETHBerlin 2018 and ETHBerlinZwei 2019 sought to marry the culture and values of Berlin with those of the builder community and arguably succeeded at it.

Now, in 2022 we are back with ETHBerlin³ - to the power of 3. This time, we are pushing even further into becoming a festival for people from all backgrounds, and most importantly, a hub where builders will be able to get their creative juices flowing by discovering various cultural and educational experiences spread across the weekend.

prizes.desc: GitHub is one of the best ways to collaborate, push code, get feedback, and show the world what you’ve built during a hackathon. name: Amritathon
desc: To celebrate the month of ‘Azaadi ka Amrit Mahautsav’, Amrit-a-thon is a 48-hour free of cost virtual hackathon bringing together student developers and designers who will compete to create the best possible solutions to the emerging issues on 1st of October 2022. name: SGCIndia Demo Day
tagline: Get a chance to pitch your Web3 startup to Sino Global Capital & FTX team, in person!
desc:
# India's first SGC Demo Day! 🎊

Sino Global Capital is bringing in a pool of $2,000,000 to back the best Indian Web3 startups in September. 

Applications are open for all startups across the Web3 landscape. 12 shortlisted startups will get flown down to Bengaluru to pitch their products to remarkable VCs and panelists from [Sino Global Capital](https://www.sinoglobalcapital.com/), [Devfolio](https://devfolio.co/), [ETHIndia](https://ethindia.co/), [FTX Ventures](https://ventures.ftx.com/) & [Buidlers Tribe](https://buidlerstribe.com/).

This is your chance to take your startup or MVP up by multiple notches and the process is as easy as pie:
* Make a compelling case in the application form for why you should get shortlisted.
* Once shortlisted, pitch your startup to our VCs & panelists.
* Bazinga, you're funded!
location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

name: TPG Bangalore Hacker House 2022
tagline: India's first female web3 hacker house
desc:
The idea is to encourage more female #builders/ aspiring #builders to come forward and build in web3 with a group of folks in a safe space with mentorship and learning, spread over a period of 2-days. 

The hacker house will be a small and intimate event so that we can provide mentorship and support to womxn who are truly interested in building something. It doesn’t have to be a complete product but we want you to engage with others in teams or work individually to create something in web3 over the weekend. Post this, 2 weeks of time will be given to complete the product virtually which they can present on demo day.
location: Chingari Villa, 15th Main Road, Koramangala 3 Block, Koramangala, Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

name: MesoHacks 2022
tagline: A community driven hackathon encouraging hackers to shape their ideas.
desc:
## About

Our mission is to encourage fresh hackers and students to open their mind and think about the various possibilities that technology has to offer and shape their ideas for a better world.

MesoHacks is a 48 hours long designing and programming marathon where undergraduate or graduate designers, developers and engineers will come together to work on their ideas, solve real-world problems and learn new skills.

MesoHacks is an official **MLH Member event** for the 2023 hackathon season.

## Venue

The hackathon is planned to be in hybrid mode where students in the university will be hacking from **The LNM Institute of Information Technology, Jaipur** and others are welcome in online mode to participate and showcase their ideas and skills.

## Theme

We have the following themes on which the hackers can work on:
-  Healthcare
-  IoT/Hardware
-  AI/ML
-  Education
-  Cybersecurity

There are no restrictions on ideas and apart from these themes, we are open to any kind of project you want to work on.

*More details can be found on our* [website here](https://www.mesohacks.co).
location: The LNM Institute of Information Technology, Rupa ki Nangal, Post-Sumel, Via-Jamdoli Jaipur-302031,, Goner Road, Dher Ki Dhani, Jaipur, Rajasthan, India

prizes.name: NEAR Protocol
prizes.desc:
**Problem statement 1 (3000$)**
Card Faction games with progressive card upgrade mechanism through the introduction of resources. 
The game should comprise of story mode, daily activities, PVE and PVP. 

Ideas on clans, daily clan tasks and clan battles (the long run goals) are important.
Reference game : [Idle heroes](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.droidhang.ad&hl=en_IN&gl=US)
 
**Problem statement 2 (3000$)**
Develop a reputation score for wallets. Provide an NFT-like egg to every wallet at the beginning. Now, as the wallet matures and does transactions it can evolve into a shell. Based on the transaction activity of the wallet, provide a reputation score for each wallet.

Let’s say those who just do transfers get a “Shell” NFT, those who provide liquidity in reputed protocols become “caterpillar” (NFT) and then those who do borrowing lending in addition and more complicated stuff, they become “butterfly”. There can be different levels of Butterflies- every NFT needs to be have a story around it. These NFTs need to be Soulbound NFTs (those that can’t be transferred)

The reputation scores can be used by protocols for airdropping, differential loan terms, etc.
 
**Problem Statement 3 (4000$)**
Design a ZK based solution on Near that can enable user to prove something to the application without revealing the exact information. For example, his age is above >18 or FICO or CIBIL score is above >X without revealing his exact age/score.

Reference: [Decentralized Lending Dapp using Mina](https://medium.com/minaprotocol/snark-powered-defi-teller-builds-decentralized-lending-dapp-using-mina-5045d29cd403) 
 
 
**Eligibility:**
- Must be deployed on NEAR testnet/mainnet.
- The code should be open-sourced on Github.

prizes.desc:

On-Chain Analytics:
Introduction
Participating in decentralized finance could be confusing for new users. Let us build an application to simplify investment opportunities for LPs by aggregating and analyzing Decentralized Exchange activities. Considering an EVM decentralized exchange (either pankcakeswap or uni-swap), build a service that actively listens to the DEX transactions and provides valuable analytics/insights to LPs.
1. Index on-chain data - Aggregate and fetch real-time on-chain data for on-chain events like:
Daily, Hourly, per minute transaction volume for every liquidity pair
Daily, Hourly, per minute reserve of every liquidity pair
To help with the analysis, you may want to index 1 months of historical data as well. Please feel free to index any other data, that you think would be more relevant to the solution
2. Generate and display analytics/insights to LPs - Create a dashboard that shows meaningful insight based on the aggregated data for decisions like:
Best LP to participate in
Identify scam/rug-pull on LPs
These are only suggestions, please feel free to generate any analytics/insights that you think will be valuable to LPs participating in pools on this DEX. 

For the other use-cases, please discuss with the onground CoinDCX team once before you start working on the problem statement

Application should:
Sync up existing block data (can set a certain block-number as starting point, for e.g: considering 1 month of historical on-chain data)
Provide real-time insights by actively listening on blockchain i.e. update the dashboard with every new block or new liquidity pool being created

prizes.name: (Sponsor) IPFS & Filecoin
prizes.desc:
Challenge Statement

Filecoin & IPFS powers the world’s largest distributed storage network. Our challenge to hackers is good use of IPFS related technologies and/or Filecoin storage helpers for persistent storage. 

Prizes & Name
Top 3: 
3x $2,500 prizes for best use of IPFS & Filecoin technology

Runners-ups: 
A selection of at least 6 projects to split a $3000 prize pool for good use of IPFS & Filecoin technology

At a minimum submissions for prizes should include the following items:

1. Project Description
- The name and summary of the project
- Names/pseudonyms of team members and contact info (e.g., GitHub handle, email address, or other)
- How the project uses IPFS and/or Filecoin and/or decentralized storage services that build on top of either with example links to where in code those technologies are used.

2. Link to the publicly visible source code repository
- Provide comprehensive README, incl. a clear description of the work and mention of how our tech is used in the Technologies Used section of README.
- Include a link to the working demo or provide a testing guide

3. Showcase
- 2-3 minute video that presents the idea, including a brief demo that demonstrates the use of IPFS and/or Filecoin or anything that builds on top of them
- If applicable, select the appropriate track when submitting the project.

NOTE:
- Submitting the same project across multiple hackathons will lead to disqualification
- Only projects or features (preferably in separate branch) built specifically for the respective hackathon will be considered for prizes
- Broken links may disqualify the project from the judging process.
- Using an IPFS HTTP gateway doesn’t count as building on top of IPFS. Exclusively basing your submission on that does not make you eligible for prizes.

Judging Criteria: Our judges grade submissions across 5 equally weighted categories,
- ✨Design
- 🤖Technical Accomplishment
- Filecoin & IPFS Implementation:
- 🚀Potential Impact
- 🤩Novelty/Creativity

Submissions will be rated with decimal numbers between 1 (worst) - 5 (best) per category (max score: 25) by each judge.

Learning Resource: Getting started with Filecoin & IPFS (https://www.notion.so/Getting-Started-With-IPFS-Filecoin-c00526cf97ba4087ba5c3ad5f5337a58 )

desc:
E-Cell DTU, for the past 12 years has been advocating the spirit of being a ‘creator’ by providing the students with the right guidance and mentorship from venture capitalists, angel investors, and top industrialists and striving to create an entrepreneurial ecosystem.

We attempt to foster new values amongst young individuals to make them exemplary engineers imbibed with the idea of productive, innovative, and independent thinking. We aim to create a 'change' with out-of-the-box ideas and training individuals to make them the creators of this change.

Dukaan® in collaboration with Entrepreneurship Cell, DTU brings to you Execute 2.0 which will provide the essential platform for those who strive to create a change in society through their out-of-the-box ideas, zeal, and ardor. Execute will sprint your mind, make you brainstorm extensively, and stretch you beyond your limits. It is a one-of-a-kind experience for amateurs, professionals, and most importantly hustlers. Be a part of executing and show your worth and potential to the world of transforming dreams into reality.

**Theme - Technology for the aid of business owners

Tech Stack - Utilise technologies such as AI/ML, Blockchain and more.**

**Timeline: **

**Introduction**
Teams will be informed about the event schedule and the problem statement.

**Checkpoint #1**
Teams would be required to submit their initial work along with a short description in the form of a GitHub link/presentation/word document. (Mentors will be assigned to only those teams who make a successful submission).

**Mentoring Session**
The teams will be assigned mentors to validate their progress and provide insights into their proposed solutions. The mentors would be industry professionals and proficient in their fields.

**Workshops**
Teams will be attending insightful workshops organised by Entrepreneurship Cell, DTU through its partners. These would serve to be beneficial for the participants equipping them with the skills needed to succeed.

**Checkpoint #2**
Teams will be required to update their progress on their hack/solution. A Github link with code would be mandatory to submit, along with a short description. The teams can additionally submit a Presentation/Word Document as well.

**Checkpoint #3**
Teams will be required to update their progress on their hack/solution. A Github link with code would be mandatory to submit, along with a short description. The teams can additionally submit a Presentation/Word Document as well.

**Final Submission**
The hacking mayhem will reach the finish line where every team would be required to submit their final hack/solution in form of a Github link/Zip file. Along with the final pitch deck that they will present in front of the esteemed judging panel.

**Judging Round**
The top 10 teams will be presenting their solutions in front of our esteemed panel of judges. Each team will be given 15 minutes, which would include Pitching followed by a QnA session by the judges.

name: Hackistica'22
tagline: Be the part of Central India's biggest codefest
desc:
Hackistica is part of central India's biggest code-fest Euristica'22. It is a 72-hour virtual hackathon bringing together student developers and designers who will compete to create the best possible solutions to emerging issues. With equally challenging and innovative problem statements, participants can test their skills and use them to build projects to solve real-world problems.

# Themes:
**EdTech**
India's educational requirements are rapidly changing, with a significant need for high-quality educational technologies. Teaching and learning are no longer limited to the classroom. The time has come to think about learning. Can we use emerging technology to effectively promote learning in rural areas?

**Fin-Tech**
Fin-Tech refers to the technological advances used to automate the traditional forms of finance. Using various tech ideas, build a sustainable solution to revolutionize and improve the current financial system.

**AI/ML**
Artificial intelligence refers to the intelligence demonstrated by computers as a result of their perception of their surroundings. AI-powered devices can operate on their own to accomplish a purpose. Will computers ever be able to handle all tasks that require human intelligence? Experts in artificial intelligence claim that they can. Can you create a solution to tackle modern world challenges using Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning? 

**Automation**
Automation is the use of technology to do activities with less human intervention.       Automation can be used in any industry that has repetitive operations, although it is more common in manufacturing, robotics, and automotive. You can experiment and innovate to create something that answers real-world challenges.

**Blockchain**
Web 3.0 refers to the next iteration of the internet that promotes decentralized protocols. Employ web 3.0 to solve community problems and build something powerful which can make an impact.

**Open Innovation**
If you don’t want to stick to a particular theme, you can explore different fields and can innovate by bringing them together to build something that solves real-world problems.

prizes.desc:

**Prizes worth**

**Overall Winner**

**Submission Guidelines**

- **Submit the GitHub link of your publicly visible source code** of the hack on Devfolio. Submissions with broken links will be marked ineligible for prizes.
- There must be **clear description about the working of the hack** in the README file. If the hack is live and can be tested, add the relevant links to that in the README file as well.

- Submission must include a link of deployed web app or mobile app.

name: Hack The Crisis 2.0
desc:
Keeping in mind the latest Conflicts situations across the world, it has become necessary to provide the solutions for the impacted areas. With thousands of people affected by these conflicts on a daily basis the youth has to come forward united to help others in such a crucial time.

**BVP ISTE** brings back the **HACK THE CRISIS 2.0** which aims to provide effective solutions for the war impacted areas. It is a virtual/online hackathon in which all the participants will work in a given timeline and develop strategies to cope up with the effects and after effects of the ongoing crisis around the world on people’s lives. This year** HackTheCrisis 2.0** will focus on solving problems related to **Education, Fintech, Logistics, Health, Emergency & Open Innovation.**

Along with all this time Hack the Crisis is providing a **virtual setting (A virtual Campus)** and tools to make this online event more interactive and fun. Each user with their **own avatar** where they can meet up and move around the virtual campus of our college, in hope to bring together passionate creative young innovators and more for a **hackathon focused on decentralized metaverse.**

Get ready and mark the dates. It’s you who would bring about a change, and it’s your idea that would impact billions.

name: Supernova
desc:
**JOIN THE 1ST GLOBAL "INTERNET COMPUTER" WEB3 HACKTHON**
Web3 is the new phase of the web, which will transform the internet, and provide extraordinary opportunities to developers and entrepreneurs. This hackathon provides you with the chance to start building using the most advanced Web3 platform in existence today, and win large prizes, grants and seed investments in the process.

You can play a key role building out a new internet in which things like social media services are directly owned, run, and updated by their communities via governance tokens that control DAOs (Decentralized Autonomous Organizations). In this brave new world, social media and online games will blend with functionality from DeFi (Decentralized Finance) to become SocialFi and GameFi, and smash together in a new decentralized metaverse. DAOs, decentralized finance and tokenization will be pervasive, and developers and entrepreneurs will be able to use DAOs to fund their exciting new projects, from anywhere in the world — and the good news is, it's happening now, and any solid coder can take advantage.

The Internet Computer is a new kind of blockchain, which took years to develop, and was created by one of the best R&D teams in tech (browse their bios here https://dfinity.org/team). Through a massive R&D program that began in 2016, this team developed a new blockchain architecture powered by new cryptography (see how it works here https://dfinity.org/howitworks). This has created a game-changing blockchain that can, for example, directly host "mass market" social media services, and all their data and computation, on-chain. That means you can now build truly decentralized online services using only advanced blockchain code ("smart contracts"), and nothing else, using programming languages such as [Rust](https://www.rust-lang.org/) and [Motoko](https://smartcontracts.org/docs/current/developer-docs/build/languages/motoko/) (a native language that can be quickly learned by any Solidity or JavaScript programmer), which compile to [WebAssembly](https://webassembly.org).

This is because on the Internet Computer, your blockchain code can serve rich, interactive web experiences directly to end users, and can store and process data with efficiency that is several orders of magnitude greater than the next most efficient competing blockchain. This means that you can build systems, dapps and decentralized services that run 100% from the blockchain, in a huge leap forwards, which means you don't need centralized IT like cloud services, or server machines in data centers, as you do when building on other blockchains. Using the Internet Computer, you can build truly decentralized dapps and services, with end-to-end security that online communities love, and leverage advanced tokenization strategies to fundraise and drive viral growth.

Join our Web3 movement to build a new generation of online services that are fully decentralized, by building them exclusively from blockchain code, then placing under the control of an advanced community DAO. Have the DAO run a "decentralization sale" to raise money for ongoing R&D from the decentralized ecosystem, quickly forming a growing community that supports your service, and gain posession of valuable governance tokens, which reward you for your success, and provide you with liquidity.

During this hackathon, decentralized services on the Internet Computer will begin creating an advanced type of DAO, called a "Service Nervous System", just by following a simple procedure, and then assigning control over their service to them, for the very first time... place yourself on the vanguard of Web3 and do the same with the project you develop.

Bonus opportunity: the novel "chain key cryptography" that powers the Internet Computer has recently been made available to hosted blockchain code via APIs. This means you can now write blockchain code that directly invokes code and controls token balances on OTHER blockchains, and create DeFi systems and meta glue that binds different blockchains together, without need for dangerous bridges. 

For inspiration: take a look at what people have built already at https://dfinity.org/showcase/, or start coordinating with prospective team members using Open Chat at https://oc.app, a SocialFi chat service that runs from the Internet Computer, where your account will soon also be a wallet.

We wish to extend thanks to our generous sponsors and judges, including Polychain Capital, Electric Capital, Huobi, Foresight Ventures, and Tomahawk.VC, Animal Ventures, and more!

WORKSHOPS
The Dfinity Foundation and community members ran a number of workshops ran to introduce participants to building on the Internet Computer. If you missed these workshops, fear not, [you can access records of them here](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLuhDt1vhGcreT8T9!)

prizes.name: Asynchronous DeFi
prizes.desc:
When a blockchain transaction invokes a smart contract on old-school blockchains, and it calls another contract, which calls another, and another, the functions of the different contracts run on a single call stack. This makes them very insecure thanks to re-entrancy, which has been one of the biggest sources of hacks on blockchain to date. Another problem is that transactions must be run in sequence, which creates a firm upper bound on transaction throughput. On the Internet Computer, smart contract calls run in parallel, because smart contracts (called "canisters") are "software actors". This removes a key security vulnerability, and provides for the unbounded, efficient scaling of blockchain computation. Now create a 100% on-chain and scalable auction house for NFTs, or a decentralized exchange for tokens. Or create a software library that helps others with the new way of coding DeFi. Or write code that interacts with other blockchains. Be a trailblazer for a new DeFi paradigm!

The Sustainable Development Goals or Global Goals are a collection of 17 interlinked global goals designed to be a "blueprint to achieve a better and more sustainable future for all". The SDGs were set up in 2015 by the United Nations General Assembly and are intended to be achieved by the year 2030.

Come and add your flavours and ingredients to make an awesome recipe from the mixture of design and engineering ***#designeering***,
# where
`flavors = {'Scratch', 'Illustrator', 'Visual Studio Code', 'Android Studio', 'Photoshop', 'Figma', ..., N}`
AND
`ingredients = {'CSE', 'Fashion', 'UI/UX', 'ID', 'CD', 'IT', ..., N}` **.**

prizes.name: Best Use of DeSo
prizes.desc:
**$100 worth of $DESO coin & an exclusive DeSo Tumbler**

**DeSo is the official Web3 sponsor of the MLH Hackathon League** and the first Layer 1 blockchain custom-built for decentralized social media applications. While a blockchain like Avalanche costs $0.50+ to store just a 200-character post, the DeSo blockchain is built with custom indexing and storage optimizations which make it [10,000X cheaper to store social content on-chain](https://hackp.ac/deso-blog-smartcontracts)! In order to qualify for the contest, you must launch an app that writes to the DeSo blockchain and implements [DeSo identity](https://hackp.ac/deso-identity). While social media apps are a great fit for DeSo, you can also build financial apps, marketplaces, and more on the DeSo blockchain. For inspiration on project ideas, you can check out some of the existing 200+ apps already live on DeSo at [Bithunt.com](https://bithunt.com/) as well as our [DeSo APIs](https://hackp.ac/deso-socialtransactions-api). **The Best Use of DeSo gets $100 worth of $DESO coin & an exclusive DeSo branded tumbler!**

GitHub is one of the best ways to collaborate, push code, get feedback, and show the world what you’ve built during a hackathon. To take it a step further, GitHub is now offering you access to industry tools, events & learning resources through something called ***GitHub Global Campus***. Win this weekend’s ***Most Creative Use of GitHub*** prize category, first by signing up for GitHub Global Campus and second by using a GitHub repository to host your hackathon project’s code! Make sure your use of GitHub stands out with a detailed ReadMe page, meaningful pull requests and collaboration history, and even a GitHub pages deployment!

name: Manthan
tagline: Participate in Manthan Ideathon and submit your ideas to bring in innovation in the securities market
desc:
**“Everything begins with an idea!”**

SEBI in association with BSE, NSE, NSDL, CDSL, KFintech, CAMS, Link Intime, MCX and NCDEX is conducting a 6-week Ideathon titled ‘Manthan’, to promote innovation in the securities market. Manthan will facilitate the creation of a pool of ideas and innovative solutions revolving around the securities market.
A great idea requires a healthy environment to be turned into reality. We are inviting innovative ideas from students, startup founders, professionals, academicians across the following themes:

1. **Investor Education, Protection and ease of investing:** Investors are the backbone of the securities market. We invite ideas focusing on building capacity of investors through education and awareness and enable them to take informed investment decisions. Your ideas can revolve around fraud prevention for retail investors, spreading awareness among investors through social media or any platforms, inclusive growth of securities market or any other endeavor that promotes education and protection of the interests of investors.  


2. **Securities Market Development:** Well-developed securities markets are the backbone of any financial system. They serve as a barometer of the financial health of the economy. Considering the tremendous growth in the recent years, there is still scope for improvement in the securities market. We encourage you to share your ideas promoting securities market development like the role of technology in implementing solutions to the challenges faced today, enhancing product innovations in the capital markets or making the commodities market better accessible to the investors.


3. **Market Regulation:** Regulation is a fundamental pillar supporting the success of the financial services industry, ensuring protection of investors and integrity of markets. With evolving regulatory requirements, it has become important to keep pace with the growing complexity, speed and sophistication of the securities market. We invite ideas focusing on building regulatory capacity in the ecosystem, role of RegTech and SupTech in streamlining the supervision and regulatory compliances, role of technology or any other innovation in the field of market regulation.   


4. **Integration within the financial ecosystem:** To digitally transform the securities market, it is necessary to integrate the financial ecosystem across various verticals. We encourage you to share ideas that promote more and more integration within financial ecosystem by providing easier onboarding facilities to new investors and making use of technology to innovate and address the challenges faced in capital markets.  


**Knowledge Sharing Workshops**

Along with Ideathon, interactive knowledge sharing sessions will be organized for registered participants using webinars. The sessions will be uploaded on Youtube subsequently. These knowledge-sharing sessions will give insight as well as enhance the knowledge base of the participants and give ideas/inputs while making their submissions for Ideathon.

Please click below to view the past knowledge sharing sessions:
[Youtube Link](https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLphY0v8N91TBvfPoru3NhIVmiFmgIfPCB)

RSVP here for the knowledge sharing workshops:  [https://lu.ma/manthanideathon](https://lu.ma/manthanideathon)

**Timelines**
**Application Launch -                          30th March**
Knowledge Sharing Workshop 1 -          9th April
Knowledge Sharing Workshop 2 -           23rd April
Knowledge Sharing Workshop 3 -          30th April
Knowledge Sharing Workshop 4 -            7th May
**The deadline to submit your ideas** -  14th May
Evaluation of ideas -                                   15th - 30th May
Announcement of Winner -                       To be Announced Later

**Submission of Ideas**
The registered participants are required to submit their ideas in video format in not more than 5 minutes covering the following as part of the final submission for Ideathon:
1. Problem Statement and Proposed Solution
2. Use Cases
3. Test Data Requirements from various stakeholders
4. APIs requirements

**Evaluation Criteria**

The ideas would be evaluated fairly for different categories including New Products, Processes and Technologies. The jury will decide the final evaluation criteria and same will be communicated to the participants at a later stage. An indicative evaluation criteria would be as follows: 
1. Completeness
2. Viability
3. Functionality
4. Originality
5. Impact

name: Hackanova
desc:
TCET's **[Hackanova](https://www.tsdw-tcet.in/)** gathers students from institutions all around India and gives them the opportunity to flaunt their technical skills. Hackanova is a national level inter-college online technical event that aims to test the skills of aspiring innovators.

The theme of the event is "Technology For the differently abled." It aims to use human thought to develop assistive technology that will aid differently abled people in overcoming their impairments. Thus developing technical solutions for differently-abled people by using hardware and software expertise in the form of a hackathon.


# **Rules & Regulations**


**01] General Rules**
Participants can submit their idea(s)/solutions based on the theme “Technology for Differently Abled People”. 
Each team may have a **maximum of 5 members** and a **minimum of 2**.** Individual Submissions won't be considered.**
The members of the team must be of the same institution.
The participation is open for all the students of recognized Technical Institutions.
Teams are allowed to select only one Problem Statement from any category. 
Same participant cannot be in multiple teams. 
It is mandatory to upload one paragraph abstract of idea at the time of registration. 
Presentation must be submitted on or before the registration deadline. 
The introductory slides of the presentation must adhere to the format and guidelines provided. 
No entries will be accepted after the deadline. 


**02] For Guidelines of Round 1 & 2** visit [www.tsdw-tcet.in](https://www.tsdw-tcet.in/)



**03] GUIDELINES FOR SUBMITTING ABSTRACT OF SOLUTION OF PROBLEM STATEMENTS
**The problem statement(s) must be chosen from a specified list of [problem statements](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1stpvPgAzW8ZQmBR9zge9QzRVghOu-fVLHOzdP2S8bh4/edit). 
Describe the main idea conceptually by you to address the problem.
Mention your Unique Selling Proposition- how your idea/concept/solution is really effective in solving the problems.

name: HackOwasp 4.0
tagline: Turning music into motivation and caffeine into codes.
desc:
**HackOWASP** is an annual national hackathon organized by the members of the **OWASP Student Chapter**, Thapar Institute of Engineering and Technology, Patiala. We are OFFICIALLY, MEMBER EVENT of MLH(Major League Hacking)(Season 2022).
It is the perfect platform for engineering students to revamp their problem-solving and risk-taking skills in a competitive environment. Continuing the legacy forward, the** fourth edition** of the event, **HackOWASP 4.0** gives a chance to all the ingenious developers to subsume creativity with ambition and give rise to innovation in the burgeoning world of technology. The event is a 36-hour long hackathon, scheduled from March 4th, 2022, to March 6th, 2022. The challenge is organized pan India and experiences the participation of zealous engineering students from all over the country.
HackOWASP 4.0 stands at a national level on the global scale and strives to motivate students to go beyond the possible. The students will be participating in teams of 2-4 members to solve real-life problem statements and develop solutions and their prototypes. The hackathon is meant for the participants to upgrade their skill set, get introduced to newer software, and estimate their competitiveness in the job market.

prizes.desc:
*MLH Track Prize*

GitHub is one of the best ways to collaborate, push code, get feedback, and show the world what you’ve built during a hackathon. To take it a step further, GitHub is now offering you access to industry tools, events & learning resources through something called GitHub Global Campus. Win this weekend’s Best Use of GitHub prize category, first by signing up for GitHub Global Campus and second by using a GitHub repository to host your hackathon project’s code! Make sure your use of GitHub stands out with a detailed ReadMe page, meaningful pull requests and collaboration history, and even a GitHub pages deployment!

**GitHub Octocat Statue, Plushy & Sticker bundle**

prizes.name: Deso
prizes.desc:
*MLH Track Prize*

DeSo is the official Web3 sponsor of the MLH Hackathon League and the first Layer 1 blockchain custom-built for decentralized social media applications. While blockchains like Avalanche or Solana cost $0.50+ to store just a 200-character post, the DeSo blockchain is built with custom indexing and storage optimizations which make it 10,000X cheaper to store social content on-chain! In order to qualify for the contest, you must launch an app that writes to the DeSo blockchain and/or implements DeSo identity. While social media apps are a great fit for DeSo, you can also build financial apps, marketplaces, and more on the DeSo blockchain. For inspiration on project ideas, you can check out some of the existing 200+ apps already live on DeSo at Bithunt.com as well as our DeSo APIs.

**Prizes up for grab:
The Best Use of DeSo gets $100 worth of $DESO coin & an exclusive DeSo branded tumbler! **

Or maybe your application needs to verify users based on their mobile numbers? Twilio makes all this possible and more. Build a hack that simplifies your life using any one of Twilio’s APIs for a chance to win a Twilio Swag Box and GameGo Console for you and each of your teammates!

tagline: Empowering Young Girls To Explore The Possibilities In CODE!
desc:
Dates: 11th March '22 - 13th March '22

Hacking for a more inclusive tomorrow!

**SheHacks** is IIITA's premier **women-only tech event**, dedicated to female coding enthusiasts and budding women developers. Organised by women, for women, it aims to inculcate the spirit of learning and promote gender equality among its stakeholders.

Since its inception, SheHacks has grown into a large-scale tech extravaganza- with an overwhelming response from women from all over the country in the field of design and development. Inspired and motivated by the fascinating projects received from participants in the last few years, we are thrilled to present the latest edition of the event- **SheHacks 5.0**, all set to be even bigger and better than all its previous iterations.

Over the course of three days, we at IIITA, will be hosting **tech talks, informative speaker sessions and useful workshops **conducted by leading experts and technocrats for all enthusiasts to upskill, innovate and finally implement their projects in a thrilling, edge-of-your-seat 36 hour hackathon. 

The SheHacks hackathon, which is the focal point of SheHacks, is a fantastic opportunity for all aspiring developers to get a hands-on experience in building tech solutions to real life problems. Hackathons are extremely constructive experiences, where participants not only learn to ideate, but also how to quickly adapt to new tech stacks, efficiently collaborate with team members, manage time and streamline solutions to be as impactful and effective as possible. 

The contributions of women are instrumental to a digitally empowered India. We welcome all female students and invite them to benefit from this, be it by participating and engineering solutions to problems or simply connecting with like minded people and learning from the mentors. So join us and let's get hacking!

name: MAKE4THON
tagline: You code your own destiny now.
desc: The archetypal Hackathon of Thapar Institute of Engineering and Technology is one of the unparalleled events organized by the Microsoft Learn Student Chapter. The most awaited Hackathon of the year, our flagship event MAKEATHON 4.0, has indeed proved to be the groundbreaking Hackathon amongst all of North India from the past three years. This 24-hour event will put forth a forum for technology fanatics to showcase their skills and give them a chance to learn with people sharing the same taste. It will be a theme-based event consisting of pre-event workshops. The purpose of MAKEATHON 4.0 is to bring forth astute and dynamic students from various colleges for an enchanting technical journey to fabricate a working prototype of a technologically innovative and sustainable project that will focus on solving several grievous issues about our society. The participants will challenge their technical boundaries and create a vision of India as an eminent world leader in wealth, health, and technology through their contributions. It will witness mind-bending tracks, including GraphQL, App development, AI/Machine learning, Robotics, Blockchain, Cryptography, Algorithms, AR/VR, and open hack.

While blockchains like Avalanche or Solana cost $0.50+ to store just a 200-character post, the DeSo blockchain is built with custom indexing and storage optimizations which make it 10,000X cheaper to store social content on-chain! In order to qualify for the contest, you must launch an app that writes to the DeSo blockchain and/or implements DeSo identity. While social media apps are a great fit for DeSo, you can also build financial apps, marketplaces, and more on the DeSo blockchain. For inspiration on project ideas, you can check out some of the existing 200+ apps already live on DeSo at Bithunt.com as well as our DeSo APIs. name: METAVERSE
desc:
Do you have an idea that you wish to share with the world?
IEEE Student Branch JIIT presents to you METAVERSE, a hackathon for all the budding developers and innovators intending to motivate and shed importance on the skill of development through innovative thinking. Imagine building something that takes you into the realm of metamorphosis, which in addition comes out as a revolution for its users. 

All we're looking for is an idea that is unique, feasible, and solves its purpose. The more an idea is developed, the more concise becomes its expression and when you get to develop it among a community, you get to foster the importance of teamwork. This event can be a tool to drive sustained innovation that can address relevant real-life business problems and social issues.

So dig into the unimaginable scope of your ideas where the physical realities merge with the digital universe.

Prove that your product is actually worthy, that it delivers a real value to your clients, and then monitization can fairly enter your game.

Pitch your product confidently, figure out how can it survive in the market, and hence think how to grow revenue from it sustainably and scalably.

name: Fintech Open Month Hackathon
desc:
The Fintech Open Month being organized by NITI Aayog in collaboration with PhonePe aims to celebrate the sea change fintech has brought to the space of digital payments, investments and lending in India. 

**Purpose of the Hackathon:**

This hackathon conducted by PhonePe in collaboration with Setu HQ will focus on using PhonePe Pulse data (a first of its kind Open-Data initiative by PhonePe that provides open and free access to aggregate and anonymized payment data at scale), and any other open-data APIs along with frameworks such as the Account Aggregator as a foundation to power the following:

- Alternate risk models for Lending, Insurance or Investments with a focus on Financial Inclusion
- Innovative Products that use the power data signals for various demographics and Geographies for broader adoption of financial services
- Improved Visualisation and Derived intelligence based on the Digital payments data

The final app that participants come up with has to incorporate one of the above.

**Platforms to use:**

Participants can use the following sources of Open Data (this is not a comprehensive list and you are open to accessing other open data platforms you are aware of.)

- **[PhonePe Pulse](https://github.com/PhonePe/pulse)**
- **[Open Government Data Platform](https://sandbox.data.gov.in/)**
- **[RBI Reports on payments](https://dbie.rbi.org.in/DBIE/dbie.rbi?site=home)**

Participants are to use one of the following Sandbox platforms for their hacks.

- **[Setu AA Sandbox](https://docs.setu.co/data/account-aggregator/overview)**
- **[Setu Payments Sandbox](https://docs.setu.co/#payments-category)**

**Example Use Cases:**

Here are a few examples of Products and Features that can accelerate the participation of the population in the Financial Services sector:

- Personal Expense Management with Demographic benchmarks
- Alternate data to augment traditional lending signals for better underwriting
- Goal-based investment advisory based on automated risk-reward profiling
- Improved and Faster claims processing by automated filtering of potentially fraudulent claims
- Personalization and Gamification of incentives through intelligent recommendation engines based on payment behavioural data
- Contextual, personalized education on financial products, across multiple languages
- Customized investment products based on personal risk profile and preferences
    - Enabling users to better understand their risk tolerance
- User fee-based wealth & investment management, to remove biases from advisory
- Enabling a purely digital/online experience for a user, across his/her investment lifecycle (onboarding, nomination, investment, redemption, etc)
- Making insurance claims processes transparent, and completely digital

**Ask Me Anything**

If you have questions regarding the theme or use cases of the Hackathon or what the end product should be, then **join in for a special AMA session on Monday, 21st February, at 5:00 PM** as we will have folks from PhonePe and Setu explain it all to you. 

[https://phonepe.zoom.us/j/82114925837?pwd=K0hiMEd0N0c0NVhDTXNJODdka1YxQT09](https://phonepe.zoom.us/j/82114925837?pwd=K0hiMEd0N0c0NVhDTXNJODdka1YxQT09)

name: PES Innovation Lab HashCode 2021
desc:
# Inviting all undergraduate developers to participate in an epic 24-hour technical showdown - HashCode 2021 by PES Innovation Lab, PES University.

We at PES Innovation Lab are proud to present the 10th iteration of HashCode, the flagship Hackathon of PES University. We invite fellow students pursuing B.Tech to the challenge. Spend 24 hours in this epic showdown of innovating, ideating, and inspiring. 

Event Sponsor: Nokia, Devfolio, Polygon, Celo, Filecoin, Tezos

### How to participate:

1. Read the rules about the event below.
2. Register for the event on this page.
3. Access the problem statements provided as part of the first round and choose the one which interests you the most.
4. Come up with a solution to the problem statement that satisfies the minimum requirements and your own considerations and cases. Make sure to follow the template provided for you (linked below).
5. Submit a PDF document of your filled-in template through Devfolio before the Round 1 deadline to complete Round 1.
6. We will inform you a few days before the final round as to whether your solution has been shortlisted.

### General Rules:

- HashCode is a team participation event. Your team size must be of 2-3 members. A team may submit one and only one idea.
- All members of shortlisted teams must be vaccinated with atleast one dose to be eligible to take part in the onsite Hackathon. You're expected to provide proof of vaccination at the event.
- The event is a two-phase hackathon consisting of a idea submission phase and an onsite hackathon phase.
- In Round 1, the teams are supposed to submit their solution to the problem statement according to the themes provided below, in the form of an abstract and implementation summary (Find the submission template below). Entries must be submitted on Devfolio according to the instructions.
- You must upload a document as part of your idea submission (in PDF format) describing your idea and the approach.
- The shortlisted teams will receive a confirmation mail a few days before the onsite finals with further details.
- The onsite hackathon will start on October 30, 2021, at 09:00 AM IST and end on October 31, 2021, at 09:00 AM IST. You are supposed to work on your hack during the allotted time only.
- The final judging of the top hacks by the judges will be on October 31, 2021, from 09:00 AM onwards.
- You are expected to come up with new and innovative ideas, hence any submission that has been plagiarized will be disqualified once brought to our attention. Code and other material will be tested for plagiarism.
- You can use open source libraries and other freely available systems or services.
- All submissions to HashCode remain the intellectual property of the teams that developed them.
- By registering for the hackathon, you agree to the terms and conditions of Devfolio.
- Please note that the event organizers and judges have sole discretion to modify the prize amounts in the event of a special case such as a tie.

### Themes:
1. ### Enhance Virtual Learning
2. ### Blockchain and Content Creation
3. ### Supply Chain And Inventory Management
4. ### Crowd Control With Robotics
5. ### Interior Design Generation
6. ### The Empty Problem
7. ### Docker Python Builds
8. ### Code-Mixed Languages & Hate Speech
9. ### Responsible AI
10. ### Bad Lockdown Habits
    
[Click to view more details about themes](https://docs.google.com/document/d/e/2PACX-1vQnJP0MfiCqavCqgADKB7WInHRjPKHOYoQM08CYOhVnuN5MzNeD33fLVcnS_zd__Ds6pOFG-okrFRiX/pub)

[Click to view submission template](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/13VNLfKjsBpxYn99x7e33jnk51jIQVseo/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=111226410682432454927&rtpof=true&sd=true)

name: Unscript 2k22
desc: Unscript 2k22 is a National Level Virtual Hackathon open to all developers across India. Conducted by one of the top colleges of Mumbai University -Fr. Conceicao Rodrigues College of Engineering is currently in it's fifth edition. Domains like Machine Learning,Deep Learning,BlockChain,Security,Web and App Development are provided for the participants. This year we are also introducing a Hardware track for you all.

prizes.name: Web/app Domain
prizes.desc:
Domain : Web / Mobile Development
Problem Name : Build a hackathon management platform for ensuring smooth communication between organizing teams and participating teams. 
Description : This year’s Unscript Hackathon took its registrations through Devfolio and the whole one-on-one communication with the teams was done through Gmail. All the teams are hosted on our Discord server currently and any form of formal communication with the teams  through the hackathon is done through Google Meet. Any sort of complaints are dealt with through Discord team channels and the final submissions would be reviewed through each team’s Github repository links. Sounds too complicated, right? This looks like a problem waiting to be solved. The goal of this problem statement is to create a one-stop seamless platform to host all activities required to organize a successful hackathon. API integrations can also be made use of. 
For this problem statement, we strongly encourage you to rack your brains and include any creative features that you feel will set your product apart.

prizes.name: Machine learning/AI Domain
prizes.desc:
Domain : Machine Learning / AI
Problem Name : Build Mathematical model using ML and signal processing concept to process the skin issues into dryness and oiliness.
Description : Patients face a lot of problems with their skin. The main issue remains with the type of skin they have. Depending on the type of skin various skin diseases can occur. So if the skin is too dry it may start to peel and lead to various skin diseases like Psoriasis, Eczema etc. likewise too oily skin can lead to pimples which in turn can lead to scars. So the identification of skin type is of utmost need.

prizes.name: Blockchain Domain
prizes.desc:
Domain : Blockchain
Problem Name : Build a user verification system.
Description : If you go to a SIM Card company, Transport Facilities, Banks require you to submit a verified identity to conduct the transaction. Even government facilities require you to submit your identity proof. Most of the time it is the same data uploaded multiple times on multiple servers which may not always be reliable and secure. How do we intend to solve this problem ? Blockchain is the solution. Develop a one-stop portal where users can securely upload and maintain various personal documents. An authority wishing to verify certain documents of a particular user can access them using a unique UID. The verifier should be able to check the authenticity of the document using various parameters.

name: Vividhata: A Blend of Ideas
desc:
> Greetings!!
>Team Tech Nexus, **N.I.T. Hamirpur**, introduces you to **VIVIDHATA**, a 3-day Hackathon, and **IMPRENDITORIA**, an Idea Incubation Program where participants would not only gain hands-on experience on the project, learn from professionals from other disciplines, and enhance their skill sets, but would also be able to put their ideas into viable business plans.

# VIVIDHATA: A Blend of Ideas 
Prepare yourselves for the beginning of the new year, as the competition has begun, and the group of bright young minds has boarded the next plane to their destination. With the release of the problem statements on our platform this midnight, we are thrilled to officially announce the start of the much-anticipated Vividhata: A Blend of Ideas, a fascinating voyage of ideas.
## Problem Statements
>**Problem Statement 1: DISASTER MANAGEMENT** 
Because it is cleaner than firewood and charcoal, liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) is a popular fuel source, particularly in metropolitan areas. Gas leakage is a serious issue in the industrial sector as well as in residential areas. Because of the rising number of gas leaks, home security has become a serious concern. Gas leakage is a major concern with ateliers, residential areas, and vehicles such as compressed natural gas (CNG), buses, and automobiles that run on gas power. What may be done to avoid such repercussions? Can you build something that can help identify and save lives in the instance that this circumstance arises?
**Problem Statement 2: ENVIRONMENT**
Wastewater treatment systems treat water so that it may be safely recycled back into the environment. However, this does not negate the fact that wastewater treatment plants confront their own set of challenges. One of the most pressing concerns facing wastewater treatment plants is energy use. Every year, the process of purifying wastewater consumes between 3% and 15% of the nation's electrical power. That's a lot of processing power going towards filtering. Wastewater treatment is used to filter water in order to make it more environmentally friendly. When wastewater treatment plants treat water, they leave an environmental impact as well. After all, the organic debris that has been removed from the water must be disposed of. Can you suggest a better approach to handling wastewater? Make an effort to solve this issue.
**Problem Statement 3: BLOCKCHAIN**
A tree contains a root node from which all other branches sprout; these branches have nodes that serve as root nodes for other nodes. If we keenly observe, we will discover that there is always some sort of connection between the nodes. Likewise, In a world of 7.9 billion people, there should be a relationship between each one of them. Attempt to discover a connection amongst people. Travelling to the root node and then figuring out how to get there could be a solution, or traveling to the neighbor node and then trying to figure out how to get there could be a possible solution as well. Whatever your approach, remember that it should be optimal.
**Problem Statement 4: AGRICULTURE**
According to the Union government, locust outbreaks in the country have damaged at least 200,000 hectares (ha) of crops across 10 states in the previous two years. The locust invasions that devastated the nation between 2019 and 2021 were the most severe since 1993. Last year, the ministry bought 60 sprayers from the United Kingdom and authorized the use of drones to combat a locust swarm that affected around 50,000 acres spanning the states of Rajasthan, Punjab, Gujarat, and Madhya Pradesh. What remedy will you offer for this issue? Can you devise a method to prevent such damage in the future?
**Problem Statement 5: HEALTH CARE**
We see massive network towers wherever we go. Have we pondered how it affects us? Several studies conducted in many countries—including Germany, Austria, Brazil, Israel, and others—have found an increase in cancer incidence in the 5 to 10 years following exposure to radiation levels of more than 1 mW/m2. People who live near cell phone towers have experienced sleep disruptions, headaches, memory loss, lack of focus, exhaustion, joint pains, visual distortion, miscarriage.

# IMPRENDITORIA: Innovation on Point
Prepare yourselves for the beginning of the new year, as the competition has begun, and the group of bright young minds has boarded the next plane to their destination. With the release of the problem statements on our platform this midnight, we are thrilled to officially announce the start of the much-anticipated  IMPRENDITORIA: Innovation on Point, a fascinating tour of ideas.
## Problem Statements
>**Problem Statement 1: Renewable & Clean Energy** 
**Problem Statement 2: Recycling & Reduced Waste**
**Problem Statement 3: Carbon Capture & Storage**

name: Plenty Global Hackathon
tagline: Where Defi meets the green-tech ecosystem!
desc:
## Objective

Adding value to the platform by

- Adding more projects/functionalities to the plenty ecosystem
- Hiring expert blockchain developers to the plenty-defi team

## Theme

**Sustainable Decentralized Finance**

The theme for the Plenty Global Hackathon 1.0 is Sustainable DeFi.

Tezos is a Proof-of-Stake blockchain that consumes over two million times less energy than Proof of Work networks like Bitcoin or Ethereum. The low carbon footprint of Tezos means developers and users can prioritize innovation without compromising sustainability.

The hackathon aims to bring together brilliance from all around the world to ideate and build more solutions on top of the existing Plenty protocol. **Use the existing Plenty smart contracts and scripts to increase the sustainability of the Plenty protocol.**

### Plenty Global Hackathon invites builders to expand Defi use cases on Tezos

- Plenty Global Hackathon is one of the largest Tezos hackathon with over $30,000 USD in prizes and $50,000 USD in potential grants
- Co-organized by [Plenty defi](https://plentydefi.com/) & [Tezos India](https://tezosindia.org.in/) Plenty Hackathon challenges participants to ideate & build solutions/hacks on top of the existing Plenty DeFi ecosystem 

**What is Plenty Global Hackathon?**

This global hackathon invites developers from all walks of life to come and participate in a two month-long event. Challenge yourself and help expand the Plenty protocol with your own idea, or based on a wide variety of use cases: a Plenty IDO Launchpad, Widgets, a Plenty Developer SDK, Bots, NFTs, Farm Auctions, UI/UX enhancements for plenty & Ctez, Flat AMM curve implementation. **Check out this [Notion](https://plenty-defi.notion.site/Problem-Statements-0598a4ceb17145359cf42376ccf330a6) for the detailed explanation of these use cases.**

The Hackathon is divided into two phases - the **ideation phase** and **implementation phase**. During the ideation phase, participants can create a proposal for an idea according to the theme. We plan to reward three best ideas submitted during the ideation phase.

Idea owners can then collaborate with interested developers/designers , re-organize their teams and implement the same during the implementation phase.

**REWARDS:**

Through the Hackathon we want to embed an innovation-driven culture by solving real-world challenges. Showcase your skills at our hackathon and win amazing prizes.

**$30k+ in prizes that will be distributed in the following pools:**

### ⭐️ Defined Use Cases: $24000 (In Plenty)

### ⭐️ Open DeFi Track: $5,500 (In Plenty)

### ⭐️ Community Choice Reward: $1,000 (In Plenty)



- The top 5 shortlisted projects have the opportunity to receive a follow-on grant of up to $10,000 each.
- Best 3 ideas submitted during the ideation phase will receive an additional $250 prize each.
    - NFT Certificate / NFT (Plenty logo) to all the
Registration for the Plenty Global Hackathon will close on 3rd December 2021.

**About Plenty defi:**

[Plenty](https://plentydefi.com/) is expanding DeFi use cases on Tezos towards a full-scale decentralized financial ecosystem. Empowering traders, liquidity providers & developers to participate in an open financial marketplace.

The Plenty Automated Market Maker (AMM) is designed for exchanging both FA1.2 and FA2 tokens on the Tezos blockchain. The smart contracts allow users to trade trustlessly, peer-to-peer, with liquidity that is supplied by other users. The architecture is based on Uniswap V2.

tagline: AI/ML Hackathon organized by DSC and the Cynaptics Club, IIT Indore
desc:
Note - Problem Statements will be shared on our Discord Channel.

For the first time ever, IIT Indore presents Énosium, a hackathon organized by the IIT Indore chapter of the Google Developers Students Club and IIT Indore's premier AI/ML body, the Cynaptics Club.

In today’s competitive world, ML is fast emerging as a very useful and in-demand skill. Its applications are too many to count, and yet new ones are found every day. The smart systems of the present and the future are based upon this powerful tool. 

On the other hand, Web Development is a well-established skill that still holds immense potential. A website is usually the first thing that a user usually sees before using a digital product. How well you can design your website plays a huge role on how successful your product might be.

Keeping in mind the importance of both these domains, we decided to come up with a platform for enthusiasts to learn and showcase their conjunction.

**Learn from others**
Not only do you get to learn while making your own project, but you can also check out other projects once the hackathon is over to see what others did differently.

**Build your network**
You’ll get exposure to some of the best minds in the country, not just among the participants, but also the judges. You can make friends and forge professional relationships with people from all across the country.

**Satisfy the coder within**
That feeling of pleasure you get when you fix a bug after searching for hours and your program finally works? Almost every coder knows that feeling. Come hunt for it here.

Important: Problem statements for the main tracks will be released on 15th of December on the Discord Server. Join via the link given on our page.

name: HACK-A-SOL 2.0
desc:
## How to Participate? 

Fill this **[GOOGLE FORM](https://forms.gle/MdakgoL5UpJmJZqT6)** to participate in the **IDEA PHASE**. Try to follow the provided **[TEMPLATE](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1XS9gNcCBxMCPXL4Z6k8zOz7FSvRBKFHWCq-eGr8CE7Y/edit?usp=sharing)** for the presentation file.

**Note :  Participants whose ideas will be shortlisted in the IDEA PHASE will be eligible to participate in the HACKING PHASE.**

**Final Date for Idea Submission is 12 Dec 2021.**

# About HACK-A-SOL 2.0

_"The Best Way To Predict The Future Is To Create It"_

TSoC and Tech4Gud in collaboration with SAC, IIIT Naya Raipur bring to you the second chapter of its largest pan-India hackathon to date. It is a 7-day virtual event for fostering innovation and problem solving skills. Students from all over the country will put their coding skills to the test while trying to build innovative solutions to the given problem statements. The winners will be provided with cash prizes from a pool of **Rs. 75,000+**. The event will be concluded with talks from some of the best minds of country.

**HACK-A-SOL 2.0** brings to you **[TRACKS](https://docs.google.com/document/d/1n0tgBJ_n9485Cdhimyliv8Pi0txcJOoFeLRdltPILSA/edit?usp=sharing)** related to AI/ML, Blockchain, WebDev, IoT, etc.


## Timeline

- **15 Nov 2021**: Tracks Release Date 
- **15 Nov 2021 to 11 Dec 2021:** Registration Starts and Idea Submission
- **12 Dec 2021 to 15 Dec 2021:** Shortlisting of teams
- **15 Dec 2021:** Hackathon commences
- **15 Dec 2021 to 21 Dec 2021:** Hacking/Coding Phase
- **22 Dec 2021:** Speaker Sessions and Announcement of Results

_So what are you waiting for? Gather your teammates and arm your weapons!_

Join our [discord server](https://discord.gg/RV4jQzmXbt) for regular updates!
