India saw a nation-wide lockdown in March following the
covid pandemic. The pandemic has left a massive impact on students and many of them don't have access to proper education at this time.
Colleges, schools, tuition and coaching centers are facing a
lot of issues they were not prepared for, such as conduction
of classes, evaluations etc.
These problems are not just affecting the academics but
now they are a problem for the young minds. Many students

name: HAC - Hack Against Covid
desc:
HAC (Hack Against Covid) is a virtual hackathon that challenges students to build proactive technology and solutions to safeguard human interaction in the up and coming post covid19 world.

###  Join HAC's discord at http://discord.codezoned.com

“The uncreative mind can spot wrong answers, but it takes a very creative mind to spot wrong questions.” ― Anthony Jay.

We at Codezoned strongly believe in this and want HAC to be a testament of the same. We are looking for creative and innovative minds that dare to ask the right questions. With lockdowns and safety measures in place, people have been left with nothing but the desire to go out and socialize. As innovators and minds of tomorrow, we want YOU to come up with technology that will help facilitate human interactions in newer ways. Come join us from the comfort of your homes to create a stronger community in these uncertain and trying times.
HAC is an innovative platform open for students, professionals, and anybody who is passionate about coding. As a supportive community, we invite people from various backgrounds including designing, marketing, analysis, and entrepreneurship join forces together to visualize a product. We assure that the HAC environment will encourage you to meet and collaborate with other participants. 
Keeping your safety and comfort in mind, HAC will be conducted virtually to freely facilitate innovation. We will be using discord to communicate throughout the hackathon, and you can find yourself teams using our discord servers.

#  Tracks

We'll be suggesting the below four themes to help spark your ideas. Remember that you're welcome to build with the technologies of your choice, across any areas that you think would drive impact for these issues, so feel free to think outside the box too!

**Health**

Address a spectrum of health initiatives, including preventative/hygiene behaviors, supporting frontline health workers, treatment and diagnosis development and more!

**Businesses**

Help businesses stay afloat, build new ways managing supply chains, and move parts of their business online.

**Education**

Alternative learning environments and tools for students, teachers, and entire school systems.

**Other**

The above themes are just suggestions. Feel empowered to get creative!

name: Account Aggregator Hackathon
tagline: Build the future of fintech for Bharat
desc:
**India's First Account Aggregator Hackathon**

In 2016, **NPCI** launched the **UPI** payments network which took off like a rocket ship; in May 2020, UPI was used by almost **100 million** people, with a total transaction volume of ~**1.25 billion** (greater than American Express globally).

It is now time for the launch of the Account Aggregator (AA) framework. From this month onwards, some of the nation's biggest and most esteemed banks will go live on the AA network. 

There is no better time for developers, startups, and engaged citizens to learn more about the potential of this system and to start building on top of it.

For this reason, India's first Account Aggregator Hackathon is being announced - a **4-week** virtual event hosted in partnership with Devfolio.

A link to the official announcement can be found [here](https://sahamati.org.in/blog/first-account-aggregator-hackathon/). 

## Hackathon Themes

- **Consent Management UI/UX**: This theme deals with designing informed consent journeys for users of Account Aggregators. How can the consent flow for users be made more accessible, understandable, and secure? Can you design consent flows for low-literacy users? Feature phone users? What does a consent authorization chain look like for SMEs and enterprises? Is there a certain design language or iconography that can make the consent experience better for users?

- **Security and Middleware**: Once a customer's data has been shared with an FIU, how can the customer gain confidence that the data will be deleted after the consent period expires? How can it be made easier for banks and other FIUs to adopt the AA framework? Can we develop secure environments for lenders to extract insights from user data without revealing the data itself? How can consent fraud be minimized? How can interoperability and user onboarding be enhanced?

- **FIU Use Cases**: What useful applications can be built with a user's financial data? Personal finance managers? Expense trackers? Robo-advisors? How about tools for underwriting? Or data enrichment?

- **AI/ML**: Thanks to the AA framework, app developers will have a much easier time getting access to high-fidelity customer financial data (with consent, of course). How can you use this data to give value to the customer? 
Personalized expense managers and savings recommendations engines? Individualized consumer spending models? Underwriting models? What insights would you generate if you could convince users to share their spending and investment data with you?


## Hackathon Format

- Hackers will form teams and begin brainstorming 

- Hackers will apply to the AA Hackathon on the Devfolio website

- Selected teams will begin hacking

- There will be an online inauguration event to kick things off, with public demos and learning sessions by Account Aggregators 

- Teams will have 4 weeks to work on their idea

- During the course of these 4 weeks, there will be periodic online masterclasses and mentorship sessions

- At the end of the 4 weeks, teams will present their ideas to a panel of judges

- To close the event, there will be a closing ceremony in which the winning teams make a public presentation of their projects
location: Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

name: HackJaipur
desc:
HackJaipur is a community-focused virtual Hackathon, designed especially for the needs of the communities, with problem statements centered around the community itself. Whether you are a beginner or an expert, here is the perfect chance to hone and show your skills and witness the competitive yet inclusive developer community around you!  

In light of the COVID-19 outbreak, your safety and well-being are our primary concerns. Hence, all the activities related to HackJaipur like workshops, talks, and presentations will also be conducted online/virtually. 

### Why Hack *Jaipur*?
_Jaipur has been always the mother of traditional communities even before the civilizations started_.

HackJaipur follows the same culture and seeks for different solutions to various issues the tradition face from time to time. HackJaipur represents the cultural integrity and bond of our tradition. 

We didn't start HackJaipur to simply conduct a Hackathon but to make people aware of our community's issues and solutions that exist currently.

### Why is HackJaipur for you or why should you participate in it?

* HackJaipur is an Online Hackathon, which means it provides you the opportunity to participate directly from your Home, no fuss of going here and there.

* Ample Goodies and Swags for every participant.

* Prizes worth 60,000 INR.

* You will learn how to work remotely and handle multiple things. Perhaps, a golden opportunity to connect with like-minded participants.

### Tracks
For HackJaipur, your project need not be focused on solely one track, it could be an amalgamation of several tracks. These tracks have been chosen on the basis of the problems we all are facing in community building, and how technology can be utilized in such cases.

1. **Diversity**: Diversity means the inclusion of all individuals as technology does not discriminate. How can technology help to increase diversity and maintain it?
2. **Remotely Working**: As work from home is becoming is a widespread culture, technology can make the process easier. Any project that makes such an effort will fall into this category.
3. **Tech and Health**: Technology can create sustainable and effective relations between a healthcare professional and the patient. It can also provide a cheaper, faster, and more beneficial solutions to prevent and battle illnesses.
4. **Creating Awareness**: With the increase in the use of technology, the dangers have also increased. Awareness is the first step towards creating a better society and community. Awareness can be social, technical, or general.

### Schedule

- Talks and Workshops will be held from 14th June to 19th June 2020.
- Teams can register till the 19th of June 2020.
- Hackathon will be from 20th June to 21st June.
- The Results will be announced on the 25th of June.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

- You can form teams of 2 to 4 people. Most teams aim to have a mix of people with both design and developer skills. Remember we won't accept project submissions from individual applicants.

- We have an active [Telegram Group](https://telegram.hackjaipur.com) for communication where you can ask for help.

For the complete schedule, visit https://schedule.hackjaipur.com

name: Restart India
tagline: Inviting India's emerging talent to make a social impact and be the future leaders.
desc:
RestartIndia Online Hackathon 2020 is an initiative for building solutions around problems that arose due to the ongoing COVID- 19 pandemic.

RestartIndia Hackathon invites techies from India’s student and professionals community to adopt the Think→Ideate→Code→Build→Deploy framework on their solutions to fight the problems running rampant.

Given the massive disruption caused by pandemic on the Indian economy and the people, there is a strong need to orchestrate an organised move to fight and prevent the Indian economy from capsizing. And as it is, we’ve seen unemployment figures in India rise by 20% and nearly 140 million people across various sectors losing employment during the lockdown within a month. We believe it's more important than ever to think about the future and make a positive difference for all us Indians. 

India will never return to the way that it was; together, we can bring about change and invent a bright new future.

Themes 
We have identified some major themes on which a team can identify the problems plaguing the country. However, if a team feels that there is some other theme that is equally worthy of a solution, they can register that idea.

1. Travel : Imagine Efficient and Safe Personal Business travel post COVID19.
2. Education : How will you make sure the learning journey continues?
3. Entertainment : Help the Entertainment Industry survive COVID19 crisis
4. Health : Re-imagine affordable & accessible healthcare for all.
5. Community : Solutions around bringing society back on toes again.
6. Employment : Revive the Jobs, Businesses and Companies post crisis.
7. Food & Restaurant : Revive the hunger saviours post the COVID crisis..
8. Other: If your innovation is beyond these categories bur still related to Covid

** Judging Criteria **

Each entry will be judged by a panel of experts based on the below criteria

- Relevant : How relevant is your idea to the goal of Restarting India which is to revive our country back from the impact of COVID19

- Practical : The solution should be feasible and likely to succeed in real work circumstances

- Impact : The proposed solution should have the capability to provide immense value to a business, community or any other stakeholder.

- Innovative : How original and creative your solution is. 

** Hackathon Timelines  **
- Hack start time : Friday 12 June 5:00 PM
- Submission Closes :  Sunday 14 June 1:00 PM
- Top 10 Teams Announced : Sunday 14 June 5:00 PM
- Top 10 Teams to present in front of Judges:  Sunday 14 June 7:00-8:00 PM
- Hackathon Results Announced : Sunday 14 June 8:30 PM 

The final where Top 10 teams will be presenting will be broadcasted live at  ** https://restartindia.org/live **

prizes.name: Matic Network
prizes.desc:
### 1. DeFi Testnet on Matic Theme (Rewards Upto $500 for each protocol)

**Objective**: 
- To enable a set of decentralized protocols on the Matic Network to make it easy for decentralized app (DApp) developers to reuse this functionality in their DApps just like on Ethereum, rather than reinventing the wheel.
- Enable automatic liquidity maintenance on Matic Network

**Expectation**:
- Deploy ONE or more of either Kyber, Compound or Uniswap on Matic Network (Upto $500 bounty for each protocol)
- Create a few dummy tokens with legit names eg., mEth, m0x, mDai.
- Create a utility which runs in the backend and maintains both sides of the orders continuously. For example mDAI-mETH pair should always have orders to consume on both buy and sell side
- You can use Biconomy for doing internal meta transactions by the utility
- User facing components must be easy to get started with. (front-end)

### 2. DEX on Plasma (Rewards Upto $1000)

**Expectation:**
A proof of concept of a decentralised exchange on Matic Network with plasma backed asset swaps. Demonstrate deposit of two tokens from main chain to matic chain and an atomic swap between the two.

- From user’s perspective, she should be able to deposit her token onto Matic, sign an order
- A page that displays all the signed orders
- An order matching logic that matches the orders and executes an atomic asset swap between the two tokens

**Relevant links:**

- Codebase for child contracts deployed on Matic - ChildERC20 and ChildERC721
- Note: Matic’s Plasma-backed asset swaps makes use of a signed transfer method (ref. transferWithSig method in the above two contracts, and the Marketplace.sol smart contract)
- You need to use Matic Plasma Swap contract instead of normal order execution 

Tokens that can be used - TEST-ERC20 and TEST-ERC721

### 3. NFT Marketplace for Decentraland (Rewards Upto $1000)

**Expectation:**
Create a marketplace where people can exchange in-game items deployed on Matic sidechains

1. Note: Use Matic TEST ERC721 token for this bounty, represented as “LAND” tokens

2. Flow:
- User accesses an NFT marketplace on Matic chain - represented as LAND marketplace for Dentraland’s LAND token
- Swaps their NFT with available NFTs
- Buy new NFTs with MANA (ERC20) tokens
3. Codebase for ChildERC721 contract (for mapped tokens on Matic)
4. Additional reward for a creative use case to deposit asset (NFT) bought on this market place as a collateral for loan

**Note:**
- Matic’s Plasma-backed asset swaps makes use of a signed transfer method (ref. transferWithSig method in the above contract, and the Marketplace.sol smart contract)
- Facilitate high-volume swaps of plasma backed assets

### 4. Open Track - Defi Ninjas (Rewards Upto $500)

**Expectation:**
Use famous DEFI projects like Sablier etc to build a use case and deploy it on Matic 

**Examples:** 
- A proof of concept for tipping content producers on social media platforms.
- Personal Time tokens. 
- Subscription Services

### Additional Awards:

**Meta transactions - additional $50 will be awarded**
- GSN
- Biconomy (Eg. [Link](https://devfolio.co/submissions/pouch-wallet)) 

**Each wallet Integration - additional $50 will be awarded**
- FortMatic
- Arkane
- Torus
- Portis


Find more details about the bounties [here](https://blog.matic.network/matic-network-provides-4k-of-bounties-for-money-legos-hackathon/).

desc:
Welcome back #BUIDLers! Applications for ETHDenver 2020 are officially live here on Devfolio for developers, creatives, volunteers, speakers and all other breed of Bufficorns. We also have exciting news to share about ETHDenver’s evolution and some fun experiences planned for 2020, in our [Medium Post here](https://medium.com/@ETHDenver/806411267606). 

For newcomers, we’re excited to welcome you to ETHDenver, the largest Web3 #BUIDLathon in the world (formerly known as a hackathon). Ethereum and other blockchain protocol enthusiasts, designers and developers converge on the mile high city to #BUIDL the decentralized future. ETHDenver is free to attend; however, must apply, and be accepted,  in advance. 

Our 3-day weekend-long event is a nonstop, 24 hours a day, innovation marathon and is alive with a wide variety of activities. From talks and workshops by top blockchain influencers/experts to tech-art exhibitions, we have a futuristic experience for everyone. 

The purpose of ETHDenver 2020 is to contribute to the global blockchain ecosystem, whether by #BUIDLing decentralized applications (dApps), contributing to infrastructure development projects, writing documentation/tutorials/white-papers, designing UI/UX, or info-graphics. So bring your inner awesomeness and some friends. We’ll provide mentors, resources, and provisions. Check out the schedule, FAQ’s and more info to help plan your trip at [https://www.ethdenver.com](https://www.ethdenver.com).

## ETHDenver 2020 Application

The ETHDenver crew is continually working to integrate community tools and “dog food” decentralized tech.  This year we’re launching our attendance application through our friends at [Devfolio](https://devfolio.co/), in partnership with [Fortmatic](https://fortmatic.com/). Your Fortmatic identity will serve as your ticket and engagement point throughout the event. Stay tuned for more on how this will work throughout the ecosytems. 

Please note that Devfolio was originally designed for #BUIDLathon/hackathon events. While a few lines of the canned verbiage focuses on developers, note that we are excited to welcome diverse intelligences and all varieties of Bufficorns regardless of technological expertise.

On the first page of the application, we will ask how you wish to participate in the event. Please indicate any and all appropriate selections, even if you don’t intend to #BUIDL a project. If you need help along the way, don’t be shy! You can find us on [Telegram](https://t.me/Ethdenver), [Twitter](https://twitter.com/ethereumdenver) or [hello@ethdenver.com](mailto:hello@ethdenver.com). We look forward to hearing your feedback on the new application experience!

### How to Apply:

1. Click the blue “Apply with Devfolio” button above and the system will assist you in creating a Fortmatic blockchain ID.
2. Complete ETHDenver event questions and mandatory waiver ([review waiver here](https://www.ethdenver.com/waiver))
3. Once complete, complete the ‘Profile’ tab on the next page.
4. After your ‘Profile’ shows 100% complete, visit the ‘Hackathons’ tab to formally submit your ETHDenver application as an individual or team (you can change later). Your application is submitted and complete after this step. 
5. **Optional: Stake your application at [https://stake.ethdenver.com/](https://stake.ethdenver.com/) to receive priority review and score rare swag. (See FAQs for more details)**

## Application Review/Acceptance Schedule

Applying early increases your probability of acceptance as space is limited. The ETHDenver team will be hard at work reviewing applications over the next few months to get you a quick response and here’s a peek at deadlines we’ll guarantee a response by: 

- WAVE 1: Apply by November 30th prior to midnight & receive confirmation no later than December 1st by 9PM MT.
- WAVE 2: Apply by December 20th prior to midnight & receive confirmation no later than December 21st by 9PM MT.
- WAVE 3: Apply by January 15th prior to midnight & receive confirmation no later than January 16th by 9PM MT.
- You may apply AFTER January 15th and if space becomes available, we will approve applications based on availability. For best results, you must have your application submitted by no later than January 15th.
- NOTE: If you are not initially accepted, you (or your team) will be automatically allocated to our waitlist and notified as space becomes available. 

## How Does Staking Work? 

Visit [https://stake.ethdenver.com/](https://stake.ethdenver.com/) to stake your application.

**A few reminders:** 
- Staking is 100% optional
- You DO NOT have to stake to be accepted and attend ETHDenver 2020
- ETHDenver is, and always will be, free to attend
- If you choose not to stake, you can consider your application complete after #4 in the “How to Apply” section above. 

**More details on staking in the FAQs below**

## Judges & Speakers

**View Current List:** [https://www.ethdenver.com/#speakers](https://www.ethdenver.com/#speakers)
location: Denver Sports Castle, 1000 Broadway, Denver, CO, USA

## Onsite and Virtual Hackathon

The Game Oasis hackathon is co-hosted by **Binance Labs**, **Celer Network**, **Contentos**, **Matic Network**, **Cocos-BCX**, **Marlin Protocol** and **Republic**. The hackathon consists of three rounds, including the preliminary online hackathon to in-person hackathons in 4 cities: **Shanghai**, **Seoul**, **Bengaluru** and **San Francisco**. 

Game developers, hackers, blockchain enthusiasts, who want to explore blockchain tech specifically in gaming are welcome to participate. The in-person hackathon will last for **36 hours**. 

The topic will be related to **blockchain gaming**. Mentors will be present to provide support on how to integrate blockchain technology with traditional games.

**Virtual participation** is allowed as well. The application process, acceptance invitations by the organizing team, and final project submissions will be similar to the in-person hackathon.

All the **workshops** and **tech talks** at the onsite hackathon will be **livestreamed** [here](https://cos.tv/videos/activity/live/1). 

**Please register [here](https://www.eventbrite.com/e/game-oasis-hackathon-san-francisco-tickets-74535219849) for participating in the onsite hackathon.**

Connect with the Game Oasis SF community on the **official Discord channel** [here](https://discord.gg/rYt8bSu).

name: Hack On Hills
desc: Hack On Hills 4.0 is the fourth edition of student held annual hackathon organized at National Institute of Technology Hamirpur campus. This is a 32-hour hackathon where we aim to provide an opportunity to 200+ students from all over India to come together and to build something cool and innovative. Hack On Hills is all about expanding coding culture and promoting diversity in the community.  Overall the third edition of hackathon received the overwhelming participation from students, so through fourth edition of the hackathon, we will be trying to take it to next level and targeting more number of students and more diverse attendees. For this, we are taking steps like introducing special prizes for all women's team and reserving some percent of seats for women.
location: NIT Hamirpur, Hamirpur, Himachal Pradesh, India

name: HackVSIT 2019
desc: ACE - CSI chapter of VIPS presents the second edition of HackVSIT under the banner of CSI - State Students' Convention 2019. We at VIPS believe in encouraging the growing talent and by HackVSIT we bring together, people with different outlook and solutions for already existing problems using technology and design. For 24 hours, you will work together with your teams to envision and develop the technology of tomorrow for solving the problems of today.
location: Vivekananda Institute of Professional Studies, Outer Ring Road, AU Block, Ranikhet, Pitam Pura, New Delhi, Delhi, India

name: CodeUtsava 3.0
desc: CodeUtsava3.0 is a 28 hour hackathon organised by students of NIT Raipur  with a mission to bring top developers across the country under a roof and make some awesome projects. CodeUtsava3.0 supports new and budding technologies and motivates developers to use them to build innovative products.
location: NIT Raipur, Great Eastern Road, Amanaka, Raipur, Chhattisgarh, India

name: DotSlash
desc: The students of SVNIT with support from Research Park, SVNIT are organising a national level hackathon named, ‘DotSlash: Root to ideas’ in SVNIT campus, Surat, on 2nd and 3rd February 2019. This hackathon will be a 30-hour long event, where we plan to accommodate approximately 100 to 150 students from across the country, and give them a platform to innovate.
location: Sardar Vallabhbhai National Institute of Technology, Keval Chowk, SVNIT Campus, Athwa, Surat, Gujarat, India

name: iHack
desc: iHack is a 30 hour hackathon which takes place at IIT Bombay during E-Summit.  We receive applications from all over the country and the best hackers are invited to IIT Bombay to take part in the hackathon.
location: IIT Bombay, Main Gate Rd, IIT Area, Powai, Mumbai, Maharashtra, India

name: Hackathon v15
desc: If you like building stuff or if you just like learning, Hackathons are one of the coolest and most exciting things you can ever be part of. Hackathons are not just about winning, they are about learning and simply creating things without worrying within 30 hours.  The best part is there are no prerequisites. Mentors will be present to help you code your crazy ideas. We also have snacks to keep you fueled.
location: IIIT-Delhi, Shyam Nagar, Okhla Industrial Area, New Delhi, Delhi, India

name: InOut
desc: InOut prides itself on being India’s biggest community hackathon. Since its inception in 2015, InOut has been a platform where technology leaders and the brightest minds come together to collaborate on building tools that solve real problems.
location: CoWrks, Swamy Vivekananda Road, Sadanandanagar, Bennigana Halli, Bangalore, Karnataka, India
